attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.alert. Business justification: Safety alerts (volcanic ash advisories, airspace closures, manufacturer bulletins) directly trigger IROP events in Operations Control. Linking flight_irop_event to the triggering safety alert supports

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: IROP events have estimated_financial_impact_amount and responsible_department requiring cost centre attribution. Airlines track IROP costs by cost centre (OCC, ground ops, crew) for budget variance an

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: IROP events triggered by safety occurrences (runway incursions, bird strikes, emergency declarations) must be directly correlated for DOT/regulatory reporting and SMS root cause analysis. Operations C

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: IROP management and CDM (Collaborative Decision Making) sessions are route-centric — network recovery planning, regulatory notification, and route performance impact assessment all require knowing whi

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: IROP events caused by technical/AOG issues must reference the triggering work order for root cause analysis and recovery planning. Operations Control Centers require this link to coordinate maintenanc

attributes.name: actual_passengers_affected
attributes.description: Actual total number of passengers impacted by the irregular operations event across all affected flights. Calculated after event resolution.

attributes.name: actual_total_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Actual cumulative delay minutes across all affected flights resulting from this irregular operations event. Calculated after event resolution.

attributes.name: atc_coordination_notes
attributes.description: Notes documenting coordination activities and communications with Air Traffic Control during the irregular operations event.

attributes.name: cdm_session_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Collaborative Decision Making session coordinating the operational response to this irregular operations event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this irregular operations event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total financial impact of the irregular operations event including operational costs, passenger compensation, and revenue loss. Expressed in airline base currency.

attributes.name: estimated_passengers_affected
attributes.description: Estimated total number of passengers impacted by the irregular operations event across all affected flights. Used for customer service resource planning.

attributes.name: estimated_total_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated cumulative delay minutes across all affected flights resulting from this irregular operations event. Used for impact assessment and reporting.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of irregular operations event. Used for operational reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the irregular operations event including circumstances, operational impact, and contributing factors.

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the irregular operations event was resolved and normal operations resumed. Nullable for ongoing events.

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the irregular operations event was first detected or began affecting operations. Critical for timeline analysis and delay attribution.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the irregular operations event. Tracks progression from initial detection through resolution and closure.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause driving the irregular operations event. Determines recovery strategy and operational response.

attributes.name: flights_cancelled_count
attributes.description: Total number of flights cancelled as a direct result of this irregular operations event. Key metric for operational impact assessment.

attributes.name: flights_delayed_count
attributes.description: Total number of flights delayed as a direct result of this irregular operations event. Key metric for operational impact assessment.

attributes.name: flights_diverted_count
attributes.description: Total number of flights diverted to alternate airports as a direct result of this irregular operations event.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this irregular operations event record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notam_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for any associated Notice to Air Missions issued in connection with this irregular operations event.

attributes.name: passenger_compensation_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this irregular operations event triggered passenger compensation obligations under applicable regulations such as EU261 or DOT rules.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 261/2004, US DOT Consumer Protection

attributes.name: recovery_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the operational recovery plan including actions, resource allocation, and timeline for restoring normal operations.

attributes.name: recovery_plan_status
attributes.description: Current state of the operational recovery plan developed to address the irregular operations event and restore normal operations.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this irregular operations event requires notification to regulatory authorities such as FAA, EASA, or national civil aviation authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when regulatory authorities were notified of this irregular operations event. Nullable if notification not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Name of the operational department or division responsible for managing the response to this irregular operations event.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the underlying root cause that triggered the irregular operations event. Used for post-event analysis and prevention planning.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Operational impact severity classification of the irregular operations event. Determines escalation procedures and resource allocation priority.

attributes.name: weather_condition_summary
attributes.description: Summary of weather conditions contributing to or associated with the irregular operations event. Applicable for weather-related IROP events.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 3 - Meteorological Service for International Air Navigation

products.name: cancellation
products.description: Records flight cancellations including cancellation reason code (IATA AHM 730), cancellation decision timestamp, cancellation authority (OCC, station, crew), whether cancellation was proactive or reactive, passenger rebooking status, estimated revenue impact, and whether the cancellation was DOT-reportable. Distinct from delay_record (flight operated late) and diversion (flight landed elsewhere). Supports DOT 14 CFR Part 234 reporting and passenger care compliance.
products.reference: DOT 14 CFR Part 234 / IATA AHM 730

attributes.name: cancellation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the flight cancellation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: absence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.absence. Business justification: Crew absence is a named root cause of flight cancellations (crew_legality_issue flag exists on cancellation). DOT/regulatory reporting and OCC root-cause analysis require direct linkage from a cancell

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Cancellations trigger AP invoices for passenger care costs (hotels, rebooking on other carriers, meal vouchers). The cancellation has passenger_care_cost_amount and compensation_amount_per_passenger.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Cancellations incur direct costs (passenger care, rebooking, compensation) that must be attributed to a cost centre for airline cost management reporting and variance analysis. Aviation finance teams

attributes.name: departure_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Cancellations are managed at the departure station responsible for passenger rebooking, care costs, and DOT/regulatory reporting. Station-level cancellation attribution is required for operational per

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cancelled flight leg in the flight operations system.

attributes.name: irop_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broader irregular operations event that triggered this cancellation, if part of a multi-flight disruption scenario.

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Safety-related cancellations (maintenance defects, crew fatigue, hazardous weather, security threats) require occurrence reporting and SMS tracking. Direct cancellation→occurrence linkage supports reg

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled flight record that was cancelled.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Maintenance-caused cancellations must reference the specific work order (AOG defect) that caused the cancellation. Required for DOT reportable cancellation analysis, reliability statistics, and mainte

attributes.name: advance_notice_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between cancellation decision and scheduled departure time. Critical for determining passenger compensation eligibility under EU261 (14-day, 7-day thresholds).

attributes.name: affected_passenger_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers with confirmed bookings on the cancelled flight who require rebooking or refund.

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: Tail number of the aircraft that was assigned to the cancelled flight at the time of cancellation.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: atc_restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of air traffic control restriction that contributed to the cancellation (SLOT=slot restriction, GDP=ground delay program, GS=ground stop, CLOSURE=airport closure, CAPACITY=capacity reduction, FLOW=flow control).

attributes.name: cancellation_type
attributes.description: Whether the cancellation was proactive (planned in advance to minimize disruption) or reactive (last-minute response to an operational event).

attributes.name: compensation_amount_per_passenger
attributes.description: Standard compensation amount per passenger under applicable regulations (e.g., EUR 250/400/600 under EU261 based on distance and delay).

attributes.name: compensation_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Status of passenger compensation eligibility determination under applicable regulations (EU261, DOT, local regulations).
attributes.references: EU Regulation 261/2004, US DOT 14 CFR Part 259

attributes.name: crew_legality_issue
attributes.description: Type of crew legality or availability issue that caused the cancellation (DUTY_TIME=exceeded duty limits, REST=insufficient rest, QUALIFICATION=crew not qualified, AVAILABILITY=crew unavailable, POSITIONING=crew positioning failure).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 - Operation of Aircraft, FAA 14 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this record.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the decision to cancel the flight was made by the authorized authority.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM - Standard Schedules Information Manual

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cancellation became effective in operational systems and passenger notifications were triggered.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated revenue loss from the cancelled flight including ticket revenue, ancillary revenue, and potential future booking impact.

attributes.name: first_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the first passenger notification was sent regarding the cancellation.

attributes.name: is_controllable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was within the airline's control (maintenance, crew, operational decisions) versus uncontrollable (weather, ATC, security, force majeure). Used for passenger compensation eligibility under EU261 and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 261/2004, US DOT 14 CFR Part 259

attributes.name: is_dot_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cancellation must be reported to the US Department of Transportation under 14 CFR Part 234 (applies to US domestic flights and international flights to/from US by US carriers).
attributes.references: US DOT 14 CFR Part 234 - Airline Service Quality Performance Reports

attributes.name: network_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was a strategic network optimization decision (e.g., consolidating low-load flights, repositioning aircraft) rather than an operational failure.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Primary method(s) used to notify affected passengers of the cancellation (e.g., SMS, email, mobile app push, airport announcement, GDS message). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SMS|EMAIL|PUSH|AIRPORT_ANNOUNCEMENT|GDS|PHONE|WEBSITE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: occ_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational remarks and notes from the Operations Control Center regarding the cancellation decision and handling.

attributes.name: passenger_care_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for passenger care obligations including meals, accommodation, transportation, and compensation payments under EU261 or DOT regulations.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 261/2004, US DOT 14 CFR Part 259

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: IATA AHM 730 standard cancellation reason code (e.g., WX for weather, MX for maintenance, CR for crew, OA for operational, etc.).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the cancellation reason for operational and customer service purposes.

attributes.name: rebooked_passenger_count
attributes.description: Number of affected passengers who were successfully rebooked on alternative flights.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cancellation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cancellation record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: refunded_passenger_count
attributes.description: Number of affected passengers who requested and received full refunds instead of rebooking.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory report (DOT, EASA, local CAA) has been submitted for this cancellation.
attributes.references: US DOT 14 CFR Part 234, EASA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the regulatory report for this cancellation was submitted to the governing authority.
attributes.references: US DOT 14 CFR Part 234, EASA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: substitute_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled departure time of the substitute flight, if one was operated to replace the cancelled service.

attributes.name: substitute_flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number of the substitute or replacement flight operated to cover the cancelled service, if applicable.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM - Standard Schedules Information Manual

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: METAR/TAF weather phenomenon code if weather was a contributing factor to the cancellation (e.g., TS for thunderstorm, FG for fog, SN for snow).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 3 - Meteorological Service for International Air Navigation

products.name: weight_balance
products.description: Weight and balance (W&B) loadsheet for each flight leg. Contains zero fuel weight (ZFW), takeoff weight (TOW), landing weight (LW), maximum structural weights, centre of gravity (CG) position at takeoff and landing, trim setting, load distribution by zone, passenger count by cabin class, cargo/baggage weight by hold, and loadmaster/dispatcher sign-off. Mandatory regulatory document for every commercial flight per FAA/EASA airworthiness requirements.
products.reference: IATA AHM 560 / FAA AC 120-27 / EASA CS-25

attributes.name: weight_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the weight and balance loadsheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: departure_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Loadsheets are prepared by the departure station's load control team. Linking weight_balance to the departure station enables station-level load control audit trails, regulatory compliance reporting,

attributes.name: dispatch_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.dispatch_release. Business justification: Weight & balance loadsheet is part of the dispatch release package in aviation operations. The W&B must be coordinated with and approved as part of the dispatch release. This is a standard operational

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight leg for which this weight and balance loadsheet was prepared.

attributes.name: load_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.load_plan. Business justification: The W&B sheet is produced directly from the cargo load plan — loadmasters use the load plan as the source document for W&B calculations. Regulatory compliance and dispatch sign-off require traceabilit

attributes.name: loadmaster_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.member. Business justification: Regulatory load sheet accountability: the loadmaster who prepares and signs the weight & balance sheet is a licensed crew member. Aviation regulators require traceability of load control sign-offs to

attributes.name: aircraft_registration
attributes.description: Tail number or registration code of the aircraft for which this weight and balance was calculated.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_code
attributes.description: ICAO or IATA aircraft type designator (e.g., B738, A320, B77W) identifying the aircraft model.

attributes.name: baggage_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of checked passenger baggage loaded in cargo holds.

attributes.name: captain_acceptance_signature
attributes.description: Digital or physical signature of the pilot in command accepting the weight and balance loadsheet and authorizing departure.

attributes.name: captain_acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pilot in command accepted and signed the weight and balance loadsheet.

attributes.name: cargo_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of revenue cargo (freight and mail) loaded in cargo holds, excluding passenger baggage.

attributes.name: cg_aft_limit_percent_mac
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centre of Gravity (CG) Aft Limit Percent Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC)
attributes.description: Aft limit of the certified CG envelope for this weight and configuration. CG must not be behind this limit.

attributes.name: cg_forward_limit_percent_mac
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centre of Gravity (CG) Forward Limit Percent Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC)
attributes.description: Forward limit of the certified CG envelope for this weight and configuration. CG must not be ahead of this limit.

attributes.name: cg_landing_percent_mac
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centre of Gravity (CG) at Landing Percent Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC)
attributes.description: Estimated longitudinal centre of gravity position at landing expressed as percentage of mean aerodynamic chord. Must remain within certified CG envelope.

attributes.name: cg_takeoff_percent_mac
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centre of Gravity (CG) at Takeoff Percent Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC)
attributes.description: Longitudinal centre of gravity position at takeoff expressed as percentage of mean aerodynamic chord. Must be within certified CG envelope.

attributes.name: dispatcher_license_number
attributes.description: FAA or EASA dispatcher license number of the dispatcher who signed off on the loadsheet.

attributes.name: dispatcher_name
attributes.description: Name of the flight dispatcher who reviewed and signed off on the weight and balance loadsheet.

attributes.name: dry_operating_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight of the aircraft including crew, crew baggage, catering, and all operational equipment but excluding fuel, passengers, cargo, and baggage. Also known as basic operating weight.

attributes.name: finalized_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loadsheet was finalized and signed off, authorizing the flight for departure.

attributes.name: hold_aft_weight_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Aft Cargo Hold Weight in Kilograms
attributes.description: Total weight loaded in the aft cargo hold compartment.

attributes.name: hold_bulk_weight_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bulk Cargo Hold Weight in Kilograms
attributes.description: Total weight loaded in the bulk cargo hold compartment, typically used for loose baggage and small cargo items.

attributes.name: hold_forward_weight_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forward Cargo Hold Weight in Kilograms
attributes.description: Total weight loaded in the forward cargo hold compartment.

attributes.name: landing_weight_kg
attributes.description: Estimated weight of the aircraft at landing. Calculated as takeoff weight minus trip fuel. Must not exceed maximum landing weight.

attributes.name: load_distribution_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the load distribution meets all structural and CG envelope requirements for safe flight.

attributes.name: loadsheet_number
attributes.description: Unique externally-known identifier for the weight and balance loadsheet document, typically assigned by the load control system or dispatcher.

attributes.name: loadsheet_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the weight and balance loadsheet. Final status indicates dispatcher sign-off and regulatory compliance approval.

attributes.name: loadsheet_version
attributes.description: Version number of the loadsheet. Incremented when corrections or updates are made prior to departure.

attributes.name: mail_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of mail cargo loaded in cargo holds.

attributes.name: max_landing_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum permissible landing weight for this aircraft as specified in the aircraft flight manual. Structural limit.

attributes.name: max_takeoff_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum permissible takeoff weight for this aircraft under current conditions (runway length, temperature, altitude, obstacles). May be limited below certified MTOW.

attributes.name: max_zero_fuel_weight_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Zero Fuel Weight (MZFW) in Kilograms
attributes.description: Maximum permissible zero fuel weight for this aircraft as specified in the aircraft flight manual. Structural limit.

attributes.name: passenger_count_business
attributes.description: Number of passengers seated in business class cabin.

attributes.name: passenger_count_economy
attributes.description: Number of passengers seated in economy cabin.

attributes.name: passenger_count_first
attributes.description: Number of passengers seated in first class cabin.

attributes.name: passenger_count_premium_economy
attributes.description: Number of passengers seated in premium economy cabin.

attributes.name: passenger_count_total
attributes.description: Total number of passengers on board across all cabin classes (first, business, premium economy, economy).

attributes.name: passenger_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of all passengers calculated using standard or actual passenger weights per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: prepared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the weight and balance loadsheet was initially prepared by the loadmaster or dispatcher.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this weight and balance record was first created in the database.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this weight and balance record was last modified in the database.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or clarifications related to the weight and balance calculation.

attributes.name: special_load_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the flight carries special loads requiring additional handling or documentation (dangerous goods, live animals, human remains, etc.).

attributes.name: takeoff_fuel_kg
attributes.description: Total usable fuel on board at takeoff, including trip fuel, contingency, alternate, final reserve, and additional fuel.

attributes.name: takeoff_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the aircraft at brake release for takeoff. Calculated as zero fuel weight plus takeoff fuel. Must not exceed maximum takeoff weight.

attributes.name: total_payload_kg
attributes.description: Total revenue payload weight including passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

attributes.name: trim_setting
attributes.description: Calculated horizontal stabilizer trim setting required for takeoff based on CG position and weight. Entered into flight management system or set manually.

attributes.name: trip_fuel_kg
attributes.description: Fuel required to fly from departure to destination airport under expected conditions.

attributes.name: underfloor_cargo_uld_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Underfloor Cargo Unit Load Device (ULD) Count
attributes.description: Number of unit load devices (containers and pallets) loaded in underfloor cargo holds.

attributes.name: zero_fuel_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the aircraft excluding usable fuel. Calculated as dry operating weight plus payload (passengers, baggage, cargo). Critical structural limit.

products.name: status

Contains status code (scheduled, boarding, departed, airborne, landed, arrived, cancelled, diverted, delayed), status timestamp, source system (ACARS, ATC feed, airport FIDS, manual OCC update), estimated departure/arrival times (ETD/ETA), gate information, and public-facing status message. Supports real-time passenger notifications, airport FIDS, and OCC monitoring via NetLine/Ops.

attributes.name: status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the flight status record. Primary key.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight leg this status record describes. Links to the flight_leg product.

attributes.name: aircraft_registration

attributes.name: altitude_feet
attributes.description: Current altitude of the aircraft in feet above mean sea level. Updated from ACARS or ADS-B feeds during flight.

attributes.name: arrival_gate
attributes.description: Current gate assignment for arrival. May be updated during flight based on airport operations and gate availability.

attributes.name: atc_slot_time
attributes.description: Allocated takeoff or landing slot time assigned by ATC. Critical for slot-controlled airports and ATFM (Air Traffic Flow Management) compliance.

attributes.name: boarding_start_time
attributes.description: Actual time when passenger boarding commenced at the departure gate. Used for operational metrics and passenger communication.

attributes.name: boarding_status
attributes.description: Current boarding process status. Indicates the stage of passenger boarding operations at the departure gate.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for flight cancellation if status is cancelled. Used for operational analysis and passenger compensation processing.

attributes.name: delay_minutes

products.name: booking_segment
products.description: This association product represents the operational booking/reservation segment linking a passenger to a specific flight leg. It captures the passenger's journey on a single flight, including seat assignment, boarding details, check-in status, fare information, and service entitlements. Each record represents one passenger's travel on one flight leg. This is the core operational entity referenced by check-in systems, boarding gate systems, departure control, and in-flight service systems. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa PNR segment concept.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, the relationship between flight legs and passenger profiles is a canonical many-to-many: each flight leg carries many passengers (typically 100-400 depending on aircraft), and each passenger travels on many flight legs over their lifetime and even within a single journey (multi-leg itineraries). This relationship is operationally managed as booking segments or PNR segments in reservation systems like Amadeus Altéa, with rich attributes including seat assignments, check-in/boarding timestamps, fare details, and service entitlements that belong to neither the flight nor the passenger alone.

products.name: irop_flight_impact
products.description: This association product represents the operational impact event between a declared irregular operations event and a specific flight leg. It captures the per-flight impact record that OCC dispatchers and recovery planners actively manage during IROP recovery workflows. Each record links one flight_irop_event to one flight_leg and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific event-flight pairing — including the type of impact, recovery action taken, delay minutes attributable to this event, and the flight's position in the recovery sequence. Recognized as a core operational concept in airline OCC systems such as Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops.. Existence Justification: In airline operations, a single IROP event (e.g., a weather ground stop at a hub) simultaneously affects dozens of flight legs, and a single flight leg can be impacted by multiple IROP events (e.g., a crew shortage compounded by an ATC ground stop on the same day). The Operations Control Center actively manages which specific flights are impacted by each declared IROP, tracking per-flight impact type, recovery actions taken, and delay minutes attributed to that specific event — data that belongs neither to the IROP event record nor to the flight leg record alone. This relationship is a recognized operational concept in airline OCC systems (e.g., NetLine/Ops 'irop_flight_impact') that dispatchers and recovery planners create, update, and close as part of the IROP recovery workflow.

products.name: contact_detail

attributes.name: is_verified

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact detail was last used for communication (email sent, SMS delivered, call made). Supports contact data quality and hygiene.

attributes.name: opt_in_date

attributes.name: opt_in_marketing

attributes.name: opt_in_operational

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.description: Free-text field for customer service agents or data stewards to record additional context, exceptions, or special handling instructions related to this loyalty linkage (e.g., VIP handling, disputed tier status, manual override reasons).

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this linkage qualifies for reciprocal benefits under alliance or partnership agreements (e.g., lounge access, priority boarding on partner airlines). True indicates eligibility; False indicates ineligible or restricted.

products.description: Manages passenger data privacy and consent records in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, and other applicable data protection regulations. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, data sharing with partners, profiling, personalisation), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent channel (web, mobile app, call centre, airport kiosk), consent timestamp, consent version (policy version at time of grant), and jurisdiction. Provides the legal basis for data processing activities and supports right-to-erasure and data portability requests. Mandatory for DOT and EASA consumer protection compliance.
products.reference: GDPR Art. 7 / CCPA / IATA Data Privacy Framework

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: A structured log or reference to detailed audit records capturing all consent lifecycle events (granted, modified, withdrawn, expired). Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the passenger provided or updated their consent. Critical for audit trail and consent validity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1), EASA Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent. Indicates whether the passenger has granted, withdrawn, or is pending decision on the consent request. Expired indicates consent has passed its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category of consent granted or withheld by the passenger. Defines the specific data processing activity for which consent is required under GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, or other applicable data protection regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the system. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Distinct from consent_granted_timestamp, which reflects the passenger's action.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the passenger to provide consent. Supports user experience analysis and consent validity verification.

attributes.name: dpo_review_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this consent record has been reviewed or flagged for review by the airline's Data Protection Officer (DPO). Used for high-risk or disputed consent cases.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be re-requested from the passenger. Null for consents with no expiration. Recorded in ISO 8601 date format (yyyy-MM-dd). Required for jurisdictions with time-bound consent validity.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the passenger granted consent. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the passenger submitted their consent. Used for fraud detection, audit trail, and jurisdiction determination. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the legal jurisdiction under which this consent was collected. Determines applicable data protection regulation (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California, PDPA for Singapore, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, GDPR Territorial Scope Article 3

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code in which the consent request was presented to the passenger. Required for demonstrating informed consent in the passenger's preferred language.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing the passenger's personal data. While this product focuses on consent, other legal bases may apply for specific processing activities.

attributes.name: minor_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this consent record pertains to a minor (passenger under the age of consent in the applicable jurisdiction). Triggers additional parental consent and verification requirements under GDPR Article 8 and COPPA.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The identifier of the system user or automated process that last modified this consent record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, exceptions, or special handling instructions related to this consent record. Used by customer service and compliance teams.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the consent was obtained via opt-in (true) or opt-out (false) mechanism. GDPR requires opt-in for most marketing and profiling activities.

attributes.name: parental_consent_verified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether parental or guardian consent has been verified for a minor passenger. Null if minor_consent_flag is false. Required for GDPR Article 8 and COPPA compliance.

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: The specific purpose for which the passenger's data will be processed under this consent. Examples include marketing communications, service personalization, loyalty program analytics, or partner offers. Required for GDPR Article 13 transparency.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the airline should proactively request consent renewal from the passenger. Used for consent lifecycle management and regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring periodic re-consent.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system or application that captured the consent record. Examples include Amadeus Altéa PSS, airline mobile app, loyalty portal, or third-party booking platform.

attributes.name: text_snapshot
attributes.description: A snapshot or reference to the exact consent text presented to the passenger at the time of consent. Supports audit and dispute resolution by preserving the wording the passenger agreed to.

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_scope
attributes.description: Description of the third-party entities or categories of entities with whom passenger data may be shared under this consent. Required for transparency under GDPR Article 13 and CCPA Section 1798.100(b).

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The user agent string of the browser or application used by the passenger to provide consent. Supports technical audit and fraud detection.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy policy or consent terms that were in effect at the time the passenger granted consent. Enables tracking of consent under different policy versions and supports re-consent workflows when policies change.

attributes.name: withdrawn_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the passenger withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for right-to-erasure compliance.

products.name: minor_guardian
products.description: Manages the relationship between unaccompanied minor (UMNR) passengers and their authorised guardians or escorts. Captures guardian full name, relationship to minor (parent, legal guardian, authorised adult), contact phone numbers, government-issued ID reference, authorisation document reference, pickup authorisation at destination, and the effective date range of the guardianship record. Required for UMNR service fulfilment, ground handling handover procedures, and liability compliance. Distinct from contact_detail — this entity carries legal authorisation and handover workflow data specific to minors.

products.name: watchlist_check
products.description: Records the results of security watchlist screening checks performed against a passenger profile — covering TSA Secure Flight, OFAC sanctions screening, Interpol notices, and national no-fly list checks. Captures check timestamp, screening programme (Secure Flight, OFAC, EU PNR Directive, etc.), match status (clear, potential match, confirmed match, resolved), resolution action, resolving officer ID, and regulatory submission reference. Mandatory for TSA Secure Flight compliance on US-bound flights and EU PNR Directive compliance on EU-bound flights. Distinct from redress_record — this captures the screening event, not the resolution credential.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is required to travel with a companion or safety assistant due to the severity of their disability. May be mandated by airline medical policy.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 2, FAA 14 CFR Part 382

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accessibility profile record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: hearing_impairment_level
attributes.description: Degree of hearing impairment. Determines need for visual safety briefings, written communication, and assistive listening devices.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006, ADA Title II

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the accessibility profile information was last verified or updated by the passenger or airline staff. Used for data quality and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date until which the medical clearance (MEDIF) is valid. Passenger cannot travel after this date without renewed clearance.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires medical clearance (MEDIF form) from airline medical services before travel. Triggered by certain medical conditions or equipment.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 2, IATA Resolution 700

attributes.name: medical_equipment_carried
attributes.description: Description of medical equipment the passenger carries onboard (CPAP, portable oxygen concentrator, nebulizer, insulin pump). Free-text field for crew awareness and stowage planning.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual, FAA 14 CFR Part 382.133

attributes.name: mobility_aid_battery_type
attributes.description: Type of battery powering the mobility aid device. Critical for dangerous goods compliance and cargo hold safety. Lithium-ion batteries have specific IATA DGR restrictions.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Section 2.3, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: mobility_aid_battery_watt_hours
attributes.description: Energy capacity of the mobility aid battery in watt-hours. Required for lithium battery compliance checks per IATA DGR (batteries over 300Wh require special handling).

attributes.name: mobility_aid_foldable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mobility aid device can be folded or disassembled for stowage. Affects cargo hold space allocation and handling procedures.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: mobility_aid_type
attributes.description: Type of mobility aid device used by the passenger. Determines handling and stowage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manual_wheelchair|electric_wheelchair|mobility_scooter|walker|cane|crutches|prosthetic|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: mobility_aid_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the mobility aid device in kilograms. Required for cargo hold planning and aircraft weight and balance calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, ICAO Annex 18

attributes.name: mobility_aid_width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the mobility aid device in centimeters. Used to determine cargo hold compatibility and stowage location.

attributes.name: oxygen_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Prescribed oxygen flow rate in liters per minute. Required for aircraft oxygen system configuration and medical clearance.

attributes.name: oxygen_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires supplemental oxygen during flight. Requires advance coordination with medical services and aircraft equipment availability.
attributes.references: IATA Medical Manual Section 8, FAA 14 CFR Part 121.574

attributes.name: preferred_seating_location
attributes.description: Passengers preferred seating location based on accessibility needs. Bulkhead seats provide extra space for mobility aids; aisle seats facilitate lavatory access.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: prm_category
attributes.description: IATA standard PRM category code. WCHR=wheelchair for ramp, WCHS=wheelchair for stairs, WCHC=wheelchair for cabin seat, customerD=dry cell battery wheelchair, customerW=wet cell battery wheelchair, WCMP=manual wheelchair, BLND=blind, DEAF=deaf, DPNA=disabled passenger needing assistance, MAAS=meet and assist. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WCHR|WCHS|WCHC|customerD|customerW|WCMP|BLND|DEAF|DPNA|MAAS — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profile_effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this accessibility profile becomes effective and can be used for booking and SSR generation.

attributes.name: profile_effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this accessibility profile remains valid. Nullable for indefinite profiles; populated for time-limited medical clearances.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accessibility profile. Active profiles are used for SSR generation; expired profiles require renewal of medical documentation.

attributes.name: seating_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes on seating restrictions or requirements (e.g., cannot sit in exit row, requires adjacent seat for companion, needs armrest removal). Used by inventory and departure control systems.

attributes.name: service_animal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger travels with a trained service animal (guide dog, hearing dog, psychiatric service animal). Requires cabin accommodation and documentation.
attributes.references: FAA 14 CFR Part 382, DOT Service Animal Rule, EU Regulation 1107/2006

attributes.name: service_animal_type
attributes.description: Type of trained service animal accompanying the passenger. Determines seating location and cabin crew briefing requirements.
attributes.references: FAA 14 CFR Part 382, DOT Service Animal Rule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or last updated this accessibility profile record (e.g., Amadeus Altéa PSS, airport kiosk, mobile app, call center CRM).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional accessibility instructions, preferences, or notes that do not fit structured fields. Visible to ground handlers and cabin crew.

attributes.name: stretcher_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger requires stretcher accommodation. Requires removal of multiple seat rows and advance aircraft configuration.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, IATA Medical Manual

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accessibility profile record was last modified. Updated on every change for audit trail and data freshness tracking.

attributes.name: visual_impairment_level
attributes.description: Degree of visual impairment. Determines need for sighted guide, Braille materials, audio announcements, and service animal accommodation.
attributes.references: IATA PRM Handling Guidelines, EU Regulation 1107/2006, ADA Title II

domains.name: reservation
domains.description: Manages PNR (Passenger Name Record) creation, booking records, itineraries, seat assignments, check-in, boarding passes, e-ticket issuance, EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document), reservation modifications, GDS distribution, interline agreements, codeshare bookings, and MCT (Minimum Connecting Time) validation. SSOT for all booking and ticketing transaction lifecycle data. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory.
domains.references: IATA PSS Standards, IATA Resolution 722, EDIFACT

products.name: pnr
products.description: Passenger Name Record (PNR) — the master booking record and SSOT for all reservation data within the airline. Captures the full PNR lifecycle from creation through ticketing, modification, and archival/purge. Stores PNR record locator (6-character alphanumeric), booking source (GDS/direct/NDC), distribution channel, booking date, ticketing time limit (TTL), booking status (confirmed/waitlisted/cancelled/archived), currency, total fare amount, form of payment summary, agency IATA number, responsible office ID, creating agent sign, creation timestamp, last modification timestamp, number of passengers, number of segments, and PNR purge date. Central hub entity to which all other reservation products relate. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa Reservation and IATA RP 1745 PNR standards.
products.reference: IATA PNR / Amadeus Altéa PNR

attributes.name: booking_type
attributes.description: Classification of the booking based on passenger type and commercial arrangement. Distinguishes individual, group, corporate contract, interline, and codeshare bookings.

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: corporate_account_number
attributes.description: Corporate discount or contract account number associated with the booking. Used for negotiated fare application and corporate reporting.

attributes.name: creating_agent_sign
attributes.description: Agent sign or user ID of the individual who created the PNR. Used for audit trail and quality control.
attributes.references: IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards, Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the PNR was first created in the reservation system. Represents the initial booking event. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this PNR. Determines the currency for total fare, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Date of the first flight segment departure in the itinerary. Used for reporting and operational planning. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: destination_city_code

attributes.name: distribution_channel

attributes.name: form_of_payment_summary

attributes.name: interline_indicator

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modifying_agent_sign

attributes.name: passenger_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers included in this PNR. Supports group bookings and family travel.

attributes.name: point_of_sale_city

attributes.references: IATA Location Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: point_of_sale_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the booking was made. Critical for revenue accounting, tax calculation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes, IATA RP 1745 PNR Standards

attributes.name: purge_date
attributes.description: Date when the PNR is scheduled to be purged or archived from the active reservation system. Typically set based on last travel date plus retention period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: queue_number

attributes.name: return_date

attributes.name: segment_count

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: ticketed_timestamp

attributes.name: ticketing_time_limit
attributes.description: Deadline by which the PNR must be ticketed or the reservation will be automatically cancelled. Critical for revenue management and inventory control. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: total_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total fare amount for all passengers and segments in the PNR, including base fare, taxes, fees, and surcharges. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.

attributes.name: tour_code

attributes.name: trip_type
