products.name: e_ticket
products.description: Electronic ticket (e-ticket) record representing the contractual document of carriage issued to a passenger. Stores ticket number (13-digit IATA format), conjunction ticket numbers, issuing airline code, issuing office IATA number, ticket issue date and time, ticket status (OPEN/USED/VOID/REFUNDED/EXCHANGED), fare amount, tax breakdown, total amount, form of payment, fare calculation string, endorsement/restriction text, tour code, commission amount, and original ticket number for exchanges. SSOT for ticketing lifecycle. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa ticketing module.
products.reference: IATA e-ticket / BSP / ARC

attributes.name: e_ticket_id
attributes.description: Primary key for e_ticket

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Tickets generate accounts receivable entries in BSP/ARC settlement cycles. Airlines track AR aging, credit control, and cash collection by ticket. Natural link for revenue accounting and cash flow man

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.reservation_booking_passenger. Business justification: An e-ticket is issued to a specific passenger within a PNR. reservation_booking_passenger is the reservation-context entity representing that passenger in the booking. While e_ticket has pax_profile_i

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: E-ticket fare class determines mileage accrual rates, refund penalty applicability, and revenue class for financial reporting. Airline revenue accounting systems require direct e-ticket-to-fare-class

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: E-tickets are issued against specific ATPCO filed fares. Revenue accounting, tax calculation, and ATPCO audit require tracing each e-ticket to its underlying fare record. This is a fundamental link in

attributes.name: fare_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.fare_quote. Business justification: E-ticket is issued based on a stored fare quote within the PNR. Linking to fare_quote provides the authoritative pricing record and fare calculation details. Columns fare_basis_code and fare_calculati

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger for whom this electronic ticket was issued. Links ticket to passenger master data.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Passenger Name Record (PNR) associated with this electronic ticket. Links the ticket to the booking record.

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: E-ticket reconciliation against revenue ticket is mandatory for BSP settlement, revenue recognition, and IATA audit. Every airline must match the passenger-facing e-ticket to the financial revenue tic

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount for the ticket before taxes and fees. Represents the airline's revenue portion of the ticket price.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount paid to the issuing agent or travel agency for selling the ticket. Used for BSP/ARC settlement.

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applied to calculate the commission amount. Null if flat commission was used.

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ticket is part of a conjunction ticket set (multiple tickets issued together for a single journey exceeding 4 flight coupons).

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related conjunction ticket numbers if this ticket is part of a multi-ticket set. Empty if not a conjunction ticket.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this e-ticket record was first created in the reservation system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this ticket (base fare, tax, total).

attributes.name: endorsement_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing fare restrictions, endorsements, and special conditions applicable to the ticket (e.g., NON-REFUNDABLE, VALID ON XX ONLY).

attributes.name: equivalent_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for the equivalent fare amount. Null if no currency conversion was applied.

attributes.name: equivalent_fare_amount
attributes.description: Fare amount converted to the currency of the country of commencement of travel, if different from ticket currency. Used for settlement purposes.

attributes.name: exchange_date
attributes.description: Date when the ticket was exchanged for a new ticket. Null if ticket has not been exchanged.

attributes.name: exchange_ticket_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ticket was issued as an exchange for a previous ticket. True if this is a reissued ticket.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_details
attributes.description: Detailed payment information including masked card number, approval code, or account reference. Sensitive financial data stored according to PCI-DSS requirements.

attributes.name: form_of_payment_type
attributes.description: Primary payment method used to purchase the ticket. Identifies how the passenger paid for the ticket. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CASH|CREDIT_CARD|DEBIT_CARD|VOUCHER|MILES|CORPORATE_ACCOUNT|INVOICE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gds_pcc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Distribution System (GDS) Pseudo City Code (PCC)
attributes.description: GDS Pseudo City Code (PCC) of the agency or office that created the booking. Used for GDS reporting and commission tracking.

attributes.name: gds_record_locator
attributes.description: GDS-specific booking reference number (record locator) linking the ticket to the GDS reservation. May differ from airline PNR.

attributes.name: in_connection_with_ticket
attributes.description: Ticket number of a related ticket when this ticket is issued in connection with another (e.g., companion ticket, family booking). Null if standalone.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the electronic ticket was issued to the passenger. Represents the contractual agreement date.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the electronic ticket was issued, including timezone. Used for audit and settlement purposes.

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA 2-letter or 3-digit airline code of the carrier that issued the electronic ticket. Identifies the validating carrier responsible for the ticket.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this e-ticket record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: original_ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit ticket number of the original ticket if this is an exchange or reissue. Null for original issuances. Used to track ticket exchange history.

attributes.name: refund_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a refund has been processed for this ticket. True if ticket has been refunded (fully or partially).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount collected on the ticket. Sum of all applicable government taxes, airport fees, and surcharges.

attributes.name: ticket_designator
attributes.description: Special fare qualifier or corporate discount code applied to the ticket. Used for negotiated corporate rates or promotional fares.

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the electronic ticket. OPEN=valid for travel, USED=travel completed, VOID=cancelled before use, REFUNDED=refund processed, EXCHANGED=replaced by new ticket, SUSPENDED=temporarily invalid.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid for the ticket including base fare, taxes, and all fees. This is the final price paid by the passenger.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour operator or bulk fare identifier if the ticket was issued under a tour or group contract. Null for regular published fares.

attributes.name: validating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the carrier responsible for fare rules, refunds, and exchanges. May differ from issuing airline in interline scenarios.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date when the ticket was voided. Null if ticket has not been voided. Voiding typically occurs within 24 hours of issuance.

products.name: booking_passenger
products.description: Passenger name element (PNE) within a PNR — the reservation-context association of a traveller to a booking. Stores passenger title, first name, last name, suffix, passenger type code (ADT/CHD/INF/INS/YTH/UNN), date of birth, gender, nationality, associated infant indicator, frequent flyer number and tier (for display/SSR purposes), known traveller number (KTN), redress number, APIS data completeness flag, seat preference (window/aisle/none), meal preference code, SSR count, and passenger sequence number within the PNR. This is the booking-scoped passenger reference; the canonical passenger identity master is owned by the passenger domain.
products.reference: IATA PNR Name Element / Amadeus Altéa PNE

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the passenger name element (PNE) within the PNR. This is the booking-scoped passenger reference; the canonical passenger identity master is owned by the passenger domain.

attributes.name: booked_tier_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier_status. Business justification: Tier-at-booking-time snapshot is a named benefit-application requirement: tier can change between booking and travel, so the tier that qualified the booking benefits (seat preference, upgrade eligibil

attributes.name: crew_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.member. Business justification: Staff travel and deadhead management: crew members traveling on staff benefit tickets or deadhead bookings appear as passengers. This FK links the passenger booking record to the crew member for staff

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Check-in and boarding benefit application (priority boarding, lounge access, upgrade eligibility) requires resolving the passenger's FFP membership at the booking-passenger level. frequent_flyer_numbe

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the canonical passenger master record in the passenger domain. Enables cross-booking passenger recognition and loyalty program linkage.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent PNR booking record. Links this passenger name element to the reservation container.

attributes.name: seat_map_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.seat_map. Business justification: Seat assignment validation is a core reservation process: when assigning a seat, the system must verify seat eligibility (exit row age/ability restrictions, bassinet capability, accessibility complian

attributes.name: apis_data_complete_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Passenger Information System (APIS) Data Complete Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required APIS data elements (name, DOB, gender, nationality, passport) have been collected for this passenger. Required for international travel compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS Requirements

attributes.name: boarding_pass_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a boarding pass has been issued to this passenger for at least one segment in the itinerary.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current reservation status of this passenger within the PNR. Reflects confirmation, waitlist, cancellation, or no-show state.

attributes.name: check_in_status
attributes.description: Current check-in and boarding status of the passenger. Tracks progression from reservation through boarding.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the passenger completed check-in for the first flight segment in the itinerary. Used for boarding priority and operational reporting.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for this passenger. Used for e-ticket delivery, flight notifications, and IROP communication.

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for this passenger. Used for flight notifications, IROP rebooking, and operational communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger name element was first added to the PNR. Audit trail for booking creation.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the passenger. Required for infant and child passengers, and for APIS (Advanced Passenger Information System) compliance on international flights.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, US CBP APIS Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the passenger's emergency contact person. Collected for safety and incident response purposes.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the passenger's emergency contact person. Used in case of flight incidents or medical emergencies.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the passenger as it appears on travel documents. Must match government-issued ID for international travel.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the passenger as recorded in the booking. M=Male, F=Female, U=Unspecified, X=Non-binary. Required for APIS compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 9, IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions

attributes.name: known_traveller_number
attributes.description: TSA PreCheck or other trusted traveler program number. Enables expedited security screening for eligible passengers on US domestic and international flights.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the passenger as it appears on travel documents. Must match government-issued ID for international travel.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: meal_preference_code
attributes.description: IATA standard meal code representing the passenger's dietary preference or restriction. VGML=Vegetarian, HNML=Hindu, KSML=Kosher, MOML=Muslim, AVML=Asian Vegetarian, DBML=Diabetic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGULAR|VGML|HNML|KSML|MOML|AVML|DBML — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the passenger. Optional field used when provided on travel documents.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Service Conference Resolutions, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this passenger name element was last modified. Tracks name corrections, SSR updates, and status changes.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the passenger's nationality. Required for APIS and visa validation.

attributes.name: passenger_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this passenger within the PNR. Used for display, SSR association, and segment assignment. Typically starts at 1.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA passenger type code indicating age category and fare eligibility. ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, INF=Infant (lap), INS=Infant (seat), YTH=Youth, UNN=Unaccompanied Minor.

attributes.name: redress_number
attributes.description: DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program (TRIP) number issued to passengers who have been misidentified during security screening. Prevents false matches on watchlists.
attributes.references: DHS TRIP Program, TSA Secure Flight Program

attributes.name: seat_preference_code
attributes.description: Passenger's preferred seat location type. Used by seat assignment algorithms and displayed to agents during check-in.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the PSS or GDS system through which this passenger name element was created. ALTEA=Amadeus Altéa, DIRECT=airline.com or mobile app.

attributes.name: special_service_request_count
attributes.description: Total number of SSR records associated with this passenger in the PNR. Includes wheelchair assistance, unaccompanied minor service, pet in cabin, extra baggage, etc.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the passenger name (e.g., Jr., Sr., III). Used for name disambiguation.

attributes.name: ticket_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the e-ticket was issued to this passenger. Used for fare rule validation and refund calculations.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA e-ticket number issued to this passenger. Format: 3-digit airline code + 10-digit serial number. Links to the ticket coupon records.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Honorific title of the passenger as recorded in the booking. Used for ticket issuance and customer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MR|MS|MRS|MISS|DR|PROF|MSTR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this passenger is traveling as an unaccompanied minor and requires special handling, escort service, and guardian handoff procedures.

attributes.name: wheelchair_assistance_code
attributes.description: IATA SSR code indicating level of wheelchair assistance required. WCHR=Can walk short distances, WCHS=Cannot climb stairs, WCHC=Immobile, requires wheelchair throughout.

products.name: ssr
products.description: Special Service Request (SSR) record attached to a PNR or specific segment/passenger combination. Captures SSR code (WCHR/VGML/UMNR/DOCS/DOCA/DOCO/FQTV etc.), SSR status (HK/KK/UN/NO/NN), free-text SSR remark, airline responsible for action, segment applicability, passenger applicability, SSR category (meal/wheelchair/document/loyalty/security), creation source, and action required flag. Supports operational fulfilment of passenger special needs and regulatory APIS/DOCA/DOCO document collection.
products.reference: IATA SSR / Amadeus Altéa SSR

attributes.name: ssr_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the special service request record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ancillary_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.ancillary_emd. Business justification: Chargeable SSRs generate EMDs for revenue collection. The ssr table has emd_number as a denormalized plain attribute. Replacing it with a proper FK to ancillary_emd enables EMD lifecycle management, r

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.booking_passenger. Business justification: SSR (Special Service Request) is often attached to a specific passenger name element within the PNR. While ssr has pax_profile_id, it should also link to the booking-context passenger to maintain the

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: SSR fulfillment (wheelchair assistance, special meals, unaccompanied minors) is executed at the operated flight_leg level by ground staff. Linking SSRs to flight_leg enables operational fulfillment tr

attributes.name: itinerary_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight segment to which this SSR applies. Nullable if SSR applies to all segments.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific passenger within the PNR for whom this SSR applies. Nullable if SSR applies to all passengers.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PNR to which this SSR is attached.

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.product_catalog. Business justification: Chargeable SSRs (WCHR, SPEML, PETC, etc.) map to specific ancillary products in the catalog for revenue attribution and NDC order management. IATA NDC standards require SSR-to-ancillary-product mappin

attributes.name: action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether operational action is required by airline staff to fulfill this SSR (e.g., wheelchair provision, meal loading, document verification).

attributes.name: apis_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SSR is required for APIS compliance (e.g., DOCS, DOCA, DOCO SSRs for border control and security).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this SSR was cancelled (e.g., passenger request, flight change, service unavailable).

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SSR was cancelled or removed from the PNR. Null if still active.

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount charged for this SSR if charge_applicable_flag is true. Null if complimentary.

attributes.name: charge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SSR incurs a charge to the passenger (e.g., paid meal upgrade, pet in cabin fee). False for complimentary services.

attributes.name: charge_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: codeshare_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SSR applies to a codeshare flight segment where the marketing and operating carriers differ.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SSR record was first created in the reservation system.

attributes.name: creation_source
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the SSR was originally created (e.g., GDS, airline website, mobile app, call center, airport check-in, API integration). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gds|web|mobile|call_center|airport|api|amadeus|sabre|galileo|worldspan — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this SSR is no longer valid or applicable. Relevant for time-sensitive SSRs such as travel documents or temporary medical conditions.

attributes.name: free_text
attributes.description: Free-text field containing additional details or remarks associated with the SSR. May include passenger-specific instructions, medical details, or document numbers.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Operational status indicating whether the SSR has been fulfilled by ground or cabin crew (e.g., wheelchair provided, meal loaded, document verified).

attributes.name: fulfillment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SSR was marked as fulfilled by operational staff. Null if not yet fulfilled.

attributes.name: gds_record_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric GDS record locator (PNR locator) in the originating GDS system (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, Worldspan).

attributes.name: interline_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SSR is subject to interline agreement terms between multiple carriers in a multi-carrier itinerary.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SSR record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: operating_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier operating the flight segment to which this SSR applies. May differ from responsible airline in codeshare scenarios.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to this SSR for fulfillment and crew attention (e.g., critical for medical oxygen, high for wheelchair, medium for meal).

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units or instances of this SSR requested (e.g., 2 wheelchairs, 3 special meals). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SSR is mandated by regulatory or security requirements (e.g., TSA, FAA, EASA, national civil aviation authorities).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional internal remarks or notes related to this SSR for operational or customer service reference.

attributes.name: responsible_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier responsible for fulfilling this SSR. Relevant for codeshare and interline bookings.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this SSR within the PNR or segment, used for display and processing order.

attributes.name: ssr_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the SSR for operational routing and fulfillment (e.g., meal service, mobility assistance, travel documentation, frequent flyer program). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meal|wheelchair|medical|document|loyalty|security|baggage|pet|infant|unaccompanied_minor|seating|other — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ssr_code
attributes.description: Four-letter IATA SSR code identifying the type of special service (e.g., WCHR for wheelchair, VGML for vegetarian meal, UMNR for unaccompanied minor, DOCS for travel document, FQTV for frequent flyer).

attributes.name: ssr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the SSR. HK=confirmed by airline, KK=confirmed by carrier, UN=unable to confirm, NO=not processed, NN=need confirmation, UC=unable to confirm space, UU=unconfirmed, RQ=requested. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HK|KK|UN|NO|NN|UC|UU|RQ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: boarding_pass
products.description: Boarding pass record issued to a passenger for a specific flight segment at check-in. Stores boarding pass sequence number, check-in method (web/mobile/kiosk/counter/CUSS), boarding pass format (BCBP/paper/mobile), barcode data (IATA BCBP Type M), gate number, boarding time, seat number at issuance, boarding zone/group, baggage tag numbers, security selectee flag, document check status, boarding pass issue timestamp, and boarding pass reprint count. SSOT for check-in and boarding event data.
products.reference: IATA BCBP (Bar Coded Boarding Pass) / Resolution 792

attributes.name: boarding_pass_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the boarding pass record. Primary key. Inferred role: TRANSACTION_HEADER (discrete check-in event with lifecycle).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 792 - Bar Coded Boarding Pass (BCBP)

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Gate agents, operations control, maintenance tracking, and post-flight reconciliation require knowing which specific tail number a passenger boarded. Critical for weight-and-balance verification, IROP

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.booking_passenger. Business justification: Boarding pass is issued to a specific passenger name element (PNE) within the PNR. While boarding_pass has pax_profile_id (master profile), it should also link to the booking-context passenger record

attributes.name: check_in_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.check_in_event. attributes.name: departure_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Boarding passes are issued at departure stations. Passenger services, gate operations, boarding metrics, and regulatory reporting (e.g., DOT on-time performance) require station linkage for operationa

attributes.name: e_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.e_ticket. Business justification: A boarding pass is issued against a specific e-ticket — the e-ticket is the contractual document of carriage that authorizes the passenger to board. boarding_pass currently has ticket_coupon_id → reve

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific flight leg (operating flight) for which this boarding pass is valid.

attributes.name: flight_number_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.flight_number. Business justification: Boarding passes are issued for specific flight numbers. Required for gate management, boarding control, operational reporting, and passenger flow analytics. Standard airport operations link boarding d

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate_assignment. Business justification: Boarding passes are issued for specific gate assignments. Operational coordination between reservation systems and airport operations (gate changes, boarding status) requires this link for real-time p

attributes.name: gate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate. Business justification: Boarding passes specify gate assignments for passenger boarding. Gate utilization tracking, passenger flow management, and boarding sequence coordination require this link. Core operational relationsh

attributes.name: itinerary_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.itinerary_segment. Business justification: Boarding pass is issued for a specific booked segment in the PNR itinerary. While boarding_pass has flight_leg_id (operational flight), it should also link to the booked segment to maintain the reserv

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the passenger (party) to whom this boarding pass is issued. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER minimum requirement for PARTY_REFERENCE.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the PNR (Passenger Name Record) that this boarding pass is issued under. Links to the reservation master record.

attributes.name: primary_baggage_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.baggage_item. Business justification: Boarding passes are issued to passengers who check baggage. Baggage reconciliation (positive passenger bag match), tracking, and irregularity investigation require this link for operational safety and

attributes.name: seat_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.seat_assignment. Business justification: A boarding pass must reflect the confirmed seat assignment record for DCS/CUTE system integrity. Linking boarding_pass to ancillary.seat_assignment enables seat change tracking, fee reconciliation, an

attributes.name: seat_map_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.seat_map. Business justification: A boarding pass is issued for a specific physical seat. Linking to seat_map replaces the denormalized seat_number text field and enables seat-map display, upgrade availability checks, and accessibilit

attributes.name: ticket_coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific ticket coupon (flight segment) for which this boarding pass is issued.

attributes.name: arrival_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA code of the arrival airport for this flight segment.

attributes.name: baggage_tag_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of baggage tag numbers (10-digit IATA license plate codes) for checked bags associated with this boarding pass.

attributes.name: barcode_data
attributes.description: Encoded barcode data string conforming to IATA BCBP Type M format. Contains passenger name, flight details, seat, boarding pass number, and security data. Confidential due to embedded passenger information.

attributes.name: boarding_group
attributes.description: Descriptive boarding group name assigned to the passenger (e.g., priority, general, family). Complements boarding_zone with business-friendly label.

attributes.name: boarding_pass_number
attributes.description: Unique boarding pass sequence number issued by the check-in system. Business identifier for the boarding pass. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER minimum requirement for BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER.

attributes.name: boarding_pass_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the boarding pass. Tracks progression from issuance through boarding gate scan. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER minimum requirement for LIFECYCLE_STATUS.

attributes.name: boarding_scan_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the boarding pass barcode was scanned at the gate, confirming passenger boarded the aircraft. Null if not yet scanned.

attributes.name: boarding_time
attributes.description: Scheduled boarding commencement time printed on the boarding pass. Advises passengers when to arrive at the gate.

attributes.name: boarding_zone
attributes.description: Boarding zone or group assigned to the passenger for sequenced boarding. May be numeric (1-9) or alphabetic (A-Z) depending on airline policy.

attributes.name: check_in_counter_number
attributes.description: Counter or kiosk number where the boarding pass was issued. Null for web or mobile check-in.

attributes.name: check_in_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code where the boarding pass was issued. May differ from departure airport for interline or codeshare itineraries.

attributes.name: check_in_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the passenger completed check-in and received the boarding pass. CUSS = Common Use Self-Service.

attributes.name: checked_bag_count
attributes.description: Number of checked bags associated with this boarding pass at check-in.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this boarding pass record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER minimum requirement for RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED.

Supports ticketing, repricing, and revenue accounting.

Stores refund type (full/partial/involuntary/voluntary), original ticket or EMD number, refund amount, penalty amount deducted, tax refund amount, refund method (original form of payment/voucher/miles), refund request date, refund processing date, refund status (requested/approved/processed/rejected), refund reason code, waiver code (for penalty waivers), processing agent ID, and refund reference number. Supports revenue accounting and BSP/ARC settlement.
products.reference: IATA Refund / BSP Refund Application / ARC

attributes.name: refund_processing_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the refund processing was completed.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code

attributes.name: refund_reason_description

attributes.name: refund_reference_number

attributes.name: refund_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was requested by the passenger or initiated by the airline.

attributes.name: refund_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the refund request was submitted or created in the system.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction in the processing workflow.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund: full (entire ticket value), partial (portion of ticket value), involuntary (airline-initiated due to schedule change, cancellation, or IROP), or voluntary (passenger-initiated).

attributes.name: refund_voucher_number
attributes.description: Unique voucher number issued when refund method is voucher or credit shell, used for future travel redemption.

attributes.name: tax_refund_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of taxes and government fees being refunded to the passenger.

attributes.name: total_refund_amount
attributes.description: The total refund amount including base fare refund, tax refund, and fee refund, after all deductions.

attributes.name: voucher_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the refund voucher or credit shell, after which it cannot be redeemed.

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if penalty fees were waived and the authorization reason (e.g., IROP, medical emergency, airline error, executive waiver).

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether penalty waiver was applied to this refund transaction.

products.name: travel_document
products.description: Passenger travel document record collected for APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) and border control compliance. Stores document type (passport/national ID/visa/resident permit/travel permit), document number, issuing country ISO code, nationality, document expiry date, document issue date, surname as on document, given names as on document, gender, date of birth, place of birth, and document verification status. Collected via SSR DOCS/DOCA/DOCO elements. Required for international travel regulatory compliance with TSA, CBP, and national border agencies.
products.reference: IATA APIS / SSR DOCS / DOCA / DOCO

attributes.name: travel_document_id
attributes.description: Primary key for travel_document

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.booking_passenger. Business justification: Travel document (passport, visa) is collected for a specific passenger name element in the PNR for APIS compliance. While travel_document has pax_profile_id, it should also link to the booking-context

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) submissions are made per operated flight_leg to border control authorities. Linking travel_document to flight_leg supports regulatory APIS compliance report

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the passenger to whom this travel document belongs.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the PNR this travel document is associated with.

attributes.name: travel_identity_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to passenger.travel_identity_document. attributes.name: apis_response_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Response Code
attributes.description: Response code received from the border control authority after APIS transmission. Used to identify acceptance, rejection, or error conditions.

attributes.name: apis_response_message
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Response Message
attributes.description: Detailed response message received from the border control authority after APIS transmission. Contains error details or acceptance confirmation.

attributes.name: apis_transmission_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Transmission Status
attributes.description: Status of the APIS data transmission to the destination country border control authority. Tracks whether passenger travel document data has been successfully submitted and acknowledged.
attributes.references: CBP APIS, TSA Secure Flight, IATA Resolution 792

attributes.name: apis_transmission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) Transmission Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the APIS data was transmitted to the border control authority.

attributes.name: boarding_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is eligible to board based on travel document validation and APIS clearance. Used by gate agents and automated boarding systems.

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the travel document information was collected from the passenger.

attributes.name: compliance_validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the travel document record was last validated for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the travel document record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the passenger as stated on the travel document. Required for APIS and border control identity verification.
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303, TSA Secure Flight, CBP APIS

attributes.name: document_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the travel document expires. Critical for validating passenger eligibility for international travel and compliance with destination country entry requirements (typically 6-month validity rule).
attributes.references: ICAO Doc 9303, destination country immigration rules

attributes.name: document_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the travel document was issued by the issuing authority. Used for document validity verification.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier of the travel document as issued by the issuing authority. Required for border control and APIS transmission.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of travel document presented by the passenger. Used for APIS (Advance Passenger Information System) compliance.

attributes.name: document_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the travel document verification process. Indicates whether the document has been validated against issuing authority databases or manual inspection.

attributes.name: gds_record_locator
attributes.description: GDS-specific record locator or confirmation code associated with the travel document collection. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the passenger as stated on the travel document. M=Male, F=Female, X=Unspecified/Non-binary, U=Unknown. Required for APIS transmission.

attributes.name: given_names
attributes.description: Given name(s) (first and middle names) of the passenger exactly as they appear on the travel document. Required for APIS and border control matching.

attributes.name: ineligibility_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason why the passenger is ineligible to board, if boarding_eligibility_status is ineligible. May include expired document, APIS rejection, or missing information.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country that issued the travel document.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the travel document record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code representing the nationality of the passenger as stated on the travel document.

attributes.name: place_of_birth
attributes.description: City and/or country of birth of the passenger as stated on the travel document. May be required by certain destination countries for visa and entry validation.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the travel document record meets all regulatory requirements for international travel (APIS, Secure Flight, destination country rules). True if compliant, False if deficient.
attributes.references: TSA Secure Flight, CBP APIS, ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which the travel document record originated (e.g., Amadeus Altéa, Sabre, mobile app, web check-in).

attributes.name: ssr_docs_element
attributes.description: Raw SSR DOCS element string as received from the GDS or PSS. Contains structured travel document information in IATA format for APIS transmission.

attributes.name: surname
attributes.description: Surname (family name) of the passenger exactly as it appears on the travel document. Required for APIS and border control matching.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the travel document verification was completed or last attempted.

products.name: group_booking
products.description: Group booking master record for coordinated reservations of 10+ passengers travelling together under a single group contract. Stores group name, group type (leisure/corporate/incentive/tour operator/sports team/military/government), total seats contracted, seats named (passengers assigned), seats confirmed, group fare basis code, negotiated fare amount per passenger, deposit amount and due date, final payment due date, name list completion deadline, ticketing deadline, group booking status (option/tentative/confirmed/partially-ticketed/fully-ticketed/cancelled), group coordinator name and contact, sales owner, and associated PNR locator list. Supports group desk operations, bulk inventory allocation, deposit tracking, and name list management workflows.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-character airline code of the carrier that operated the flight for this coupon.

attributes.name: original_ticket_number
attributes.description: The original ticket number if this coupon was reissued or exchanged from a prior ticket.

attributes.name: previous_status_code
attributes.description: The coupon status code immediately prior to the current status, enabling status transition tracking.

attributes.name: processing_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the coupon status change was processed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile|kiosk|counter|call_center|gds|api — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the coupon was refunded to the passenger.

attributes.name: reissue_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this coupon was reissued as part of a ticket exchange or voluntary change.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or notes related to this coupon status, for operational or customer service reference.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled departure date for this coupon segment, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: status_change_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the status change (e.g., passenger no-show, voluntary change, involuntary reroute, schedule change).

attributes.name: status_change_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the status change.

attributes.name: status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the coupon status was last changed, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: The 13-digit electronic ticket number to which this coupon belongs, formatted per IATA standards.

attributes.name: validating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-character code of the airline responsible for validating and settling this coupon.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the coupon was voided, if applicable.

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any fare rule waiver applied to this coupon (e.g., change fee waived due to IROP).

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Revenue management and pricing SSOT — HOW the airline prices and captures revenue. Owns fare structures, pricing rules, yield management parameters, fare classes, dynamic pricing, RASK/CASK/RPK/ASK performance metrics, revenue accounting records, BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) settlements, ARC reporting, and ancillary revenue aggregation. Aligns with Sabre AirVision Revenue Management.

products.name: fare
products.description: Master fare definition record representing a published or private fare basis — the atomic pricing unit in the airline revenue management system. Owns fare basis code, fare amount, currency, cabin class, booking class (RBD), fare type (published/negotiated/private/web), one-way or round-trip indicator, directionality, origin-destination city pair, carrier designator, ticketing carrier, global indicator, routing number, fare tariff number, IATA fare filing reference, effective date, discontinue date, and fare ownership (ATPCO/SITA/carrier-filed). Aligns with Sabre AirVision fare filing and ATPCO Fare Filing standards.
products.reference: ATPCO Fare Basis Code / IATA Fare Filing

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fare record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the fare master definition table.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: Fares are filed by a specific carrier (ATPCO filing carrier). Carrier-level fare management, competitive fare analysis, and regulatory filing audits require linking fares to the authoritative carrier

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Fares are managed by route/region cost centers for yield management accountability and revenue optimization. Links pricing strategy to financial responsibility centers.

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: Fares are associated with booking classes (RBDs). The booking_class attribute in fare should reference the authoritative fare_class master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict. bookin

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Individual fares are grouped into fare families (branded fares). A fare belongs to one fare family. This is the authoritative link between the atomic fare definition and its branded fare grouping. Sta

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Fares are defined for specific routes. This FK links the fare to the route master for pricing analysis, revenue management, and competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that the ticket must be purchased to qualify for this fare. A value of 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement. Key yield management parameter.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Published or filed fare amount in the specified currency, representing the one-way or round-trip base fare before taxes and surcharges. This is the principal monetary value of the fare record as filed with ATPCO or SITA.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: atpco_record_type
attributes.description: ATPCO record type number identifying the category of fare data: Record 1=Fare by Rule, Record 2=Fare Amount, Record 3=Fare Rules, Record 4=Footnote, Record 5=Routing, Record 6=Fare Class. Governs how the fare is processed in GDS and PSS systems.

attributes.name: basis_code
attributes.description: ATPCO-standard alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fare construction rules, booking class, and conditions (e.g., YOW, KLAXOW, B21NR). The atomic pricing identifier used across GDS, PSS, and revenue management systems. Maximum 8 characters per ATPCO convention.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) that maps this fare to an inventory bucket in the PSS (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, K). Controls seat availability and yield management in Amadeus Altéa and Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Physical cabin of service associated with this fare (e.g., first, business, premium_economy, economy). Determines the onboard product and service level entitlement for the passenger.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: changeable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the itinerary or date may be changed after ticketing (True) or is a fixed non-changeable fare (False). May be subject to a change fee defined in the associated fare rule.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: One or two-letter code representing the fare class grouping within the cabin (e.g., Y for full economy, B for discounted economy). Used in revenue management for yield optimization and load factor reporting.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: combinability_code
attributes.description: ATPCO code governing how this fare may be combined with other fares in a half-round-trip or end-on-end combination. Controls fare construction logic in GDS and PSS pricing engines.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare record was first ingested into the lakehouse silver layer from the source system (Sabre AirVision or ATPCO feed). Supports data lineage, audit, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the fare amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the settlement currency for BSP and ARC reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Resolution 728; BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Manual

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport or city code representing the arrival point of the fare's origin-destination city pair (e.g., LAX, CDG, NRT). Together with origin defines the O&D market for revenue management analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fare destination point. Used for international fare applicability, bilateral air service agreement compliance, and CORSIA carbon reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATA Resolution 728; CORSIA; ICAO Annex 9

attributes.name: directionality
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fare applies to a one-way journey, round-trip, circle trip, or open-jaw itinerary. Determines how the fare is combined in fare construction and pricing calculations.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: The date after which this fare is no longer valid for ticketing. A null value indicates the fare has no defined expiry. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing discontinue date field.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this fare becomes valid for ticketing and travel. Fares may not be sold or applied to itineraries before this date. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing effective date field.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: fare_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fare record: active (available for sale), inactive (not currently sellable), pending (filed but not yet effective), withdrawn (removed from filing), superseded (replaced by a newer fare version).
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: fare_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fare by its distribution and ownership model. Published fares are filed publicly via ATPCO/SITA; negotiated fares are corporate or agency-specific; private fares are not publicly visible in GDS; web fares are exclusive to direct channels; net fares are wholesale fares for consolidators. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: published|negotiated|private|web|net|consolidator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fare was originally filed with ATPCO, SITA, or the carrier's own system. Used for audit trails, regulatory compliance, and fare history analysis.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: global_indicator
attributes.description: IATA-defined two-letter code specifying the geographic routing area applicable to this fare (e.g., AT=Atlantic, PA=Pacific, TS=Trans-Siberian, AP=Asia-Pacific). Governs which routing rules and mileage systems apply for fare construction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AT|PA|TS|AP|SA|EH|FE|NA|PO|RU|US — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Fare Construction Rules; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: iata_fare_filing_ref
attributes.description: IATA-assigned reference number or identifier for the fare filing submission. Used for audit, dispute resolution, and cross-referencing with IATA BSP settlement records.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Manual; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this fare record in the lakehouse, including fare amount changes, status updates, or rule amendments. Supports data lineage and audit requirements.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: maximum_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before the return journey must commence. A null value indicates no maximum stay restriction.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: minimum_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare's conditions. Commonly used for round-trip leisure fares to prevent business travelers from using discounted fares.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport or city code representing the departure point of the fare's origin-destination city pair (e.g., JFK, LHR, SIN). Defines the directional applicability of the fare.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fare origin point. Used for regulatory compliance, DOT reporting, and country-of-sale restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: ownership
attributes.description: Identifies the filing channel through which this fare was submitted and is maintained: ATPCO (Airline Tariff Publishing Company), SITA (Société Internationale de Télécommunications Aéronautiques), or carrier-filed directly into the PSS.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; SITA Fare Distribution; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: owrt_indicator
attributes.description: ATPCO one-way/round-trip indicator: O=one-way only, R=round-trip only, X=either. Controls how the fare may be combined in half-round-trip pricing and fare construction.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter Passenger Type Code specifying the eligible passenger category for this fare (e.g., ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, INF=Infant, SRC=Senior, MIL=Military, STU=Student). Restricts fare applicability to qualifying passengers.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Type Codes; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: refundable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare is eligible for a cash refund upon cancellation (True) or is non-refundable (False). Critical for passenger service, revenue accounting, and DOT consumer protection compliance.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: ATPCO-assigned routing number that specifies the permitted intermediate points and carrier combinations for this fare. A value of '0' typically indicates a mileage-based fare with no specific routing restriction.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: sales_restriction
attributes.description: Defines geographic or channel restrictions on where this fare may be sold. Controls distribution eligibility across GDS, direct channels, and agency networks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_restriction|country_of_origin|carrier_office|internet_only|agency_only|consolidator_only — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific tariff under which this fare is filed (e.g., PUBL for published, PRIV for private). Determines the visibility and distribution rules in GDS channels.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: tariff_number
attributes.description: ATPCO tariff number identifying the rule set (conditions, restrictions, penalties) associated with this fare. Links the fare amount to its governing fare rules in the ATPCO database.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: ticketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter code of the carrier authorized to issue tickets under this fare. May differ from the operating carrier in codeshare and interline arrangements. Used for BSP settlement and ARC reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Manual; ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) Standards

attributes.name: travel_discontinue_date
attributes.description: The last date on which travel may be completed using this fare. Defines the travel validity window in conjunction with travel_effective_date.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

attributes.name: travel_effective_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which travel may commence using this fare. Distinct from the ticketing effective date; governs the travel window rather than the sale window.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Fare Construction Rules

products.name: fare_rule
products.description: Business rules governing the conditions of use for a fare basis — the regulatory and commercial constraints attached to a fare. Captures rule category (advance purchase, minimum/maximum stay, stopovers, transfers, combinability, blackout dates, seasonality, day-of-week restrictions, tour code requirements, penalties, refundability, endorsement/restriction text). References the parent fare and ATPCO rule category numbers (Cat 1–35). Owns the full rule text and structured rule parameters used by pricing engines and ticketing systems.
products.reference: ATPCO Category Rules (Cat 1–35)

attributes.name: fare_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fare rule record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: Fare rules often specify which booking classes (RBDs) they apply to. The fare_class_code attribute in fare_rule should reference the authoritative fare_class master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidi

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fare basis code to which this rule applies. Links the rule to its governing fare product in the revenue management system.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: advance_purchase_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours before departure by which the ticket must be purchased to qualify for this fare (ATPCO Cat 5). Null if no advance purchase requirement applies. Expressed in hours to accommodate sub-day requirements (e.g., 3-hour, 6-hour, 24-hour, 72-hour, 168-hour/7-day, 336-hour/14-day).

attributes.name: atpco_category_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Airline Tariff Publishing Company (ATPCO) Category Number
attributes.description: ATPCO rule category number (Cat 1–35) that classifies the type of restriction or condition this rule record governs. Examples: Cat 2 = Day/Time, Cat 3 = Seasonality, Cat 4 = Flight Application, Cat 5 = Advance Purchase, Cat 6 = Min Stay, Cat 7 = Max Stay, Cat 8 = Stopovers, Cat 9 = Transfers, Cat 14 = Travel Restrictions, Cat 15 = Sales Restrictions, Cat 16 = Penalties, Cat 31 = Voluntary Changes, Cat 33 = Voluntary Refunds.

attributes.name: blackout_end_date
attributes.description: End date of a travel blackout period during which this fare is not available for travel (ATPCO Cat 11). Null if no blackout period applies.

attributes.name: blackout_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of a travel blackout period during which this fare is not available for travel (ATPCO Cat 11 — Blackout Dates). Null if no blackout period applies. Multiple blackout periods should be stored as separate rule records.

attributes.name: cabin_type
attributes.description: Physical cabin of the aircraft to which this fare rule applies. Determines the service level and seating configuration associated with the fare.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline designator code of the validating carrier that owns and filed this fare rule. Identifies the airline responsible for the tariff.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Codes; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ATPCO rule category (e.g., 'Advance Purchase', 'Minimum Stay', 'Maximum Stay', 'Stopovers', 'Transfers', 'Penalties', 'Combinability', 'Blackout Dates', 'Seasonality', 'Day/Time Restrictions'). Derived from the ATPCO category number for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: change_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty charged to the passenger for a voluntary ticket change under this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 31). Expressed in the currency defined by change_fee_currency. Null if changes are not permitted or no fee applies.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 31 (Voluntary Changes); IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: change_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the change fee amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if no change fee applies.

attributes.name: combinability_type
attributes.description: Specifies how this fare may be combined with other fares to construct a complete itinerary (ATPCO Cat 10). 'end_on_end' = fares combined sequentially; 'back_to_back' = two one-way fares used together; 'open_jaw' = origin or destination differs on outbound/return; 'round_trip' = must be used as a round trip; 'none' = no combination permitted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare rule record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code for the destination to which this fare rule applies. Used to scope the rule to a specific arrival market. Null if the rule applies globally regardless of destination.

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: Date after which this fare rule is no longer applicable. Null indicates the rule is open-ended with no planned expiry. Corresponds to the ATPCO discontinue date field.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this fare rule becomes commercially effective and is applied by the pricing engine. Aligns with the ATPCO effective date field in the tariff filing.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: endorsement_text
attributes.description: Free-text endorsement or restriction box content that must be printed on the ticket (ATPCO Cat 20 — Endorsements). Contains regulatory or commercial restrictions such as 'NON-ENDORSE/NON-REROUTE', 'VALID ON XX ONLY', or 'NO REFUND AFTER DEPARTURE'. Required by IATA ticketing standards.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 20 (Endorsements); IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 253

attributes.name: global_indicator
attributes.description: IATA global indicator code that defines the geographic routing area for which this fare rule is valid. Determines the applicable IATA area and sub-area for international fare construction. Examples: AT = Atlantic, PA = Pacific, PN = Pacific/North America, EH = Eastern Hemisphere, WH = Western Hemisphere. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AT|PA|PN|PO|AP|EH|FE|TS|WH|ZA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Fare Construction Rules (IATA Timetable)

attributes.name: is_changeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ticket issued under this fare may be voluntarily changed (date, routing, or flight change) by the passenger (ATPCO Cat 31 — Voluntary Changes). True = changes permitted (possibly with fee); False = no changes allowed.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 31 (Voluntary Changes); DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fare is eligible for a monetary refund upon cancellation (ATPCO Cat 33 — Voluntary Refunds). True = refundable (possibly with penalty); False = non-refundable.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 33 (Voluntary Refunds); DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: max_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before the return journey must commence (ATPCO Cat 7). Null if no maximum stay restriction applies.

attributes.name: min_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 6). Null if no minimum stay applies. A value of 0 with a non-null field indicates a Sunday rule (must include a Saturday night).

attributes.name: min_stay_type
attributes.description: Qualifier for the minimum stay requirement. 'days' = calendar day count applies; 'saturday_night' = passenger must include a Saturday night at destination; 'none' = no minimum stay restriction.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code for the point of origin to which this fare rule applies. Used to scope the rule to a specific departure market. Null if the rule applies globally regardless of origin.

attributes.name: permitted_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of the week on which travel under this fare is permitted (ATPCO Cat 2 — Day/Time). Values: MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN. Null or empty means all days are permitted. Example: 'MON,TUE,WED,THU' restricts to weekday travel only.

attributes.name: refund_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty deducted from the refund amount when a passenger cancels a refundable ticket under this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 33). Expressed in the currency defined by refund_penalty_currency. Null if the fare is non-refundable or no penalty applies.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 33 (Voluntary Refunds); IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: refund_penalty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the refund penalty amount is denominated. Null if no refund penalty applies.

attributes.name: rule_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned rule number that groups related rule categories under a single tariff filing. Used by pricing engines to retrieve the full rule set for a fare basis. Corresponds to the ATPCO rule number field.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fare rule record. 'active' = currently in force and applied by pricing engines; 'inactive' = suspended or withdrawn; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer rule version; 'pending' = filed but not yet effective.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: rule_text
attributes.description: Complete free-text narrative of the fare rule as filed with ATPCO or the carrier's internal tariff system. Contains the full legal and commercial conditions of use. Used by ticketing agents and displayed in GDS fare displays.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 253

attributes.name: sales_restriction_type
attributes.description: Channel restriction governing where this fare may be sold (ATPCO Cat 15 — Sales Restrictions). 'internet_only' = only available via airline direct web/app; 'agency_only' = only through accredited travel agents; 'direct_only' = only via airline direct channels; 'gds_only' = only through Global Distribution Systems; 'none' = no channel restriction.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 15 (Sales Restrictions); IATA Resolution 728; GDS (Global Distribution System) Distribution Agreements

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Seasonal classification applied to this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 3 — Seasonality). Determines the travel season band in which the fare is valid. 'peak' = high-demand season; 'shoulder' = transitional season; 'off_peak' = low-demand season; 'none' = no seasonal restriction.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this fare rule was sourced. 'ATPCO' = Airline Tariff Publishing Company filing; 'SABRE' = Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; 'AMADEUS' = Amadeus Altéa; 'INTERNAL' = carrier's internal pricing system.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory; ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards

attributes.name: stopovers_permitted
attributes.description: Maximum number of stopovers (intentional interruptions of journey exceeding the Minimum Connecting Time) permitted under this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 8). A value of 0 means no stopovers allowed; null means unlimited.

attributes.name: tariff_number
attributes.description: ATPCO tariff number under which this rule is filed. Tariffs group fare rules by market type (e.g., domestic, international, specific bilateral markets). Used by GDS pricing engines to locate applicable rules.
attributes.references: ATPCO Tariff Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour operator or inclusive tour code required to be present on the ticket for this fare to be valid (ATPCO Cat 27 — Tour Conductor Discounts / inclusive tour requirements). Null if no tour code is required. Used for IT (Inclusive Tour) and BT (Bulk Tour) fares.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 27; IATA Resolution 728; BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Rules

attributes.name: transfers_permitted
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfers (connections within Minimum Connecting Time) permitted under this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 9). A value of 0 means no transfers allowed; null means unlimited.

attributes.name: travel_restriction_type
attributes.description: Directional travel restriction applied to this fare rule (ATPCO Cat 14 — Travel Restrictions). Specifies whether the rule applies to the outbound journey, inbound journey, or both directions of travel.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare rule record was most recently modified. Used to detect changes from the source ATPCO filing or Sabre AirVision Revenue Management system and support incremental data loads.

products.name: fare_class
products.description: Reference master for Reservation Booking Designators (RBDs) defining the booking class hierarchy — the inventory bucket alphabet that maps sellable seats to fare products. Each record defines a single RBD: cabin assignment (First/Business/Premium Economy/Economy), booking class letter code (Y, B, M, Q, etc.), fare class family grouping, yield class ranking within cabin, upgrade eligibility flag, mileage accrual multiplier, and revenue management bucket assignment. Serves as the bridge between inventory availability (how many seats to sell at each price point) and revenue accounting (what was actually sold and at what yield).
products.reference: IATA RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) Standard

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) fare class record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the fare_class master reference table.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) Standards

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.baggage_allowance. Business justification: Fare classes define included baggage allowances — a fundamental airline product design relationship. This drives ancillary upsell logic (what is chargeable vs. included), GDS display, and IATA ATPCO b

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Fare classes (booking classes/RBDs) are defined within specific cabin products, mapping service levels to pricing tiers. Foundational relationship for fare structure, revenue management, and inventory

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a ticket must be purchased to qualify for this fare class (e.g., 7, 14, 21 days).
