A value of 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement. Used by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management to enforce time-based fare restrictions and manage booking curve yield optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Restriction Rules; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: availability_control_method
attributes.description: Revenue management inventory control methodology applied to this fare class: leg = leg-based availability control; segment = segment-level control; od = Origin and Destination (O&D) control; virtual_nesting = virtual nesting across multiple fare classes. Determines how Sabre AirVision allocates and protects seat inventory for this RBD across the network.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Inventory Control Configuration; IATA RM Methodology Standards

attributes.name: award_redemption_class
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare class is designated as an FFP (Frequent Flyer Program) award redemption booking class (True), meaning seats in this class are allocated from the award inventory pool and redeemed using loyalty miles/points rather than cash. Award classes are managed separately in Oracle Loyalty Cloud and do not generate direct ticket revenue.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — Award Inventory Management; IATA Resolution 722 — FFP Award Standards

attributes.name: blackout_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare class is subject to blackout date restrictions (True), meaning it cannot be sold or used for travel during defined peak or holiday periods. When True, blackout dates are defined in the associated fare rule or seasonal restriction records. Relevant for both revenue fares and FFP award redemption classes.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Blackout Date Configuration; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: carry_on_bag_allowance
attributes.description: Number of carry-on baggage items (cabin bags) included at no additional charge for passengers traveling in this fare class. A value of 0 indicates no complimentary carry-on allowance (applicable to ultra-low-cost basic fare products). Feeds ancillary revenue calculation and gate agent enforcement workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 — Baggage Allowance Standards; FAA Carry-On Baggage Regulations

attributes.name: changeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the itinerary on a ticket issued in this fare class can be changed after purchase (True) or is a fixed, non-changeable booking (False). When True, change fees and fare difference rules defined in the associated fare rule record apply. Drives Amadeus Altéa PSS voluntary change workflow.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Rules; Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Voluntary Change Processing

attributes.name: checked_bag_allowance
attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included at no additional charge for passengers traveling in this fare class. A value of 0 indicates no complimentary checked baggage (e.g., basic economy). Drives ancillary baggage fee revenue calculation and EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) issuance logic in Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 — Baggage Allowance Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS — Baggage Rules Configuration

attributes.name: codeshare_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare class may be sold on codeshare-operated flights (True) or is restricted to the operating carrier's own metal only (False). Codeshare eligibility governs interline proration and revenue sharing agreements between partner airlines under BSP settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Interline Proration Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare class record was first created in the revenue management system. Provides audit trail for fare class configuration history and supports regulatory compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; IATA Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Specifies the permitted distribution channels through which this fare class may be sold: all = no channel restriction; gds_only = available only through Global Distribution System (GDS) channels; direct_only = available only through the airline's direct channels (website, app, airport); ndc_only = available only through IATA NDC-compliant channels; gds_and_direct = available through both GDS and direct channels. Critical for revenue management channel strategy and NDC migration tracking.
attributes.references: IATA NDC (New Distribution Capability) Standard; IATA Resolution 787 — Distribution Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this fare class definition becomes active and available for booking and inventory allocation in the PSS and revenue management system. Used to manage fare class lifecycle transitions and seasonal product introductions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — RBD Effective Date Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Class Activation

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this fare class definition is no longer active for new bookings. A null value indicates the fare class has no defined expiry and remains active indefinitely. Used to manage seasonal fare class retirement and product sunset timelines.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — RBD Lifecycle Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Class Deactivation

attributes.name: family
attributes.description: Grouping label that clusters related RBDs into a commercial fare product family (e.g., FLEX, SEMI-FLEX, SAVER, BASIC, BUSINESS_FLEX, BUSINESS_SAVER). Used by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management for fare family-level yield management, ancillary bundling rules, and customer-facing fare product presentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FLEX|SEMI-FLEX|SAVER|BASIC|BUSINESS_FLEX|BUSINESS_SAVER|LIGHT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Family Configuration; IATA NDC (New Distribution Capability) Offer Management

attributes.name: fare_basis_code_pattern
attributes.description: Alphanumeric pattern or prefix associated with fare basis codes that map to this fare class (e.g., 'YOW', 'BAPOW14', 'QSAVER21'). Fare basis codes are the detailed pricing identifiers used in ATPCO (Airline Tariff Publishing Company) fare filings and GDS displays. This field captures the naming convention pattern rather than individual fare basis codes, which are managed in the fare rule product.
attributes.references: ATPCO (Airline Tariff Publishing Company) Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: fare_class_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of this fare class, capturing its commercial purpose, target customer segment, and key product characteristics (e.g., 'Fully flexible full-fare economy class with unlimited changes and refunds, eligible for all upgrades and lounge access'). Used in internal revenue management documentation and business reporting.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Fare Class Documentation Standards

attributes.name: fare_class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fare class record: active = currently in use for booking and inventory control; inactive = suspended from sale but retained for historical reference; deprecated = permanently retired RBD no longer used in any market; seasonal = active only during defined seasonal periods. Governs whether the RBD is available for inventory allocation in the PSS.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — RBD Lifecycle Management; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: interline_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued in this fare class may be used on interline itineraries involving other carriers under interline ticketing agreements (True) or are restricted to the issuing carrier's own flights only (False). Interline eligibility affects BSP settlement, ARC reporting, and proration calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Interline Ticketing Agreements; ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) Interline Settlement

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this fare class record in the revenue management system. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion pipeline and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; IATA Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: lounge_access_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether airport lounge access is included as a bundled benefit for passengers traveling in this fare class (True) or is not included (False). Typically True for premium cabin classes (First, Business) and certain elite fare products. Drives lounge access entitlement checks at airport ground operations.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform — Lounge Access Entitlement; IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Product Benefits

attributes.name: max_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before the return journey must commence, as required by this fare class. A null value indicates no maximum stay restriction. Enforced during ticketing by the Amadeus Altéa PSS fare calculation engine.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Rules; Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Fare Rule Enforcement

attributes.name: mileage_accrual_multiplier
attributes.description: Decimal multiplier applied to base flight distance (in miles or kilometers) to calculate Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles/points earned when a ticket is issued in this fare class. For example, 1.00 = 100% accrual, 0.50 = 50% accrual, 1.50 = 150% elite bonus accrual. A value of 0.00 indicates no mileage accrual (e.g., deeply discounted or award redemption classes). Feeds Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP accrual calculation engine.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud — FFP Accrual Rules; IATA Resolution 722 — Frequent Flyer Program Standards

attributes.name: min_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare class (e.g., Saturday night stay requirement = 1 day minimum). A value of 0 indicates no minimum stay requirement. Used to prevent business travelers from arbitraging leisure fares.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Rules; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Stay Restriction Configuration

attributes.name: no_show_fee_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a no-show penalty fee is charged when a passenger holding a ticket in this fare class fails to cancel before departure and does not board the flight (True). No-show fees are an ancillary revenue stream tracked in SAP S/4HANA and reported in ARC settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Rules; ARC Settlement Standards; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: overbooking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether seats sold in this fare class are included in the overbooking authorization calculation (True) or are excluded from overbooking (e.g., group blocks, charter allocations, staff travel) (False). Overbooking-eligible classes contribute to the denied boarding risk pool managed by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Configuration; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding Compensation

attributes.name: priority_boarding_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether priority boarding access is included as a bundled benefit for passengers traveling in this fare class (True) or must be purchased separately as an ancillary service (False). Relevant for fare product differentiation and ancillary revenue attribution in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform — Boarding Sequence Configuration; IATA NDC Ancillary Services Standards

attributes.name: rbd_code
attributes.description: Single uppercase alphabetic character representing the booking class letter code (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, H, K, L, V, W, S, T, G, E, N, R, O, X, I, J, C, D, Z, F, A, P, U) as defined by IATA Resolution 728. This is the inventory bucket identifier used in the Global Distribution System (GDS) and Passenger Service System (PSS) to control seat availability at each price point.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) Standards; Amadeus Altéa Inventory RBD Configuration

attributes.name: refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued in this fare class are eligible for a monetary refund upon cancellation (True) or are non-refundable (False). Non-refundable fares may still qualify for travel credit or voucher issuance depending on fare rules. Critical for revenue accounting, BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) settlement, and ARC reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Rules; ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) Settlement Standards; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: revenue_class_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the commercial nature of this fare class for revenue accounting and BSP/ARC settlement purposes: revenue = standard commercial fare generating ticket revenue; award = FFP redemption (no cash revenue); staff = employee/industry discount travel; charter = charter block-seat allocation; group = group booking class; tour_operator = wholesale tour operator allocation. Drives revenue recognition rules in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Fare Classification; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; ARC Settlement Standards

attributes.name: same_day_change_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued in this fare class qualify for same-day confirmed flight changes (True) or are restricted to the originally booked flight (False). Drives customer service agent workflows in the Amadeus Altéa PSS and is a key commercial differentiator between fare products.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Same-Day Change Rules; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: seat_selection_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance seat selection is included at no additional charge for passengers booking this fare class (True) or whether seat selection requires an additional ancillary fee (False). Drives ancillary seat revenue calculation and the seat map availability display in the booking engine.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Seat Assignment Rules; IATA NDC Offer and Order Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this fare class record originated: SABRE_AV = Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; AMADEUS_ALTEA = Amadeus Altéa Inventory PSS; MANUAL = manually entered configuration; ATPCO = sourced from ATPCO fare filing. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Source System Registry; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: standby_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers holding tickets in this fare class may be placed on the standby list for an earlier or alternative flight at no additional charge (True) or are restricted from standby (False). Relevant for same-day change and irregular operations (IROP) reprotection workflows.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS — Standby Queue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding Compensation

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets booked in this fare class are eligible for complimentary or paid cabin upgrades (True) or are explicitly excluded from upgrade consideration (False). Upgrade eligibility is enforced at check-in and gate by the Amadeus Altéa PSS and is a key differentiator between fare products in the same cabin.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation — Upgrade Eligibility Rules; IATA Resolution 735 — Upgrade Policies

attributes.name: yield_class_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of this RBD within its cabin by revenue yield, where 1 represents the highest-yielding (most expensive) booking class and higher numbers represent progressively lower-yielding classes. Used by the revenue management system to sequence inventory bucket availability — higher-ranked (lower-yield) classes are closed first as load factor increases, protecting higher-yield inventory. Directly drives RASK (Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer) optimization logic.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Booking Class Hierarchy; IATA RM Best Practices

products.name: pricing_record
products.description: Transactional record of a fare quote or pricing calculation event generated by the pricing engine for a specific itinerary and passenger type combination. Captures the priced itinerary (origin, destination, routing, flight segments), total fare amount, tax breakdown, surcharges (YQ/YR fuel surcharge, carrier-imposed fees), passenger type code (ADT/CHD/INF), fare basis codes applied per segment, pricing date, ticketing time limit, form of payment restrictions, and pricing source (GDS, direct, NDC). Represents the SSOT for how a specific booking was priced before ticketing.
products.reference: IATA Pricing and Ticketing / Sabre AirVision Pricing

attributes.name: pricing_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pricing calculation event generated by the pricing engine. Primary key of this table.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: Pricing quotes generated for travel agencies should reference the agency master. This enables agency-specific pricing and commission tracking. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.bundle. Business justification: Pricing quotes in airline reservation systems must track which fare family/ancillary bundle was selected during shopping. Revenue management and offer construction depend on this link to calculate tot

attributes.name: corporate_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.corporate_contract. Business justification: Pricing calculations can apply corporate contract discounts. This links the pricing event to the contract being applied. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Pricing decisions are attributed to cost centers for revenue management accountability and performance tracking. Links RM actions to financial outcomes.

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: RM pricing audit and post-departure revenue analysis require knowing which fare_class_bucket was open when a pricing_record was created. Bucket availability (booking_limit, protection_level) at time o

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: Pricing records capture the booking_class (RBD) that was quoted. This should reference the authoritative fare_class master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict. booking_class remains

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Pricing calculations should capture which fare family (branded fare) was quoted. This enables revenue analysis by brand tier. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: Pricing records are generated from fare definitions. A pricing_record represents a quote/calculation event based on a specific fare basis. The fare_basis_code attribute in pricing_record should refere

attributes.name: fare_quote_id
attributes.description: The native quote or pricing solution identifier assigned by the GDS (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport) when the fare was priced through a GDS channel. Null for direct or NDC-sourced pricing. Used for GDS billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa PSS; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Pricing quotes are generated from real-time flight inventory availability. Revenue management systems query specific flight inventory to calculate fares, apply booking class availability, and generate

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger profile for whom this fare was priced. Links the pricing event to the traveller identity in the Passenger domain.

attributes.name: tax_fee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pricing Tax Breakdown - Tax Fee Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the tax/fee reference master record that defines the tax type, rate, and remittance rules.

attributes.name: validating_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: The validating carrier on a pricing record is the BSP settlement party. Carrier-level pricing analytics, NDC offer management, and BSP remittance reconciliation require linking pricing records to the

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Number of days before departure that the ticket must be purchased to qualify for this fare, as defined in the fare rules. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement. Key yield management parameter.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount of this tax or fee applied to this specific pricing record. May differ from the reference rate_amount on tax_fee due to proration across segments, minimum/maximum caps, or passenger-type exemptions. This is the amount that appears on the ticket and is remitted to the collecting authority.

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: The net fare amount before taxes, fees, and surcharges, expressed in the pricing currency. Represents the airline's revenue component used for yield and RASK calculations. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT Form 41; ARC Reporting Standards

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) / inventory class in which the fare was priced (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V). Determines seat availability consumption in the inventory system.

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: Physical cabin of service associated with the priced fare. Derived from the booking class mapping. Used for revenue reporting segmentation by cabin.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The monetary or numeric value against which the tax rate was applied to derive the applied_amount. For ad valorem taxes, this is the base fare amount; for per-segment taxes, this is the segment count; for flat taxes, this is 1. Enables audit and reconciliation of the tax calculation.

attributes.name: carrier_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Total carrier-imposed surcharges (YQ fuel surcharge and YR carrier-imposed fees) applied to this fare. Distinct from government taxes; retained by the carrier. Critical for revenue accounting and BSP settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA YQ/YR Surcharge Guidelines; BSP Manual

attributes.name: changeable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the priced fare permits voluntary changes (True) or is a no-change fare (False). If True, change fees and fare difference rules from the fare basis apply.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was first persisted to the Silver Layer data store. Audit field for data lineage tracking. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the fare was originally priced (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for BSP settlement and multi-currency revenue accounting. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the journey destination point used in the fare construction. Defines the end of the priced itinerary.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: equivalent_fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount converted to IATA Neutral Units of Construction (NUC) or the airline's reporting currency equivalent. Used for international fare construction, proration, and interline settlement where fares are built in NUC and converted via IATA Rate of Exchange (ROE).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Rate of Exchange (ROE) Manual

attributes.name: exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger was exempt from this tax on this specific pricing record (e.g., diplomatic exemption, infant exemption, government traveller exemption). When true, the applied_amount is zero but the tax line is retained for audit and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Type Code Exemption Rules

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Primary IATA fare basis code applied to the priced itinerary (e.g., YLOWUS, QHXAP). Encodes the fare class, booking class, seasonality, advance purchase, and restriction conditions. For multi-segment itineraries, this represents the governing fare basis code.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: fare_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fare by its commercial nature. PUBLIC = filed public tariff fare; PRIVATE = unpublished/private fare; NEGOTIATED = corporate or agency negotiated rate; CORPORATE = corporate account fare; NET = net fare for consolidators; TOUR = inclusive tour fare. Impacts revenue accounting and BSP settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; ARC Reporting Standards; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: form_of_payment_restriction
attributes.description: Any restriction on the form of payment permitted for this fare. NONE = no restriction; CREDIT_CARD_ONLY = must be paid by credit card; CASH_ONLY = cash payment required; SPECIFIC_CARD = restricted to a specific card type or issuer; MILES_ONLY = award redemption only. Impacts checkout and payment processing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; PCI DSS; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: iata_rate_of_exchange
attributes.description: The IATA-published Rate of Exchange (ROE) used to convert the NUC fare amount to the local pricing currency at the time of pricing. Required for international fare construction and interline proration under IATA Resolution 722.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Rate of Exchange Manual

attributes.name: max_stay_requirement
attributes.description: Maximum stay condition attached to the fare rule (e.g., '1M' for one month, '30D' for 30 days). Null if no maximum stay applies. Constrains the return travel date for round-trip fares.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: min_stay_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum stay condition attached to the fare rule (e.g., 'SU' for Sunday night stay, '3D' for 3 days). Null if no minimum stay applies. Used for round-trip fare rule validation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: ndc_offer_reference
attributes.description: Unique offer identifier assigned by the airline's NDC offer engine when the fare was priced via an IATA NDC-compliant channel. Null for GDS or legacy-sourced pricing. Enables NDC order management and settlement.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the journey origin point used in the fare construction. Defines the start of the priced itinerary.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA-standard Passenger Type Code (PTC) indicating the traveller category used for fare calculation. ADT = Adult; CHD = Child; INF = Infant; YTH = Youth; MIL = Military; SRC = Senior. Determines applicable fare rules and discount eligibility.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Passenger Type Codes

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric booking reference (PNR locator) in the Passenger Service System (PSS) to which this pricing record is associated. Links the fare quote to the reservation context.

attributes.name: pricing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the fare was priced. Used to determine applicable fare rules, advance purchase requirements, and seasonality. Distinct from the ticketing date and travel date.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: pricing_source
attributes.description: The distribution channel or system through which this fare was priced. GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport); DIRECT = airline direct website/app; NDC = IATA New Distribution Capability; API = third-party API; INTERLINE = interline agreement pricing; CODESHARE = codeshare partner pricing.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard (PADIS); IATA Resolution 787; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: pricing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing record. QUOTED = fare quote generated but not yet ticketed; TICKETED = fare has been issued as an e-ticket; EXPIRED = ticketing time limit passed without issuance; CANCELLED = booking cancelled; REPRICED = superseded by a subsequent pricing event; VOIDED = ticket voided post-issuance.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: pricing_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the pricing engine generated this fare quote or pricing calculation. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: quote_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the pricing engine (Sabre AirVision) to this specific fare quote or pricing calculation event. Used for audit trail and repricing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the priced fare is refundable (True) or non-refundable (False) per the applicable fare rules. Critical for customer service, revenue protection, and DOT consumer protection compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; EASA Consumer Rights

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: The scheduled departure date of the return journey for round-trip fares. Null for one-way fares. Used for minimum/maximum stay rule validation in fare construction.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: routing_code
attributes.description: IATA routing code or routing number associated with the fare basis, specifying permitted intermediate points and carrier combinations for the priced itinerary. Governs which connecting points are allowed under the fare rules.

attributes.name: segment_count
attributes.description: Total number of flight segments (individual flight legs) included in the priced itinerary. Used to identify direct vs. connecting itineraries and for proration calculations on multi-segment fares.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all government-imposed taxes applied to this fare (e.g., US Federal Excise Tax, PFC, international departure/arrival taxes). Collected on behalf of taxing authorities and remitted via BSP/ARC. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IRS Revenue Ruling; DOT 14 CFR Part 399; BSP Manual

attributes.name: tax_sequence_number
attributes.description: The IATA-mandated display order of this tax line within the full tax breakdown for the pricing record. Determines the order in which taxes appear on the ticket and in BSP/ARC settlement files. Sequence is specific to this pricing record's tax manifest.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722f, Ticket Tax Box Sequencing

attributes.name: ticketing_time_limit
attributes.description: The deadline by which the e-ticket must be issued to honour this fare quote. After this timestamp, the fare quote expires and the booking must be repriced. Critical for revenue management and seat inventory control.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa PSS; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: total_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total amount payable by the passenger: base fare + taxes + carrier surcharges. This is the amount displayed to the customer and collected at ticketing. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Compliant with DOT full-fare advertising rules.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 399 (Full-Fare Advertising); BSP Manual

attributes.name: travel_date
attributes.description: The scheduled departure date of the first flight segment in the priced itinerary. Used for advance purchase rule validation, seasonality determination, and revenue period attribution.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: trip_type
attributes.description: Classification of the itinerary structure. OW = One-Way; RT = Round-Trip; OJ = Open-Jaw; CT = Circle Trip. Determines fare construction method and applicable fare rules under IATA Resolution 722.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pricing record (e.g., status change from QUOTED to TICKETED, repricing event). Audit field for change tracking. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

products.name: tax_fee
products.description: Reference master for all government-mandated taxes, carrier-imposed fees, and airport charges applicable to air tickets. Defines tax/fee code (IATA standard tax codes), tax name, collecting authority (government, airport, carrier), tax type (ad valorem percentage, flat amount, per-segment), currency, applicability rules (domestic/international, route-specific, passenger type), effective and expiry dates, and remittance destination. Used by pricing engines to construct the full ticket price breakdown and by revenue accounting for tax remittance.
products.reference: IATA Tax Code Standard / ATPCO Tax Filing

attributes.name: tax_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax or fee record in the reference master. Primary key for the tax_fee data product.

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Airport-specific taxes and fees (Passenger Facility Charges, airport improvement fees, departure taxes) are directly tied to a specific station. The station FK enables tax applicability validation, PF

attributes.name: applicability_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax or fee applies to domestic itineraries, international itineraries, or both. A key filter used by the pricing engine when constructing the tax breakdown for a ticket.

attributes.name: cabin_class_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the cabin class to which this tax or fee applies: all (applies regardless of cabin), economy, premium_economy, business, first. Certain taxes (e.g., UK Air Passenger Duty Band B) vary by cabin class.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; UK Air Passenger Duty Legislation

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Defines how the tax or fee amount is computed: flat_amount (fixed monetary amount per occurrence), ad_valorem_percent (percentage of the applicable fare or charge base), per_segment (charged once per flight segment), per_coupon (charged per ticket coupon), per_pax_per_direction (charged per passenger per direction of travel). Drives the pricing engine calculation logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Tax Configuration

attributes.name: collecting_authority_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the authority or entity to which the collected tax or fee must be remitted (e.g., 'Internal Revenue Service', 'Heathrow Airport Holdings', 'EUROCONTROL'). Used in remittance instructions and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: collecting_authority_type
attributes.description: Category of the entity legally mandated to collect and remit the tax or fee: government (national or sub-national tax authority), airport_operator (airport authority or concessionaire), carrier (airline collecting on behalf of itself), intergovernmental (body such as EUROCONTROL). Determines remittance workflow and BSP/ARC settlement routing.

attributes.name: corsia_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax or fee is related to or counts toward CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation) compliance obligations (True) or is unrelated to carbon/environmental compliance (False).
attributes.references: CORSIA; ICAO Doc 9501; IATA Environmental Programme

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax or fee record was first created in the revenue management reference master. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements for the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the tax or fee rate_amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Null or not applicable for ad_valorem_percent types where the rate is a dimensionless percentage.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the arrival country to which this tax or fee applies. Null if the tax applies globally or is not destination-country-specific. Used in conjunction with origin_country_code for bilateral tax rule matching.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this tax or fee rate and rules become effective and must be applied to new ticket issuances. Aligns with the IATA ticketing date convention for tax applicability.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: exempt_passenger_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA Passenger Type Codes (PTCs) or categories that are legally exempt from this tax or fee (e.g., 'INF,DIP,GOV' for infants, diplomatic, and government passengers). Null if no exemptions apply. Used by the pricing engine to suppress the tax for qualifying passengers.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA PTC Standard; ICAO Doc 9562

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this tax or fee record is no longer applicable to new ticket issuances. Null for open-ended taxes with no legislated sunset date. Enables the pricing engine to apply only currently valid tax rules.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: gds_display_code
attributes.description: The tax or fee code as it appears in GDS (Global Distribution System) displays and fare quote responses (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). May differ from the IATA tax_code in legacy GDS implementations. Used for GDS reconciliation and agency settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa PSS; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA general ledger account code to which collected amounts for this tax or fee are posted in the revenue accounting system. Ensures correct financial reporting and tax liability tracking on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IATA Resolution 728; IFRS 15

attributes.name: iata_tax_category
attributes.description: IATA-defined category distinguishing the nature of the charge as published in the IATA Tax Code Directory: tax (government-mandated levy), fee (service-based charge), charge (airport or infrastructure charge), surcharge (carrier-imposed additional charge such as fuel surcharge YQ/YR).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax or fee record was most recently modified in the revenue management reference master. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: maximum_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary amount of the tax or fee that may be collected, capping the calculated value. Applicable to ad_valorem_percent taxes with a legislated ceiling. Denominated in currency_code. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monetary amount of the tax or fee that must be collected, regardless of the calculated value. Applicable primarily to ad_valorem_percent taxes where the computed amount could fall below a legislated floor. Denominated in currency_code.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the departure country to which this tax or fee applies. Null if the tax applies globally or is not origin-country-specific. Used by the pricing engine for route-specific tax applicability filtering.

attributes.name: passenger_type_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies which IATA passenger type codes (PTCs) are subject to this tax or fee: all (applies to every passenger type), adult, child, infant, unaccompanied_minor. Certain taxes (e.g., UK APD) have reduced or zero rates for infants.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Passenger Type Code (PTC) Standard

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collecting authority officially published or announced this tax or fee rate or rule change. Distinct from effective_date; used for advance notice compliance tracking and pricing team workflow management.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount or percentage rate of the tax or fee. For flat_amount and per-segment/per-coupon types, this is the fixed charge value. For ad_valorem_percent, this is the percentage rate (e.g., 7.5 for 7.5%). Interpreted in conjunction with calculation_method.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax or fee is refundable to the passenger upon ticket cancellation or refund (True) or is non-refundable (False). Drives the refund calculation logic in the Passenger Service System and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific legislation, regulation, or IATA resolution that mandates or authorizes this tax or fee (e.g., 'US Internal Revenue Code Section 4261', 'UK Finance Act 1994 Section 28', 'IATA Resolution 728'). Supports regulatory compliance documentation and audit.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ICAO Doc 9562; National Tax Legislation

attributes.name: remittance_channel
attributes.description: The settlement channel through which collected tax amounts are remitted: bsp (IATA Billing and Settlement Plan), arc (Airlines Reporting Corporation), direct_to_authority (direct payment to government or airport), interline_settlement (via interline billing agreement). Drives the revenue accounting remittance workflow.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: remittance_destination_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the remittance destination account or clearing body (e.g., BSP country code, ARC settlement code, or government tax authority reference). Used by revenue accounting to route tax remittance payments correctly.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: route_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax or fee is applicable only to specific origin-destination route pairs (True) or applies broadly based on country/airport-level rules (False). When True, origin_country_code, destination_country_code, and/or airport_code fields define the specific applicability.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Tax Configuration

attributes.name: sap_tax_code
attributes.description: The corresponding tax code as configured in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module for general ledger posting and tax remittance processing. Enables automated mapping between the IATA tax_code and the SAP financial accounting tax configuration for revenue accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: superseded_by_tax_code
attributes.description: The IATA tax code of the successor record when this tax or fee has been superseded (status = superseded). Enables the pricing engine and revenue accounting to trace the lineage of tax code changes and apply the correct current code.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The fare component or amount upon which an ad_valorem_percent tax is calculated: base_fare (net fare excluding taxes), total_fare (gross fare including other charges), fuel_surcharge (applied only to the YQ/YR surcharge component), carrier_imposed_fee, ticket_price. Relevant only for ad_valorem_percent calculation_method.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Tax Configuration

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: IATA-standard two-to-four character alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tax or fee (e.g., US, YQ, YR, GB, DE). Used by pricing engines, GDS, and BSP settlement to identify and apply the correct charge on a ticket.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Tax Code Directory

attributes.name: tax_fee_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the tax or fee record: active (currently in force and applicable), inactive (no longer applicable), superseded (replaced by a newer version of the same tax code), pending (approved but not yet effective). Controls whether the pricing engine includes this record in tax calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: tax_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the tax or fee as published by the collecting authority (e.g., 'US Federal Excise Tax', 'UK Air Passenger Duty', 'Airport Passenger Facility Charge'). Displayed on passenger itineraries and tax remittance reports.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the charge: government_tax (legislated by a national or regional authority), airport_charge (levied by an airport operator), carrier_surcharge (carrier-imposed fee such as fuel or insurance surcharge), security_fee (security-related government levy), passenger_facility_charge (PFC levied by US airports under FAA authority), environmental_levy (carbon or environmental charge such as CORSIA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: government_tax|airport_charge|carrier_surcharge|security_fee|passenger_facility_charge|environmental_levy|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; FAA PFC Program; CORSIA

attributes.name: ticket_type_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the ticket document type to which this tax or fee applies: all, e_ticket (electronic ticket), paper_ticket, emd (Electronic Miscellaneous Document). Most modern taxes apply to all ticket types, but some legacy charges are document-type-specific.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this tax or fee record, incremented each time the rate, rules, or applicability conditions are updated by the collecting authority. Enables historical rate tracking and audit trail for tax remittance reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; SAP S/4HANA Change Management

attributes.name: waivable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has authority to waive this tax or fee under specific circumstances (True) or whether collection is legally mandatory and cannot be waived (False). Relevant for IROP (Irregular Operations) handling and diplomatic/government fare exemptions.

products.name: yield_parameter
products.description: Revenue management configuration record defining yield management parameters and optimization settings for a specific market, route, or flight group. Stores bid price curves, booking class availability thresholds, load factor targets, revenue per available seat kilometer (RASK) targets, cost per available seat kilometer (CASK) benchmarks, minimum acceptable yield floors, overbooking authorization levels, spoilage and dilution tolerance settings, and forecast model weights. Owned by the Revenue Management team and aligned with Sabre AirVision RM optimization modules.
products.reference: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management / IATA RM Best Practices

attributes.name: yield_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the yield management parameter configuration record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Revenue management systems set yield parameters (load factor targets, overbooking authorization rates, dynamic pricing floors) per aircraft type because seat capacity and cabin mix differ by type. An

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Yield parameters (load_factor_target, overbooking_authorization_rate, dynamic_pricing_ceiling) are always cabin-specific in RM systems. An RM analyst configuring yield parameters for Business vs Econo

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: yield_parameter is a revenue management configuration record that defines optimization settings at the booking class level. Currently cabin_class (STRING) is stored as a denormalized reference with no

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Yield management parameters can be configured at the fare family level (branded fare optimization). This links yield management settings to the fare family being optimized. Standard N:1 relationship.

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: Yield parameters define revenue management optimization settings (RASK targets, load factor targets, overbooking rates, bid price curves) that are configured FOR specific fare contexts. The yield_para

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Revenue management teams configure yield parameters (load factor targets, overbooking rates, dynamic pricing floors/ceilings) at the route level. This FK enables route-level yield optimization reports

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Yield parameters are season-specific (IATA summer/winter seasons drive distinct demand curves and overbooking rates). Revenue management configures separate parameter sets per season. The existing sea

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Revenue Manager who authorized this yield parameter configuration for production use. Supports audit trail and governance accountability.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: booking_class_threshold_count
attributes.description: Number of booking class availability thresholds (authorization levels) configured for this yield parameter set. Defines how many fare class buckets are actively managed by the RM optimization engine.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: cancellation_rate
attributes.description: Historical booking cancellation rate (0.0000–1.0000) for this market or route, used alongside no-show rate to calibrate overbooking levels and availability controls.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: cask_benchmark
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK) Benchmark
attributes.description: Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK) benchmark in the operating currency used as the cost floor reference for yield optimization decisions. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO cost accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Economics; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yield parameter configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary yield parameters (RASK target, CASK benchmark, yield floor, pricing bounds) are expressed for this configuration.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination point of the market or route to which this yield parameter applies. Null for global or flight-group-level parameters.

attributes.name: dilution_tolerance
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable revenue dilution rate — the percentage of passengers who could have paid a higher fare but were sold a lower fare class. Constrains how aggressively lower booking classes are opened.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_ceiling
attributes.description: Maximum fare amount (in operating currency) above which the dynamic pricing engine is not permitted to set a fare for this market or route. Prevents consumer protection violations and brand damage.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations; IATA Dynamic Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic (continuous) pricing is enabled for this yield parameter configuration. When true, the RM engine applies real-time fare adjustments within authorized bounds rather than discrete fare class steps.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Dynamic Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_floor
attributes.description: Minimum fare amount (in operating currency) below which the dynamic pricing engine is not permitted to set a fare for this market or route. Protects against revenue dilution under automated pricing.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Dynamic Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this yield parameter configuration becomes active and is applied by the RM optimization engine. Aligns with schedule season or pricing period start.
attributes.references: IATA Scheduling Guidelines; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this yield parameter configuration expires and is no longer applied. Null for open-ended configurations. Aligns with schedule season or pricing period end.
attributes.references: IATA Scheduling Guidelines; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days ahead for which the demand forecast is generated and applied in yield optimization. Defines the planning window for booking class availability controls.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: Type of demand forecasting model applied by the RM optimization engine for this parameter set. Determines how historical booking curves and pickup patterns are weighted in availability decisions.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: group_booking_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of passengers (Pax) that qualifies a booking as a group booking, triggering separate group inventory controls and pricing rules distinct from individual seat availability management.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: historical_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor (0.0000–1.0000) applied to historical booking data in the blended demand forecast model. Higher values favor historical patterns; lower values favor recent pickup trends. Must sum to 1.0 with pickup_weight.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this yield parameter configuration was most recently reviewed by the Revenue Management team. Supports governance tracking and parameter staleness detection.

attributes.name: load_factor_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable load factor threshold below which the RM system triggers promotional availability or fare class opening actions. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: load_factor_target
attributes.description: Target load factor (percentage of available seats filled with revenue passengers) for this market or route configuration. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Balances spoilage risk against dilution risk in RM optimization.
attributes.references: IATA Economics; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: minimum_yield_floor
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable yield (revenue per Revenue Passenger Kilometer) below which seat inventory must not be sold. Acts as the absolute revenue protection floor in bid price calculations. Expressed in operating currency per RPK.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: no_show_rate
attributes.description: Historical no-show rate (0.0000–1.0000) for this market or route, used as an input to overbooking authorization calculations. Sourced from Amadeus Altéa PSS departure control data.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: od_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether origin-destination (O&D) network revenue management control is active for this parameter set. When true, the RM engine optimizes across connecting itineraries rather than leg-by-leg.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: optimization_method
attributes.description: Optimization algorithm applied by Sabre AirVision for seat inventory allocation under this parameter set. EMSR-A and EMSR-B are Expected Marginal Seat Revenue variants; LP-based and network bid price methods support O&D (origin-destination) optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin point of the market or route to which this yield parameter applies. Null for global or flight-group-level parameters.

attributes.name: overbooking_authorization_rate
attributes.description: Authorized overbooking percentage above physical seat capacity for this market or route. Expressed as a percentage above 100% (e.g., 5.00 means 5% above capacity). Governed by DOT consumer protection regulations and airline denied boarding policy.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this yield parameter configuration within Sabre AirVision RM. Used for cross-system reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: parameter_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing business context for this yield parameter configuration, including rationale for non-standard settings, market conditions, or special events driving the configuration.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the yield parameter configuration, e.g., 'TRANSATLANTIC_PEAK_SUMMER_2025'. Used for display and reporting in revenue management dashboards.

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the yield parameter configuration record. Active records are applied by the RM optimization engine; draft records are under review; archived records are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the scope at which this yield parameter applies: market-level, route-level, flight-group-level, cabin-level, or global default. Determines the optimization hierarchy in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: pickup_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor (0.0000–1.0000) applied to recent booking pickup trend data in the blended demand forecast model. Complements historical_weight; both must sum to 1.0.

attributes.name: rask_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer (RASK) Target
attributes.description: Target Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer (RASK) in the operating currency for this market or route configuration. Expressed as revenue per ASK. Used as the primary revenue performance benchmark in RM optimization.
attributes.references: IATA Economics; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which the Revenue Management team reviews and potentially updates this yield parameter configuration. Drives the RM governance and parameter maintenance workflow.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: spoilage_tolerance
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable seat spoilage rate (percentage of seats departing empty) tolerated before the RM system adjusts availability controls to open lower fare classes. Expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yield parameter configuration record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

products.name: ticket
products.description: Electronic ticket (e-ticket) master record representing the issued travel document for a passenger. Stores ticket number (13-digit IATA format), issuing carrier code, issuing office/IATA location identifier, ticket issue date and time, passenger name, passenger type code, form of payment, total fare amount, tax total, net remit amount, ticket status (open/used/refunded/voided/exchanged/lifted), conjunction ticket indicator, tour code, endorsement/restriction text, original ticket number (for exchanges), and BSP/ARC reporting indicator. SSOT for issued ticket lifecycle.
products.reference: IATA Resolution 722 (e-Ticket) / ARC/BSP Ticket Record

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ticket

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: Tickets sold through travel agencies should reference the agency master. This enables agency performance tracking and commission calculation. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Tickets sold through BSP channels are included in BSP settlement batches. The ticket should reference which BSP settlement batch it was included in. This is a temporal FK (populated during billing cyc

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every ticket is issued by a legal entity (company code) for IFRS 15 revenue recognition, consolidated financial reporting, and regulatory compliance. Essential for multi-entity airline groups.

attributes.name: corporate_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.corporate_contract. Business justification: Tickets can be issued under corporate contracts. This links the ticket to the negotiated contract terms. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: fare_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_class. Business justification: Tickets have a booking_class attribute that should reference the authoritative fare_class master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict. booking_class remains as denormalized lookup.

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Tickets are issued under branded fare families (Basic Economy, Main Cabin, Premium, etc.). While fare_family_id already exists in ndc_offer_order, traditional tickets should also reference the fare fa

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: Tickets are issued based on a specific fare. The fare_basis_code in ticket should reference the authoritative fare master record. This establishes which published/private fare was used for the ticket

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Tickets must track FFP member for mileage accrual posting, tier recognition, and revenue attribution. Core operational link between revenue capture and loyalty program. Replaces denormalized ffp_membe

attributes.name: issuing_crew_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crew.crew_member. Business justification: Tracks crew member who manually issued ticket at airport counter/service desk. Required for crew sales performance tracking, commission calculation for crew-issued tickets, and audit trail. Existing i

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger master record associated with this ticket. Links the ticket to the traveller's profile for loyalty, reporting, and personalisation. PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: FK to reservation.pnr.pnr_id — Tickets are issued against PNR bookings. This link enables revenue-to-booking traceability for refund processing, exchange handling, and revenue recognition against booking context.

attributes.name: pricing_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.pricing_record. Business justification: Tickets are issued based on a pricing calculation event. The pricing_record captures the quote/calculation that led to the ticket issuance. This establishes the audit trail from ticket back to the pri

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Tickets are issued for travel on specific routes; route determines applicable fare rules, bilateral agreements, traffic rights, and revenue recognition treatment. Critical for revenue accounting, inte

attributes.name: ticketing_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: The ticketing carrier is the BSP settlement party responsible for the ticket. Carrier-level revenue accounting, BSP remittance reconciliation, and IATA billing require linking tickets to the authorita

attributes.name: travel_identity_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to passenger.travel_identity_document. Business justification: APIS/Secure Flight compliance requires airlines to link each issued ticket to the specific identity document verified at ticketing. Regulators (TSA, ICAO) mandate this audit trail. Aviation compliance

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: The published or negotiated base fare amount before taxes, fees, and surcharges, expressed in the ticket's fare currency. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for yield calculation (revenue per RPK), RASK, and BSP/ARC settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA ATPCO; DOT Form 41; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter Reservation Booking Designator (RBD) representing the inventory class in which the ticket was booked (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V). Determines the fare level, upgrade eligibility, and frequent flyer mileage accrual. Aligns with inventory bucket management.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA SSIM; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: The physical cabin of service for which the ticket was issued. F=First, C=Business, W=Premium Economy, Y=Economy. Used for revenue segmentation, load factor analysis, and RASK reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT Form 41 Schedule P-1.2

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ticket is part of a conjunction ticket set (multiple ticket documents covering a single itinerary exceeding 4 coupons). True = conjunction ticket; False = standalone ticket. Required for correct coupon sequencing and BSP settlement.

attributes.name: conjunction_ticket_number
attributes.description: The 13-digit ticket number of the related conjunction ticket document in the same set. Populated only when conjunction_ticket_indicator is True. Enables full itinerary reconstruction across multiple ticket documents.

attributes.name: coupon_count
attributes.description: Number of flight coupons (individual flight segments) contained within this ticket document. Standard tickets carry 1–4 coupons. Used for itinerary completeness validation and conjunction ticket detection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ticket record was first ingested into the lakehouse silver layer. Distinct from issue_timestamp which reflects the real-world ticketing event. Used for data lineage and audit. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the ticketed journey's final destination. Combined with origin forms the O&D (Origin and Destination) pair for yield management and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: endorsement_restriction_text
attributes.description: Free-text endorsement and restriction field printed on the ticket indicating fare conditions such as 'NON-ENDORSE/NON-REROUTE', 'VALID ON XX ONLY', or interline restrictions. Governs reissue, refund, and exchange eligibility.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA ATPCO Fare Rules

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric fare basis code identifying the specific fare product applied to this ticket (e.g., 'YLOWUS', 'BAPUS30'). Encodes the booking class, fare family, restrictions, and seasonality. Drives revenue accounting, yield analysis, and RASK/RPK reporting in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA ATPCO Fare Filing; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: fare_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the ticket fare amounts (base, tax, total, net remit) are denominated. Required for multi-currency BSP settlement and FX conversion in revenue accounting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Manual

attributes.name: fare_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fare applied to the ticket. PUB=Published/ATPCO filed fare, NEG=Negotiated/corporate fare, NET=Net/bulk fare, GOV=Government fare, FFP=Frequent Flyer award ticket, GRP=Group fare. Drives revenue accounting treatment and yield analysis in Sabre AirVision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PUB|NEG|NET|GOV|FFP|GRP|EMD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA ATPCO; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: ffp_miles_earned
attributes.description: Number of frequent flyer miles/points accrued on this ticket based on the fare basis, booking class, and FFP tier. Zero for award tickets (fare_type=FFP) or non-accruing fares. Feeds Oracle Loyalty Cloud for member account crediting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Oracle Loyalty Cloud; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: form_of_payment_detail
attributes.description: Masked payment instrument detail, e.g., last 4 digits of credit card number with card type prefix (VISA****1234) or bank reference. Stored in masked/tokenised form per PCI DSS. Used for settlement reconciliation and chargeback management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; IATA Resolution 722; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: form_of_payment_type
attributes.description: Code indicating the payment instrument used to purchase the ticket. CC=Credit Card, CA=Cash, CK=Check, TP=Tour Order/Prepaid, MS=Miscellaneous, EP=Electronic Payment/EMD. Drives BSP/ARC settlement routing and fraud monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CC|CA|CK|TP|MS|EP|GV|LO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) at which the e-ticket was issued by the ticketing system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the ticket transaction lifecycle. Used in BSP/ARC reporting periods and revenue recognition. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: net_remit_amount
attributes.description: The net amount remitted to the airline after deducting agency commission and applicable incentives from the total fare. Used in BSP/ARC settlement reconciliation and airline revenue accounting in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the ticketed journey's origin point. Used for route revenue analysis, OTP reporting, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: original_ticket_number
attributes.description: The 13-digit IATA ticket number of the original ticket when this record represents a reissued or exchanged ticket. Null for original issuances. Enables exchange chain tracing for revenue accounting and DOT consumer protection reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: passenger_name
attributes.description: Full name of the ticketed passenger as printed on the ticket, in IATA PNR name format (SURNAME/FIRSTNAME TITLE). Stored on the ticket for check-in, boarding, and regulatory compliance. PII — restricted.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; GDPR Article 4; TSA Secure Flight Program (49 CFR Part 1560)

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA Passenger Type Code classifying the traveller category for fare eligibility and pricing. ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, INF=Infant (no seat), INS=Infant with seat, UNN=Unaccompanied Minor, MIL=Military, SRC=Senior Citizen. Drives fare rule application and tax calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ADT|CHD|INF|INS|UNN|MIL|SRC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA TACT Rules; IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision PTC Table

attributes.name: pnr_locator
attributes.description: The 6-character alphanumeric GDS booking reference (PNR locator) associated with this ticket. Links the issued ticket back to the originating reservation in Amadeus Altéa or the GDS. Essential for IROP handling, reprotection, and customer service.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa PSS; GDS EDIFACT PNRGOV

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount refunded to the passenger when ticket_status is 'refunded'. May be less than total_fare_amount due to cancellation penalties or non-refundable fare components. Used for revenue accounting and DOT refund compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Manual

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a refund was processed for this ticket. Null for non-refunded tickets. Used for DOT consumer protection reporting (14 CFR Part 250), revenue reversal accounting, and refund SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Manual

attributes.name: sale_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which the ticket was sold. Determines applicable taxes, consumer protection regulations (DOT, EASA), and BSP/ARC settlement jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATA Resolution 722; DOT 14 CFR Part 399; EASA Regulation (EC) No 1008/2008

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the ticket was sold. GDS=Global Distribution System (Amadeus/Sabre/Travelport), DIRECT_WEB=airline.com, MOBILE=airline mobile app, AIRPORT=airport ticket office, CALL_CENTER=reservations centre, NDC=IATA New Distribution Capability, INTERLINE=interline agreement. Used for distribution cost analysis and channel revenue attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GDS|DIRECT_WEB|MOBILE|AIRPORT|CALL_CENTER|NDC|INTERLINE|OTA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard (IATA Resolution 787); IATA Distribution Cost Study

attributes.name: tax_total_amount
