attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Branded fare families (e.g., 'Signature Suite', 'Business Suite') are commercially restricted to specific aircraft types — a first-class fare family only applies on A380 or 777 wide-bodies. Airlines c

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.baggage_allowance. Business justification: Branded fare families (e.g., Basic, Standard, Flex) define specific baggage allowances as a core product differentiator. This link drives NDC offer construction, GDS branded fare display, and ancillar

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Fare families are defined per cabin class — Economy Light, Economy Flex, Business Flex are distinct fare families per cabin. fare_family has cabin_class as a plain text attribute; normalizing to cabin

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: Fare families (branded fares) are carrier-defined products. Brand management, GDS distribution configuration, and NDC offer assembly require linking fare families to the authoritative carrier record.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a ticket must be purchased under this fare family. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement. Aligns with ATPCO Category 5 advance purchase rules.

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the ancillary services bundle configuration associated with this fare family in the ancillary revenue management system. Links to the specific set of included and excluded ancillary services (EMD-eligible items) for merchandising.
attributes.references: IATA EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) Standards; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial marketing name of the fare family as displayed to passengers across all sales channels (e.g., 'Basic Economy', 'Standard', 'Flex', 'Business Lite', 'Business Plus'). This is the customer-facing label used in GDS displays, NDC offers, and airline.com.

attributes.name: carry_on_bags_included
attributes.description: Number of carry-on bags included in the fare family at no additional charge. Zero indicates no carry-on is included (e.g., Basic Economy). Used for ancillary merchandising and EMD issuance logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 (Baggage); DOT Baggage Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: change_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee in the fare family's base currency charged to the passenger for changing an itinerary when change_permitted is true. Zero indicates a fee-free change. Null indicates changes are not permitted.

attributes.name: change_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is permitted to change the itinerary (date, routing, or flight) on a ticket issued under this fare family. When true, change_fee_amount may apply.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259 (Consumer Protections)

attributes.name: checked_bags_included
attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included in the fare family at no additional charge. Drives ancillary upsell logic and EMD issuance in Amadeus Altéa. Reported per DOT baggage disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 (Baggage); DOT 14 CFR Part 399 Baggage Disclosure

attributes.name: combinability_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether fares within this fare family may be combined with fares from other fare families or carriers to construct a round-trip or multi-sector itinerary. Aligns with ATPCO Category 10 combinability rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this fare family record was first created in the revenue management system. Provides audit trail for fare family lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which change_fee_amount and refund_fee_amount are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with IATA BSP settlement currency conventions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this fare family is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates the fare family is open-ended with no planned end date. Aligns with ATPCO discontinue date conventions.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Integer ranking that controls the display order of fare families in shopping results across GDS, NDC, and direct channels. Lower values indicate higher display priority (e.g., 1 = displayed first). Used by Sabre AirVision and Amadeus Altéa for branded fare shelf ordering.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA NDC Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this fare family becomes commercially active and available for sale across all applicable channels. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing effective date conventions.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: family_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fare family in the revenue management and merchandising system. ACTIVE = currently sold; DRAFT = under configuration; RETIRED = no longer sold; SUSPENDED = temporarily withdrawn from sale.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: fare_class_mapping
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of one-letter IATA booking class codes (RBDs) that are associated with this fare family (e.g., 'Y,B,M,H'). Defines which inventory buckets in Amadeus Altéa and Sabre AirVision are merchandised under this branded fare.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: fare_family_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fare family across GDS, NDC, and direct channels (e.g., BASICECO, FLEX, BIZPLUS). Used as the business key in Sabre AirVision and distributed to Amadeus Altéa for branded fare merchandising.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 (Branded Fares); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: gds_display_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare family is visible and bookable through Global Distribution System (GDS) channels (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). When false, the fare family is restricted to direct or NDC channels only.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: interline_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this fare family may be used on interline partner carrier segments. When false, the fare family is restricted to the issuing carrier's own-metal flights only.
attributes.references: IATA Interline Traffic Agreements; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this fare family record was most recently modified in the revenue management system. Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental lakehouse ingestion.

attributes.name: lounge_access_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary airport lounge access is included as part of this fare family's service bundle. Typically applicable to premium cabin fare families (Business Plus, First).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Short customer-facing marketing description of the fare family's value proposition, displayed in booking flows and GDS/NDC shopping responses (e.g., 'Our most flexible fare with full refund and free seat selection'). Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: maximum_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare family's conditions. Null indicates no maximum stay restriction. Aligns with ATPCO Category 7.

attributes.name: meal_service_type
attributes.description: Type of complimentary meal or catering service included with this fare family. NONE = no complimentary meal; SNACK = light snack; MEAL = standard meal; PREMIUM_MEAL = enhanced meal selection; MULTI_COURSE = full multi-course dining (typically First/Business).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: miles_accrual_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Miles Accrual Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of base miles earned per Revenue Passenger Kilometer (RPK) flown under this fare family, expressed as a decimal multiplier (e.g., 0.50 = 50%, 1.00 = 100%, 1.50 = 150%). Feeds Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP mileage posting logic.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Oracle Loyalty Cloud (FFP Management)

attributes.name: minimum_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before returning, as required by this fare family's conditions. Zero or null indicates no minimum stay requirement. Aligns with ATPCO Category 6.

attributes.name: ndc_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare family is available for distribution via IATA New Distribution Capability (NDC) API channels, enabling rich offer and order management with full ancillary bundling.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA Passenger Type Code (PTC) indicating the passenger category eligible for this fare family (e.g., ADT = Adult, CHD = Child, INF = Infant, MIL = Military). Null indicates the fare family applies to all passenger types.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Type Codes; ATPCO Passenger Type Codes

attributes.name: priority_boarding_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether priority boarding is included as part of this fare family's service bundle, allowing passengers to board before general boarding groups.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: refund_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee in the fare family's base currency charged to the passenger when processing a refund where refund_permitted is true. Zero indicates a fee-free refund. Null indicates refunds are not permitted.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: refund_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a refund to the original form of payment is permitted for tickets issued under this fare family. Drives refund eligibility logic in Amadeus Altéa and BSP/ARC settlement processing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; DOT 14 CFR Part 259; BSP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: route_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic scope of routes to which this fare family applies. DOMESTIC = within a single country; INTERNATIONAL = cross-border; TRANSOCEANIC = long-haul intercontinental; ALL = no geographic restriction.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: sabre_brand_code
attributes.description: Native brand identifier assigned to this fare family within the Sabre AirVision Revenue Management system. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational Sabre environment.

attributes.name: seat_selection_included
attributes.description: Level of complimentary seat selection included with this fare family. NONE = no free seat selection; STANDARD = standard seats only; PREFERRED = preferred/extra-legroom seats; ANY = unrestricted seat selection including premium seats.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric tier ranking of this fare family within its cabin class, used for upsell and cross-sell logic (e.g., 1 = entry-level Basic Economy, 2 = Standard, 3 = Flex within Economy cabin). Enables structured upsell path configuration in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this fare family are eligible for complimentary or paid cabin upgrades (e.g., using miles, cash, or status). Feeds upgrade inventory logic in Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory; Oracle Loyalty Cloud (FFP Management)

attributes.name: wifi_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary in-flight Wi-Fi connectivity is included as part of this fare family's ancillary service bundle.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

products.name: corporate_contract
products.description: Corporate travel contract record defining negotiated fare agreements between the airline and corporate accounts or travel management companies (TMCs). Captures contract reference number, corporate account name and ID, contract type (net fare/discount/commission override/soft dollar), applicable markets and routes, discount percentage or net fare amounts, minimum volume commitment (revenue or segment targets), contract period, blackout dates, reporting requirements, account manager, and contract status (draft/active/expired/suspended). SSOT for corporate pricing and B2B revenue agreements.
products.reference: IATA Corporate Travel Agreement Standards

attributes.name: corporate_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the corporate travel contract record in the revenue management system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Corporate contracts frequently specify aircraft type restrictions (widebody-only for long-haul, specific cabin configurations). Contract compliance validation, pricing accuracy, and inventory allocati

attributes.name: ancillary_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.bundle. Business justification: Corporate contracts negotiate specific ancillary bundle inclusions (e.g., free checked bags, lounge access for all travelers). Contract management and corporate booking tools require this link to enfo

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: Corporate contracts are issued by a specific carrier. Carrier-level corporate account management, volume commitment tracking, and contract compliance reporting require linking corporate contracts to t

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account or Travel Management Company (TMC) that is party to this contract. Links to the corporate account master record.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: fare_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare_family. Business justification: Corporate contracts often specify which fare families (branded fares) are eligible under the contract. The applicable_cabin_classes and applicable_booking_classes attributes suggest fare family applic

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: corporate_contract defines negotiated fare agreements between the airline and corporate accounts, including net_fare_amount and applicable_booking_classes. However, there is no FK to the fare master r

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Corporate contracts often specify individual traveler FFP accounts for mileage accrual despite company payment. Tracks personal loyalty benefits within corporate travel programs. New attribute; no exi

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a booking must be made to qualify for the negotiated corporate fare. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 5; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: applicable_booking_classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) booking class codes to which this contract's fares apply (e.g., 'Y|B|M|K'). Governs inventory access in the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — RBD Standards; Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory

attributes.name: applicable_cabin_classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of cabin classes to which the negotiated fares or discounts under this contract apply (e.g., 'Y|C|F' for Economy, Business, First). Aligns with IATA cabin class designators.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Designators; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corporate contract is set to automatically renew upon reaching the expiry date without requiring a new signed agreement. True = auto-renews; False = requires manual renewal.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of specific dates or date ranges (in yyyy-MM-dd format) during which the corporate contract fares are not applicable (e.g., peak holiday periods, major events). Stored as a structured string for downstream parsing.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: changeable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this corporate contract permit voluntary changes (rebooking). True = changes permitted; False = no changes allowed. Governs change fee waiver rules.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 31; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: commission_override_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate (as a percentage) paid to the TMC or travel agent above the standard base commission, applicable when contract_type is 'commission_override'. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 = 5%).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 824; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the corporate contract, typically including the corporate account name and contract year (e.g., 'Acme Corp Global Agreement 2024'). Used for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the corporate contract, used in correspondence with the corporate account and TMC. Serves as the business identifier across systems including Sabre AirVision and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the corporate contract. Draft: under negotiation. Active: in force and bookable. Expired: past end date. Suspended: temporarily halted. Terminated: cancelled before end date.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing mechanism governing this corporate agreement. Net fare: fixed negotiated fare net of commission. Discount: percentage reduction off published fare. Commission override: elevated agency commission. Soft dollar: non-cash incentive credits. Zone fare: flat fare within a geographic zone.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 824 — Interline and Corporate Fare Agreements; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: corporate_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the corporate account or TMC for contract-related communications, reporting delivery, and renewal notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: corporate_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the corporate account or TMC who is the counterpart for this contract. Used for contract correspondence and account management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data; IATA BSP Agreement Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corporate contract record was first created in the revenue management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values (net fare amounts, volume commitments, soft dollar credits) under this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 024a — Currency Standards

attributes.name: destination_airport_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of IATA three-letter airport codes representing the destination points covered by this corporate contract. Null or wildcard indicates all destinations are applicable.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated percentage discount applied to the applicable published or base fare for this corporate contract. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Applicable when contract_type is 'discount'. Null for net_fare or commission_override contracts.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Pricing; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the corporate contract terms become binding and fares are bookable. Aligns with ATPCO fare filing effective dates where applicable.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corporate contract ceases to be binding. After this date, fares under this contract are no longer bookable unless the contract is renewed. Nullable for open-ended agreements.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: gds_corporate_code
attributes.description: Unique corporate code loaded into the Global Distribution System (GDS) — such as Amadeus, Sabre, or Travelport — that travel agents and TMCs use to access the negotiated corporate fares when booking on behalf of the corporate account.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory — Corporate Fare Access; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this corporate contract record in the revenue management system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: min_revenue_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum annual or contract-period revenue (in contract currency) that the corporate account commits to generate under this agreement. Used for volume-based tier qualification and rebate calculations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: min_segment_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of flight segments the corporate account commits to book with the airline during the contract period. Used alongside or as an alternative to min_revenue_commitment for volume qualification.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: net_fare_amount
attributes.description: Fixed negotiated net fare amount agreed under this corporate contract, net of all commissions and agency fees. Applicable when contract_type is 'net_fare'. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Pricing; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: origin_airport_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of IATA three-letter airport codes representing the origin points covered by this corporate contract. Null or wildcard indicates all origins are applicable.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: pnr_corporate_code
attributes.description: Corporate identifier embedded in the PNR (Passenger Name Record) to associate bookings with this corporate contract for tracking, reporting, and volume measurement purposes within the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Reservation and Inventory — PNR Corporate Field; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rebate paid back to the corporate account when volume commitments are met or exceeded. Expressed as a percentage of qualifying revenue (e.g., 3.00 = 3%).
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: rebate_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Revenue threshold (in contract currency) that the corporate account must exceed to qualify for a volume rebate payment. When actual revenue exceeds this threshold, the rebate_rate applies to the qualifying spend.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; IATA Resolution 824

attributes.name: refundable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this corporate contract are refundable. True = refundable; False = non-refundable. Governs refund processing in the Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards — Rule Category 33; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for contract renewal review or automatic renewal. Used by account managers to trigger renegotiation workflows ahead of expiry.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

attributes.name: reporting_requirement
attributes.description: Frequency at which the airline is contractually obligated to provide travel and spend reports to the corporate account or TMC. Drives automated report scheduling in the revenue management system.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; DOT Consumer Protection

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corporate contract was formally executed and signed by both the airline and the corporate account or TMC. Used for audit and legal compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: soft_dollar_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total non-cash incentive credit amount committed under this contract for soft dollar arrangements (e.g., upgrades, lounge access, marketing co-op funds). Applicable when contract_type is 'soft_dollar'. Expressed in contract currency.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module; DOT Consumer Protection

attributes.name: volume_measurement_period
attributes.description: The time period over which minimum volume commitments (revenue or segment) are measured and evaluated for compliance and rebate qualification.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Corporate Accounts Module

products.name: refund
products.description: Refund transaction record capturing the processing of a ticket or EMD refund to a passenger or agent. Stores refund reference number, original ticket/EMD number, refund type (voluntary/involuntary/IROP/schedule change), refund amount, penalty amount deducted, tax refund breakdown, refund method (original form of payment/voucher/miles), refund request date, processing date, refund status (requested/approved/processed/rejected/pending), approving agent or system, and BSP/ARC refund indicator. SSOT for refund liability management and revenue reversal accounting.
products.reference: IATA Refund Standards / BSP Refund Processing

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Primary key for refund

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Refunds create AP obligations to passengers or agents. Required for cash disbursement processing and AP aging.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: Refunds processed through travel agencies should reference the agency master. The travel_agent_iata_code attribute in revenue_refund should reference the authoritative agency record. Standard N:1 rela

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Refunds processed through BSP channels are included in BSP settlement batches. The bsp_arc_settlement_date attribute suggests settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authoritative bsp_settleme

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Refunds must be attributed to the correct airline legal entity for financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Multi-entity airline groups require company_code attribution on refunds for intercompa

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Refund processing triggers seat release back to flight inventory. The refund workflow must reference flight_inventory to update seats_available and load_factor_pct. revenue_refund has origin/destinati

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: DOT 14 CFR 259.5 mandates prompt refunds for cancelled/significantly delayed flights. Linking revenue_refund to flight_leg enables compliance reporting, IROP refund cost tracking per operated flight,

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Ticket refunds generate GL journal entries (debit revenue, credit AP/cash) required for airline financial close and audit. Revenue refund→GL traceability is mandatory for IFRS 15 variable consideratio

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Refunds resulting from maintenance-induced cancellations/delays must link to causative work orders for cost recovery from maintenance providers, dispute resolution, and operational impact tracking. Cr

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: When a safety occurrence (emergency landing, diversion, cabin event) forces involuntary passenger disruption, refunds are issued. The 'involuntary refund due to safety event' process requires linking

attributes.name: order_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.order_item. Business justification: Ancillary service refunds must trace back to the specific order item being refunded for accurate refund processing, customer service resolution, and DOT/IATA refund reporting. Revenue refund processin

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger (traveller) record who is the beneficiary of this refund. Links to the passenger master data entity in the Passenger domain.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS

attributes.name: revenue_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.emd. Business justification: revenue_refund can also process refunds for EMDs (ancillary services). Each refund may reference one EMD. The table has original_emd_number (STRING) as a business key. Adding emd_id FK to emd.emd_id e

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: revenue_refund captures refund transactions for tickets. Each refund references one original ticket. The table has original_ticket_number (STRING) as a business key. Adding ticket_id FK to ticket.reve

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when the refund was approved by an authorised agent or automated revenue management rule engine. Distinct from the processed timestamp; captures the approval decision event in the refund workflow lifecycle.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management Workflow

attributes.name: bsp_arc_settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the refund amount was settled through the IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) or Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) settlement cycle. Null for direct refunds or miles refunds not routed through BSP/ARC.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Operations Manual; ARC Industry Agent Handbook

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: The cabin class of the original ticket being refunded. F — First Class; C — Business Class; W — Premium Economy; Y — Economy. Used for revenue reversal reporting segmented by cabin.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Cabin Class Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this refund transaction record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this refund transaction are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the currency of the original ticket sale.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IATA Resolution 024 — Currency Regulations

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code of the final destination on the original ticket or EMD being refunded. Used for revenue reversal reporting by route and for regulatory reporting to DOT.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; DOT Form 41 Reporting

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: The net base fare amount approved for refund after deducting any applicable cancellation penalty from the gross fare amount. This is the fare component of the total refund disbursement. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: The ATPCO fare basis code of the original fare being refunded (e.g., 'YLOWUS', 'QSAVER'). Determines the applicable refund and penalty rules per ATPCO Category 16. Sourced from the original ticket coupon data in Amadeus Altéa PSS.
attributes.references: ATPCO Fare Filing Standards; IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: ffp_miles_refunded
attributes.description: Number of Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles credited back to the passenger's loyalty account as the refund method, or miles reinstated when an award ticket is cancelled. Populated only when refund_method is 'miles'. Interfaces with Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management; IATA Resolution 735; Internal FFP Policy

attributes.name: gross_fare_amount
attributes.description: The total base fare amount on the original ticket or EMD before any taxes, fees, or surcharges. Represents the revenue component subject to refund calculation and penalty deduction. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM)

attributes.name: involuntary_reason
attributes.description: For involuntary refunds, the specific airline-caused reason triggering the mandatory refund obligation. 'flight_cancellation' — flight cancelled by airline; 'significant_delay' — delay exceeding regulatory threshold; 'denied_boarding' — involuntary denied boarding (IDB); 'downgrade' — passenger downgraded to lower cabin; 'schedule_change' — schedule change beyond passenger tolerance. Null for voluntary refunds.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding; EU Regulation 261/2004 — Passenger Rights; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: issuing_airline_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA carrier code of the airline that originally issued the ticket or EMD being refunded. May differ from the operating carrier in codeshare or interline scenarios. Used for BSP/ARC settlement routing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762 — Airline Designators; BSP Data Interchange Specifications

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this refund transaction record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code of the origin point on the original ticket or EMD being refunded. Used for revenue reversal reporting by route and for regulatory reporting to DOT.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; DOT Form 41 Reporting

attributes.name: original_form_of_payment_code
attributes.description: IATA-standard form of payment code from the original ticket transaction (e.g., CC — credit card, CA — cash, CK — check, MS — miscellaneous, TP — tour order). Required for 'original_form_of_payment' refund method to route the credit correctly through BSP or ARC settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Form of Payment; BSP Data Interchange Specifications

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary penalty amount deducted from the gross fare amount per the fare rule conditions (e.g., ATPCO Category 16 — Penalties). Zero for involuntary refunds and IROP refunds where no penalty applies. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 16 — Penalties; IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management Fare Rules

attributes.name: pnr_code
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric Passenger Name Record (PNR) locator code in the Amadeus Altéa PSS associated with the original booking from which this refund originates. Links the refund to the reservation context.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa PSS Data Model

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when the refund was fully processed and funds were disbursed or credit was issued. Used to calculate refund processing duration for DOT compliance (7-day rule for credit card refunds, 20-day rule for cash/check). Null if not yet processed.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259.5; IATA Resolution 735; ARC Industry Agent Handbook

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised IATA or carrier-defined reason code identifying the specific cause of the refund (e.g., CANX — flight cancelled, DELY — significant delay, INVOL — involuntary reroute, SKED — schedule change, VOLU — voluntary cancellation). Sourced from Sabre AirVision Revenue Management and Amadeus Altéa PSS refund reason tables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CANX|DELY|INVOL|SKED|VOLU|DNBD|WVNO|MEDX|BEAV|DUPL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management Refund Module

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this refund transaction by the Passenger Service System (PSS) or revenue accounting system. Used for passenger and agent communication and BSP/ARC settlement tracking.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 824 — Refund Procedures; ARC Industry Agent Handbook

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: The method by which the refund value is returned to the passenger or agent. 'original_form_of_payment' — credit back to the original payment instrument; 'voucher' — travel credit voucher issued; 'miles' — Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles credited; 'cash' — physical cash refund at airport; 'bank_transfer' — direct bank transfer; 'check' — paper check issued.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; DOT 14 CFR Part 259.5; ARC Industry Agent Handbook

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the refund transaction. 'requested' — refund application received; 'approved' — authorised by agent or automated rule; 'processed' — funds disbursed or credit issued; 'rejected' — refund denied; 'pending' — awaiting additional information or system processing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 259.5 — Refund Processing

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason category driving the refund. 'voluntary' — passenger-initiated cancellation; 'involuntary' — airline-initiated cancellation or denial of boarding; 'irop' — Irregular Operations (IROP) such as flight cancellation or significant delay; 'schedule_change' — airline schedule change exceeding MCT or passenger tolerance thresholds; 'no_show_waiver' — waiver granted for no-show penalty under exceptional circumstances.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 — Refund of Unused Transportation; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Denied Boarding Compensation

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when the refund was formally requested by the passenger, travel agent, or automated system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the refund lifecycle and is used for DOT refund processing time compliance measurement.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259.5 — Refund Processing Timelines; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the original ticket was sold, which determines the refund routing and settlement process. 'direct' — airline website or app; 'gds' — Global Distribution System (GDS) such as Amadeus or Sabre; 'ota' — Online Travel Agency; 'airport' — airport ticket office; 'call_center' — airline reservations call centre; 'interline' — interline ticketing agreement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 854 — Distribution Standards; BSP Data Interchange Specifications

attributes.name: tax_breakdown_json
attributes.description: Serialised JSON string containing the itemised breakdown of individual tax and fee components included in the tax_refund_amount (e.g., {"US": 12.50, "XF": 4.50, "AY": 5.60}). Each key is the IATA tax code and the value is the refund amount for that tax. Required for regulatory tax reporting and passenger transparency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Tax Codes; IATA Ticketing Handbook; DOT Tax Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: tax_refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of government taxes and airport fees refunded to the passenger. Taxes are generally refundable even when the fare is non-refundable (e.g., Passenger Facility Charges (PFC), government-imposed taxes). Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; IRS Revenue Ruling; DOT 14 CFR Part 259.5; IATA Ticketing Handbook

attributes.name: total_refund_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount disbursed to the passenger or agent, equal to refund_fare_amount plus tax_refund_amount. This is the net settlement value of the refund transaction. Expressed in the transaction currency. Used for revenue reversal accounting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; IATA Revenue Accounting Manual (RAM); SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting

attributes.name: voucher_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the travel credit voucher issued to the passenger when refund_method is 'voucher'. Used to track voucher liability on the balance sheet and redemption against future bookings. Null when refund method is not voucher.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting — Deferred Revenue

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Airline-issued waiver code authorising the override of standard fare rule penalty conditions (e.g., weather waiver, pandemic waiver, operational disruption waiver). When populated, the penalty_amount is typically zero. Sourced from Sabre AirVision Revenue Management waiver management module.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Waiver Management; Internal Revenue Policy

products.name: ticket_exchange
products.description: Ticket exchange (reissue) transaction record capturing the voluntary or involuntary modification of an existing ticket to a new itinerary or fare. Stores exchange reference number, original ticket number, new ticket number, exchange type (voluntary/involuntary/upgrade/downgrade/IROP reprotection), fare difference amount (additional collection or residual value), penalty amount, exchange date, exchanging office, original fare basis, new fare basis, and exchange status. SSOT for ticket reissue lifecycle and associated revenue impact tracking.
products.reference: IATA Ticket Exchange / ATPCO Reissue Rules

attributes.name: ticket_exchange_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ticket_exchange

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.agency. Business justification: Ticket exchanges processed through travel agencies should reference the agency master. Standard N:1 relationship. No bidirectional conflict.

attributes.name: ancillary_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.ancillary_emd. Business justification: Ticket exchanges generate change-fee EMDs. ticket_exchange.emd_number is a denormalized text reference to the ancillary_emd entity. Replacing it with a proper FK enables exchange audit trails, BSP set

attributes.name: bsp_settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.bsp_settlement. Business justification: Ticket exchanges (reissues) processed through BSP channels are included in BSP settlement batches. The settlement_plan_type attribute suggests settlement tracking. This should be a FK to the authorita

attributes.name: e_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.e_ticket. Business justification: A ticket exchange references the original e-ticket being reissued. Linking enables complete exchange audit trail, e-ticket lifecycle tracking, and conjunction ticket management required for IATA resol

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Exchange transactions post to GL for revenue adjustments (fare differences, penalties). Required for accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.

attributes.name: irop_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_irop_event. Business justification: Involuntary ticket exchanges caused by IROP events (cancellations, diversions, mass delays) must reference the triggering IROP event for DOT/EC261 regulatory reporting, IROP cost attribution, and pass

attributes.name: new_fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: ticket_exchange captures the new fare details after reissue (new_fare_amount, new_fare_basis_code as execution-specific values) but has no FK to the fare master. Adding new_fare_id → revenue.fare.fare

attributes.name: new_flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Ticket exchange (reissue) moves a passenger to a new flight, requiring confirmation of seat availability on the new flight_inventory. Role-prefix 'new_' distinguishes the target flight from the origin

attributes.name: original_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: ticket_exchange captures voluntary or involuntary ticket modifications (reissues). Each exchange references an original ticket being exchanged. The table has original_ticket_number (STRING) as a busin

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger profile record for whom the ticket exchange was performed. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE linking this transaction to the traveller.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa Passenger Profile

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.pnr. Business justification: Ticket exchanges must reference the PNR for exchange history tracking, reissue audit, and passenger itinerary reconciliation. ticket_exchange.pnr_locator is a denormalized PNR reference; a proper FK e

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Involuntary ticket exchanges caused by AOG or technical cancellations must be traced to the triggering maintenance work order for irregular operations cost recovery, insurance claims, and carrier liab

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Method by which any additional fare difference or penalty was collected from the passenger. EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) is used for ancillary collections per IATA standards. Waived applies to involuntary exchanges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|emd|residual_value|waived — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) Standard; Amadeus Altéa EMD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this exchange transaction record was first captured in the Silver layer data product. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this exchange transaction are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the point-of-sale currency at the time of exchange.

attributes.name: exchange_date
attributes.description: Principal business event timestamp recording the exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the ticket exchange transaction was executed in the PSS. Distinct from audit timestamps. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: exchange_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ticket exchange transaction, typically generated by the Passenger Service System (PSS) or GDS at the time of reissue. Used for cross-system reconciliation and customer-facing reference.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa PSS Exchange Reference

attributes.name: exchange_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ticket exchange transaction. Pending indicates initiated but not finalized; completed indicates successfully processed; voided indicates cancelled before settlement; failed indicates processing error; reversed indicates post-completion reversal.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Amadeus Altéa Exchange Workflow

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason or nature of the ticket exchange. Voluntary indicates passenger-initiated change; involuntary indicates airline-initiated change; upgrade/downgrade reflect cabin class changes; irop_reprotection covers Irregular Operations (IROP) rebooking; schedule_change covers airline schedule modifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|involuntary|upgrade|downgrade|irop_reprotection|schedule_change — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735 (Involuntary Refunds); DOT 14 CFR Part 250; Sabre AirVision Exchange Type Codes

attributes.name: fare_difference_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary difference between the new fare amount and the original fare amount (new_fare_amount minus original_fare_amount). A positive value indicates an additional collection (ADC) owed by the passenger; a negative value indicates a residual credit. Central to revenue impact tracking for ticket reissues.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; Sabre AirVision Exchange Pricing; IATA BSP

attributes.name: gds_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) — such as Amadeus or Sabre — at the time the exchange was processed. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the PSS and GDS settlement records.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa PSS; Sabre AirVision; IATA BSP

attributes.name: involuntary_reason_code
attributes.description: Airline-defined reason code specifying the cause of an involuntary ticket exchange (e.g., flight cancellation, significant schedule change, equipment downgrade, denied boarding). Populated only when exchange_type is involuntary or irop_reprotection. Required for DOT and EASA regulatory reporting on involuntary rerouting.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; EASA Regulation EC 261/2004; IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: issuing_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter or ICAO three-letter airline designator code of the carrier that issued the new ticket. May differ from the operating carrier in codeshare or interline scenarios.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Airline Designator Code Standard

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this exchange transaction record was last modified in the Silver layer data product. Used for incremental load tracking and change detection. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: new_cabin_class
attributes.description: IATA cabin class code of the newly issued ticket after exchange. F=First, C=Business, W=Premium Economy, Y=Economy. Used in conjunction with original_cabin_class to classify upgrade or downgrade transactions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Cabin Class Codes

attributes.name: new_destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the final destination on the newly issued ticket itinerary after exchange. Used for O&D revenue analysis and network planning.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: new_fare_amount
attributes.description: Gross base fare amount of the newly issued ticket in the transaction currency, excluding taxes and fees. Used to compute the fare difference and assess revenue uplift or dilution from the exchange.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP Reporting Standard

attributes.name: new_fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code of the newly issued ticket after exchange. Identifies the fare product, booking class, and applicable conditions governing the replacement itinerary. Used for revenue impact analysis and yield management reporting.
attributes.references: IATA ATPCO Fare Basis Code Standard; Sabre AirVision Fare Basis

attributes.name: new_origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the origin point on the newly issued ticket itinerary after exchange. Used for route-level revenue impact analysis and yield management reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: new_ticket_number
attributes.description: 13-digit IATA e-ticket number of the newly issued ticket resulting from the exchange. Conforms to IATA standard ticket numbering. Used to link the exchange event to the replacement travel document.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA Ticket and Document Numbering Standard

attributes.name: new_travel_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the first flight segment on the newly issued ticket itinerary after exchange. Used for demand forecasting, load factor impact assessment, and revenue period reporting.

attributes.name: original_cabin_class
attributes.description: IATA cabin class code of the original ticket prior to exchange. F=First, C=Business, W=Premium Economy, Y=Economy. Used to identify upgrade/downgrade exchanges and assess revenue impact.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; IATA Cabin Class Codes

attributes.name: original_destination_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the final destination on the original ticket itinerary prior to exchange. Used for O&D (Origin and Destination) revenue analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: original_fare_amount
attributes.description: Gross base fare amount of the original ticket in the transaction currency, excluding taxes and fees. Used as the baseline for fare difference calculation and revenue accounting reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Reporting Standard

attributes.name: original_fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code of the original ticket prior to exchange. Identifies the fare product, booking class, and applicable conditions that governed the original itinerary. Used for fare difference calculation and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA ATPCO Fare Basis Code Standard; Sabre AirVision Fare Basis

attributes.name: original_origin_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the origin point on the original ticket itinerary prior to exchange. Used for route-level revenue impact analysis and yield management reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Code Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: original_travel_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the first flight segment on the original ticket itinerary prior to exchange. Used for seasonality analysis, advance purchase tracking, and revenue accounting period alignment.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter Passenger Type Code (PTC) applicable to the exchanged ticket (e.g., ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, INF=Infant, MIL=Military). Determines applicable fare rules, penalty waivers, and pricing logic for the exchange.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Type Code Standard; ATPCO PTC Reference

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Change fee or penalty amount charged to the passenger for the voluntary ticket exchange, as defined by the applicable fare rule. Zero for involuntary exchanges or IROP reprotections where penalties are waived per IATA Resolution 735.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; ATPCO Category 16 (Penalties); DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the ticket exchange was processed. GDS (Global Distribution System) covers Amadeus/Sabre/Travelport agency sales; NDC (New Distribution Capability) covers IATA NDC API channels; direct channels cover airline-owned touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gds|direct_web|direct_mobile|airport_counter|call_center|ndc|interline — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA NDC (New Distribution Capability) Standard; IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa

attributes.name: settlement_plan_type
attributes.description: Identifies the settlement mechanism through which the exchange transaction will be financially settled. BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) for IATA-member markets; ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) for US/Canada markets; direct for airline-direct sales channels.
attributes.references: IATA BSP; ARC Reporting Standard; IATA Resolution 722

attributes.name: tax_difference_amount
attributes.description: Net difference in applicable taxes and surcharges between the new ticket and the original ticket. Positive indicates additional tax collection; negative indicates tax credit. Required for accurate BSP settlement and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP; IATA Tax Code Standard

attributes.name: validating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline designator code of the validating carrier responsible for the new ticket. The validating carrier is accountable for BSP settlement and revenue recognition on the reissued document.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 722; IATA BSP; Sabre AirVision

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Airline-issued waiver code authorizing the exchange under special circumstances (e.g., weather events, IROP, pandemic waivers, elite status benefit). When populated, indicates that standard change fees or fare rules were overridden. Sourced from Amadeus Altéa or Sabre AirVision waiver management.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; Amadeus Altéa Waiver Management

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason code explaining why a waiver was applied to the exchange transaction. Used for waiver cost tracking, regulatory compliance reporting, and customer service analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|irop|schedule_change|goodwill|elite_status|pandemic|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 735; DOT Consumer Protection Rules; Internal Waiver Policy

domains.name: crew
domains.description: Crew scheduling, rostering, pairings, duty periods, rest requirements, crew qualifications, type ratings, recency, crew bases, deadhead positioning, crew legality checks, fatigue risk management, and crew-to-flight leg assignments. This is the SSOT for crew identity within the crew domain, distinct from the workforce domain employee record which owns HR/payroll data.
