attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the cabin configuration (e.g., 'High-Density Economy', 'Premium Three-Class').

attributes.name: configuration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cabin configuration. Active configurations are in operational use; planned configurations are approved but not yet installed; retired configurations are no longer in service.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cabin configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: door_count
attributes.description: Total number of passenger entry/exit doors in this cabin configuration. Critical for emergency evacuation certification.

attributes.name: economy_seat_count
attributes.description: Number of seats in the Economy (standard coach) cabin.

attributes.name: economy_seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: Average seat pitch in Economy class, measured in inches.

attributes.name: economy_seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Average seat width in Economy class, measured in inches.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cabin configuration became (or will become) active and available for operational use.

attributes.name: first_class_seat_count
attributes.description: Number of seats in the First Class cabin. Zero if First Class is not offered in this configuration.

attributes.name: first_class_seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: Average seat pitch (distance from one seat to the same point on the seat in front) in First Class, measured in inches. Null if First Class is not offered.

attributes.name: first_class_seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Average seat width in First Class, measured in inches. Null if First Class is not offered.

attributes.name: galley_count
attributes.description: Total number of galleys (food and beverage preparation areas) installed in this cabin configuration.

attributes.name: ife_system_type
attributes.description: Type or model of the In-Flight Entertainment system installed (e.g., 'Panasonic eX3', 'Thales AVANT', 'Streaming-only'). Null if no IFE is installed.

attributes.name: lavatory_count
attributes.description: Total number of lavatories (restrooms) installed in this cabin configuration.

attributes.name: lie_flat_seat_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this configuration includes lie-flat seats (typically in First or Business Class). True if any cabin class offers lie-flat capability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cabin configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: overwing_exit_count
attributes.description: Number of overwing emergency exits in this cabin configuration. Used for evacuation planning and seating restrictions.

attributes.name: power_outlet_availability
attributes.description: Indicates the availability of power outlets (AC or USB) for passenger devices. Values: none (no power outlets), selected_seats (available in premium cabins or select rows), all_seats (available at every seat).

attributes.name: premium_economy_seat_count
attributes.description: Number of seats in the Premium Economy cabin. Zero if Premium Economy is not offered in this configuration.

attributes.name: premium_economy_seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: Average seat pitch in Premium Economy, measured in inches. Null if Premium Economy is not offered.

attributes.name: premium_economy_seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Average seat width in Premium Economy, measured in inches. Null if Premium Economy is not offered.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cabin configuration was retired from service. Null if the configuration is still active or planned.

attributes.name: seat_map_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the detailed seat map diagram for this configuration. Used by reservation systems and passenger-facing applications.

attributes.name: total_seat_count
attributes.description: Total number of passenger seats installed in this cabin configuration across all classes. Critical for revenue management and Available Seat Kilometer (ASK) calculations.

attributes.name: wifi_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-flight Wi-Fi connectivity is available in this cabin configuration.

attributes.name: wifi_provider
attributes.description: Name of the Wi-Fi service provider (e.g., 'Gogo', 'Viasat', 'Panasonic Avionics'). Null if Wi-Fi is not available.

products.name: seat_map
products.description: Seat-level detail for a cabin configuration — each row represents one physical seat position. This is the granular seat inventory that passenger service systems, revenue management, and check-in reference for seat assignment, blocking, and special service request (SSR) fulfillment. Captures seat designator (e.g. 12A), deck (main/upper), cabin class assignment, row number, column letter, seat type (window/middle/aisle), location attributes (exit-row, bulkhead, overwing, last-row, bassinet-capable), physical dimensions (pitch inches, width inches), recline capability (standard/limited/lie-flat/angle-flat), blocking flags (is_blocked, block_reason), crew rest indicator, IFE availability, power outlet type (none/AC/USB/both), and premium attributes relevant to ancillary seat selection revenue.
products.reference: IATA PADIS / SSIM Seat Map Standard

attributes.name: seat_map_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the seat map record. Primary key for the seat map entity.

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific aircraft configuration that this seat belongs to. Links to the aircraft configuration master data defining the overall cabin layout.

attributes.name: block_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the seat is blocked from assignment. Provides operational context for seat inventory management and passenger service recovery.

attributes.name: cabin_class
attributes.description: The service class or cabin compartment to which this seat is assigned. Determines service level, amenities, and fare eligibility.

attributes.name: column_letter
attributes.description: The alphabetic column identifier for the seat position within the row (A through K). Typically A and K are window seats in wide-body aircraft.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this seat map record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deck
attributes.description: The deck or level of the aircraft where the seat is located. Relevant for wide-body aircraft with multiple passenger decks.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this seat map configuration becomes active and available for passenger assignment. Supports configuration versioning and fleet changes.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this seat map configuration is retired and no longer valid for passenger assignment. Nullable for current active configurations.

attributes.name: galley_proximity
attributes.description: Indicates the proximity of the seat to galley (kitchen) facilities. Proximity to galleys can impact passenger experience due to noise and crew activity.

attributes.name: has_ife
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is equipped with an in-flight entertainment system. IFE availability is a key amenity for passenger satisfaction and ancillary revenue.

attributes.name: ife_screen_size_inches
attributes.description: The diagonal screen size in inches of the in-flight entertainment display at this seat. Used for product differentiation and passenger communication.

attributes.name: is_accessible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is designated as accessible for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility. Accessible seats meet regulatory requirements for space and proximity to facilities.

attributes.name: is_bassinet_capable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat position can accommodate an infant bassinet attachment. Typically available at bulkhead seats with sufficient wall space.

attributes.name: is_blocked
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is currently blocked from passenger assignment. Blocked seats are unavailable for sale or assignment due to operational, regulatory, or commercial reasons.

attributes.name: is_bulkhead
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is located directly behind a bulkhead (dividing wall). Bulkhead seats typically offer extra legroom but may have restricted under-seat storage.

attributes.name: is_crew_rest
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is designated for crew rest on long-haul flights. Crew rest seats are blocked from passenger assignment and reserved for flight crew during rest periods.

attributes.name: is_exit_row
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is located in an emergency exit row. Exit row seats have special regulatory requirements and passenger eligibility restrictions.

attributes.name: is_last_row
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is in the last row of the cabin or section. Last row seats often have limited or no recline and proximity to lavatories.

attributes.name: is_overwing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is located over the aircraft wing, which may restrict window views. Used for passenger communication and seat selection preferences.

attributes.name: is_preferred_seat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the seat is designated as a preferred or premium seat eligible for ancillary seat selection fees. Preferred seats typically offer enhanced comfort or location.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this seat map record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lavatory_proximity
attributes.description: Indicates the proximity of the seat to lavatory facilities. Proximity to lavatories can be a positive (convenience) or negative (noise, traffic) factor for seat selection.

attributes.name: power_outlet_type
attributes.description: The type of power outlet available at the seat for passenger device charging. Power availability is increasingly important for passenger satisfaction and ancillary revenue.

attributes.name: recline_angle_degrees
attributes.description: The maximum recline angle of the seat in degrees from vertical. Used to communicate seat comfort specifications and differentiate premium products.

attributes.name: recline_type
attributes.description: The recline capability of the seat, ranging from no recline to full lie-flat configurations. Critical for premium cabin differentiation and passenger comfort.

attributes.name: row_number
attributes.description: The numeric row identifier within the aircraft cabin. Used for seat assignment logic and cabin zone management.

attributes.name: seat_designator
attributes.description: The unique seat identifier within the aircraft, combining row number and column letter (e.g., 12A, 34F). This is the seat label passengers see on their boarding pass.

attributes.name: seat_fee_tier
attributes.description: The pricing tier for ancillary seat selection fees. Used by revenue management systems to price seat assignments and optimize ancillary revenue.

attributes.name: seat_map_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the seat map record. Indicates whether the seat configuration is currently in use, pending activation, or retired.

attributes.name: seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: The distance in inches from one point on a seat to the same point on the seat in front or behind, measuring legroom and seat spacing. Key metric for passenger comfort and cabin density.

attributes.name: seat_type
attributes.description: The positional type of the seat within the row, indicating whether it is adjacent to the window, in the middle of a seat group, or adjacent to the aisle. Critical for passenger preference and ancillary revenue.

attributes.name: seat_width_inches
attributes.description: The width of the seat in inches, measured at the widest point of the seat cushion. Impacts passenger comfort and cabin configuration.

attributes.name: storage_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates any restrictions on carry-on baggage storage at this seat location. Some seats (e.g., bulkhead, exit row) have limited under-seat or overhead storage.

products.name: fleet_order
products.description: Records aircraft purchase orders and lease commitments placed with OEMs (Boeing, Airbus, Embraer) or lessors for fleet growth, replacement, or renewal. Each record represents a firm order, option, or letter of intent. Captures order reference number, aircraft type ordered, quantity (firm/option/LoI), deliveries completed, cancellations, order date, contractual delivery window (start/end), list price per unit (USD), negotiated price per unit where available, total order value, order status (firm/option/LoI/cancelled/converted), financing structure (cash/debt/sale-leaseback/operating-lease), counterparty (OEM or lessor), and associated fleet plan scenario reference. Supports fleet planning, capital expenditure forecasting, and delivery pipeline management.
products.reference: Aircraft Purchase Agreement / Lease Agreement

attributes.name: fleet_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet order record. Primary key for aircraft purchase orders and lease commitments.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aircraft type being ordered (e.g., Boeing 737-800, Airbus A320neo). Links to aircraft type master data containing ICAO/IATA designators and specifications.

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget_plan. Business justification: Aircraft purchase orders must reference the approved CAPEX budget plan for board-level fleet investment authorization and budget vs. actual variance reporting. Airline finance teams track fleet order

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Fleet orders drive CAPEX cost centre assignments that determine where aircraft depreciation will be posted once delivered. Airline CAPEX controllers require fleet orders to reference a cost centre for

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Fleet purchase orders are contracted by a specific airline legal entity (subsidiary), which is essential for group CAPEX consolidation, purchase contract management, and entity-level financial reporti

attributes.name: lessor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.lessor. Business justification: fleet_order records both purchase orders (with OEMs) and lease commitments. When order_type indicates a lease commitment, the counterparty is a lessor tracked in the lessor master table. Adding fleet_

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_code
attributes.description: Planned cabin layout configuration for the ordered aircraft. Defines seating classes and arrangement (e.g., 2-class, 3-class, high-density). Links to detailed seat map specifications.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the order was officially cancelled or terminated. Null for active orders.

attributes.name: cancellation_penalty_usd
attributes.description: Financial penalty amount in US Dollars if the order is cancelled before delivery. Defined in contract terms.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for order cancellation. Examples: strategic fleet plan change, financial constraints, route network adjustment, OEM delivery delays. Null for active orders.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Legal contract or purchase agreement reference number. Links to the binding legal document governing the order terms and conditions.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date when an option or letter of intent was converted to a firm order. Null if order was firm from inception or has not been converted.

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty. OEM = Original Equipment Manufacturer (Boeing, Airbus), Lessor = Aircraft leasing company, Broker = Intermediary facilitating the transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: delivery_window_end_date
attributes.description: Latest contractual delivery date for aircraft in this order. Defines the end of the delivery period.

attributes.name: delivery_window_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest contractual delivery date for aircraft in this order. Defines the beginning of the delivery period.

attributes.name: deposit_amount_usd
attributes.description: Initial deposit or down payment amount paid to secure the order, in US Dollars. Typically a percentage of total order value.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: Specific engine model selected for the aircraft order. Examples: CFM LEAP-1A, Pratt & Whitney PW1100G, Rolls-Royce Trent 7000. Critical for maintenance planning and fuel efficiency.

attributes.name: financing_structure
attributes.description: Method of financing the aircraft acquisition. Cash = direct purchase, Debt Financing = loan-backed purchase, Sale-Leaseback = sell and lease back, Operating Lease = rental, Finance Lease = lease-to-own, Hybrid = combination of methods.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet order record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: list_price_per_unit_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: List Price Per Unit (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Manufacturer's published list price per aircraft in US Dollars. This is the catalog price before any negotiated discounts.

attributes.name: negotiated_price_per_unit_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Negotiated Price Per Unit (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Actual negotiated price per aircraft in US Dollars after discounts and concessions. Highly confidential commercial terms. Null if not disclosed or still under negotiation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional order details, special terms, delivery conditions, or internal planning notes. Supports operational context and decision documentation.

attributes.name: option_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date by which option rights must be exercised or they expire. Applicable only for orders with option quantities. Null for firm orders.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the order was officially placed with the OEM or lessor. Marks the contractual commitment date.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fleet order. Firm = binding commitment, Option = right to purchase, Letter of Intent = preliminary agreement, Cancelled = order terminated, Converted = option converted to firm, Delivered = order fulfilled.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the acquisition structure. Purchase = outright ownership, Operating Lease = rental without ownership transfer, Finance Lease = lease with ownership transfer option, Sale-Leaseback = sell owned aircraft and lease back, Wet Lease = aircraft with crew, Dry Lease = aircraft only, ACMI = Aircraft Crew Maintenance Insurance lease. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|operating_lease|finance_lease|sale_leaseback|wet_lease|dry_lease|acmi — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Strategic business purpose for the aircraft order. Fleet Growth = net addition to fleet size, Fleet Replacement = replacing retiring aircraft, Fleet Renewal = modernizing existing capacity, Capacity Expansion = increasing seat capacity, Route Expansion = supporting new route network.

attributes.name: quantity_cancelled
attributes.description: Number of aircraft from this order that have been cancelled or terminated before delivery.

attributes.name: quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Number of aircraft from this order that have been delivered and accepted into the fleet.

attributes.name: quantity_firm
attributes.description: Number of aircraft under firm binding commitment. These are contractually committed deliveries.

attributes.name: quantity_loi
attributes.description: Number of aircraft covered by letter of intent. Non-binding preliminary agreement expressing purchase interest.

attributes.name: quantity_option
attributes.description: Number of aircraft under option rights. Airline has the right but not obligation to purchase at predetermined terms.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the aircraft order or lease commitment. Used in contracts and communications with OEMs and lessors.

attributes.name: total_order_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Order Value (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Total financial value of the entire order in US Dollars. Calculated as quantity times negotiated price (or list price if negotiated not available). Represents total capital commitment.

attributes.name: total_seat_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of passenger seats in the planned cabin configuration. Sum of all seating classes (First, Business, Premium Economy, Economy).

products.name: aircraft_delivery
products.description: Transactional record of each aircraft delivery event — when a new or leased aircraft is formally accepted into the airline's fleet from a manufacturer or lessor. Captures delivery date, delivery location (airport ICAO), aircraft MSN, tail number assigned at delivery, aircraft type, delivery flight number (ferry flight), acceptance certificate reference, technical acceptance inspection outcome, delivery condition (new/used), hours at delivery, cycles at delivery, engine serial numbers at delivery, APU serial number at delivery, and delivery team sign-off. Triggers aircraft registration and initial airworthiness documentation.
products.reference: Aircraft Delivery Acceptance Certificate

attributes.name: aircraft_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft delivery event. Primary key for the aircraft delivery transaction.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aircraft master record that was delivered. Links to the aircraft asset registry.

attributes.name: aircraft_lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_lease. Business justification: An aircraft delivery event — particularly for wet-lease, dry-lease, or ACMI arrangements — fulfills a specific lease agreement. Linking aircraft_delivery.aircraft_lease_id → aircraft_lease.aircraft_le

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Aircraft delivery records the type of aircraft being delivered. Currently denormalizes aircraft_type_icao and aircraft_type_iata. Adding aircraft_type_id FK normalizes this and allows delivery records

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: aircraft_delivery currently stores cabin_configuration_code as a plain STRING, denormalizing the cabin layout installed at delivery. The cabin_configuration table is the authoritative source for confi

attributes.name: delivery_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: New aircraft acceptance logistics, delivery team deployment, and acceptance flight planning require station linkage. Fleet planning and delivery coordination depend on accurate station tracking. Repla

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: When aircraft is delivered, it's capitalized as a fixed asset. Delivery record must link to fixed_asset entry for acquisition cost, depreciation tracking, and asset register reconciliation. Real busin

attributes.name: fleet_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_order. Business justification: Aircraft delivery fulfills a fleet order. fleet_order tracks purchase orders and lease commitments; aircraft_delivery records the actual delivery event. Linking delivery to order establishes traceabil

attributes.name: acceptance_certificate_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal acceptance certificate document signed by the airline and manufacturer/lessor confirming aircraft delivery and acceptance.

attributes.name: airframe_cycles_at_delivery
attributes.description: Total accumulated flight cycles (takeoff and landing cycles) on the airframe at the time of delivery. Zero for new aircraft, non-zero for used aircraft.

attributes.name: airframe_hours_at_delivery
attributes.description: Total accumulated flight hours (block hours) on the airframe at the time of delivery. Zero for new aircraft, non-zero for used aircraft.

attributes.name: apu_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) installed on the aircraft at delivery. APU provides electrical power and pneumatic air on the ground and in-flight backup.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this aircraft delivery record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_condition
attributes.description: Condition classification of the aircraft at delivery: new from manufacturer, used from lessor, refurbished after major overhaul, or pre-owned from another operator.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the aircraft was formally accepted into the airline's fleet from the manufacturer or lessor. Marks the start of operational availability.

attributes.name: delivery_flight_number
attributes.description: Flight number assigned to the ferry flight that delivered the aircraft from the manufacturer or lessor facility to the airline's base. May be a non-revenue positioning flight.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional details about the delivery event, including any special conditions, snags identified during acceptance inspection, or deviations from standard delivery procedures.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this aircraft delivery transaction, typically assigned by the manufacturer or lessor.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the aircraft delivery transaction: scheduled (planned future delivery), in transit (ferry flight underway), accepted (delivery completed and aircraft in service), rejected (delivery refused), cancelled (delivery cancelled), or deferred (delivery postponed).

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the aircraft delivery acceptance was signed off and the aircraft officially transferred to the airline's operational control.

attributes.name: engine_1_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the engine installed in position 1 (typically left engine on twin-engine aircraft) at delivery.

attributes.name: engine_2_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the engine installed in position 2 (typically right engine on twin-engine aircraft) at delivery.

attributes.name: engine_3_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the engine installed in position 3 (for tri-jet or quad-jet aircraft) at delivery. Null for twin-engine aircraft.

attributes.name: engine_4_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the engine installed in position 4 (for quad-jet aircraft) at delivery. Null for twin-engine and tri-jet aircraft.

attributes.name: etops_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is certified for ETOPS operations at delivery, allowing extended-range twin-engine flights over routes distant from diversion airports.
attributes.references: FAA Part 121 Appendix P, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: etops_rating_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Rating in Minutes
attributes.description: ETOPS rating in minutes (e.g., 120, 180, 207, 330) indicating the maximum diversion time the aircraft is certified for. Null if not ETOPS certified.
attributes.references: FAA Part 121 Appendix P, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: mel_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Minimum Equipment List (MEL) is applicable to this aircraft, allowing dispatch with certain non-critical equipment inoperative under specified conditions.

attributes.name: msn
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the aircraft manufacturer at production. Permanent identifier for the airframe throughout its lifecycle.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Type of ownership or lease arrangement under which the aircraft was acquired: owned (purchased outright), wet lease (aircraft with crew), dry lease (aircraft only), ACMI (Aircraft Crew Maintenance Insurance), finance lease, or operating lease.

attributes.name: tail_number
attributes.description: Civil aviation registration number (tail number) assigned to the aircraft at delivery. Displayed on the aircraft fuselage and used for ATC identification.

attributes.name: technical_acceptance_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the technical acceptance inspection performed by the airline's engineering team: accepted (no issues), accepted with conditions (minor snags to be resolved), rejected (major defects), or deferred (inspection postponed).

attributes.name: total_seat_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of passenger seats installed in the aircraft at delivery, across all cabin classes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this aircraft delivery record was last modified in the system.

products.name: aircraft_lease
products.description: Master record for each aircraft lease agreement covering dry-lease, wet-lease, and ACMI arrangements. Captures lease agreement number, lessor name, lessee entity, aircraft tail number, aircraft type, lease type (dry/wet/ACMI), lease start date, lease end date, monthly rental rate (USD), security deposit amount, return conditions (hours/cycles limits), maintenance reserve rate per flight hour, redelivery location, extension options, early termination clause flag, governing law jurisdiction, and current lease status (active/expired/terminated/extended). SSOT for fleet ownership and cost allocation.
products.reference: IATA Aircraft Lease Agreement / ACMI Contract

attributes.name: aircraft_lease_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft lease agreement record. Primary key for the aircraft lease entity.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific aircraft asset covered by this lease agreement. Links to the aircraft master registry.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: aircraft_lease currently stores aircraft_type_code as a plain STRING, which is a denormalized reference to the aircraft type. Lease agreements are often structured around a specific aircraft type (e.g

attributes.name: fleet_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_order. Business justification: A lease agreement often originates from a fleet order commitment (when fleet_order.order_type = lease commitment). Linking aircraft_lease.fleet_order_id → fleet_order.fleet_order_id allows the lease r

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: aircraft_lease is the operational lease record; lease_contract is the financial/accounting representation under IFRS16. Same lease must exist in both domains for compliance. Real business process: lea

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessee entity (airline operating unit or subsidiary) receiving the aircraft. Links to internal organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: lessor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.lessor. Business justification: aircraft_lease has denormalized lessor_name (STRING) attribute. The lessor product exists in fleet domain as the authoritative master for lessor entities. This FK normalizes the relationship, allowing

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the aircraft was physically delivered to the lessee and accepted into operational service. May differ from lease start date.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the aircraft was returned to the lessor and removed from lessee operational control. Populated upon lease termination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease agreement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: early_termination_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement includes provisions allowing early termination by either party under specified conditions.

attributes.name: early_termination_penalty_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Early Termination Penalty (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Financial penalty amount in US dollars payable if the lease is terminated before the scheduled end date. Nullable if no penalty applies.

attributes.name: extension_option_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement includes an option for the lessee to extend the lease term beyond the original end date.

attributes.name: extension_option_duration_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for which the lease can be extended if the extension option is exercised. Nullable if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law specified in the lease agreement for dispute resolution and contract interpretation (e.g., New York, England and Wales, Singapore).

attributes.name: insurance_responsibility
attributes.description: Party responsible for maintaining aircraft hull and liability insurance coverage during the lease term. Critical for ACMI vs dry lease distinction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease agreement record was most recently updated. Tracks the latest change to any attribute in the record.

attributes.name: lease_agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the lease agreement as referenced in legal contracts and financial systems. Business identifier for the lease.

attributes.name: lease_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the lease agreement. While amounts are stored in USD, this captures the original contract currency for reference.

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled expiration date of the lease agreement when the aircraft must be returned to the lessor. Nullable for open-ended leases.

attributes.name: lease_execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement was formally signed and executed by both lessor and lessee parties. Legal effective date of the contract.

attributes.name: lease_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the lease agreement becomes binding and the aircraft is delivered to the lessee. Marks the beginning of rental obligations.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lease agreement. Tracks the agreement from negotiation through active operation to closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|extended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease arrangement. Dry lease: aircraft only. Wet lease: aircraft with crew. ACMI: Aircraft, Crew, Maintenance, Insurance. Damp lease: aircraft with some crew.
attributes.references: IATA Leasing Standards, FAA Part 121 Subpart W

attributes.name: maintenance_reserve_rate_per_cycle
attributes.description: Maintenance reserve contribution rate in US dollars per flight cycle (takeoff and landing). Applied to landing gear and other cycle-sensitive components.
attributes.references: IATA Maintenance Cost Standards, MRO Financial Standards

attributes.name: maintenance_reserve_rate_per_fh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maintenance Reserve Rate per Flight Hour (FH)
attributes.description: Maintenance reserve contribution rate in US dollars per flight hour. Accumulated reserves fund major maintenance events and are reconciled at lease end.
attributes.references: IATA Maintenance Cost Standards, MRO Financial Standards

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Party responsible for performing and funding aircraft maintenance during the lease term. Defines operational obligations under the lease type.

attributes.name: monthly_rental_rate_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Monthly Rental Rate (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly lease payment amount in US dollars payable to the lessor. Base rental rate excluding maintenance reserves and other variable charges.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Financial Standards, IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which lease rental payments are due to the lessor. Defines the billing cycle for the lease obligation.

attributes.name: redelivery_location_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code specifying the contractual location where the aircraft must be returned to the lessor at lease end.

attributes.name: return_condition_max_cycles
attributes.description: Maximum total flight cycles allowed on the aircraft at lease return. Contractual limit for takeoff/landing cycles at redelivery.

attributes.name: return_condition_max_flight_hours
attributes.description: Maximum total flight hours allowed on the aircraft at lease return. Contractual limit defining acceptable utilization at redelivery.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Security Deposit Amount (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Refundable security deposit amount in US dollars held by the lessor as collateral against lease obligations and aircraft return conditions.

products.name: engine
products.description: Master record for each aircraft engine tracked as an independent serialized asset. Engines move between aircraft (on-wing swaps), go to MRO shops, and serve as spares — requiring independent lifecycle tracking separate from the airframe. Captures engine serial number (ESN), manufacturer (CFM International, GE Aviation, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney), engine model/variant (e.g. CFM56-7B27, LEAP-1A26), current position on aircraft (1/2/3/4 or spare/shop), current installed aircraft reference, installation date, last removal date, total flight hours since new (TSN), total cycles since new (CSN), hours since last shop visit (TSLSV), cycles since last shop visit (CSLSV), engine status (installed/spare/QEC/shop/beyond-repair/retired), thrust rating (lbf/kN), ETOPS eligibility flag, and life-limited parts (LLP) remaining cycles summary. Critical for engine shop visit planning and lease return.
products.reference: EASA / FAA Engine Type Certificate Data Sheet

attributes.name: engine_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft engine asset. Primary key for the engine master record.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aircraft on which this engine is currently installed. Null if engine is in spare pool or shop.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Engine MRO costs, PBH (power-by-hour) contract charges, and depreciation must be attributed to a cost centre for airline management accounting and CASK reporting by fleet type. Aviation finance contro

attributes.name: current_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Off-wing engine inventory management and shop visit logistics require station tracking. Spare engine positioning, MRO coordination, and rotable pool management depend on knowing current engine locatio

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Engines are individually capitalized assets under IFRS/GAAP requiring their own fixed_asset records for depreciation, impairment testing, and disposal accounting. Engine acquisition_cost and current_b

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: Engines are often leased separately from airframes (power-by-hour contracts, standalone engine leases). Finance must track engine lease liabilities independently for IFRS16 compliance and cash flow fo

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost of this engine in the airline's reporting currency. Used for asset valuation, depreciation calculation, and financial reporting. Null if cost information is not tracked.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when this engine was acquired by the airline, either through purchase, lease commencement, or delivery from manufacturer. Used for asset accounting and depreciation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engine master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: cslsv_cycles
attributes.description: Flight cycles accumulated since the engine's last major shop visit or overhaul. Resets to zero after each shop visit. Used alongside TSLSV for shop visit planning.
attributes.references: IATA Engine Maintenance Cost Working Group Standards

attributes.name: csn_cycles
attributes.description: Total number of flight cycles (takeoff and landing pairs) accumulated by this engine since manufacture. One cycle equals one takeoff-landing sequence. Used for fatigue life tracking.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 120-16 - Continuing Analysis and Surveillance

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current depreciated book value of this engine on the airline's balance sheet. Updated based on depreciation schedule and any impairment charges. Null if not tracked.

attributes.name: engine_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the engine. Installed (on-wing), spare (serviceable spare pool), QEC (Quick Engine Change kit), shop (undergoing MRO), beyond-repair (uneconomical to repair), retired (end of service life), or AOG (Aircraft on Ground - engine causing aircraft grounding). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: installed|spare|QEC|shop|beyond-repair|retired|AOG — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Maintenance Cost Task Force Standards

attributes.name: esn
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for this engine. The globally unique identifier used for tracking, MRO, and lease return. Also known as ESN in aviation industry.

attributes.name: etops_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engine meets ETOPS certification requirements for extended over-water or remote area operations. True if engine is ETOPS-certified and current on all ETOPS maintenance requirements.

attributes.name: etops_rating_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Rating Minutes
attributes.description: ETOPS diversion time rating in minutes (e.g., 120, 180, 207, 330). Defines maximum allowable distance from suitable alternate airport. Null if engine is not ETOPS-certified.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when this engine was installed on the current aircraft. Null if engine is not currently installed on an aircraft.

attributes.name: last_shop_visit_date
attributes.description: Date when this engine completed its most recent major shop visit or overhaul. Used to calculate TSLSV and CSLSV intervals.

attributes.name: last_shop_visit_type
attributes.description: Type of maintenance work performed during the last shop visit. Performance restoration (PR), life-limited parts replacement, hot section inspection (HSI), or full overhaul. Determines next shop visit scope.
attributes.references: IATA Engine Maintenance Cost Working Group Standards

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current engine lease agreement expires. Critical for return condition planning and lease extension negotiations. Null if engine is owned.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Disclosure Guide - Leased Assets

attributes.name: lease_return_condition
attributes.description: Contractual maintenance condition requirements that must be met when returning this leased engine to the lessor. Typically specifies minimum remaining hours/cycles on LLPs and maintenance status. Null if owned.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Disclosure Guide - Leased Assets

attributes.name: llp_lowest_remaining_cycles
attributes.description: Remaining cycles until mandatory retirement of the most limiting life-limited part in this engine. Critical for shop visit planning and residual value assessment.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 39-8 - Continued Airworthiness Assessments

attributes.name: llp_summary
attributes.description: Summary of remaining cycles for critical life-limited parts (LLP) in this engine. LLPs are components with mandatory retirement life limits due to fatigue considerations. Format typically includes part numbers and remaining cycles.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 39-8 - Continued Airworthiness Assessments

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the engine manufacturer. Major manufacturers include CFM International, GE Aviation, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney, IAE (International Aero Engines), and Engine Alliance.

attributes.name: mel_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engine has any active MEL items that allow aircraft dispatch with certain engine components inoperative under controlled conditions. True if MEL items are currently active.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 120-91 - Airport Obstacle Analysis

attributes.name: mel_item_count
attributes.description: Number of active MEL items currently logged against this engine. Zero indicates no MEL items. Higher counts may indicate declining engine health or deferred maintenance.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 120-91 - Airport Obstacle Analysis

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Specific engine model and variant designation (e.g., CFM56-7B27, LEAP-1A26, Trent 1000, PW4000). Defines thrust rating, fuel efficiency, and maintenance program applicability.

attributes.name: mro_provider
attributes.description: Name of the MRO facility or provider currently responsible for this engine's maintenance, or the facility where the engine is currently undergoing shop work. May be OEM, third-party MRO, or airline in-house facility.

attributes.name: next_shop_visit_due_date
attributes.description: Planned or forecast date when this engine is scheduled for its next major shop visit or overhaul. Based on maintenance program intervals and current utilization rates.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership and financial arrangement for this engine. Owned (airline owns outright), finance_lease (capital lease with ownership transfer), operating_lease (rental), power_by_hour (pay-per-use MRO contract), or spare_lease (short-term spare engine rental).
attributes.references: IATA Airline Disclosure Guide - Leased Assets

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Current position of the engine. For installed engines: 1, 2, 3, or 4 (left to right facing forward). For uninstalled: spare (serviceable spare pool), shop (undergoing MRO), or QEC (Quick Engine Change kit assembly). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|spare|shop|QEC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: power_by_hour_contract
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engine is covered under a power-by-hour (PBH) or similar pay-per-use maintenance contract with the OEM or MRO provider. True if under PBH contract.
attributes.references: IATA Engine Maintenance Cost Working Group Standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or operational remarks about this engine. May include historical events, special handling requirements, or configuration notes.

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date when this engine was last removed from an aircraft. Used to track off-wing time and shop visit intervals.

attributes.name: thrust_rating_kn
attributes.description: Maximum certified thrust output of this engine variant measured in kilonewtons (kN). International standard unit for thrust measurement.

attributes.name: thrust_rating_lbf
attributes.description: Maximum certified thrust output of this engine variant measured in pounds-force (lbf). Determines aircraft performance capabilities and operational limitations.

attributes.name: tslsv_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time Since Last Shop Visit (TSLSV) Hours
attributes.description: Flight hours accumulated since the engine's last major shop visit or overhaul. Resets to zero after each shop visit. Used to plan next shop visit interval.
attributes.references: IATA Engine Maintenance Cost Working Group Standards

attributes.name: tsn_hours
attributes.description: Total flight hours accumulated by this engine since it was manufactured (Time Since New). Critical metric for life-limited parts tracking and residual value calculation.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 120-16 - Continuing Analysis and Surveillance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engine master record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute of the engine record changes. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage for this engine expires. After this date, all maintenance costs are borne by the airline or covered under separate maintenance agreements.

products.name: aircraft_utilization
products.description: Daily utilization ledger for each aircraft capturing actual operational activity — the authoritative source for airframe time and cycles used by maintenance planning, lease return monitoring, and fleet economics. Each record is keyed to aircraft + date. Stores daily block hours flown, flight hours (airborne), flight cycles completed, number of sectors, number of landings, fuel burn (kg), APU hours, and revenue vs. non-revenue (ferry/positioning) breakdown. Maintains running cumulative totals: total airframe hours since new (TSN), total cycles since new (CSN). Feeds maintenance interval calculations, CASK/RASK analytics, lease return condition tracking, and regulatory utilization reporting.
products.reference: IATA AHM (Airport Handling Manual) / ACARS OOOI Data

attributes.name: aircraft_utilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each daily aircraft utilization record. Primary key for the aircraft utilization ledger.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the aircraft master data. Links this utilization record to the specific aircraft asset.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Daily aircraft utilization drives cost allocation (fuel, crew, maintenance reserves). Finance allocates costs by aircraft to cost centres for profitability analysis, CASK calculation, and route/fleet

attributes.name: operating_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Daily utilization records require station context for station-level performance reporting, cost center allocation, and operational efficiency analysis. Critical for hub vs spoke utilization comparison

attributes.name: apu_hours
attributes.description: Total APU operating hours on this date. APU provides ground power and air conditioning when main engines are off. Tracked for APU maintenance intervals.

attributes.name: average_daily_utilization_hours
attributes.description: Rolling 30-day average daily block hours for this aircraft, calculated as of this utilization date. Used for fleet planning and lease utilization benchmarking.

attributes.name: block_hours
attributes.description: Total block hours flown on this date, measured from gate departure (off-blocks) to gate arrival (on-blocks). Primary utilization metric for lease agreements and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the quality and completeness of this utilization record. Verified indicates data has been validated against multiple sources, estimated indicates calculated or interpolated values, incomplete indicates missing data elements, reconciled indicates discrepancies have been resolved.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system from which this utilization data was captured. ACARS (Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System) provides automated flight data, FMS (Flight Management System) provides flight planning data, AMOS (Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System) provides maintenance records, manual indicates operator-entered data.

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Total delay minutes attributed to this aircraft on this date, summed across all flights. Used for OTP (On-Time Performance) analysis and aircraft reliability tracking.

attributes.name: etops_sectors
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Sectors
attributes.description: Number of ETOPS-certified flight sectors operated on this date. ETOPS allows twin-engine aircraft to fly routes more than 60 minutes from the nearest suitable airport.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 Part I, FAA AC 120-42B - ETOPS

attributes.name: flight_cycles
attributes.description: Total number of flight cycles (pressurization cycles) completed on this date. One cycle equals one takeoff and landing. Critical for fatigue-sensitive component maintenance.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: flight_hours
attributes.description: Total airborne flight hours on this date, measured from wheels-off to wheels-on. Used for airframe and engine maintenance interval calculations.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: fuel_burn_kg
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed (in kilograms) on this date across all flights. Used for CASK calculation and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: ground_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total ground time (turnaround time) between flights on this date, summed across all sectors. Used for ground operations efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: landings
attributes.description: Total number of landings performed on this date. Used for landing gear and brake maintenance tracking.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: mel_items_open
attributes.description: Number of open MEL items (deferred defects) at the end of this utilization date. MEL allows aircraft to operate with certain non-critical systems inoperative under specific conditions.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs, MMEL/MEL

attributes.name: night_flight_hours
attributes.description: Total flight hours operated during night hours (as defined by local aviation authority) on this date. Used for crew scheduling and fatigue management compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 Part I - Operation of Aircraft

attributes.name: non_revenue_block_hours
attributes.description: Block hours flown on non-revenue flights including ferry, positioning, maintenance test flights, and crew training.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the aircraft on this date. In_service indicates normal revenue operations, maintenance indicates scheduled or unscheduled maintenance, AOG (Aircraft on Ground) indicates unplanned downtime, storage indicates temporary or long-term parking, ferry indicates non-revenue positioning.

attributes.name: pirep_count
attributes.description: Number of pilot-reported maintenance discrepancies logged on this date. Used for aircraft reliability trending and predictive maintenance.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilization record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilization record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: revenue_block_hours
attributes.description: Block hours flown on revenue-generating flights (passenger or cargo). Excludes ferry, positioning, and maintenance flights.

attributes.name: sectors_flown
attributes.description: Total number of flight sectors (legs) operated on this date. Equivalent to number of departures.

attributes.name: tail_number
attributes.description: The unique aircraft registration identifier (tail number) for operational reference. Denormalized from aircraft master for query performance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: technical_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Delay minutes caused by technical or maintenance issues on this date. Subset of total delay minutes, used for aircraft reliability and maintenance effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: total_airframe_hours_tsn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Airframe Hours Time Since New (TSN)
attributes.description: Cumulative total airframe hours since the aircraft was manufactured, as of the end of this utilization date. Running total used for major maintenance checks and lease return conditions.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: total_cycles_csn
attributes.description: Cumulative total flight cycles since the aircraft was manufactured, as of the end of this utilization date. Running total used for fatigue-sensitive component tracking.
attributes.references: FAA AC 120-16F - Air Carrier Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: utilization_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (UTC) for which this utilization record applies. Each aircraft has one record per operational day.

products.name: etops_authorization
products.description: Records ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) authorization for each aircraft, specifying the approved diversion time (e.g. 120, 180, 240 minutes), the authorizing regulatory body (FAA, EASA, national CAA), authorization certificate number, effective date, expiry date, applicable route pairs or geographic areas, required maintenance program compliance references, and current authorization status (active/suspended/expired). Each aircraft may have multiple ETOPS authorizations from different regulators. Critical for long-haul twin-engine route dispatch.
products.reference: FAA AC 120-42B / EASA AMC 20-6 ETOPS

attributes.name: etops_authorization_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Authorization ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ETOPS authorization record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aircraft asset that holds this ETOPS authorization. Links to the aircraft master registry in the fleet domain.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: ETOPS authorization is granted for a specific aircraft-engine type combination. etops_authorization currently stores engine_type_designator as a STRING descriptor but has no FK to aircraft_type. Addin

attributes.name: authorizing_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: ETOPS authorizations often tied to specific maintenance stations with certified capabilities. Regulatory compliance audits and diversion planning require tracking which station holds ETOPS maintenance

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Regulatory ETOPS compliance requires linking each aircraft ETOPS authorization to the specific routes it covers. Dispatch and safety departments must verify that etops_required routes are served only

attributes.name: apu_etops_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: APU (Auxiliary Power Unit) ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the APU on this aircraft meets ETOPS reliability and operational standards. True if APU is ETOPS-compliant and available for in-flight use; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the audit or inspection report that validated compliance with ETOPS requirements prior to authorization issuance. May include document ID or inspection case number.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Authorization Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ETOPS authorization. Active authorizations are valid for dispatch; suspended, expired, or revoked authorizations prohibit ETOPS operations.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: cargo_fire_suppression_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cargo Fire Suppression ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo compartment fire suppression system meets ETOPS requirements for extended diversion times. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA 14 CFR 121.161, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: communication_system_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Communication System ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft communication systems (HF, SATCOM, ACARS) meet ETOPS requirements for extended overwater operations. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ETOPS authorization record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: diversion_time_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Approved Diversion Time in Minutes
attributes.description: The maximum approved diversion time in minutes that the aircraft is authorized to operate from the nearest suitable alternate airport. Common values include 120, 138, 180, 207, or 240 minutes.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6 Part I, FAA 14 CFR 121.161, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Authorization Effective Date
attributes.description: The date on which this ETOPS authorization becomes valid and the aircraft is approved to commence ETOPS operations under this authorization.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA 14 CFR 121.161, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: electrical_system_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electrical System ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft electrical power generation and distribution systems meet ETOPS redundancy standards. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: engine_type_designator
attributes.description: ICAO or manufacturer engine type designator for the engines installed on this aircraft under this ETOPS authorization (e.g., CFM56-7B, GE90-115B). ETOPS authorization is engine-type specific.
attributes.references: ICAO Engine Type Designators, FAA Type Certificate Data Sheet

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Authorization Expiry Date
attributes.description: The date on which this ETOPS authorization expires and is no longer valid for dispatch. Nullable for authorizations without a fixed expiry (subject to continuous compliance).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: fuel_system_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel System ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft fuel system (including pumps, crossfeed, and monitoring) meets ETOPS reliability and redundancy standards. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: hydraulic_system_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydraulic System ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft hydraulic systems meet ETOPS redundancy and reliability requirements. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: last_compliance_verification_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent compliance verification or audit confirming that the aircraft and operator continue to meet ETOPS standards. Used to track ongoing compliance.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT, Internal Compliance Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ETOPS authorization record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: maintenance_program_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Maintenance Program Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the approved ETOPS maintenance program document or section number that this authorization is contingent upon. Compliance with this program is mandatory for maintaining authorization validity.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT, Operator Maintenance Program

attributes.name: mel_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: MEL (Minimum Equipment List) Reference for ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards)
attributes.description: Reference to the specific MEL section or revision that governs ETOPS dispatch requirements for this aircraft. Identifies which equipment must be operational for ETOPS flight.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT, Operator MEL

attributes.name: navigation_system_etops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Navigation System ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft navigation systems (FMS, GPS, INS) meet ETOPS accuracy and redundancy requirements. True if compliant; false otherwise.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: next_compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit to ensure continued ETOPS authorization validity. Nullable if no periodic review is mandated.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT, Internal Compliance Standard

attributes.name: operator_etops_experience_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operator ETOPS (Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards) Experience Level
attributes.description: The operator's ETOPS experience classification at the time of this authorization. Initial operators may have more restrictive conditions; advanced operators may have fewer limitations.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text remarks, notes, or clarifications related to this ETOPS authorization. May include historical context, amendment notes, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special conditions, operational limitations, or additional requirements imposed by the regulatory authority on this ETOPS authorization (e.g., seasonal restrictions, crew qualification requirements, alternate airport specifications).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

attributes.name: time_limited_system_extension_minutes
attributes.description: For certain ETOPS authorizations, the approved extension time (in minutes) for time-limited systems (e.g., cargo fire suppression discharge time). Nullable if not applicable.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA AC 120-42B, EASA Part-CAT

products.name: aircraft_registration
products.description: Official regulatory registration record for each aircraft with the national civil aviation authority. Captures registration mark (tail number), registering country (ICAO country prefix), national civil aviation authority (CAA) name, certificate of registration number, registration date, registration expiry date, registered owner name, registered operator name, aircraft category (transport/general aviation), certificate of airworthiness number, airworthiness category, noise certificate number, and registration status (current/expired/cancelled/transferred). This is the regulatory identity record for the aircraft asset.
products.reference: ICAO Annex 7 Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: aircraft_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft registration record. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent aircraft master record in the fleet domain. Links this registration record to the physical aircraft asset.

attributes.name: registered_operator_legal_entity_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registered Operator Legal Entity Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: The registered operator and owner on an aircraft registration certificate must be a legal entity for AOC compliance, insurance, and regulatory filings. registered_operator_name and registered_owner_na

attributes.name: aircraft_category
attributes.description: The regulatory category classification of the aircraft. Transport category includes commercial passenger and cargo aircraft. General aviation includes smaller aircraft for personal or business use.

attributes.name: airworthiness_category
attributes.description: The category of the certificate of airworthiness indicating the operational limitations and certification basis. Standard is for normal commercial operations, restricted for limited operations, provisional for temporary certification.

attributes.name: airworthiness_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current certificate of airworthiness expires. Nullable for certificates that remain valid subject to continuing airworthiness requirements.

attributes.name: airworthiness_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current certificate of airworthiness was issued by the national civil aviation authority.

attributes.name: certificate_of_airworthiness_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Airworthiness (C of A) Number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the national civil aviation authority certifying that the aircraft meets airworthiness standards and is safe to fly. Also known as C of A number.

attributes.name: certificate_of_registration_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the national civil aviation authority for this aircraft registration. This is the official document number proving the aircraft is registered.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: export_certificate_date
attributes.description: The date on which the export certificate of airworthiness was issued by the exporting country civil aviation authority.

attributes.name: export_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate number issued by the exporting country civil aviation authority when the aircraft was transferred from another jurisdiction. Required for international aircraft transfers.

attributes.name: national_caa_name
attributes.description: The name of the national civil aviation authority that issued the registration. Examples: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), Civil Aviation Authority (CAA).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: noise_certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the national civil aviation authority certifying that the aircraft meets noise emission standards per ICAO Annex 16. Required for commercial operations at most airports.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 16 - Environmental Protection, Volume I - Aircraft Noise

attributes.name: noise_chapter_compliance
attributes.description: The ICAO Annex 16 noise certification chapter that the aircraft complies with. Chapter 4 is the most stringent current standard. Chapter 2 aircraft are banned from most airports.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 16 - Environmental Protection, Volume I - Aircraft Noise

attributes.name: previous_registering_country_code
attributes.description: The ICAO country code of the previous country of registration, if the aircraft was transferred from another jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: previous_registration_mark
attributes.description: The previous registration mark (tail number) assigned to this aircraft before the current registration, if applicable. Used to track aircraft that have been re-registered or transferred between jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registering_country_code
attributes.description: The ICAO two or three-letter country code prefix indicating the country of registration. Examples: N (USA), G (UK), D (Germany), C (Canada).
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the aircraft was officially registered with the national civil aviation authority. This is the effective start date of the registration.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current aircraft registration expires and must be renewed. Nullable for registrations without expiry or perpetual registrations.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registration_mark
attributes.description: The official registration mark (tail number) assigned by the national civil aviation authority. This is the unique identifier painted on the aircraft fuselage and tail. Also known as aircraft registration number or tail number.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registration_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the aircraft registration. May include restrictions, special authorizations, or historical notes.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the aircraft registration. Current indicates active registration, expired indicates registration has lapsed, cancelled indicates registration has been terminated, suspended indicates temporary suspension, transferred indicates registration has been moved to another jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: registration_status_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current registration status became effective. Used to track when a registration was cancelled, suspended, or transferred.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 7 - Aircraft Nationality and Registration Marks

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this registration record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: lessor
products.description: Master reference table for lessor. Referenced by lessor_id.

attributes.name: lessor_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lessor

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Lessors are external legal entities requiring formal entity registration for contract management, counterparty credit risk assessment, and regulatory reporting. Lessor registration_number and tax_iden

attributes.name: parent_lessor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on lessor (parent_lessor_id)

attributes.name: aircraft_leased_to_airline_count
attributes.description: Number of aircraft currently leased from this lessor to Airlines.
