attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the lessor's registered business address (street number and name).

attributes.name: business_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the lessor's registered business address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: business_city
attributes.description: City of the lessor's registered business address.

attributes.name: business_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the lessor's registered business address.

attributes.name: business_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the lessor's registered business address.

attributes.name: business_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the lessor's registered business address.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current master lease agreement or relationship with this lessor is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended relationships.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the first lease contract with this lessor became effective.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lessor record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Current credit rating assigned to the lessor by recognized rating agencies (e.g., Moody's, S&P, Fitch).

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the credit rating agency that issued the credit rating.

attributes.name: credit_rating_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit rating was issued or last updated.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the lessor's preferred invoicing and payment currency.

attributes.name: fleet_size
attributes.description: Total number of aircraft owned by the lessor across all customers and aircraft types.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the lessor's primary headquarters office is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the lessor's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the lessor's liability insurance certificate on file with Airlines.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the lessor's current liability insurance certificate.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent financial or operational audit conducted on the lessor by Airlines or a third-party auditor.

attributes.name: lessor_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the lessor for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the aircraft lessor organization.

attributes.name: lessor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the lessor relationship in the fleet management system.

attributes.name: lessor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lessor based on their business model and lease structure (operating lease, finance lease, sale-leaseback, manufacturer-backed, bank-owned, or private equity).

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next financial or operational audit of the lessor.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the lessor relationship.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard payment terms in days for lease payments to this lessor (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days).

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessor has preferred vendor status with Airlines for priority consideration in lease negotiations.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the lessor for operational communications and lease administration.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the lessor organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the lessor's main business contact, including country code.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory approvals required for the lessor to lease aircraft to Airlines in applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lessor record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the lessor organization.

domains.name: maintenance
domains.description: Aircraft MRO (Maintenance Repair and Overhaul) lifecycle management including scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, work orders, airworthiness directives (ADs), component life-limited parts tracking, MEL (Minimum Equipment List) deferrals, AOG (Aircraft on Ground) events, APU maintenance, Part-145 approved maintenance organisation records, and defect tracking. Aligns with AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System.
domains.references: FAA Part 145, EASA Part-M/Part-145, ICAO Annex 8

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core MRO work order entity representing a discrete maintenance task or package issued against an aircraft, component, or system. Captures work order number, type (scheduled/unscheduled/AOG/modification), status lifecycle (open/in-progress/deferred/closed), originating source (AD, SB, MEL, defect, interval), estimated and actual man-hours, labour cost, material cost, station, start and completion timestamps, sign-off authority, Part-145 approval reference, and associated AMO. SSOT for all maintenance execution records. Links upward to maintenance program/check and downward to tasks, material requests, and component removals.
products.reference: AMOS Work Order

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance work order. Primary key for all MRO (Maintenance Repair and Overhaul) execution records.
attributes.references: IATA Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM), Part-145 Maintenance Organisation Approval

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aircraft on which this maintenance work order is being performed. Links to the aircraft master record.

attributes.name: airworthiness_directive_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.airworthiness_directive. Business justification: work_order.ad_reference is a denormalized STRING reference to an Airworthiness Directive. Replacing with a proper FK to maintenance.airworthiness_directive normalizes the relationship, enables referen

attributes.name: approved_maintenance_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AMO (Approved Maintenance Organisation) or Part-145 certified organization performing the work. Links to the maintenance organization master record.

attributes.description: The actual total labor hours consumed during execution of this maintenance check. Used for cost accounting and efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_release_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the aircraft was certified airworthy and released back to operational service after completion of the maintenance check.
attributes.references: EASA Part-145 Release Certificate, FAA Form 8130-3

attributes.name: airworthiness_directives_complied
attributes.description: The number of mandatory Airworthiness Directives (ADs) complied with during this maintenance check. ADs are legally enforceable safety regulations issued by aviation authorities.
attributes.references: FAA Airworthiness Directives, EASA Airworthiness Directives

attributes.name: aog_event_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this maintenance check was triggered by or resulted in an Aircraft on Ground event, indicating unscheduled downtime with high operational impact.

attributes.name: check_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the maintenance check event. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: check_type
attributes.description: The category of scheduled maintenance check being performed. A-checks are light, frequent inspections; D-checks are heavy overhauls requiring aircraft disassembly.
attributes.references: IATA Maintenance Program Standards, EASA Part-M

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when all maintenance tasks were completed and the aircraft was certified for return to service. Used for audit trail and performance tracking.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total cost amount. Airlines operate globally and may incur maintenance costs in multiple currencies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this maintenance check record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: defects_found_count
attributes.description: The total number of defects, discrepancies, or non-conformities identified during execution of this maintenance check. Used for quality and reliability analysis.
attributes.references: EASA Part-145 Quality Standards, IATA Safety Management

attributes.name: downtime_days
attributes.description: The total number of days the aircraft was out of service for this maintenance check, calculated from induction to release. Critical for fleet utilization metrics.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The calendar date by which this maintenance check must be completed to maintain airworthiness certification. Calculated from maintenance program intervals.
attributes.references: EASA Part-M, FAA Part 121 Maintenance Requirements

attributes.name: due_flight_cycles
attributes.description: The cumulative aircraft flight cycles (takeoff-landing pairs) at which this maintenance check is due. Critical for structural fatigue monitoring.
attributes.references: IATA Maintenance Program Standards, ICAO Annex 8

attributes.name: due_flight_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative aircraft flight hours at which this maintenance check is due. One of three interval metrics (hours, cycles, calendar) used to trigger maintenance.

attributes.name: interval_days
attributes.description: The calendar day interval between occurrences of this check type as defined in the maintenance program. For example, A-checks typically occur every 500-800 flight hours or 200-300 cycles or 60-90 days, whichever comes first.
attributes.references: EASA Part-M, Manufacturer Maintenance Planning Documents

attributes.name: interval_flight_cycles
attributes.description: The flight cycle interval between occurrences of this check type as defined in the maintenance program.
attributes.references: EASA Part-M, Manufacturer Maintenance Planning Documents

attributes.name: interval_flight_hours
attributes.description: The flight hour interval between occurrences of this check type as defined in the maintenance program.
attributes.references: EASA Part-M, Manufacturer Maintenance Planning Documents

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this maintenance check record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture processes.

attributes.name: mel_deferrals_count
attributes.description: The number of defects deferred under Minimum Equipment List provisions during this check, allowing aircraft return to service with specific inoperative equipment.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 6, FAA MEL Regulations, EASA MEL Standards

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: The projected calendar date when the next occurrence of this check type will be due, calculated from completion date plus maintenance interval.
attributes.references: EASA Part-M, FAA Part 121 Maintenance Programs

attributes.name: next_due_flight_cycles
attributes.description: The projected cumulative aircraft flight cycles at which the next occurrence of this check type will be due.

attributes.name: next_due_flight_hours
attributes.description: The projected cumulative aircraft flight hours at which the next occurrence of this check type will be due.

attributes.name: planned_man_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total labor hours required to complete this maintenance check, used for resource planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: release_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Release to Service (CRS) Number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Certificate of Release to Service issued upon completion of this maintenance check, certifying the aircraft is airworthy.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special circumstances related to this maintenance check. Used for operational context and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: scheduled_induction_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the aircraft will enter the maintenance facility to begin this check. Used for capacity planning and aircraft rotation scheduling.

attributes.name: scheduled_release_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the aircraft is expected to be released back to service after completion of the maintenance check.

attributes.name: service_bulletins_incorporated
attributes.description: The number of manufacturer service bulletins (recommended but not mandatory modifications or inspections) incorporated during this maintenance check.

products.name: airworthiness_directive
products.description: Airworthiness Directive (AD) master record issued by FAA, EASA, or national CAA mandating corrective action on aircraft, engines, or components. Captures AD number, issuing authority, effective date, compliance method (one-time/repetitive), threshold (FH/FC/calendar), interval, applicability (aircraft type, serial number range), superseded AD references, and compliance status per tail number. SSOT for regulatory AD tracking.
products.reference: FAA AD / EASA AD

attributes.name: airworthiness_directive_id
attributes.description: Primary key for airworthiness_directive

attributes.name: ad_number
attributes.description: Official AD number issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., FAA AD 2023-12-05, EASA AD 2023-0145). Unique identifier assigned by the issuing authority.

attributes.name: ad_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AD. Active=currently enforceable, Superseded=replaced by newer AD, Cancelled=no longer applicable, Proposed=under review, Interim=temporary emergency AD.

attributes.name: aircraft_type
attributes.description: Aircraft type designation to which this AD applies (e.g., Boeing 737-800, Airbus A320-200, Embraer E175). May include multiple types if AD applies broadly.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 8, Type Certificate Data Sheet

attributes.name: airworthiness_directive_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the unsafe condition, the corrective action required, and the rationale for the airworthiness directive.

attributes.name: alternative_compliance_method
attributes.description: Description of approved Alternative Methods of Compliance (AMOC) that may be used in lieu of the prescribed action, if permitted by the issuing authority.

attributes.name: applicability
attributes.description: Defines which aircraft, engines, propellers, or components are affected by this AD. Includes aircraft type, model, serial number ranges, and part numbers.

attributes.name: compliance_interval_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for repetitive compliance interval. FH=Flight Hours, FC=Flight Cycles, days/months/years=calendar time. Null for one-time ADs.

attributes.name: compliance_interval_value
attributes.description: Numeric interval value for repetitive compliance actions (e.g., repeat inspection every 1000 flight hours). Null for one-time ADs.

attributes.name: compliance_method
attributes.description: Type of compliance action required. One-time=single inspection or action, Repetitive=recurring inspections at intervals, Terminating=final action that eliminates need for repetitive compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for compliance threshold. FH=Flight Hours, FC=Flight Cycles, days/months/years=calendar time.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value at which initial compliance action must be performed (e.g., 5000 flight hours, 2500 flight cycles, 180 calendar days).

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Category of component affected by the AD. Airframe=aircraft structure, Engine=propulsion system, Propeller=propeller assembly, Appliance=accessory or system component, APU=Auxiliary Power Unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AD record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official AD document on the issuing authority's website (e.g., FAA AD docket, EASA AD repository).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the airworthiness directive becomes legally enforceable and compliance is required.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_per_aircraft
attributes.description: Estimated cost in USD to comply with the AD per affected aircraft, including labor, parts, and downtime. Provided by issuing authority or operator estimate.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Estimated labor hours required to perform the compliance action per aircraft, as provided by the issuing authority or manufacturer.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the airworthiness directive was officially published by the issuing authority.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AD record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: part_number_affected
attributes.description: Specific part number(s) of components affected by this AD. May include multiple part numbers if AD applies to a family of parts.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or operator-specific annotations regarding the AD compliance, interpretation, or fleet impact.

attributes.name: serial_number_range
attributes.description: Serial number range of aircraft or components to which this AD applies (e.g., 'S/N 1001 through 5000'). Null if AD applies to all serial numbers.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line describing the nature of the airworthiness directive (e.g., 'Engine Fan Blade Inspection', 'Landing Gear Actuator Replacement').

attributes.name: superseded_ad_number
attributes.description: AD number(s) that this directive supersedes or replaces. Multiple ADs may be listed if this AD consolidates previous directives. Null if no supersession.

products.name: ad_compliance
products.description: Compliance record tracking the status of each Airworthiness Directive against each applicable aircraft or component. Records compliance method selected, accomplishment date, flight hours at accomplishment, cycles at accomplishment, next-due date/hours/cycles for repetitive ADs, work order reference, certifying staff sign-off, and open/closed/deferred status. Enables airworthiness compliance reporting to FAA/EASA/CAA.
products.reference: AMOS AD Compliance Tracking

attributes.name: general_ledger_id

attributes.name: maintenance_airworthiness_directive_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.airworthiness_directive. Business justification: AD compliance tracks compliance with a specific airworthiness directive. The ad_compliance table has ad_number, ad_title, and issuing_authority but no FK to airworthiness_directive. Adding maintenance

attributes.name: triggering_occurrence_id

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order under which the airworthiness directive compliance action was performed.

attributes.name: accomplishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the airworthiness directive compliance action was completed.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System, FAA 14 CFR Part 43

attributes.name: accomplishment_flight_cycles
attributes.description: The total flight cycles (airframe or component) at the time the airworthiness directive compliance action was completed.

attributes.name: accomplishment_flight_hours
attributes.description: The total flight hours (airframe or component) at the time the airworthiness directive compliance action was completed.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System, FAA 14 CFR Part 43

attributes.name: ad_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the airworthiness directive becomes effective and compliance is required.

attributes.name: amoc_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Alternative Method of Compliance (AMOC) Approval Date
attributes.description: The date on which the alternative method of compliance was approved by the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: amoc_approval_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Alternative Method of Compliance (AMOC) Approval Number
attributes.description: The regulatory approval number for an alternative method of compliance, if an AMOC has been granted by the authority.

attributes.name: applicability
attributes.description: Description of the aircraft models, serial numbers, or component part numbers to which this airworthiness directive applies.

attributes.name: certifying_mechanic_license_number
attributes.description: The license or certificate number of the mechanic who certified the airworthiness directive compliance action.

attributes.name: compliance_method
attributes.description: The method selected to comply with the airworthiness directive: inspection, modification, replacement, operational limitation, or alternative method of compliance (AMOC).

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting additional details, findings, or special circumstances related to the airworthiness directive compliance action.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of compliance with the airworthiness directive: open (pending action), complied (completed), deferred (postponed under MEL), not applicable (does not apply to this aircraft/component), superseded (replaced by newer AD), or cancelled (withdrawn by authority).

attributes.name: deferral_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which the deferred airworthiness directive compliance action must be completed.

attributes.name: deferral_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Minimum Equipment List (MEL) or Configuration Deviation List (CDL) item under which compliance with this airworthiness directive has been deferred.

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: The calendar date by which the next repetitive airworthiness directive compliance action is due.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System, FAA 14 CFR Part 39

attributes.name: next_due_flight_cycles
attributes.description: The flight cycles threshold at which the next repetitive airworthiness directive compliance action is due.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System, FAA 14 CFR Part 39

attributes.name: next_due_flight_hours
attributes.description: The flight hours threshold at which the next repetitive airworthiness directive compliance action is due.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System, FAA 14 CFR Part 39

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this airworthiness directive compliance record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that last updated this airworthiness directive compliance record.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this airworthiness directive compliance record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: AMOS Aircraft Maintenance and Engineering System

attributes.name: repetitive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airworthiness directive requires repetitive compliance actions (true) or is a one-time action (false).

attributes.name: repetitive_interval_cycles

attributes.name: repetitive_interval_days
attributes.description: The calendar days interval at which the airworthiness directive compliance action must be repeated, if applicable.

attributes.name: repetitive_interval_hours
attributes.description: The flight hours interval at which the airworthiness directive compliance action must be repeated, if applicable.

attributes.name: superseded_by_ad_number
attributes.description: The airworthiness directive number that supersedes this AD, if applicable.

products.name: service_bulletin
products.description: Manufacturer Service Bulletin (SB) and Service Letter (SL) master record issued by OEM (Airbus, Boeing, CFM, etc.) recommending or mandating modifications, inspections, or part replacements. Captures SB number, revision, OEM, ATA chapter, category (mandatory/recommended/optional), effectivity, compliance threshold, and cross-reference to any associated AD. SSOT for OEM technical communication tracking.
products.reference: OEM Service Bulletin / Service Letter

attributes.name: service_bulletin_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service bulletin record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aircraft_model_applicability
attributes.description: Aircraft model designations to which this service bulletin applies (e.g., 'A320-200', 'Boeing 737-800', 'Embraer E190'). May include multiple models separated by commas.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 8, FAA Type Certificate Data Sheets

attributes.name: ata_chapter
attributes.description: ATA 100 chapter code identifying the aircraft system or component category addressed by the service bulletin (e.g., 32 for Landing Gear, 71 for Power Plant, 27 for Flight Controls).

attributes.name: bulletin_category
attributes.description: Classification of the service bulletin indicating the urgency and compliance requirement. Mandatory bulletins are typically linked to Airworthiness Directives (ADs), while Recommended and Optional bulletins are at operator discretion.

attributes.name: bulletin_number
attributes.description: Official service bulletin number issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). Format varies by manufacturer (e.g., Boeing SB format: 737-57-1234, Airbus SB format: A320-32-1045).

attributes.name: bulletin_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the service bulletin summarizing the subject matter and purpose of the modification or inspection.

attributes.name: bulletin_type
attributes.description: Type of technical communication issued by the OEM. Service Bulletins are formal modification instructions, Service Letters are informational, Alert Service Bulletins address urgent safety issues.
attributes.value_regex: Service Bulletin|Service Letter|Alert Service Bulletin|All Operators Message|Technical Bulletin|Product Improvement

attributes.name: compliance_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when compliance with the service bulletin was completed across the applicable fleet. Null if compliance is not yet complete. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the service bulletin within the operator's fleet. Tracks whether the bulletin has been implemented, is in progress, or has been deferred.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold
attributes.description: Compliance deadline or threshold expressed in flight hours, flight cycles, calendar time, or next scheduled maintenance event (e.g., 'Within 12 months', 'Before 10,000 flight hours', 'At next C-Check').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service bulletin record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Bulletin (SB) Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full service bulletin document stored in the airline's document management system or OEM portal.

attributes.name: effectivity
attributes.description: Aircraft serial numbers, model series, or configuration codes to which the service bulletin applies. Defines the population of aircraft or components affected (e.g., 'All A320-200 MSN 1000-5000', 'Boeing 737-800 Line Numbers 1-999').

attributes.name: engine_model_applicability
attributes.description: Engine model designations to which this service bulletin applies (e.g., 'CFM56-5B', 'PW1100G', 'Trent 1000'). Null if bulletin does not apply to engines.
attributes.references: ICAO Annex 8, EASA Type Certificate Data Sheets

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated total cost to implement the service bulletin including parts, labor, and downtime. Expressed in USD for standardization.

attributes.name: estimated_man_hours
attributes.description: OEM-estimated labor hours required to complete the service bulletin task. Used for maintenance planning and cost estimation.
attributes.references: ATA MSG-3, IATA Maintenance Cost Task Force

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service bulletin is currently active and applicable. False if the bulletin has been superseded, cancelled, or completed across the fleet.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the service bulletin was officially issued by the OEM. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service bulletin record was last updated in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: oem_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or supplier that issued the service bulletin (e.g., Airbus, Boeing, CFM International, Pratt & Whitney). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Airbus|Boeing|Bombardier|Embraer|ATR|CFM International|Pratt & Whitney|Rolls-Royce|General Electric|Honeywell|Collins Aerospace|Safran|Thales|Liebherr|Goodrich — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: part_numbers_affected
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of part numbers (P/N) affected by this service bulletin. Identifies components requiring modification, inspection, or replacement.

attributes.name: reason_for_issue
attributes.description: Business or technical justification for issuing the service bulletin (e.g., 'Prevent premature wear', 'Improve reliability', 'Address safety concern', 'Regulatory compliance').

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision to the service bulletin. Null if no revisions have been issued. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Revision level of the service bulletin. Tracks updates and amendments to the original bulletin (e.g., Original, 1, 2, A, B).

attributes.name: superseded_bulletin_number
attributes.description: Service bulletin number that this bulletin supersedes or replaces. Null if this is the original bulletin with no predecessor.

attributes.name: technical_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the modification, inspection, or replacement procedure outlined in the service bulletin. Summarizes the work scope and technical rationale.

products.name: ad_incorporation
products.description: This association product represents the formal incorporation of an Airworthiness Directive into a specific Maintenance Program (AMP). It captures the regulatory compliance contract between a program and an AD — tracking incorporation status, compliance method selected for this program, effective date of incorporation, the program revision at which the AD was incorporated, and any operator-specific applicability overrides. Each record is a live regulatory obligation managed by the CAMO and subject to airworthiness authority audit.. Existence Justification: In aviation MRO operations, a Maintenance Program (AMP) formally incorporates multiple Airworthiness Directives, and a single AD applies to multiple maintenance programs (e.g., across different aircraft types or operator AMPs). Airlines and CAMOs actively manage an 'AD Incorporation' or 'Program AD Compliance Matrix' as a regulatory obligation — tracking which ADs are incorporated into which programs, at what revision, with what compliance method and status. This is not an analytical correlation; it is a live, audited, regulatory record that engineers create, update, and present to airworthiness authorities.

products.name: sb_incorporation
products.description: This association product represents the formal SB Incorporation contract between a maintenance program and a service bulletin. It captures the CAMO's official evaluation and embodiment decision for each Service Bulletin within a specific Approved Aircraft Maintenance Program (AMP), including incorporation status, decision date, revision level incorporated, and program-level cost estimate. Each record links one program to one service_bulletin and holds attributes that exist only in the context of this program-SB combination, supporting EASA Part-M/Part-CAMO regulatory compliance reporting and lessor SB status reporting.. Existence Justification: In MRO aviation operations, airlines formally manage an 'SB Incorporation Matrix' — a structured record of which Service Bulletins have been evaluated, incorporated, deferred, or rejected for each Approved Aircraft Maintenance Program (AMP). This is an actively managed operational concept: maintenance planners create, update, and close these records as SBs are issued by OEMs and evaluated against each program's scope, configuration, and regulatory requirements. A single AMP covers multiple SBs (e.g., all applicable Airbus SBs for an A320 fleet program), and a single SB may be evaluated against multiple AMPs (e.g., an Airbus SB applicable to both narrow-body and wide-body programs operated by the same airline). The relationship carries its own data — incorporation status, decision date, revision incorporated, and cost estimate — that belongs to neither the program nor the SB alone.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record tracking the end-to-end movement of cargo from acceptance to delivery, including granular milestone events. Captures shipment status (received, built-up, loaded, in-transit, arrived, delivered, on-hold), actual pieces and weight at acceptance, volume, commodity code (IATA/HS), special handling codes (SHC), temperature range for perishables, routing segments, current location, estimated and actual arrival times, proof of delivery, exception flags, and milestone event history (event code per IATA Cargo-XML: RCS, DEP, ARR, NFD, DLV, DIS with timestamps, station, flight, and responsible party). Links AWB to physical ULD build-up and flight manifest. SSOT for shipment lifecycle tracking and real-time shipment visibility.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg

attributes.name: transit_cargo_indicator

attributes.name: uld_count

attributes.name: valuable_cargo_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this manifest includes high-value cargo requiring enhanced security and handling procedures.

attributes.name: dg_class

attributes.name: dg_division
attributes.description: Subdivision within the DG class providing further hazard classification (e.g., 2.1 for flammable gases, 6.2 for infectious substances). May be null for classes without divisions.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or organization to contact in case of emergency involving the dangerous goods shipment.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone

attributes.name: gross_weight_per_package_kg

attributes.name: net_quantity_per_package

attributes.name: net_quantity_unit

attributes.name: number_of_packages

attributes.name: overpack_used_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an overpack (single enclosure containing one or more packages) was used for this dangerous goods shipment.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger presented by the substance: I=Great Danger, II=Medium Danger, III=Minor Danger. Not applicable to all DG classes.

attributes.name: packing_instruction
attributes.description: IATA packing instruction code specifying how the dangerous goods must be packaged for air transport (e.g., PI 965 for lithium ion batteries).

attributes.description: The official IATA-recognized name used to describe the dangerous goods substance or article as specified in the DGR List of Dangerous Goods.

attributes.name: radioactive_category

attributes.name: shipper_declaration_text
attributes.description: Full text of the shipper's declaration certifying that the dangerous goods are properly classified, packaged, marked, labeled, and in proper condition for transport by air.

attributes.name: special_provision_codes

attributes.name: state_variation_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of country-specific variation codes indicating deviations from IATA DGR by national civil aviation authorities.

attributes.name: subsidiary_risk_class

attributes.name: total_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of all packages containing dangerous goods in this declaration, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: total_net_quantity
attributes.description: Total net quantity of dangerous goods across all packages in this declaration. Calculated as net_quantity_per_package multiplied by number_of_packages.

attributes.name: transport_index
attributes.description: Single number assigned to a package, overpack, or freight container containing radioactive material to provide control over radiation exposure. Applicable only to Class 7 DG.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number assigned to the dangerous substance or article. Mandatory for all DG shipments per IATA DGR.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods - Model Regulations

SSOT for all cargo pricing and revenue sharing. Aligns with Mercator rating and interline modules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: rate_status

attributes.name: settlement_reference

attributes.name: surcharge_calculation_basis
attributes.description: Method for calculating surcharge amount. PERCENTAGE (percent of base freight), FLAT_AMOUNT (fixed charge), PER_KG (per kilogram), PER_SHIPMENT (per AWB).

attributes.name: surcharge_type
attributes.description: Type of surcharge if rate_type is SURCHARGE. products.name: uld_content
products.description: This association product represents the ULD Build-Up Event between uld_movement and shipment. It captures the operational record of which shipments were loaded into a specific ULD for a specific movement event, including the piece count, weight contribution, hold position, seal, and special handling codes applicable to that shipment within that ULD movement. Each record links one uld_movement to one shipment and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific build-up assignment. Aligns with IATA ULD Regulations and Cargo-XML messaging standards for ULD content manifesting.. Existence Justification: In air cargo operations, the ULD build-up process is a distinct, actively managed business activity where multiple shipments are physically loaded into a ULD for a specific movement event, and a single shipment may traverse multiple ULD movement events across its routing legs (e.g., built into ULD-A at origin, transferred to ULD-B at a hub). This relationship — known in the industry as a 'ULD Content Record' or 'ULD Shipment Assignment' — is operationally created, updated, and deleted by cargo handlers and is the authoritative record of which shipments were in which ULD at each movement event. The existing shipment.uld_id FK points only to the ULD asset (cargo.uld), not to a specific movement event, meaning it cannot represent the temporal/event-level assignment that cargo operations actually require.

Belongs to the association because weight allocation per shipment per ULD movement is an operational record distinct from the shipment's total weight.

Distinct from the total ULD piece count (which aggregates all shipments) and from the shipment's total actual_pieces (which spans all legs). Belongs to the association because the same shipment may contribute different piece counts to different ULD movements across routing legs.

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: current_miles_balance
attributes.description: Current available miles or points balance that can be redeemed for awards, upgrades, or partner benefits. Reflects accruals minus redemptions and expirations.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Member's date of birth, used for age verification, birthday promotions, and member identity validation.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for member communication, account notifications, and promotional offers.

attributes.name: email_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive email communications. True=consent given, False=opt-out.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member enrolled in the FFP. Used for channel attribution and marketing analysis.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member first enrolled in the FFP. Used for tenure-based benefits and anniversary promotions.

attributes.name: ffp_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique FFP membership number issued to the member. This is the business identifier used across all customer touchpoints, partner airlines, and GDS systems.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Member's gender. M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Other, U=Undisclosed/Prefer not to say.

attributes.name: home_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code representing the member's primary departure airport. Used for targeted route promotions and service personalization.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's most recent FFP activity (flight, redemption, or partner transaction). Used for dormancy detection and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: lifetime_miles_balance
attributes.description: Total cumulative miles or points earned by the member since enrollment, never decremented by redemptions. Used for lifetime status qualification.

attributes.name: lifetime_status_flag

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive marketing communications and promotional offers. True=consent given, False=opt-out.

attributes.name: meal_preference
attributes.description: Member's dietary preference or special meal request code (e.g., VGML=vegetarian, KSML=kosher, DBML=diabetic). Free-text or SSR code.

attributes.name: member_first_name
attributes.description: First name (given name) of the FFP member as registered in the loyalty program.

attributes.name: member_last_name
attributes.description: Last name (family name) of the FFP member as registered in the loyalty program.

attributes.name: member_middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the FFP member, if provided.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FFP membership. Active=member in good standing, Inactive=no recent activity, Suspended=temporarily restricted, Closed=permanently terminated, Pending=enrollment not yet complete.

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: preferred_cabin_class
attributes.description: Member's preferred cabin class for travel. Used for upgrade targeting and personalized offers.

attributes.name: preferred_language

attributes.name: preferred_seat_type

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive SMS/text message communications. True=consent given, False=opt-out.

attributes.name: special_service_requests

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the member's mailing address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: tier_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current tier status expires and will be re-evaluated based on qualifying activity.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the member achieved their current tier level.

attributes.name: tier_qualifying_miles
attributes.description: Miles earned in the current qualification period that count toward tier status. Typically excludes bonus miles and partner accruals.

attributes.name: tier_qualifying_segments
attributes.description: Number of flight segments flown in the current qualification period that count toward tier status.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FFP member record was last modified.

products.name: tier_status
products.description: Defines the elite tier levels within the FFP (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Executive Platinum). Captures tier name, tier code, qualification thresholds (miles, segments, spend), tier benefits summary, tier validity period rules, upgrade eligibility, lounge access entitlement, bonus mile multiplier, and priority service flags. Reference entity governing tier qualification logic across the program.
products.reference: FFP Tier Level — IATA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: tier_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the frequent flyer program tier status level. Primary key.

attributes.name: award_booking_discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the mileage cost of award bookings for members at this tier level (e.g., 10.00 for 10% discount). Zero if no discount is provided.

attributes.name: benefits_summary
attributes.description: Comprehensive text description of all benefits, privileges, and entitlements associated with this tier level. Used for member communications, marketing materials, and customer service reference.

attributes.name: bonus_mile_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base miles earned on eligible flights for members holding this tier status (e.g., 1.25 for 25% bonus, 1.50 for 50% bonus). Used to calculate total accrued miles including tier bonuses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier status record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier level definition became active and available for member qualification. Used for historical tracking of tier structure changes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier level definition was discontinued or superseded. Null for currently active tiers. Used for historical tracking and legacy member support.

attributes.name: extra_baggage_allowance_kg
attributes.description: Additional checked baggage weight allowance in kilograms granted to members at this tier level beyond the standard fare allowance. Zero if no extra allowance is provided.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier status record was most recently updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lifetime_status_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether achieving this tier level contributes toward lifetime status qualification. True if this tier counts toward lifetime elite status milestones.

attributes.name: lounge_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier level have complimentary access to airline lounges (e.g., business class lounges, first class lounges, partner lounges). True if lounge access is a tier benefit.

attributes.name: partner_tier_equivalent_code
attributes.description: Code representing the equivalent tier level in partner airline frequent flyer programs for reciprocal benefit recognition (e.g., Star Alliance Gold, oneworld Sapphire). Used for interline and codeshare benefit mapping.

attributes.name: priority_baggage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier level receive priority baggage handling, ensuring their checked luggage is among the first delivered at baggage claim. True if priority baggage handling is included.

attributes.name: priority_boarding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier level receive priority boarding privileges, allowing them to board the aircraft ahead of general passengers. True if priority boarding is included.

attributes.name: priority_checkin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier level have access to priority check-in counters and expedited check-in processes. True if priority check-in is a tier benefit.

attributes.name: qualification_miles_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying miles a member must earn within the qualification period to achieve or maintain this tier status. Measured in miles flown on eligible flights.

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which qualification activity is measured (e.g., 12 for calendar year, 24 for rolling two-year period). Defines the window for accumulating qualifying miles, segments, or spend.

attributes.name: qualification_segments_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying flight segments a member must complete within the qualification period to achieve or maintain this tier status. One segment equals one takeoff and landing.

attributes.name: qualification_spend_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum monetary spend amount on eligible flights required within the qualification period to achieve or maintain this tier status. Typically measured in the program's base currency.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier level within the FFP system (e.g., SLV, GLD, PLT, EXPL). Used as business identifier in operational systems.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier within the program hierarchy, where higher numbers indicate more premium status (e.g., 1=Base, 2=Silver, 3=Gold, 4=Platinum). Used for tier comparison and upgrade logic.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Full marketing name of the tier level (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Executive Platinum). Human-readable label displayed to members and in customer communications.

attributes.name: tier_status_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier level within the program. Active tiers are available for member qualification; discontinued tiers are legacy levels no longer offered but may still have active members.

attributes.name: tier_validity_months
attributes.description: Number of months the tier status remains valid once earned, before re-qualification is required. Common values are 12 (annual) or 24 (biennial).

attributes.name: upgrade_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier level are eligible for complimentary or mileage-based cabin upgrades (e.g., economy to business, business to first). True if upgrade benefits are included.

attributes.name: waitlist_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for waitlist clearance and standby processing. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when multiple members are waitlisted for the same flight or upgrade.

products.name: tier_qualification
products.description: Tracks each member's active and historical tier qualification periods, including standard annual qualification cycles and special qualification events (status matches, tier challenges). Records qualification year/cycle, qualifying miles (QM), qualifying segments (QS), qualifying spend (QSP), tier achieved, tier effective date, tier expiry date, rollover miles, tier extension events, qualification source breakdown, and for status match/challenge cases: competing airline, competing tier held, proof of status reference, challenge conditions, challenge activity required/achieved, and match outcome. Enables year-end tier review processing, proactive tier challenge management, and competitive status match adjudication. Aligns with Oracle Loyalty Cloud tier qualification module.
products.reference: Tier Qualification Record — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: tier_qualification_id

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FFP member who achieved or is pursuing this tier qualification.

attributes.name: adjudication_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by FFP administrators during the adjudication of status match, tier challenge, or special qualification cases.

attributes.name: challenge_activity_achieved
attributes.description: Description of the actual activity achieved by the member during the tier challenge period, used to determine challenge success.

attributes.name: challenge_activity_required
attributes.description: Description of the activity requirements (e.g., number of flights, miles, or spend) that the member must achieve during the tier challenge period to qualify.

attributes.name: challenge_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tier challenge period ends and qualification is evaluated for members participating in a tier challenge program.

attributes.name: challenge_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tier challenge period commenced for members participating in a tier challenge program.

attributes.name: competing_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter or three-letter airline code of the competing carrier from which the member held status for status match or tier challenge purposes.

attributes.name: competing_tier_held
attributes.description: Name or level of the elite tier held by the member with the competing airline at the time of status match or tier challenge request.

attributes.name: extension_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tier extension period expires if an extension was granted.

attributes.name: extension_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tier extension or grace period was granted to the member (True if extension granted, False otherwise).

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for granting a tier extension (e.g., medical hardship, service recovery, loyalty gesture, pandemic exception).

attributes.name: lifetime_miles_accumulated
attributes.description: Cumulative lifetime qualifying miles accumulated by the member across all qualification cycles, used for lifetime status determination.

attributes.name: match_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the status match or tier challenge request was approved by the FFP administration team.

attributes.name: match_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the status match or tier challenge request: approved (status granted), denied (request rejected), pending (under review), or expired (request lapsed).

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tier qualification record was processed, adjudicated, or finalized in the FFP system.

attributes.name: proof_of_status_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the proof of status submitted by the member (e.g., membership card image, statement reference) for status match adjudication.

attributes.name: qualification_source_breakdown
attributes.description: Detailed breakdown of the sources contributing to the qualification (e.g., own flights, partner airline flights, credit card spend, hotel stays, car rentals) with corresponding qualifying miles or segments.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tier qualification: in progress (cycle active), qualified (tier achieved), not qualified (thresholds not met), extended (grace period granted), expired (tier period ended), or revoked (status removed).

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of qualification event: standard annual qualification based on activity, status match from competing airline, tier challenge program, lifetime status award, promotional grant, or courtesy status.

attributes.name: qualification_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the tier qualification was earned or evaluated.

attributes.name: qualifying_miles_earned
attributes.description: Total qualifying miles (QM) earned by the member during the qualification period. Used to determine tier eligibility.

attributes.name: qualifying_segments_earned
attributes.description: Total number of qualifying flight segments (QS) flown by the member during the qualification period. Used to determine tier eligibility.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total qualifying spend (QSP) amount in base currency spent by the member on eligible flights and services during the qualification period. Used to determine tier eligibility.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the qualifying spend amount.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier qualification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier qualification record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: rollover_miles
attributes.description: Excess qualifying miles earned beyond the tier threshold that may roll over to the next qualification cycle or contribute to lifetime status.

attributes.name: tier_achieved
attributes.description: The elite tier level achieved by the member as a result of this qualification (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, or lifetime tiers). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base|silver|gold|platinum|diamond|lifetime_gold|lifetime_platinum — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tier_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the achieved tier status becomes active and member benefits commence.

attributes.name: tier_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the achieved tier status expires unless re-qualified. Null for lifetime status.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_miles
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying miles (QM) threshold required to achieve the tier for this qualification cycle.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_segments
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying segments (QS) threshold required to achieve the tier for this qualification cycle.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_spend
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying spend (QSP) threshold required to achieve the tier for this qualification cycle.

products.name: mileage_accrual
products.description: Transactional record of every mile-crediting event for an FFP member, including flight earnings, partner earnings, credit card accruals, miles purchases, manual adjustments (goodwill credits, retro-claims, error corrections, fraud reversals), and reinstatements. Captures accrual source (flight, partner, credit card, hotel, car rental, retail, purchase, adjustment), flight details (PNR, flight number, origin, destination, cabin class, fare class), partner transaction reference, base miles, bonus miles, elite bonus multiplier, promotional bonus, total miles credited, accrual date, posting date, accrual status (pending, posted, reversed), expiry date of earned miles, adjustment reason code, authorizing agent ID, and approval reference. Core SSOT ledger for all credit-side loyalty currency movements.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mileage accrual transaction. Pending indicates awaiting validation or posting; posted indicates credited to member account; reversed indicates clawed back due to refund or fraud; expired indicates miles lapsed before use; cancelled indicates transaction voided.

attributes.name: adjustment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for manual adjustments. Captures customer service agent notes, retro-claim justification, or fraud investigation details. Null for standard accruals.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason category for manual adjustments to member accounts. Null for standard flight and partner accruals. Used for goodwill credits, retro-active claims, error corrections, fraud reversals, and policy exceptions.

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Case number, ticket number, or workflow reference for manual adjustments requiring supervisory approval. Null for standard accruals.

attributes.name: base_miles
attributes.description: Core mileage amount earned before any bonuses or multipliers. For flights, typically calculated from actual flown distance or fare class earning rate. For partners, based on transaction value or partner agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the mileage accrual record was first created in the FFP ledger. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: elite_bonus_miles
attributes.description: Additional miles earned due to member's elite tier status (e.g., Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Calculated as a percentage multiplier of base miles based on tier level.

attributes.name: elite_bonus_multiplier
attributes.description: Percentage multiplier applied to base miles for elite tier members (e.g., 1.25 for 25% bonus, 1.50 for 50% bonus). Zero or 1.00 for non-elite members.

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the flight for flight-based accruals. Null for non-flight accruals.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA flight designator (carrier code + numeric flight number) for flight-based accruals. Null for non-flight accruals.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier whose flight number appears on the ticket for codeshare or interline accruals. Determines earning eligibility and rate. Null for non-flight accruals.

attributes.name: miles_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the miles earned in this transaction will expire if not used. Null for programs with no expiration policy or lifetime miles.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the mileage accrual record was last updated. Audit trail for record modifications (e.g., status changes, adjustments, reversals).

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier that physically operated the flight for codeshare or interline accruals. May differ from marketing carrier. Null for non-flight accruals.

attributes.name: pnr
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric booking reference for flight-based accruals. Links the mileage credit to the original reservation. Null for non-flight accruals.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the miles were credited to the member's FFP account. May differ from accrual date due to processing delays, batch cycles, or retro-claims.

attributes.name: promotional_bonus_miles
attributes.description: Additional miles earned through limited-time promotions, campaigns, or special offers (e.g., double miles promotion, new route bonus, seasonal campaign). Zero if no promotion applies.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the miles were reversed or clawed back from the member account. Null unless accrual_status is reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why miles were reversed after initial posting (e.g., ticket refund, fraudulent activity detected, duplicate posting, partner transaction cancelled). Null unless accrual_status is reversed.

attributes.name: total_miles_credited
attributes.description: Sum of base miles, elite bonus miles, and promotional bonus miles. This is the net amount credited to the member's account for this transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the partner transaction in the transaction currency for spend-based accruals (e.g., credit card purchase amount, hotel bill total). Null for distance-based flight accruals.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for partner transactions where miles are earned based on spend amount (e.g., credit card purchases, hotel stays). Null for distance-based flight accruals.

products.name: mileage_redemption

Core SSOT ledger for all debit-side loyalty currency movements.
