attributes.name: partner_transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction reference provided by the partner program for reconciliation. Null for airline-only redemptions.

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the airline or partner for processing the redemption transaction (e.g., award booking fee, transfer fee).

attributes.name: processing_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the processing fee.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was last modified in the source system.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member initiated the redemption: airline website, mobile app, call center, airport counter, partner portal, or self-service kiosk.

attributes.name: redemption_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the redemption transaction, captured by agent or system for audit and customer service purposes.

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the redemption transaction: requested (pending), confirmed (approved), ticketed (award ticket issued), cancelled (member cancelled), refunded (miles returned), or expired (award not used).

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption transaction was initiated by the member or agent.

attributes.name: redemption_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique transaction number for the redemption event, used for customer service and reconciliation.

attributes.name: redemption_type
attributes.description: Category of redemption: award flight booking, cabin upgrade, partner airline/hotel reward, merchandise purchase, charity donation, peer-to-peer miles transfer, miles purchase with cash co-pay, or co-pay booking combining miles and cash. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: award_flight|upgrade|partner_reward|merchandise|charity_donation|miles_transfer|purchase_miles|co_pay_booking — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_miles
attributes.description: Number of miles returned to the member account upon cancellation or refund of the redemption. Zero if no refund occurred.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when miles were refunded to the member account. Null if no refund occurred.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or code of the operational system that originated this redemption record (e.g., Oracle Loyalty Cloud, partner API, legacy FFP system).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for transferring miles to another member. Null for non-transfer redemptions.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer fee.

attributes.name: transfer_recipient_ffp_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transfer Recipient Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Number
attributes.description: FFP membership number of the recipient member for peer-to-peer miles transfers or family pooling. Null for non-transfer redemptions.

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Type of miles transfer: gift (peer-to-peer gifting), family_pool (pooling within family account), purchase (buying miles for another member), or none (not a transfer redemption).

products.name: miles_balance
products.description: Current and historical miles balance ledger for each FFP member. Maintains total miles balance, redeemable miles, qualifying miles (QM) year-to-date, qualifying segments (QS) year-to-date, qualifying spend (QSP) year-to-date, lifetime miles earned, lifetime miles redeemed, miles expiring in next 90/180 days, last transaction date, and balance as-of timestamp. Serves as the authoritative running balance for member account statements and real-time eligibility checks.
products.reference: Member Miles Account — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: miles_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the miles balance ledger record. Primary key for the miles balance entity.

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the FFP member to whom this miles balance belongs. Links to the member master record.

attributes.name: account_inception_date
attributes.description: Date when the member first enrolled in the FFP and the miles balance account was created. Used for member tenure analysis and lifetime value calculation.

attributes.name: balance_as_of_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this balance snapshot was calculated. Critical for point-in-time balance queries and historical balance reconstruction.

attributes.name: balance_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate this balance snapshot. Real-time balances are updated transactionally; batch balances are calculated in nightly runs; reconciled balances include manual adjustments.

attributes.name: balance_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this balance record was last modified by any transaction or adjustment. Used for data freshness validation and audit trail.

attributes.name: balance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the miles balance account. Active accounts allow accrual and redemption; suspended accounts are temporarily restricted; frozen accounts are under investigation; closed accounts are terminated.

attributes.name: balance_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this balance record, incremented with each update. Used for optimistic locking and concurrency control in real-time balance updates.

attributes.name: bonus_miles_balance
attributes.description: Subset of total miles balance earned through promotional campaigns, partner bonuses, or special offers. Tracked separately for marketing attribution analysis.

attributes.name: elite_bonus_miles_ytd
attributes.description: Additional miles earned year-to-date as elite tier status bonuses (e.g., 25%, 50%, 100% bonus on base miles). Separate from base miles for tier benefit tracking.

attributes.name: is_lifetime_status_qualified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has achieved lifetime elite status qualification based on lifetime miles earned or lifetime qualifying criteria. True if qualified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_accrual_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent miles accrual transaction posted to this account. Used for account activity monitoring and dormancy detection.

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent miles redemption transaction posted to this account. Used for member engagement analysis and redemption pattern tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction (accrual or redemption) posted to this account. Used for account activity monitoring and expiration policy enforcement.

attributes.name: lifetime_miles_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all miles earned by the member since program enrollment. Used for lifetime status qualification and member recognition. Never decreases.

attributes.name: lifetime_miles_redeemed
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all miles redeemed by the member since program enrollment. Used for member engagement analytics and redemption behavior analysis.

attributes.name: member_number
attributes.description: The externally-known FFP membership number assigned to the member. Used for member identification across all touchpoints.

attributes.name: miles_expiring_180_days
attributes.description: Total miles scheduled to expire within the next 180 days based on program expiration policy. Used for proactive member engagement and redemption encouragement.

attributes.name: miles_expiring_90_days
attributes.description: Total miles scheduled to expire within the next 90 days based on program expiration policy. Used for member communication and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: next_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the next batch of miles is scheduled to expire based on program expiration policy. Used for member notification and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: on_hold_miles
attributes.description: Miles temporarily held and unavailable for redemption due to fraud investigation, dispute resolution, or account review. Released once issue is resolved.

attributes.name: partner_miles_balance
attributes.description: Subset of total miles balance earned through partner airline flights, hotel stays, car rentals, credit card spend, or coalition program activities. Tracked for partner settlement.

attributes.name: pending_miles
attributes.description: Miles that have been earned but not yet posted to the redeemable balance. Typically includes miles from recent flights or partner transactions awaiting verification.

attributes.name: qualification_year_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current qualification year for elite tier status. QM, QS, and QSP counters reset after this date.

attributes.name: qualification_year_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current qualification year for elite tier status. Typically calendar year or membership anniversary date depending on program rules.

attributes.name: qualifying_miles_ytd
attributes.description: Total qualifying miles earned year-to-date that count toward elite tier status qualification. QM are typically based on distance flown and fare class, excluding bonus miles.

attributes.name: qualifying_segments_ytd
attributes.description: Total number of qualifying flight segments flown year-to-date that count toward elite tier status qualification. Each eligible flight leg counts as one segment.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the qualifying spend amount. Typically the program base currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_ytd
attributes.description: Total qualifying spend amount year-to-date that counts toward elite tier status qualification. Typically based on ticket price paid, excluding taxes and fees.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this miles balance record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: redeemable_miles
attributes.description: Subset of total miles balance that is currently available for redemption. Excludes miles that are pending, on hold, or not yet eligible for use.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that last updated this balance record. Typically Oracle Loyalty Cloud for operational balances, or partner feed systems for coalition programs.

attributes.name: total_miles_balance
attributes.description: Total accumulated miles currently available in the member account, including all earned miles minus all redeemed miles. This is the authoritative running balance.

products.name: award_booking
products.description: Master record for award flight bookings made using FFP miles. Captures award PNR, award type (saver, standard, upgrade, companion), origin, destination, travel dates, cabin class, number of passengers, total miles cost, co-pay amount, ticketing status, award ticket number, booking channel, waitlist status, award inventory bucket used, partner airline involvement, and cancellation/refund details. Links to mileage_redemption for the miles debit event.
products.reference: Award PNR — Oracle Loyalty Cloud / Amadeus Altéa

attributes.name: award_booking_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award flight booking. Primary key for the award booking record.

attributes.name: award_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.award_inventory. Business justification: award_booking consumes award seat inventory from award_inventory. The award_inventory_bucket attribute (STRING) indicates which inventory bucket was used. Adding award_inventory_id FK links the bookin

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Award bookings require cabin class specification for pricing, availability, and seat allocation. Normalizes existing cabin_class text column. Essential for award inventory management and FFP redemptio

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FFP member who made the award booking. Links to the loyalty program member whose miles were redeemed.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: Once an award flight operates, the award booking must reconcile against the actual flight_leg for mileage posting confirmation, revenue accounting, and DOT reporting. The existing scheduled_flight FK

attributes.name: interline_billing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.interline_billing. Business justification: Partner award bookings (is_partner_award flag exists) on codeshare/alliance carriers generate interline billing entries for award settlement between carriers. Airlines must reconcile award redemptions

attributes.name: mileage_redemption_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the mileage redemption transaction that debited the miles for this award booking.

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.partner_program. Business justification: award_booking has is_partner_award flag, operating_carrier_code, and marketing_carrier_code attributes. When is_partner_award is true, the booking is made through a partner airline agreement. Adding p

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.pnr. Business justification: Award bookings generate reservation PNRs for check-in, boarding, and operational processing. award_pnr is a denormalized PNR locator string on award_booking. This FK normalizes it, enabling check-in s

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_promotion. Business justification: award_booking has no FK to loyalty_promotion, yet promotional award bookings are a core FFP business concept (e.g., bonus mile promotions, discounted award redemptions). upgrade_request already carrie

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.scheduled_flight. Business justification: Award bookings must reference the scheduled flight master for inventory control, schedule changes, cancellation processing, and award seat allocation. Current flight_number/date denormalization is ins

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket. Business justification: Award bookings generate tickets upon confirmation. Link required for ticketing workflow, refund processing, and revenue accounting. Replaces denormalized award_ticket_number with proper FK.

attributes.name: award_type
attributes.description: Classification of the award booking type. Saver awards require fewer miles but have limited availability; standard awards have higher mileage cost but greater availability; upgrade awards convert paid tickets to higher cabin; companion awards allow a second passenger at reduced miles; mixed cabin combines different service classes; partner awards are on codeshare or alliance airlines.

attributes.name: booking_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the award booking was made. Web indicates airline website; mobile app is the carrier's mobile application; call center is telephone reservation; airport counter is in-person booking; partner portal is through alliance or coalition partner; GDS is Global Distribution System booking.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award booking. Confirmed indicates space is held; waitlisted means awaiting availability; ticketed means e-ticket issued; cancelled indicates member-initiated cancellation; expired means booking lapsed without ticketing; pending indicates awaiting payment or verification.

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the award booking was created in the reservation system. Represents the moment the member initiated the award redemption.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for award booking cancellation. Member request is voluntary cancellation; schedule change is airline-initiated due to flight changes; IROP is irregular operations; fraud is security cancellation; system timeout is automatic expiry; payment failure is co-pay processing issue.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the award booking was cancelled. Null if booking has not been cancelled. Represents when the member or system terminated the reservation.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount paid by the member in addition to miles for this award booking. Covers taxes, fees, and carrier-imposed surcharges not covered by miles.

attributes.name: copay_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the co-pay amount. Indicates the currency in which taxes and fees were charged.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this award booking record was first created in the loyalty management system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of departure for the outbound award flight. First travel date of the award itinerary.

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport of the award journey. Represents the final destination of the award travel itinerary.

attributes.name: is_partner_award
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this award booking involves travel on a partner airline (alliance member or codeshare partner) rather than the marketing carrier's own metal.

attributes.name: is_round_trip
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a round-trip award booking (true) or one-way (false). Round-trip awards include both outbound and return travel.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this award booking record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for audit purposes.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier whose FFP miles were redeemed. Represents the loyalty program under which the award was booked.

attributes.name: number_of_passengers
attributes.description: Total count of passengers included in this award booking. Represents how many travelers are covered by this single award PNR.

attributes.name: number_of_segments
attributes.description: Total count of flight segments (individual flight legs) included in this award booking itinerary. Multi-segment awards involve connections.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline code of the carrier operating the award flight. May differ from the marketing carrier if this is a codeshare or partner award.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport of the award journey. Represents the starting point of the award travel itinerary.

attributes.name: refund_fee_miles
attributes.description: Number of FFP miles charged as a cancellation or change fee when refunding the award booking. Represents the penalty for award cancellation.

attributes.name: refund_miles_amount
attributes.description: Number of FFP miles returned to the member account upon cancellation or refund of the award booking. May be less than original redemption if cancellation fees apply.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of return for the inbound award flight. Null for one-way award bookings. Represents the return travel date for round-trip awards.

attributes.name: ticketing_deadline
attributes.description: Date and time by which the award booking must be ticketed or it will be automatically cancelled. Enforces time limits for award space holds.

attributes.name: ticketing_status
attributes.description: Current status of e-ticket issuance for the award booking. Not ticketed means reservation exists but no ticket issued; ticketed means e-ticket generated; voided indicates ticket cancelled before travel; refunded means ticket cancelled with miles returned; exchanged means ticket modified for different travel.

attributes.name: ticketing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the award e-ticket was issued. Null if booking has not been ticketed. Represents when the reservation was converted to a confirmed ticket.

attributes.name: total_miles_redeemed
attributes.description: Total number of FFP miles debited from the member account for this award booking. Represents the mileage cost across all passengers and segments.

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Numeric position in the waitlist queue for this award booking. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Null if not waitlisted.

attributes.name: waitlist_status
attributes.description: Status of waitlist request for award space. Not waitlisted means booking was immediately confirmed; waitlisted indicates awaiting availability; confirmed from waitlist means space opened and booking confirmed; waitlist expired means request timed out without confirmation.

products.name: partner_program
products.description: Master record for FFP earn/burn partner agreements. Captures partner name, partner type (airline codeshare, hotel, car rental, credit card, retail, telecom), partner IATA/ICAO code where applicable, earn rate (miles per dollar/unit), burn rate (miles per reward unit), partner tier recognition flag, partner bonus mile eligibility, agreement effective date, agreement expiry date, settlement currency, settlement frequency, and partner contact details. SSOT for all loyalty partner configurations.
products.reference: FFP Partner Agreement — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FFP (Frequent Flyer Program) partner program agreement. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.carrier. Business justification: FFP partner airline programs must reference the structured carrier entity for partner settlement, accrual rate management, and interline reporting. partner_iata_code and partner_icao_code are denormal

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Partner program agreements are contracted by a specific legal entity (company_code). Airline groups with multiple subsidiaries must attribute partner program liabilities and settlement obligations to

attributes.name: accrual_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of days after a qualifying partner transaction before earned miles are posted to the member account. Allows for transaction validation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: agreement_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner agreement becomes active and earn/burn transactions are permitted. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: agreement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner agreement terminates. Null for evergreen agreements with no fixed end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the partner agreement. Active agreements permit earn/burn transactions; suspended/terminated agreements block new activity.

attributes.name: auto_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Airlines FFP members are automatically enrolled in the partner loyalty program for seamless earn/burn. True if auto-enrollment is enabled.

attributes.name: bonus_mile_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions with this partner are eligible for promotional bonus mile campaigns and tier multipliers. True if eligible.

attributes.name: burn_rate
attributes.description: Redemption rate for using FFP miles with this partner, expressed as miles required per reward unit (e.g., miles per free night, miles per rental day, miles per dollar value).

attributes.name: burn_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the burn rate calculation (e.g., per hotel night redeemed, per car rental day, per dollar value of merchandise). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: night|day|dollar|euro|pound|item|service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner program record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: earn_rate
attributes.description: Base mileage accrual rate for member transactions with this partner, expressed as miles earned per unit (dollar, euro, night, rental day, etc.). Subject to tier multipliers and promotions.

attributes.name: earn_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the earn rate calculation (e.g., per dollar spent, per hotel night, per car rental day). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dollar|euro|pound|night|day|transaction|point — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this partner program record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: maximum_earn_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum number of miles that can be earned in a single transaction with this partner. Null if no cap applies. Prevents abuse and controls liability.

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction value (in settlement currency) required for a partner transaction to qualify for mileage accrual. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: partner_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the partner business contact. Used for operational communications, settlement queries, and program updates.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Internal Airlines Data Standard

attributes.name: partner_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the partner organization responsible for FFP program coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: partner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the partner business contact, including country code and extension where applicable.

attributes.name: partner_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the partners primary country of operation or headquarters location.

attributes.name: partner_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the FFP earn/burn partner organization (e.g., Marriott Hotels, Hertz Car Rental, Chase Bank).

attributes.name: partner_program_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used in operational systems to identify this partner program in transaction records, reports, and member statements.

attributes.name: partner_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number or business registration number for the partner organization. Used for financial settlement and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner organization by business category. Determines applicable earn/burn rules and integration requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: airline_codeshare|hotel|car_rental|credit_card|retail|telecom|dining|travel_services — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: partner_website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the partner organization. Used for member communications and marketing materials promoting partner earn/burn opportunities.

attributes.name: redemption_blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner imposes blackout dates or capacity restrictions on award redemptions. True if blackouts apply.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for financial settlement of earn/burn transactions between Airlines and the partner (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial reconciliation and settlement occurs between Airlines and the partner for accrued earn/burn transactions.
attributes.references: IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) Standards

attributes.name: tier_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner honors Airlines FFP elite tier status with reciprocal benefits (e.g., priority service, upgrades, bonus earn). True if tier benefits apply.

products.name: partner_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of miles earned or redeemed through non-airline FFP partners (hotels, car rentals, credit cards, retail). Captures partner program ID, member FFP number, partner transaction reference, transaction date, transaction amount, transaction currency, miles awarded or redeemed, bonus miles, partner location/property, transaction type (earn/burn), posting status, and dispute flag. Feeds into mileage_accrual and mileage_redemption for consolidated member ledger.
products.reference: Partner Earn/Burn Record — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: partner_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FFP member who earned or redeemed miles through this partner transaction.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Partner transactions carry settlement_amount requiring GL posting for partner mile accrual cost recognition and partner billing reconciliation. Airlines post partner program revenue/cost to GL per acc

attributes.name: original_transaction_partner_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original partner transaction ID if this record is a reversal or adjustment of a prior transaction.

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the partner program (hotel chain, car rental, credit card issuer, retail coalition) through which the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_promotion. Business justification: partner_transaction has promotion_code (STRING) attribute for promotional bonus miles earned through partners. loyalty_promotion defines promotional campaigns. Adding loyalty_promotion_id FK enables j

attributes.name: base_miles_awarded
attributes.description: Number of base FFP miles earned or redeemed through this partner transaction, calculated per the partner agreement earn/burn rate.

attributes.name: bonus_miles_awarded
attributes.description: Number of bonus or promotional miles awarded in addition to base miles, based on member tier status, promotional campaigns, or partner-specific bonuses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner transaction record was first created in the Airlines FFP system.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner transaction is under dispute by the member or partner (true if disputed, false otherwise).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if the transaction is flagged for dispute (e.g., miles not posted, incorrect amount, transaction not recognized).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the dispute was resolved, if applicable.

attributes.name: earn_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to calculate miles earned per unit of partner transaction amount, as defined in the partner agreement (e.g., 1.5 miles per dollar spent).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the miles awarded in this partner transaction will expire if not used, per FFP expiration policy.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner transaction record was last modified in the Airlines FFP system.

attributes.name: member_tier_at_transaction
attributes.description: FFP tier status of the member at the time of the partner transaction (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum), which may affect bonus miles calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this partner transaction, used for operational context or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: partner_category
attributes.description: Category of partner business type (hotel, car rental, credit card issuer, retail merchant, dining, travel services).

attributes.name: partner_location_city
attributes.description: City where the partner transaction occurred.

attributes.name: partner_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific partner location where the transaction occurred (e.g., hotel property code, car rental branch code, retail store identifier).

attributes.name: partner_location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the partner transaction occurred.

attributes.name: partner_location_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the partner location where the transaction occurred (e.g., Marriott Times Square, Hertz LAX Airport).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the miles from this partner transaction were posted to the member FFP account ledger.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the transaction in the FFP posting workflow indicating whether miles have been successfully credited or debited to the member account.
attributes.references: Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management - Transaction Status

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when this transaction was reconciled with the partner for settlement purposes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of financial reconciliation between Airlines and the partner for this transaction.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: External reference number or confirmation code provided by the partner for this transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previous partner transaction (true if reversal, false otherwise).

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid or received by Airlines for this partner transaction as part of the partner revenue-sharing or cost-sharing agreement.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the settlement amount between Airlines and the partner.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or partner integration platform from which this transaction was received (e.g., Oracle Loyalty Cloud, Partner API Gateway).

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier in the source system or partner platform, used for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: total_miles
attributes.description: Total miles awarded or redeemed in this transaction (sum of base miles and bonus miles).

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the partner transaction in the original transaction currency (e.g., hotel bill amount, car rental charge, credit card purchase amount).

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner transaction occurred (e.g., hotel checkout date, car rental return date, credit card purchase date).

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the partner transaction was recorded in the partner system, including time zone information.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of partner transaction indicating whether miles were earned (accrual) or redeemed (burn), or if this is a reversal or adjustment.

products.name: promotion
products.description: Master record for FFP promotional campaigns offering bonus miles, tier accelerators, or special rewards. Captures promotion code, promotion name, promotion type (double miles, tier challenge, status match, bonus on route, partner bonus), target segment, eligible member tiers, eligible routes or partners, promotion start date, promotion end date, bonus miles formula, maximum bonus cap, opt-in requirement flag, opt-in count, redemption count, and promotion status. Aligns with Oracle Loyalty Cloud promotions module.
products.reference: FFP Promotion — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FFP (Frequent Flyer Program) promotional campaign. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE (promotional campaign as a managed marketing resource).

attributes.name: budget_plan_id

attributes.name: fare_family_id

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual total financial cost incurred by the promotion after completion, calculated from bonus miles awarded and their valuation. Used for ROI (Return on Investment) analysis. Business-sensitive financial data.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition, IATA Financial Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for the promotion before it can be scheduled or activated. Used for governance and financial control over promotional spend.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the manager or executive who approved the promotion. Null if not yet approved. Used for accountability and audit.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the promotion was approved. Null if not yet approved. Distinct lifecycle event from creation and modification.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, ISO 27001 Audit Standards

attributes.name: bonus_miles_formula
attributes.description: Business rule or formula defining how bonus miles are calculated (e.g., '2x base miles', 'flat 5000 miles', 'base_miles * 1.5 + 1000'). Free-text expression used by accrual engine. Measurement/value category for the promotion.

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel(s) used to communicate the promotion to members (email, SMS, push notification, in-app message, website banner, or all). Used for campaign execution and member engagement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the promotion record was first created in the system. Record audit created timestamp.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, ISO 27001 Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for estimated_cost and actual_cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency financial reporting.

attributes.name: eligible_member_tiers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of FFP (Frequent Flyer Program) member tier codes eligible to participate (e.g., 'SILVER,GOLD,PLATINUM' or 'ALL'). Empty or 'ALL' indicates no tier restriction.

attributes.name: eligible_partners
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of partner airline IATA codes or coalition partner identifiers eligible for bonus earn (e.g., 'AA,BA,QF' for airline partners or 'HOTEL_CHAIN_X' for non-air partners). Empty or 'ALL' indicates no partner restriction.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion expires and no further bonus accruals are allowed. Effective-until date for the promotion. Nullable for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total financial cost or liability of the promotion in the airline's reporting currency (e.g., USD). Used for budgeting and financial planning. Business-sensitive financial data.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition, IATA Financial Standards

attributes.name: external_promotion_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion in the source operational system (e.g., Oracle Loyalty Cloud promotion ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the promotion record was last updated. Record audit updated timestamp.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, ISO 27001 Audit Standards

attributes.name: maximum_bonus_cap
attributes.description: Maximum total bonus miles a member can earn under this promotion. Null indicates no cap. Used to control promotion liability and prevent abuse.

attributes.name: opt_in_count
attributes.description: Total number of members who have opted into this promotion. Updated in real-time or batch. Used for campaign performance measurement.

attributes.name: opt_in_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must explicitly opt-in or register for the promotion (true) or if it is automatically applied to eligible members (false). Used for campaign engagement tracking.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority or precedence rank when multiple promotions are eligible for the same transaction. Lower number indicates higher priority. Used by accrual engine to resolve conflicts.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the promotion (e.g., DOUBLE2024, TIERBOOST). Used by members to opt-in or by system to auto-apply. Business identifier for the promotion.

attributes.name: promotion_description

attributes.name: promotion_name

attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion: draft (being designed), scheduled (approved, not yet started), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated before completion). Lifecycle status for the promotion.

attributes.name: promotion_type

Classification category for the promotion. attributes.description: Total number of transactions or bookings where this promotion was successfully applied and bonus miles were awarded. Used for ROI (Return on Investment) analysis and campaign effectiveness.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion becomes active and members can begin earning bonus miles or benefits. Effective-from date for the promotion.

attributes.name: target_segment
attributes.description: Marketing segment or customer cohort targeted by this promotion (e.g., 'Inactive Members', 'High-Value Flyers', 'New Enrollees', 'Corporate Travelers'). Used for campaign targeting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: Web URL linking to the full legal terms and conditions document for the promotion. Used for regulatory compliance and member transparency.
attributes.references: IATA Loyalty Standards, Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the marketing or loyalty operations staff who created the promotion record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

Enables targeted promotion tracking and bonus posting automation.

Reference entity linking tier levels to their operational benefit entitlements with consumption tracking for benefit cap enforcement and utilization reporting.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the miles were successfully posted to recipient account and deducted from sender account. Null if transfer not yet completed.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the transferred miles will expire in the recipient account, if different from standard expiry rules. Null if standard expiry applies.

attributes.name: fee_discount_applied
attributes.description: Monetary discount amount applied to the standard transfer fee due to promotion, tier status, or relationship type. Zero if no discount applied.

attributes.name: fraud_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer was flagged for manual fraud review. True if flagged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Automated fraud detection risk score assigned to this transfer at time of initiation (0.00 = no risk, 100.00 = high risk). Used to flag suspicious transfers for review.

attributes.name: miles_transferred
attributes.description: Quantity of loyalty miles transferred from sender to recipient in this transaction. Must be positive integer value.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used by sender to pay the transfer fee: credit_card, debit_card, miles_deduction (fee paid in miles), bank_transfer, paypal, wallet (digital wallet).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment gateway or processor transaction reference number for the transfer fee payment. Null if no fee charged.

attributes.name: recipient_annual_receipt_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative miles the recipient has received in the current calendar year after this transaction completes. Used to enforce annual receipt limits.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: recipient_annual_receipt_limit
attributes.description: Maximum miles the recipient is allowed to receive per calendar year according to FFP program rules. Captured at time of transfer for audit purposes.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was first created in the source system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified in the source system. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the transfer was rejected (e.g., insufficient miles, limit exceeded, fraud detected, policy violation). Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Declared relationship between sender and recipient. Some FFP programs offer preferential transfer terms for family members. Self-declared by sender at time of transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: family|friend|spouse|partner|child|parent|sibling|unrelated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FFP family pooling and relationship policies

attributes.name: relationship_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the declared relationship between sender and recipient has been verified by the airline (e.g., through documentation submission). True if verified, False if unverified or not required.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a completed transfer was reversed (e.g., fraud investigation, payment chargeback, system error). Null if not reversed.
attributes.references: FFP operational procedures and fraud management

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer was reversed and miles returned to sender. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: sender_annual_transfer_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative miles the sender has transferred in the current calendar year after this transaction completes. Used to enforce annual transfer limits.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: sender_annual_transfer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum miles the sender is allowed to transfer per calendar year according to FFP program rules and sender tier status. Captured at time of transfer for audit purposes.
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this transfer record (e.g., Oracle Loyalty Cloud, legacy FFP system). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transfer_channel
attributes.description: Digital or physical channel through which the transfer was initiated: web (airline website), mobile_app, call_center (agent-assisted), partner_portal (coalition partner interface), kiosk (airport self-service).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fee charged to the sender for executing the miles transfer. Zero for fee-waived transfers (e.g., family pool contributions).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transfer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the transfer, entered by sender (e.g., gift message) or operations agent (e.g., special handling instructions). Null if no notes.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the miles transfer: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet posted), completed (miles successfully transferred), rejected (transfer denied), cancelled (sender cancelled before completion), reversed (transfer reversed after completion due to fraud or error).

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the miles transfer was initiated by the sender. Represents the business event time of the transfer request.

attributes.name: transfer_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique transaction reference number for the miles transfer, used for customer service inquiries and audit trails.

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the miles transfer transaction: gift (one-time transfer to another member), family_pool (contribution to family pooling account), purchase (bought miles transferred to recipient), share (reciprocal sharing arrangement), donation (charitable contribution of miles).
attributes.references: FFP program rules and transfer policies

products.name: award_inventory
products.description: Manages the availability of award seats allocated for FFP redemption across flights and cabin classes. Captures flight number, travel date, origin, destination, cabin class, award bucket code (saver/standard/premium), total award seats allocated, seats available, seats held, seats redeemed, blackout date flag, partner award availability flag, and last updated timestamp. Distinct from the revenue inventory domain — this is the loyalty-specific award seat pool managed by the FFP program.
products.reference: Award Seat Availability — Oracle Loyalty Cloud

attributes.name: award_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award inventory record. Primary key for the award seat allocation entity.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
