attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Award inventory allocation is managed per cabin class with distinct availability and pricing. Normalizes cabin_class text column. Critical for award seat availability management and FFP redemption ope

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: Award Seat Allocation by Cabin Configuration: award inventory must reflect the exact onboard product (seat count, lie-flat availability) defined in the cabin configuration. Loyalty revenue managers co

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: Award inventory is managed at the fare class bucket level in airline inventory systems (e.g., Altea). Award bucket codes map directly to RBD fare class buckets. Revenue management links award availabi

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Award inventory control requires reconciling award seat allocations against total flight capacity. Revenue management teams query flight_inventory to validate available seats before releasing award bu

attributes.name: flight_number_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.flight_number. Business justification: Award seat inventory is allocated per scheduled flight number for GDS distribution and award availability management. Linking award_inventory to route.flight_number enables schedule-aware award capaci

attributes.name: minimum_tier_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier_status. Business justification: award_inventory.minimum_tier_required is a STRING denormalized reference to the minimum tier level required to access this award inventory bucket. Adding minimum_tier_status_id FK to tier_status norma

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.partner_program. Business justification: award_inventory has partner_award_availability_flag indicating partner award seats exist, but no FK to partner_program. Award inventory can be allocated specifically for partner airline redemptions. A

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Award seat allocation strategy by route, route profitability analysis including award redemption costs, and network planning for award availability all require linking award inventory to routes. Essen

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.scheduled_flight. Business justification: Award seat inventory is allocated and managed at the scheduled flight level. Revenue management systems control award availability per scheduled flight. The current award_inventory carries denormalize

attributes.name: allocation_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this award seat allocation becomes effective and available for member booking.

attributes.name: allocation_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this award seat allocation expires and is no longer available for booking. Null for open-ended allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special conditions, restrictions, or context for this award inventory allocation. Used by revenue management and FFP operations teams.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: The source or method by which award seats were allocated to this inventory bucket. Revenue management indicates standard RM allocation; partner agreement indicates contractual allocation; promotional indicates campaign-driven allocation; dynamic indicates real-time algorithmic allocation.

attributes.name: award_bucket_type
attributes.description: The award redemption tier type. Saver awards require fewer miles but have limited availability; standard and premium awards offer greater availability at higher mileage cost.

attributes.name: blackout_date_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this travel date is designated as a blackout date for award redemptions. True means no award seats are available regardless of inventory.

attributes.name: booking_window_close_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days before departure that award bookings close. Typically 1-14 days depending on route and cabin.

attributes.name: booking_window_open_days
attributes.description: The number of days in advance that award seats become available for booking. Standard is 330-365 days for most airlines.

attributes.name: cancellation_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard award cancellation fee is waived for bookings in this inventory bucket. Often applies to elite members or promotional awards.
attributes.references: FFP Award Change and Cancellation Policy

attributes.name: change_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard award change fee is waived for bookings in this inventory bucket. Often applies to elite members or promotional awards.
attributes.references: FFP Award Change and Cancellation Policy

attributes.name: co_pay_amount
attributes.description: The mandatory cash co-payment amount required in addition to miles for award redemption. Zero if no co-pay is required.

attributes.name: co_pay_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the co-payment amount. Null if no co-pay is required.

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic award pricing is enabled for this inventory, allowing mileage cost to vary based on demand and availability rather than fixed award chart rates.

attributes.name: elite_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether award seat availability is restricted to elite tier members only. Used for premium cabin inventory management.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the award inventory. Open means available for booking; closed means no longer accepting reservations; suspended means temporarily unavailable; restricted means limited access.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award inventory record was last modified. Critical for real-time availability synchronization across distribution channels.

attributes.name: miles_required
attributes.description: The number of FFP miles required to redeem one award seat in this bucket and cabin class. Varies by route, cabin, and bucket type.

attributes.name: partner_award_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether these award seats are available for redemption by partner FFP members under reciprocal agreements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award inventory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: The current number of award seats available for immediate booking. Decremented upon award reservation confirmation.

attributes.name: seats_held
attributes.description: The number of award seats currently held in pending or unconfirmed reservations. These seats are temporarily unavailable but not yet redeemed.

attributes.name: seats_redeemed
attributes.description: The cumulative number of award seats that have been successfully redeemed and ticketed for this flight, cabin, and bucket.

attributes.name: seats_waitlisted
attributes.description: The number of members currently on the waitlist for award seats on this flight and cabin when availability is zero.

attributes.name: total_award_seats_allocated
attributes.description: The total number of seats allocated to the FFP award inventory pool for this flight, cabin, and bucket combination. Set by revenue management.

attributes.name: travel_date
attributes.description: The scheduled departure date of the flight for which award inventory is allocated. Key dimension for award seat availability queries.

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether these award seats are eligible for mileage upgrade from a lower cabin class. Relevant for upgrade award inventory management.

domains.name: airport
domains.description: Ground handling and airport operations data including gate assignments, turnaround operations, baggage handling and tracing, ramp services, aircraft servicing, ground support equipment (GSE) scheduling, slot management, CDM (Collaborative Decision Making) messages, PFC (Passenger Facility Charge) records, check-in and boarding process events, and airport facility coordination. Manages hub operations and spoke station activities. Aligns with SITA Airport Management Platform.
domains.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM), Airport CDM

products.name: terminal_facility
products.description: Master record for airport terminal facilities including terminal buildings, concourses, piers, satellite structures, and check-in counter/kiosk assets. Captures IATA/ICAO airport codes, terminal identifiers, facility type, total gate count, check-in counter inventory (counter zones, types including full-service/self-service/CUSS/bag-drop, airline assignments, accessibility compliance, biometric capability), lounge count, capacity (PAX per hour), operational status, hub classification (hub vs spoke station), and owning airline or joint-use designation. SSOT for physical airport facility assets and check-in infrastructure managed by the airline.
products.reference: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) — Terminal Facility Registry

attributes.name: terminal_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the airport terminal facility record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Terminal facilities are cost centers for budgeting, P&L reporting, and operational expense allocation. Airlines track terminal operating costs (utilities, maintenance, staffing) against budgets for st

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Airlines owning dedicated terminal facilities (e.g., hub terminals) must record them as fixed assets under IFRS/GAAP for depreciation, impairment testing, and balance sheet reporting. Aviation finance

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: terminal_facility exists at a specific station/airport. Currently stores airport_code and icao_code (both STRING). FK to station provides access to station details including both IATA and ICAO codes,

attributes.name: accessibility_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal facility meets accessibility standards for passengers with reduced mobility (PRM) including wheelchair access, accessible counters, and assistance services.

attributes.name: annual_passenger_volume
attributes.description: Total number of passengers processed through this terminal facility in the most recent full calendar year.

attributes.name: bag_drop_counter_count
attributes.description: Number of dedicated self-service bag drop counters for passengers who have completed online or kiosk check-in.

attributes.name: biometric_capability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal facility is equipped with biometric passenger processing technology (facial recognition, fingerprint scanning) for check-in and boarding.

attributes.name: cdm_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal facility participates in Airport Collaborative Decision Making (A-CDM) for real-time information sharing between airport, airlines, and Air Traffic Control (ATC).

attributes.name: check_in_counter_count
attributes.description: Total number of full-service check-in counters staffed by airline agents for passenger processing and baggage acceptance.

attributes.name: contact_gate_count
attributes.description: Number of contact gates equipped with jet bridges for direct aircraft-to-terminal passenger boarding.

attributes.name: counter_zone_designation
attributes.description: Alphanumeric designation of check-in counter zones within the terminal (e.g., Zone A, Rows 1-20, Island 3).

attributes.name: customs_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has customs and border control facilities for international passenger processing.

attributes.name: facility_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the terminal facility for operational coordination and ground transportation routing.

attributes.name: facility_city
attributes.description: City where the terminal facility is located.

attributes.name: facility_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the terminal facility location (e.g., USA, GBR, ARE).

attributes.name: facility_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for terminal facility operational communications and coordination.

attributes.name: facility_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for terminal facility operations and coordination.

attributes.name: facility_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the terminal facility address.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the terminal facility structure type.

attributes.name: hub_classification
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the airport station in the airline's network (hub = central connecting airport, spoke = route from hub to destination).

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major renovation or modernization project completed for this terminal facility.

attributes.name: lounge_count
attributes.description: Number of airline lounges operated within this terminal facility for premium passengers and Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) members.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal facility first became operational for passenger services.

attributes.name: operating_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the primary operating carrier for this terminal facility (null for joint-use or airport authority facilities).

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the terminal facility.

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Designation of facility ownership and usage rights (airline-owned, joint-use with other carriers, or airport authority managed).

attributes.name: passenger_capacity_per_hour
attributes.description: Design capacity of the terminal facility measured in passengers (PAX) that can be processed per hour during peak operations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal facility record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal facility record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: remote_gate_count
attributes.description: Number of remote gates requiring bus transportation for passenger boarding (no jet bridge connection).

attributes.name: security_checkpoint_count
attributes.description: Number of Transportation Security Administration (TSA) or equivalent security screening checkpoints in the terminal facility.

attributes.name: self_service_kiosk_count
attributes.description: Number of self-service check-in kiosks (CUSS - Common Use Self-Service) available for passenger self-check-in.

attributes.name: slot_coordinated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport requires slot coordination (allocated takeoff and landing times) due to capacity constraints.

attributes.name: terminal_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area of the terminal facility measured in square meters.

attributes.name: terminal_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier for the terminal within the airport (e.g., Terminal 1, Terminal A, Concourse B, Satellite Terminal).

attributes.name: total_gate_count
attributes.description: Total number of aircraft gates available in this terminal facility for passenger boarding and deplaning operations.

products.name: gate
products.description: Master record for individual aircraft gates within a terminal facility. Captures gate identifier, terminal reference, concourse, gate type (contact/remote/hardstand), compatible aircraft categories (ICAO size codes A–F), jetbridge availability, ground power unit (GPU) availability, potable water availability, operational status, and maximum wingspan clearance. Serves as the SSOT for gate asset definitions used in gate assignment and turnaround planning.
products.reference: IATA AHM 810 — Gate/Stand Master

attributes.name: gate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft gate. Primary key for the gate master record.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Gates incur direct operating costs (ground power, jetbridge maintenance, utilities) that must be allocated to cost centers for financial reporting, station P&L analysis, and turnaround cost modeling u

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: gate exists at a specific station/airport. Currently stores airport_code (STRING). FK to station provides access to station details, time zone, and operational context. The airport_code becomes redund

attributes.name: terminal_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the terminal facility that contains this gate.

attributes.name: aircraft_size_code_max
attributes.description: Maximum ICAO aircraft size code (A through F) that this gate can accommodate based on wingspan, parking envelope, and structural limitations.

attributes.name: aircraft_size_code_min
attributes.description: Minimum ICAO aircraft size code (A through F) that this gate can accommodate based on wingspan and parking envelope.

attributes.name: common_use_gate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate is operated as a common-use facility available to multiple airlines through dynamic assignment, or is dedicated to a specific carrier.

attributes.name: concourse
attributes.description: The concourse or pier designation within the terminal (e.g., A, B, C, D, International).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_facility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate has direct access to customs and immigration facilities for international arrivals processing.

attributes.name: domestic_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate is equipped and authorized to handle domestic flights.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this gate configuration became or will become operationally effective.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this gate configuration will cease to be valid (null for indefinite configurations).

attributes.name: fuel_hydrant_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether underground fuel hydrant system is available at this gate position for aircraft refueling operations.

attributes.name: gate_number
attributes.description: The alphanumeric gate identifier displayed to passengers and used in operational systems (e.g., A12, B5, C23).

attributes.name: gate_type
attributes.description: Classification of gate based on aircraft parking configuration: contact (jetbridge-connected), remote (apron position requiring bus), hardstand (unpaved remote stand), bus_gate (passenger bus boarding point), swing_gate (can serve domestic or international).

attributes.name: ground_power_unit_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether fixed ground power unit (GPU) electrical supply is available at this gate for aircraft systems during turnaround.

attributes.name: international_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate is equipped and authorized to handle international flights with customs, immigration, and border control requirements.

attributes.name: jetbridge_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a passenger boarding bridge (jetbridge/airbridge) is installed and operational at this gate.

attributes.name: jetbridge_count
attributes.description: Number of passenger boarding bridges available at this gate (0 for remote stands, 1-3 for contact gates serving wide-body aircraft).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate master record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the gate parking position in decimal degrees for Ground Support Equipment (GSE) navigation and airport mapping systems.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the gate parking position in decimal degrees for Ground Support Equipment (GSE) navigation and airport mapping systems.

attributes.name: max_aircraft_length_meters
attributes.description: Maximum aircraft fuselage length in meters that can be accommodated at this gate position.

attributes.name: max_wingspan_meters
attributes.description: Maximum aircraft wingspan in meters that can be safely accommodated at this gate position.

attributes.name: minimum_turnaround_time_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum aircraft turnaround time in minutes required at this gate based on facility capabilities and Ground Support Equipment (GSE) availability.

attributes.name: narrow_body_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate can accommodate narrow-body aircraft (typically ICAO codes B, C such as A320 family, B737 family).

attributes.name: operating_airline_code
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the carrier that has preferential or exclusive use rights to this gate under lease or operating agreement (null if common-use gate).

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational availability status of the gate for flight assignments and turnaround operations.

attributes.name: parking_stand_designation
attributes.description: The official apron parking stand identifier used in airport operations and ATC communications (may differ from passenger-facing gate number).

attributes.name: potable_water_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether fixed potable water supply connection is available at this gate for aircraft water system servicing.

attributes.name: preconditioned_air_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether fixed preconditioned air system is available at this gate for aircraft cabin climate control during turnaround, reducing APU usage.

attributes.name: regional_jet_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate can accommodate regional jet aircraft (typically ICAO code A such as CRJ, ERJ families).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes regarding gate restrictions, special handling requirements, or temporary conditions affecting gate usage.

attributes.name: schengen_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate can handle flights within the Schengen Area (European airports only) without passport control requirements.

attributes.name: wide_body_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate can accommodate wide-body aircraft (typically ICAO codes D, E, F such as B777, B787, A330, A350, A380).

products.name: gate_assignment
products.description: Transactional record linking a specific flight leg to a gate for a defined time window. Captures flight identifier, tail number, scheduled and actual gate-in/gate-out timestamps (OOOI-aligned), gate identifier, assignment source (CDM/manual/auto-assign), conflict flag, priority override reason, and assignment status (planned/confirmed/released). Supports turnaround sequencing, CDM messaging, and OTP reporting.
products.reference: IATA AHM 730 — Gate/Stand Allocation

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gate assignment record. Primary key for the gate assignment transaction.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Gate compatibility verification (aircraft size vs gate capability), stand planning, and ground equipment deployment require aircraft linkage. Critical for operational safety and efficient gate utiliza

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Gate planners at hub airports use real-time load factors from flight_inventory to assign appropriately-sized gates (wide-body vs narrow-body) and allocate jet bridges. This is a named CDM (Collaborati

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight leg being assigned to the gate. Links to the flight operations domain.

attributes.name: gate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate. Business justification: gate_assignment references a specific gate but currently uses gate_identifier (STRING) and terminal_code. Normalizing to FK allows joining to gate master for all gate attributes (gate_number, concours

attributes.name: actual_gate_in_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Gate In Time (Actual On-Block Time)
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when aircraft arrived at gate and set parking brake (Actual On-block from OOOI). Captured via ACARS or manual entry. Critical for OTP calculation and turnaround tracking.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - OOOI Times

attributes.name: actual_gate_out_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Gate Out Time (Actual Off-Block Time)
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when aircraft pushed back from gate and released parking brake (Actual Off-block from OOOI). Captured via ACARS or manual entry. Marks gate release and availability for next assignment.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - OOOI Times

attributes.name: aircraft_size_category
attributes.description: Size classification of aircraft assigned to gate, used for gate compatibility validation. Narrow-body: single aisle; Wide-body: twin aisle; Regional: small aircraft; Heavy: large aircraft; Super: A380 class.

attributes.name: airport_iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Airport International Air Transport Association (IATA) Code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code where this gate assignment occurs (e.g., JFK, LHR, DXB). Identifies the operational airport for multi-hub airline networks.

attributes.name: arrival_gate
attributes.description: The gate number or stand identifier at the destination airport where the flight arrived. [Moved from flight_leg: arrival_gate is a STRING attribute in flight_leg that represents the gate assignment at arrival. This should be replaced by the gate_assignment association, as a flight can be reassigned to multiple gates during IROP. The actual gate used is determined by querying gate_assignment with assignment_type='arrival' or 'turnaround' and assignment_status='completed'.]

attributes.name: assignment_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the gate reservation expires and becomes available for next assignment, typically includes buffer after scheduled gate-out for cleanup and turnaround completion.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the gate assignment, formatted as GA followed by 8 digits. Used for operational reference and CDM messaging.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: assignment_source
attributes.description: Origin of the gate assignment decision. CDM: Collaborative Decision Making system; Manual: dispatcher override; Auto-assign: automated allocation; Rescheduled: changed from original; IROP: irregular operations reassignment.

attributes.name: assignment_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the gate was reserved for this flight, typically earlier than scheduled gate-in to allow for ground equipment setup and early arrival buffer.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the gate assignment. Planned: initial assignment; Confirmed: verified by operations; Active: aircraft at gate; Completed: turnaround finished; Released: gate available; Cancelled: assignment voided.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate assignment record was initially created in the system. Represents the business event time of assignment decision, distinct from technical audit timestamps.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: cdm_milestone_status
attributes.description: Current CDM milestone achieved for this gate assignment. TOBT: Target Off-Block Time set; TSAT: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued; AOBT: Actual Off-Block Time; AIBT: Actual In-Block Time; ALDT: Actual Landing Time.

attributes.name: conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate assignment has a scheduling conflict with another assignment (overlapping time windows). True when conflict detected; requires resolution by operations.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting how a gate assignment conflict was resolved, including dispatcher actions, alternative gate assignments, or operational adjustments made.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: departure_gate
attributes.description: The gate number or stand identifier at the origin airport from which the flight departed. [Moved from flight_leg: departure_gate is a STRING attribute in flight_leg that represents the gate assignment at departure. This should be replaced by the gate_assignment association, as a flight can be reassigned to multiple gates during IROP. The actual gate used is determined by querying gate_assignment with assignment_type='departure' or 'turnaround' and assignment_status='completed'.]

attributes.name: domestic_international_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flight assigned to this gate is domestic or international. Schengen applies to intra-European flights with no border control. Determines gate area assignment and customs/immigration requirements.

attributes.name: gate_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for any gate hold or delay in releasing the gate assignment. Documents operational reasons such as late arriving aircraft, maintenance issues, or ATC delays.

attributes.name: gate_type
attributes.description: Classification of gate facility type. Contact: jet bridge equipped; Remote: bus boarding; Hardstand: tarmac parking; Cargo: freight operations. Determines boarding method and ground service requirements.

attributes.name: ground_power_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ground power unit (GPU) is available at this gate for this assignment. Required for aircraft electrical power during turnaround when APU is shut down.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - Ground Support Equipment

attributes.name: hub_spoke_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of airport operational role in airline network. Hub: major connecting airport; Spoke: destination from hub; Focus city: secondary hub; Outstation: remote station with limited operations.

attributes.name: jet_bridge_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a jet bridge (passenger boarding bridge) is available and operational at this gate for this assignment. Critical for passenger boarding operations and accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate assignment record was last updated. Tracks changes to assignment details, status transitions, or operational adjustments.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: passenger_facility_charge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Passenger Facility Charge applies to this gate assignment based on airport authority regulations. Used for financial settlement and regulatory reporting to DOT.
attributes.references: US DOT 14 CFR Part 158 - Passenger Facility Charges

attributes.name: preconditioned_air_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether preconditioned air (PCA) system is available at this gate for cabin climate control during turnaround. Reduces APU usage and fuel burn.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - Ground Support Equipment

attributes.name: priority_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment received priority treatment overriding normal allocation rules. True for VIP flights, IROP recovery, or operational priority situations.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: priority_override_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for priority override of normal gate assignment rules. Documents justification for preferential gate allocation outside standard procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vip_flight|irop_recovery|maintenance_priority|diplomatic|medical_emergency|operational_necessity|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and comments related to this gate assignment. Used by dispatchers and ground operations for coordination and situational awareness.
attributes.references: SITA Airport Management Platform - Gate Assignment Module

attributes.name: scheduled_gate_in_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when aircraft is scheduled to arrive at the gate and set parking brake (On-block time from OOOI). Used for gate allocation planning and OTP reporting.

attributes.name: scheduled_gate_out_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when aircraft is scheduled to push back from gate and release parking brake (Off-block time from OOOI). Used for gate release planning and next assignment scheduling.

attributes.name: slot_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gate assignment requires coordination with airport slot allocation due to capacity constraints at slot-controlled airport. True for Level 3 coordinated airports.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Special Service Request code indicating special handling requirements for this gate assignment (e.g., WCHR for wheelchair, DEPA for deportee, MEDA for medical). Drives ground service and security coordination.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: stand_compatibility_code
attributes.description: ICAO aerodrome reference code indicating maximum aircraft size the gate can accommodate (A through F). Ensures aircraft-gate physical compatibility for safe operations.

attributes.name: turnaround_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes for aircraft turnaround at the gate, from gate-in to gate-out. Varies by aircraft type, service level, and operational requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) - Turnaround Standards

products.name: turnaround
products.description: Master operational record for an aircraft turnaround event at a gate, representing the full ground servicing cycle between inbound and outbound flight legs. Captures inbound and outbound flight references, tail number, gate assignment, scheduled and actual block-in/block-out times, turnaround type (standard/quick/overnight/transit), target turnaround time (TTT), actual turnaround time, overall status, responsible ground handler, ramp service order details (ordered services, service window, handler instructions, completion status, deviation notes), and OTP contribution metrics. Central entity for ground operations coordination, handler SLA measurement, and OTP root-cause analysis.
products.reference: IATA AHM 730 — Aircraft Turnaround Management

attributes.name: turnaround_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft turnaround event. Primary key for the turnaround record.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft. Business justification: Turnaround performance analysis by aircraft, maintenance event correlation, and technical delay attribution require aircraft linkage. Ground operations planning and aircraft-specific service requireme

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Turnaround operations are cost-tracked activities for CASK (cost per available seat kilometer) calculation, station profitability analysis, and ground handling cost allocation. Essential for financial

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.gate_assignment. Business justification: turnaround occurs at a specific gate assignment (time-bound gate allocation). Currently stores gate_assignment as STRING. FK to gate_assignment provides access to gate details, assignment times, and a

attributes.name: ground_handler_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.ground_handler. Business justification: turnaround services are performed by a specific ground handler. Currently stores ground_handler_code (STRING). FK to ground_handler provides access to handler name, capabilities, performance tier, SLA

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Aircraft turnaround events occur at specific airport stations. The turnaround table currently has airport_code as a STRING denormalized attribute, but no FK to station. Adding station_id normalizes th

attributes.name: turnaround_inbound_flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the arriving flight leg that initiates this turnaround event.

attributes.name: turnaround_outbound_flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the departing flight leg that concludes this turnaround event.

attributes.name: actual_block_in_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the inbound aircraft arrived at the gate and parking brake was set (OOOI - On event).

attributes.name: actual_block_out_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the outbound aircraft pushed back from the gate and began taxi (OOOI - Off event).

attributes.name: actual_turnaround_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration in minutes from block-in to block-out. Calculated as the difference between actual_block_out_time and actual_block_in_time.

attributes.name: all_services_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all ordered ground services have been completed and signed off. True when turnaround is ready for departure.

attributes.name: baggage_pieces_loaded
attributes.description: Total number of baggage pieces loaded onto the outbound flight during turnaround.

attributes.name: baggage_pieces_offloaded
attributes.description: Total number of baggage pieces offloaded from the inbound flight during turnaround.

attributes.name: cargo_weight_loaded_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of cargo and mail loaded onto the outbound flight.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual (CSCRM)

attributes.name: cargo_weight_offloaded_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of cargo and mail offloaded from the inbound flight.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual (CSCRM)

attributes.name: cdm_milestone_status
attributes.description: JSON or delimited string capturing CDM milestone timestamps (TOBT, TSAT, TTOT, AOBT, ASAT, ATOT) for Airport CDM integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delay_code
attributes.description: Two-digit IATA delay code indicating the primary cause of any turnaround delay (e.g., 31=aircraft defect, 32=lack of crew, 81=weather, 82=ATC).

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Total delay in minutes attributed to turnaround operations. Calculated as actual_turnaround_time_minutes minus target_turnaround_time_minutes when positive.

attributes.name: deviation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any deviations from standard turnaround procedures, service failures, or operational irregularities encountered.

attributes.name: fuel_uplift_kg
attributes.description: Quantity of fuel in kilograms added to the aircraft during this turnaround.

attributes.name: ground_support_equipment_assigned
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GSE unit identifiers assigned to this turnaround (e.g., GPU-123, belt loader-456, tug-789).

attributes.name: handler_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions or notes for the ground handler regarding this specific turnaround (e.g., VIP passenger, special cargo, MEL items, security requirements).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: otp_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this turnaround contributed to an on-time performance failure (departure delay >15 minutes). Used for OTP root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: passenger_count_boarded
attributes.description: Number of passengers who boarded the outbound flight during this turnaround.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: passenger_count_deplaned
attributes.description: Number of passengers who deplaned from the inbound flight during this turnaround.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual (PSCRM)

attributes.name: ramp_service_order_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ramp service order that defines all ground services to be performed during this turnaround.

attributes.name: scheduled_block_in_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the inbound aircraft is scheduled to arrive at the gate (OOOI - On event).

attributes.name: scheduled_block_out_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the outbound aircraft is scheduled to push back from the gate (OOOI - Off event).

attributes.name: service_window_end_time
attributes.description: Latest timestamp by which all ground service operations must be completed to meet scheduled block-out time.

attributes.name: service_window_start_time
attributes.description: Earliest timestamp when ground service operations can commence, typically shortly after block-in.

attributes.name: services_completion_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when all ground services were completed and aircraft was declared ready for departure.

attributes.name: services_ordered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ground services ordered for this turnaround (e.g., fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, GPU, air start, deicing, baggage handling, cargo loading).

attributes.name: target_turnaround_time_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes for the complete turnaround cycle from block-in to block-out, based on aircraft type and turnaround type.

attributes.name: turnaround_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the turnaround event. Tracks lifecycle from scheduled through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: turnaround_type
attributes.description: Classification of turnaround based on duration and service scope. Standard (60-90 min), quick (<45 min), overnight (>8 hours), transit (international connection), maintenance (scheduled service), extended (unplanned delay).

products.name: turnaround_task
products.description: Individual ground servicing task within a turnaround event, including GSE deployment details. Captures task type (fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, de-icing, cargo loading, PAX boarding, pushback), planned and actual start/end times, responsible service provider, task status (pending/in-progress/complete/skipped), delay reason code, sequence order, assigned GSE asset(s), GSE operator, GSE deployment start/end times, fuel consumed by GSE, and any equipment defect noted. Enables milestone tracking, SLA compliance measurement, and GSE utilization optimization for each turnaround service element.
products.reference: IATA AHM 730 — Turnaround Milestone Tracking

attributes.name: turnaround_task_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual ground servicing task within a turnaround event. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual turnaround tasks (ramp, catering, cleaning) belong to different cost centres even within the same turnaround. Direct cost_centre attribution on each task enables granular ground operations

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight leg associated with this turnaround task. Connects the ground service task to the specific flight operation.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Individual ground service task costs (fueling, catering, cleaning) must be posted to specific GL accounts for flight-level CASK analysis and ground operations cost accounting. Aviation finance teams r

attributes.name: ground_handler_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.ground_handler. Business justification: Individual turnaround tasks are performed by ground handling service providers. turnaround_task currently carries service_provider_code and service_provider_name as denormalized STRING attributes. gro

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ground crew or team assigned to perform this turnaround task.

attributes.name: occurrence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.occurrence. Business justification: Individual tasks (fueling, catering, pushback) are the specific activity during which safety occurrences happen. Task-level occurrence linking supports detailed root cause analysis and task-specific s

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Individual turnaround tasks (fueling, catering, cleaning, etc.) occur at specific airport stations. The turnaround_task table currently has airport_code as a STRING denormalized attribute, but no FK t

attributes.name: turnaround_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent turnaround event that this task belongs to. Links this task to the overall aircraft turnaround operation.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground servicing task was completed. Used for SLA compliance measurement and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the ground servicing task commenced. Used for performance measurement and delay analysis.

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the service provider upon task completion, including any exceptions, observations, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Direct cost incurred for this ground servicing task, including labor, equipment, and materials. Used for turnaround cost analysis and vendor billing.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround task record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of task delay in minutes, calculated as the difference between planned and actual completion times. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized IATA delay code indicating the reason for any task delay or late completion. Used for root cause analysis and performance improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full IATA delay code taxonomy]

attributes.name: gate_stand_position
attributes.description: Specific gate or stand position identifier where the aircraft is parked and this task is being performed.

attributes.name: gse_defect_description
attributes.description: Textual description of any GSE defect, malfunction, or maintenance issue observed during task execution. Populated when defect flag is true.

attributes.name: gse_defect_noted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Defect Noted Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether any equipment defect or malfunction was noted during this task. Triggers maintenance follow-up.

attributes.name: gse_deployment_end_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Deployment End Time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GSE asset was released from this task and became available for other operations. Used for GSE utilization optimization.

attributes.name: gse_deployment_start_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Deployment Start Time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GSE asset was deployed and positioned for this task. Used for GSE utilization tracking and availability management.

attributes.name: gse_fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Volume of fuel consumed by the GSE asset during this task deployment, measured in liters. Used for environmental reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turnaround task record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the ground servicing task is planned to be completed, based on standard service times and turnaround requirements.

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the ground servicing task is planned to begin, based on the turnaround schedule and task dependencies.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the task indicating urgency and importance for turnaround completion. Critical tasks are mandatory for flight departure.

attributes.name: quality_check_performed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether a quality inspection or verification check was performed for this task. Used for quality assurance and safety compliance.

attributes.name: quality_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection or verification check, if performed. Used for quality assurance tracking and corrective action triggering.

attributes.name: quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of service delivered or resource provided during this task (e.g., liters of fuel, kilograms of cargo, number of meals, gallons of water). Unit depends on task type.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether any safety incident, near-miss, or hazard was reported during this task execution. Triggers safety investigation and SMS reporting.

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric order indicating the planned sequence of this task within the turnaround event. Used to coordinate dependencies and parallel operations during aircraft servicing.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the task was completed within the SLA target duration. Used for service provider performance measurement.

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Contractual service level agreement target duration for this task type, measured in minutes. Used for performance benchmarking and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: task_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the specific ground servicing task, including any special instructions, requirements, or notes for the service provider.

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the turnaround task. Tracks progression from pending assignment through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|ASSIGNED|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETE|SKIPPED|CANCELLED|FAILED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: task_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of ground servicing task being performed. Examples include fueling, catering, cleaning, water service, lavatory service, de-icing, cargo loading/unloading, passenger boarding/deplaning, pushback, ground power unit (GPU), air start unit (ASU), potable water, waste removal, cabin preparation, security check, or pre-flight inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FUEL|CATER|CLEAN|WATER|LAV|DEICE|CARGO_LOAD|CARGO_UNLOAD|PAX_BOARD|PAX_DEPLANE|PUSHBACK|GPU|ASU|POTABLE|WASTE|CABIN_PREP|SECURITY|INSPECTION — 18 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Ground Operations Manual (IGOM), AHM 810 (Airport Handling Manual)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity delivered field. Varies by task type (e.g., liters for fuel, kilograms for cargo, units for catering). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LITERS|KILOGRAMS|GALLONS|UNITS|MEALS|PASSENGERS|BAGS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: slot
products.description: Airport slot record representing an allocated takeoff or landing time at a capacity-constrained airport, including utilization tracking. Captures IATA season, slot type (arrival/departure), allocated time, slot coordinator reference, airport ICAO code, airline designator, aircraft type, slot series (regular/ad-hoc), slot status (allocated/confirmed/returned/swapped), historic slot precedence flag, and per-operating-date utilization data including actual flight reference, compliance status (used/missed/cancelled/swapped), variance in minutes, reason for non-compliance, and regulatory reporting flag. Aligns with IATA Worldwide Slot Guidelines (WSG) and supports slot compliance monitoring and slot pool management.
products.reference: IATA Worldwide Slot Guidelines (WSG) — Slot Allocation

attributes.name: slot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the airport slot record. Primary key.

attributes.name: route_id

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Every airport slot belongs to an IATA schedule season. Slot return deadlines, historic rights protection, and season-level slot portfolio management require this FK. iata_season is a denormalized text

attributes.name: slot_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_slot_allocation. Business justification: Slot coordination management requires tracing each airport-held slot back to the route-level allocation that generated it. Slot compliance monitoring, historic precedence tracking, and IATA WSG report

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: slot is allocated at a specific airport/station. Currently stores airport_icao_code (STRING). FK to station provides access to station name, time zone, slot coordinator, CDM capability, and operationa

attributes.name: terminal_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.terminal_facility. Business justification: An airport slot is allocated for operations at a specific terminal at slot-coordinated airports. slot currently carries terminal_identifier as a denormalized STRING. terminal_facility has terminal_ide

attributes.name: actual_flight_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the actual flight that operated using this slot, typically the flight leg identifier or operational flight number. Used for post-operation reconciliation and compliance tracking. Null if slot was not used.

attributes.name: actual_operation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which this slot was actually used for a flight operation. Populated post-operation for utilization tracking. Null if not yet operated or if slot was not used.

attributes.name: actual_operation_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the flight operation occurred (actual takeoff time for departure slots, actual landing time for arrival slots). Used to calculate variance from allocated time. Null if not yet operated.

attributes.name: airline_designator
attributes.description: Two or three-character IATA airline code of the carrier to whom this slot is allocated (e.g., BA, AA, LH).

attributes.name: allocated_time
attributes.description: The specific date and time allocated for this slot operation (takeoff or landing). This is the coordinated time assigned by the slot coordinator.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: Date when this slot was initially allocated to the airline by the slot coordinator.

attributes.name: cdm_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for Airport Collaborative Decision Making (A-CDM) messages related to this slot, used for real-time coordination between airline, airport, ATC, and ground handlers. Aligns with SITA Airport Management Platform.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot was used in compliance with allocation: used (operated within tolerance), missed (not operated without valid reason), cancelled (airline cancelled in advance), swapped (exchanged with another slot), not_yet_operated (future slot).

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the airline confirmed intention to use this slot. Null if not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: coordinator_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by the airport slot coordinator (e.g., Airport Coordination Limited, Flughafen-Koordinierung Deutschland) for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Planned flight number for this slot operation, combining airline designator and numeric identifier (e.g., BA123, LH456). May be null for slots not yet assigned to specific flights.

attributes.name: historic_precedence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot carries historic precedence (grandfather rights) under IATA 80/20 rule, meaning the airline used the slot at least 80% of the time in the previous equivalent season and has priority for renewal.

attributes.name: justification_category
attributes.description: Categorized reason for non-compliance or slot misuse. Weather: meteorological conditions; ATC delay: air traffic control restrictions; Technical: aircraft maintenance or defect; Operational: crew, ground handling, or airport issues; Commercial: passenger or cargo demand changes; Other: miscellaneous.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a slot was missed or operated outside tolerance. May reference weather, Air Traffic Control (ATC) delays, technical issues, or other justifiable causes. Used for regulatory reporting and historic precedence calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or operational notes related to this slot allocation. May include coordinator instructions, special handling requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: pool_category
attributes.description: Classification of the slot pool from which this slot was allocated. New entrant: reserved for new carriers; Domestic: domestic operations; International: international operations; General: unrestricted pool. Used for regulatory compliance and fair competition monitoring.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot record must be included in regulatory compliance reports to aviation authorities (e.g., for 80/20 rule enforcement, slot pool management, or competition monitoring). True if reporting required.
attributes.references: IATA WSG, EU Regulation 95/93, FAA slot rules

attributes.name: series
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a regular series slot (recurring throughout the season) or an ad-hoc slot (one-time or irregular operation).

attributes.name: series_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this slot to a series of recurring slots. Populated for regular series slots; null for ad-hoc slots.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of flight service this slot is allocated for: passenger (revenue passenger service), cargo (freight service), ferry (non-revenue aircraft repositioning with no payload), positioning (deadhead crew or aircraft movement).

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the slot allocation. Allocated: initially assigned; Confirmed: airline confirmed usage; Returned: handed back to coordinator; Swapped: exchanged with another carrier; Cancelled: withdrawn; Suspended: temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is for an arrival or departure operation at the airport.

attributes.name: swap_date
attributes.description: Date when the slot swap transaction was executed and recorded with the slot coordinator. Null if no swap occurred.

attributes.name: swap_partner_airline
attributes.description: IATA airline code of the carrier with whom this slot was swapped, if applicable. Null if no swap occurred.

attributes.name: time_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference in minutes between allocated slot time and actual operation time. Positive values indicate late operation, negative values indicate early operation. Used for compliance monitoring against tolerance thresholds (typically +/- 5 or 15 minutes depending on airport rules).

products.name: slot_utilization
products.description: Transactional record tracking actual use of an allocated slot against its planned parameters. Captures slot reference, associated flight, operated date, planned vs actual departure/arrival time, slot compliance status (used/missed/cancelled/swapped), variance in minutes, reason for non-compliance, and regulatory reporting flag for slot return obligations. Supports IATA slot compliance monitoring and slot pool management.
products.reference: IATA WSG — Slot Utilization Monitoring

attributes.name: slot_utilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the slot utilization transaction record.

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight operation that utilized this slot.

attributes.name: gate_assignment_id

attributes.name: infant_accompanying_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this check-in session record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: seat_assigned

attributes.name: special_service_requests
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SSR codes processed or confirmed during check-in (e.g., WCHR, VGML, PETC). Reflects special assistance, meal preferences, or service requests.

attributes.name: standby_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passenger is confirmed, on standby, or waitlisted at check-in. Confirmed = seat guaranteed, standby = awaiting seat assignment, waitlisted = not yet cleared.

attributes.name: travel_document_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the passengers travel documents (passport, visa) were verified during check-in. True if documents verified.

Enables final PAX count reconciliation, no-show tracking, and security compliance.

attributes.name: scan_timestamp

attributes.name: seat_number

attributes.name: security_screening_status

attributes.name: special_service_request_codes

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: weight_kg

attributes.name: width_cm
