attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure when the ancillary product becomes available for purchase. Null if available immediately upon flight booking. Used for time-sensitive products like seat upgrades.

attributes.name: cabin_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cabin classes for which this ancillary product is available (e.g., 'economy,premium_economy,business,first'). Used to restrict or target products by travel class.

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels where the ancillary product is available for purchase (e.g., 'web,mobile,airport,call_center,gds'). Used to control distribution and channel-specific merchandising.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage commission rate paid to sales agents, travel agencies, or distribution partners for selling this ancillary product. Used for partner settlement and revenue sharing calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ancillary product record was first created in the catalog system. Used for audit trail and product lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the ancillary product is no longer available for new bookings. Null for products with indefinite availability. Used for limited-time offers and product phase-outs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the ancillary product becomes available for sale and booking. Used for seasonal products, new product launches, and promotional offerings.

attributes.name: fare_family_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fare families or branded fare products for which this ancillary is available or included (e.g., 'basic,standard,flex,premium'). Used for unbundled fare strategy and fare family differentiation.
attributes.references: IATA New Distribution Capability (NDC) - Fare Families

attributes.name: iata_emd_service_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) Service Type Code
attributes.description: IATA-standardized service type code used for EMD issuance and settlement. Maps ancillary products to industry-standard codes for interline billing and BSP/ARC settlement (e.g., '0CC' for baggage, '0G1' for lounge).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 - EMD Service Type Codes

attributes.name: iata_ssim_service_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM) Service Code
attributes.description: IATA SSIM service code used for schedule and service data exchange. Identifies ancillary services in GDS and reservation systems.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Chapter 6 - Service Information Codes

attributes.name: inventory_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product is subject to inventory control and capacity limits (e.g., lounge seats, premium seats, onboard meal quantities). True if inventory-controlled; false if unlimited availability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ancillary product record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units that can be purchased per passenger or per booking. Used to enforce business rules and prevent inventory abuse (e.g., maximum 3 checked bags per passenger).

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be purchased in a single transaction. Typically 1 for most ancillary products; may be higher for bulk or group purchases.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the product record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: partner_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product is provided by a third-party partner (e.g., car rental, hotel, travel insurance) rather than directly by the airline. True if partner product; false if airline-owned product.

attributes.name: passenger_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of passenger types eligible to purchase this ancillary product (e.g., 'adult,child,infant,senior,military,ffp_elite'). Used to enforce eligibility rules and targeted merchandising.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Pricing strategy applied to the ancillary product. Fixed pricing uses a constant price; dynamic pricing varies by demand, route, or booking class; tiered pricing offers volume discounts; bundled pricing includes multiple products; promotional pricing applies temporary discounts.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the ancillary product across all systems. Used for inventory, pricing, and settlement. Aligns with IATA EMD service type codes where applicable.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 - EMD Service Type Codes

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the ancillary product, including features, benefits, terms, and conditions. Used for customer-facing marketing and internal reference.
attributes.references: DOT Consumer Protection Regulations - Transparency Requirements

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the ancillary product as displayed to customers and used in internal systems (e.g., 'Priority Boarding', 'Extra Baggage 23kg', 'Lounge Access Day Pass').

attributes.name: product_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or shortened display name for the product, used in space-constrained interfaces such as mobile apps, boarding passes, and receipts.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ancillary product in the catalog. Active products are available for sale; inactive products are temporarily unavailable; suspended products are under review; discontinued products are permanently retired; pending_approval products await commercial approval.

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product purchase is refundable if the passenger cancels or changes their booking. True if refundable; false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: revenue_accounting_code
attributes.description: Internal accounting code used to classify ancillary revenue for financial reporting, revenue management, and general ledger posting. Maps to specific GL accounts in SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: route_applicability
attributes.description: Defines the geographic or route scope where the ancillary product is available. Values include all routes, domestic only, international only, regional (e.g., intra-Europe), or specific routes defined in separate route mapping tables.

attributes.name: ssr_code
attributes.description: Four-letter IATA SSR code used in PNR and reservation systems to request and track special services (e.g., 'BAGP' for prepaid baggage, 'SEAT' for seat assignment, 'MEAL' for meal preference).
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolution 700 - SSR Codes

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code used to determine applicable taxes, VAT, GST, or other government charges for the ancillary product. Maps to tax calculation rules in revenue accounting systems.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product can be transferred to another passenger or booking. True if transferable; false if non-transferable and tied to the original purchaser.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit by which the ancillary product is quantified and sold (e.g., 'each' for lounge access, 'kilogram' for baggage weight, 'hour' for Wi-Fi, 'segment' for seat selection, 'piece' for baggage count). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|kilogram|pound|hour|day|trip|segment|piece — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: category
products.description: Reference taxonomy classifying ancillary products into standardized categories aligned with IATA PADIS and ATPCO Optional Services standards — e.g., baggage, seat, boarding, lounge, catering, connectivity, ground transport, accommodation, insurance, bundles. Drives merchandising logic, reporting hierarchies, and EMD issuance rules.
products.reference: IATA PADIS / ATPCO Optional Services Category

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ancillary product category. Primary key.
attributes.references: IATA PADIS, ATPCO Optional Services Standards

attributes.name: parent_category_ancillary_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to a parent ancillary category, enabling hierarchical taxonomy structures (e.g., Baggage as parent, Checked Baggage and Carry-On Baggage as children).

attributes.name: ancillary_category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ancillary category indicating whether it is actively used in merchandising and revenue systems.

attributes.name: atpco_service_group
attributes.business_glossary_term: Airline Tariff Publishing Company (ATPCO) Service Group
attributes.description: ATPCO Optional Services service group classification for the ancillary category, used for fare filing and distribution through GDS channels.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the ancillary category, aligned with IATA PADIS and ATPCO Optional Services taxonomy (e.g., BAG for baggage, SEAT for seat selection, LOUNGE for lounge access).
attributes.references: IATA PADIS, ATPCO Optional Services Standards

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the ancillary category, including scope, typical products included, and business purpose.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of the hierarchical level of this category within the taxonomy (e.g., 1 for top-level, 2 for sub-category, 3 for detailed classification).

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ancillary category (e.g., Baggage, Seat Selection, Priority Boarding, Lounge Access, In-Flight Meals, Wi-Fi Connectivity).
attributes.references: IATA PADIS, ATPCO Optional Services Standards

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the ancillary category distinguishing between service-based, product-based, bundled offerings, insurance, ground transport, or accommodation.
attributes.references: IATA PADIS, ATPCO Optional Services Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ancillary category record was first created in the system, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: direct_channel_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is exclusively sold through direct airline channels (website, mobile app, call center) and not available via third-party distributors.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering for display of this category in user interfaces, merchandising platforms, and reporting hierarchies.

attributes.name: dot_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue from this ancillary category must be reported to the US Department of Transportation (DOT) in quarterly ancillary revenue disclosures.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this ancillary category is no longer effective and should not be used for new product assignments. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ancillary category becomes effective and available for use in product catalog and merchandising systems.

attributes.name: emd_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ancillary products in this category are eligible for issuance via Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) per IATA standards.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Specifies the EMD type applicable to this category: EMD-S (standalone, not linked to e-ticket) or EMD-A (associated with e-ticket). Not applicable if EMD is not used.

attributes.name: gds_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ancillary products in this category are distributed through Global Distribution Systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

attributes.name: iata_padis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Passenger and Airport Data Interchange Standards (PADIS) Code
attributes.description: IATA PADIS standard code for the ancillary category, enabling interoperability across Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and Passenger Service Systems (PSS).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ancillary category record was last updated, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: merchandising_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority of this category in merchandising and upsell workflows, with lower numbers representing higher priority.

attributes.name: ndc_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ancillary category is compatible with IATA New Distribution Capability (NDC) standards for modern retailing and distribution.

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ancillary products in this category are generally refundable per airline policy and fare rules.
attributes.references: IATA Fare Rules, Internal Refund Policy

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any regulatory compliance considerations specific to this ancillary category, including Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), or consumer protection requirements.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 399, EASA Regulations, Consumer Protection Laws

attributes.name: service_delivery_point
attributes.description: Indicates the primary point in the passenger journey where the ancillary service is delivered (e.g., pre-flight for advance seat selection, in-flight for meals, airport for lounge access).

attributes.name: ssr_code
attributes.description: Four-letter IATA Special Service Request (SSR) code associated with this ancillary category for communication between airlines and service providers (e.g., WCHR for wheelchair, PETC for pet in cabin).

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ancillary products in this category can be transferred to another passenger or booking.

attributes.name: unbundled_fare_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category represents a component of an unbundled fare strategy, where services traditionally included in the base fare are sold separately.

products.name: price
products.description: Pricing records for ancillary products defining the fare amount, currency, applicable route or market, cabin class, passenger type code (PTC), booking class, sales channel, and effective date range. Supports dynamic and static ancillary pricing strategies including yield-linked and flat-fee models. Source of truth for ancillary price points used in offer generation.
products.reference: ATPCO Optional Services Pricing / IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: price_id
attributes.description: Primary key for price

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Ancillary pricing varies by cabin class (premium seat selection costs more, business class baggage allowances differ). Revenue management pricing requires formal cabin class linkage for price rule app

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Ancillary prices are governed by the selling legal entity (company code) for BSP/ARC settlement, tax jurisdiction, and multi-entity revenue reporting. Aviation domain experts expect price records to b

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: Ancillary pricing rules are enforced per fare class bucket (RBD) in airline RM systems. Revenue management teams report ancillary price applicability by fare bucket to ensure correct pricing is applie

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ancillary product being priced (e.g., baggage, seat selection, lounge access, Wi-Fi).

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Ancillary pricing varies by route (distance bands, regional regulations, competitive dynamics). Revenue management systems require route-level price configuration for baggage, seats, meals. Real busin

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Ancillary prices are reviewed and updated each IATA schedule season — seasonal demand patterns drive ancillary fee adjustments. The price product has travel_date_from/to but no season FK. A revenue ma

attributes.name: booking_class
attributes.description: Single-letter booking class (fare class) code for which this price applies. Used in yield-linked pricing strategies. Null if price applies across all booking classes.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage paid to the sales channel or agent for selling this ancillary product at this price. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this price record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fare amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination of the route or market where this price applies. Null if price is not route-specific.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price becomes valid and can be used in offer generation and booking.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) used to record this ancillary charge: EMD-S (standalone) or EMD-A (associated with e-ticket). Null if not EMD-linked.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this price is no longer valid. Null for open-ended prices.

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: The base price amount for the ancillary product in the specified currency. Does not include taxes or fees.

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: Fare basis code that this ancillary price is linked to, used in yield-linked pricing strategies. Null for flat-fee or non-fare-linked pricing.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Geographic market or region code where this price applies (e.g., origin-destination pair, country, or region). Used when price is market-specific rather than route-specific.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units that can be purchased at this price. Null if no maximum limit applies.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be purchased for this price to apply. Typically 1 for most ancillary products. Used for volume-based pricing.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin of the route or market where this price applies. Null if price is not route-specific.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: Three-letter passenger type code indicating the passenger category for which this price applies (e.g., ADT for adult, CHD for child, INF for infant, SRC for senior). Null if price applies to all passenger types.

attributes.name: price_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the price record, used in revenue management and offer generation systems.

attributes.name: price_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the price, including any special conditions, restrictions, or promotional messaging. Used for customer-facing display.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price record: active (in use), inactive (not currently offered), pending (scheduled for future activation), expired (past expiration date), or suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy: flat fee (fixed amount), yield-linked (varies with fare class), dynamic (real-time demand-based), bundled (part of fare package), promotional (temporary discount), or seasonal (time-based).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Ranking or priority order for this price when multiple prices are available for the same product and conditions. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in offer generation logic.

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary product purchased at this price is refundable. True if refundable, False if non-refundable.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: IATA Reason For Issuance Sub-Code identifying the specific ancillary service type (e.g., 0CC for checked baggage, 0B5 for seat selection). Used in EMD processing and settlement.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the ancillary service being priced: baggage, seat selection, meal, lounge access, Wi-Fi, travel insurance, priority boarding, fast track security, cabin upgrade, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: baggage|seat|meal|lounge|wifi|insurance|priority_boarding|fast_track|upgrade|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the ancillary product price, including VAT, GST, or other jurisdiction-specific taxes.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total price including base fare amount and all applicable taxes and fees.

attributes.name: travel_date_from
attributes.description: The earliest travel date for which this price is applicable. Used for seasonal or date-restricted pricing. Null if no travel date restriction applies.

attributes.name: travel_date_to
attributes.description: The latest travel date for which this price is applicable. Used for seasonal or date-restricted pricing. Null if no travel date restriction applies.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this price record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price record was last modified.

products.name: bundle
products.description: Defines bundled ancillary fare products (e.g., Basic, Standard, Flex, Premium bundles) that package multiple ancillary services into a single purchasable offer. Captures bundle composition rules, included service entitlements, pricing tiers, and unbundling eligibility. Supports the airline's unbundled fare strategy and branded fare merchandising.

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bundle

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.ancillary_category. Bundles are a distinct ca

attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included in the bundle entitlement. Null if baggage is not included or uses weight-based allowance.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight allowance in kilograms for checked baggage included in the bundle. Null if baggage is not included or uses piece-based allowance.

attributes.name: base_price_amount

attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the bundle product used in reservation systems and merchandising platforms (e.g., BASIC_ECO, FLEX_PLUS, PREMIUM_BIZ).

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the bundle product including all included services, entitlements, restrictions, and value proposition for customer communication.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the bundle displayed to customers during booking and merchandising (e.g., Basic Economy, Flex Plus, Premium Business).

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bundle product indicating its availability for sale and merchandising.

attributes.name: bundle_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier level of the bundle within the airlines branded fare structure, indicating the level of service and entitlements included.

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle product by its primary business purpose and composition strategy.

attributes.name: cancellation_refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets purchased with this bundle are refundable upon cancellation (True) or non-refundable (False).

attributes.name: change_fee_waived_flag

attributes.name: minimum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days before departure that this bundle must be purchased. Null if no advance purchase requirement exists.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The pricing methodology applied to this bundle indicating whether pricing is fixed, dynamically adjusted based on demand, or subject to yield management rules.

attributes.name: priority_boarding_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether priority boarding privileges are included in this bundle entitlement (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: route_restriction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle is available on all routes or restricted to specific route types (domestic, international, regional, or specific route list).

attributes.name: seat_selection_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance seat selection is included as an entitlement in this bundle (True) or must be purchased separately (False).

attributes.name: seat_selection_type
attributes.description: The category of seats available for selection under this bundle entitlement (standard, preferred, extra legroom, or any seat).

attributes.name: standby_priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to passengers on this bundle when placed on standby lists for earlier or alternative flights. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: travel_date_restriction_end
attributes.description: The latest travel date for which this bundle is valid and can be applied to bookings. Null if no end date restriction exists.

attributes.name: travel_date_restriction_start

attributes.name: wifi_included_flag

attributes.name: passenger_type_code
attributes.description: IATA passenger type code. ADT=adult, CHD=child, INF=infant, SRC=senior citizen, MIL=military, STU=student. Determines eligibility for certain ancillary services and pricing.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method of payment used to purchase the EMD. Identifies the financial instrument used for settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|miles|voucher|corporate_account|bank_transfer — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the EMD is refundable. True if the ancillary service can be refunded per fare rules, false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ancillary service is scheduled to be consumed or delivered. For flight-related services, typically matches the flight departure date.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the ancillary service purchased. Examples: Extra Baggage 23kg, Premium Seat 12A, Priority Boarding, Lounge Access.

attributes.name: service_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the ancillary service purchased. For example, number of baggage pieces, number of meal vouchers, or 1 for single-use services like lounge access.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the EMD. Sum of all applicable taxes such as VAT, GST, or service taxes on the ancillary service.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount payable for the EMD including face value, taxes, and any fees. This is the final charge to the passenger.

attributes.name: tour_code
attributes.description: Tour or promotional code associated with the EMD. Used for tracking special offers, packages, or corporate agreements.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the EMD is valid for use. After this date, the EMD expires and cannot be consumed or refunded.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: First date on which the EMD is valid for use. Defines the beginning of the service consumption window.

products.name: seat_product
products.description: Commercial seat product definitions available for ancillary purchase or upgrade, defining seat types (standard, preferred, extra legroom, exit row, bulkhead), zone classifications, pitch/width specifications, applicable aircraft types, cabin class associations, and pricing tier references. This is the sellable seat product catalog — distinct from the physical seat map (fleet domain) and operational seat assignment (reservation domain). Drives seat merchandising offers and revenue attribution by seat tier.
products.reference: IATA PADIS Seat Map / ATPCO Optional Services Sub-code 0B5

attributes.name: seat_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commercial seat product definition. Primary key for the seat product catalog.

attributes.name: aircraft_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.aircraft_type. Business justification: Seat products (sellable seat types) are aircraft-type-specific for merchandising and pricing. Airlines price "A350 Premium Economy" differently from "777 Premium Economy" due to seat specifications. R

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Seat products are cabin-specific (business extra legroom vs economy preferred seats). Seat merchandising and inventory control require formal cabin class linkage for product applicability and pricing.

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: Seat product merchandising (extra legroom, preferred seats) must reference the specific cabin configuration to identify qualifying physical seats. A single aircraft type can have multiple configuratio

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Seat products (extra legroom, preferred, exit row) are sold ancillaries requiring GL account mapping for revenue recognition. Parallel to product_catalog GL mapping; seat products need dedicated reven

attributes.name: minimum_tier_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier_status. Business justification: Seat product tier eligibility: seat products (exit rows, premium economy seats) are complimentary or discounted for members above a minimum tier. This FK replaces the denormalized ffp_tier_eligibility

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.product_catalog. Business justification: seat_product defines commercial seat products available for ancillary purchase. product_catalog is the master catalog of all ancillary products and services. A seat product IS an ancillary product and

attributes.name: advance_selection_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before departure that advance seat selection opens for this product. Null if no time restriction applies.

attributes.name: base_price_usd
attributes.description: Standard base price for this seat product in USD. Actual pricing may vary by route, fare class, and dynamic pricing rules. Used as reference price for revenue attribution.

attributes.name: bundle_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fare bundle codes that include this seat product as a complimentary benefit (e.g., 'BASIC,STANDARD,PREMIUM,BUSINESS'). Empty if not included in any bundle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seat product record was first created in the ancillary catalog system. Used for audit trail and product lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base price (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this seat product is discontinued or removed from sale. Null for products with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this seat product becomes available for sale and merchandising. Supports seasonal product launches and fleet configuration changes.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD issued for this seat product purchase. EMD-S (standalone) for ancillary-only purchases; EMD-A (associated) when linked to an e-ticket.

attributes.name: fare_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fare class codes eligible to purchase or select this seat product (e.g., 'Y,B,M,H,Q,V,W'). Empty indicates available to all fare classes.

attributes.name: in_seat_entertainment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product includes a personal in-flight entertainment (IFE) screen. Key amenity for merchandising and customer experience differentiation.

attributes.name: is_advance_selection_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers can select this seat product in advance during booking or check-in. False for seats assigned only at gate or by operational staff.

attributes.name: is_bassinet_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product supports bassinet attachment for infant passengers. Typically applies to bulkhead seats in long-haul configurations.

attributes.name: is_bulkhead
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product is located at a bulkhead position (wall or divider in front). Affects legroom, storage, and bassinet availability.

attributes.name: is_chargeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product incurs a charge for passengers. False for complimentary seat assignments included in fare bundles or elite status benefits.

attributes.name: is_exit_row
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat product is located in an emergency exit row. Triggers regulatory eligibility checks and safety briefing requirements per FAA/EASA regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seat product record was last updated. Tracks pricing changes, configuration updates, and status transitions.

attributes.name: merchandising_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking for display priority in seat selection interfaces and upsell offers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for merchandising presentation.

attributes.name: power_outlet_type
attributes.description: Type of power outlet available at this seat product for passenger device charging. Key amenity for merchandising premium seat products.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Revenue tier classification for this seat product. References pricing rules and fare class eligibility in revenue management systems.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the seat product in the ancillary catalog. Controls availability for merchandising and booking channels.

attributes.name: recline_inches
attributes.description: Maximum recline distance of the seat in inches. Null for non-reclining seats (e.g., exit row, bulkhead).

attributes.name: refundability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seat product purchase is refundable if the passenger cancels or changes their seat selection. Subject to fare rules and timing restrictions.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: Three-character IATA RFISC code identifying the ancillary service type for EMD issuance and settlement (e.g., '0B5' for preferred seat, '0B6' for extra legroom seat).

attributes.name: seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: Distance from one point on a seat to the same point on the seat in front or behind, measured in inches. Key comfort metric for merchandising and customer communication.

attributes.name: seat_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the seat product defining its physical and commercial characteristics. Drives merchandising strategy and revenue attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|preferred|extra_legroom|exit_row|bulkhead|bassinet|window|aisle|middle — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the seat measured in inches. Key comfort specification for merchandising and customer communication.

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: Two-letter IATA service type code for ancillary categorization and reporting (e.g., 'SA' for seat assignment, 'SB' for seat upgrade).

attributes.name: special_service_request_code
attributes.description: Four-letter IATA SSR code associated with this seat product for GDS and Passenger Service System (PSS) integration (e.g., 'EXST' for extra seat, 'BLND' for blind passenger). Null if no SSR applies.

attributes.name: transferability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seat product can be transferred to another passenger on the same Passenger Name Record (PNR) or flight. Typically false for personalized seat assignments.

attributes.name: wifi_access_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary Wi-Fi access is included with this seat product. False if Wi-Fi requires separate purchase or is not available.

attributes.name: zone_classification
attributes.description: Cabin zone or section identifier where this seat product is typically located (e.g., 'Forward Cabin', 'Mid Cabin', 'Aft Cabin', 'Zone A', 'Zone B'). Used for operational boarding and merchandising segmentation.

products.name: seat_assignment
products.description: Transactional record of a paid or complimentary seat assignment made for a passenger on a specific flight segment. Captures seat number, deck, cabin, seat product type, assignment method (self-select, agent-assigned, auto-assigned), assignment timestamp, associated ancillary order item reference, upgrade type if applicable, and current assignment status. Enables seat revenue tracking and operational manifest generation.
products.reference: IATA PADIS Seat Assignment / SSR SEAT

attributes.name: seat_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for seat_assignment

attributes.name: ancillary_emd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.ancillary_emd. Business justification: Paid seat assignments are documented via EMD. The seat_assignment table has emd_number (STRING) but no FK. Adding this FK links seat assignment transactions to EMD documentation for revenue accounting

attributes.name: ancillary_order_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ancillary order item if this seat assignment was purchased as a paid ancillary product. Null for complimentary or auto-assigned seats.

attributes.name: booking_passenger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.reservation_booking_passenger. Business justification: Seat assignments are per-passenger per-segment. attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.ffp_member. Business justification: Elite complimentary seat assignment: seat assignments for loyalty elite members are created without an ancillary_order (complimentary benefit). Direct FK enables tier-based seat benefit fulfillment, e

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: Seat assignments consume physical seat inventory on specific flights. Departure control and seat map management require linking assignments to flight inventory for real-time availability tracking. Ope

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to flight.flight_leg. Business justification: Cabin crew and gate agents require seat assignments mapped to the actual operating flight (not just reservation segment) for boarding, service delivery, and operational seat map management. Flight_leg

attributes.name: itinerary_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flight segment for which the seat is assigned.

attributes.name: mel_deferral_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.mel_deferral. Business justification: When a seat is deferred under MEL (seat inoperative), the seat_assignment record must reference the active mel_deferral to document why the seat is blocked. Aviation ops teams and auditors require thi

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual passenger for whom this seat is assigned.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the passenger name record under which this seat assignment was made.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: seat_map_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.seat_map. Business justification: Seat assignments must reference the physical seat record from the seat map to enable operational reporting on seat characteristics (exit rows, accessibility, bulkhead) and enforce assignment rules. Cr

attributes.name: seat_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.seat_product. Business justification: Seat assignments reference commercial seat product definitions (e.g., Extra Legroom, Preferred, Standard). The seat_assignment table has seat_product_type (STRING) but no FK. Adding this FK normalizes

attributes.name: ticket_coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.ticket_coupon. Business justification: Seat assignments are made against specific ticket coupons in airline departure control systems. This link is required for check-in processing, boarding pass generation, and post-flight revenue settlem

attributes.name: upgrade_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.upgrade_transaction. Business justification: seat_assignment records paid or complimentary seat assignments for passengers. When a cabin upgrade is processed via upgrade_transaction, a new seat assignment is created in the upgraded cabin. Linkin

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The method or channel through which the seat assignment was made, indicating whether it was passenger self-service, agent-assisted, or system auto-assigned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self_select|agent_assigned|auto_assigned|kiosk|mobile_app|web|gate — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: assignment_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or channel that originated the seat assignment transaction (PSS=Passenger Service System, DCS=Departure Control System, GDS=Global Distribution System). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pss|dcs|kiosk|mobile_app|web|gds|api — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the seat assignment indicating whether it is active, cancelled, or in transition.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the seat assignment was created or last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: block_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason why the seat is blocked if is_blocked is true. Examples include crew rest, broken seat, social distancing, etc.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: boarding_zone
attributes.description: The boarding zone or group assigned to this seat, used for boarding sequence management. May be numeric or alphabetic depending on airline policy.

attributes.name: cabin_class_code
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA cabin class code indicating the service class of the assigned seat (F=First, J=Business, W=Premium Economy, Y=Economy).

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this seat assignment was cancelled or released. Null if the assignment is still active. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for a seat assignment change if the seat was reassigned after initial assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: passenger_request|operational|equipment_change|overbooking|upgrade|downgrade|irop|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: check_in_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequence number assigned during check-in process, used for boarding pass generation and boarding order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this seat assignment record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: deck_level
attributes.description: The deck or level of the aircraft where the seat is located. Relevant for wide-body aircraft with multiple decks.

attributes.name: group_booking_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this seat assignment is part of a group booking, which may have special handling or pricing rules.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: infant_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an infant (lap child) is associated with this seat assignment, which may restrict certain seat types such as exit rows.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: is_blocked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the seat is blocked from assignment due to operational, safety, or commercial reasons.
attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: is_complimentary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the seat assignment was provided at no charge (true) or as a paid ancillary service (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this seat assignment record was last updated or modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_assignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Loyalty Tier at Assignment
attributes.description: The passenger's loyalty program tier status at the time of seat assignment, which may influence seat selection privileges and complimentary upgrades.

attributes.name: previous_seat_number
attributes.description: The seat number previously assigned to this passenger on this flight segment before a change was made. Null if this is the first assignment.

attributes.name: seat_characteristics
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of seat characteristics or attributes such as window, aisle, extra legroom, power outlet, restricted recline, etc.

attributes.name: seat_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount charged for the seat assignment if it was a paid ancillary product. Zero or null for complimentary assignments.

attributes.name: seat_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the seat assignment fee amount.

attributes.name: seat_number
attributes.description: The alphanumeric seat identifier consisting of row number and seat letter (e.g., 12A, 34F). Follows standard aircraft seat numbering convention.

attributes.name: special_service_request_code

attributes.references: IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual - SSR Codes

attributes.name: upgrade_type
attributes.description: Indicates the type of upgrade applied if the seat assignment represents an upgrade from the originally booked cabin or seat type. Null or none if no upgrade. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paid|complimentary|operational|elite_status|voucher|bid|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: baggage_allowance
products.description: Defines the baggage entitlement rules associated with a fare product, frequent flyer tier, or ancillary purchase — including number of pieces, weight limits (kg/lbs), size restrictions, and applicable route/cabin/PTC combinations. Supports both piece concept and weight concept allowance models per IATA Resolution 302. Used for entitlement validation at check-in and ancillary upsell logic.
products.reference: IATA Resolution 302 / Baggage Allowance

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_id
attributes.description: Primary key for baggage_allowance

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: Baggage allowances are defined per cabin class in fare construction rules (business 2 pieces, economy 1 piece). Fare rule application and ticketing require formal cabin class linkage. Fare constructio

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.category. Business justification: Baggage allowances should be classified by ancillary category (e.g., Baggage, Checked Bag, Carry-On). The baggage_allowance table has baggage_category (STRING) but no FK. Adding this FK normalizes the

attributes.name: interline_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.interline_agreement. Business justification: Baggage allowances under interline agreements are governed by specific interline agreement terms — IATA Resolution 302 requires carriers to honor partner baggage allowances per interline agreement. Th

attributes.name: tier_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier_status. Business justification: Elite baggage benefit assignment: baggage allowances are defined per loyalty tier (Platinum gets 3 free bags, Gold gets 2). This FK replaces the denormalized ffp_tier_code text field and enables autom

attributes.name: allowance_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the baggage allowance rule, used for reference in fare products and ancillary catalogs.

attributes.name: allowance_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the baggage allowance rule (e.g., 'Economy Standard 2PC', 'Business Premium 3PC 32KG').

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: The allowance model applied: piece_concept (number of bags), weight_concept (total weight limit), or hybrid (combination of both).

attributes.name: applicable_ptc
attributes.description: Passenger Type Code this allowance applies to (e.g., ADT=adult, CHD=child, INF=infant, MIL=military). Null if applies to all passenger types.

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the baggage allowance rule: active (in use), inactive (not in use), pending (scheduled for future), expired (past validity), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baggage allowance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the destination of travel. Null if not country-specific.

attributes.name: destination_region_code
attributes.description: IATA region or sub-region code for the destination (e.g., TC1=North America, TC2=Europe, TC3=Asia). Null if not region-specific.

attributes.name: dimension_limit_cm
attributes.description: Maximum dimensions allowed for each piece in centimeters, expressed as LxWxH (e.g., '158x90x75'). Null if no dimension restriction applies.

attributes.name: dimension_limit_inches
attributes.description: Maximum dimensions allowed for each piece in inches, expressed as LxWxH (e.g., '62x35x30'). Provided for markets using imperial units.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this baggage allowance rule becomes active and applicable to bookings.

attributes.name: emd_type
attributes.description: Type of EMD used to document this baggage allowance when purchased as ancillary: EMD-S (standalone) or EMD-A (associated with e-ticket).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this baggage allowance rule ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended rules.

attributes.name: fare_brand_code
attributes.description: Fare brand or product code associated with this allowance (e.g., BASIC, STANDARD, FLEX, PREMIUM). Null if not brand-specific.

attributes.name: is_combinable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allowance can be combined with other allowances (e.g., fare allowance + FFP tier allowance). True if combinable, false if exclusive.

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the baggage allowance (if purchased as ancillary) is refundable. True if refundable, false if non-refundable.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baggage allowance can be transferred to another passenger or booking. True if transferable, false if non-transferable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baggage allowance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: linear_dimension_limit_cm
attributes.description: Maximum sum of length, width, and height in centimeters (L+W+H). Common standard is 158 cm for international checked baggage.

attributes.name: linear_dimension_limit_inches
attributes.description: Maximum sum of length, width, and height in inches (L+W+H). Common standard is 62 inches for international checked baggage.

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline code of the marketing carrier for which this allowance applies. Null if applies to all carriers.

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline code of the operating carrier for which this allowance applies. Null if applies to all carriers.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the origin of travel. Null if not country-specific.

attributes.name: origin_region_code
attributes.description: IATA region or sub-region code for the origin (e.g., TC1=North America, TC2=Europe, TC3=Asia). Null if not region-specific.

attributes.name: piece_count
attributes.description: Number of baggage pieces allowed under this rule (applicable for piece concept allowances). Null if weight concept only.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple allowance rules apply to the same booking context. Lower number = higher priority.

attributes.name: rfisc_code
attributes.description: IATA RFISC code identifying the specific ancillary service type for baggage (e.g., 0CC1=first checked bag, 0CC2=second checked bag).

attributes.name: route_group_code
attributes.description: Route group or geographic zone code this allowance applies to (e.g., DOM=domestic, INTL=international, TRANSATLANTIC). Null if applies globally.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field describing any special conditions, restrictions, or notes applicable to this baggage allowance (e.g., 'Applies only to direct flights', 'Excludes codeshare partners').

attributes.name: weight_limit_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight allowed per piece or total weight limit in kilograms. Applicable for weight concept or per-piece weight restrictions.

attributes.name: weight_limit_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum weight allowed per piece or total weight limit in pounds. Provided for markets using imperial units.

Supports revenue-optimized upgrade merchandising programs.

attributes.name: fixed_price_amount
attributes.description: The fixed monetary price for instant upgrade offers. Null for bid-based or miles-based offers. Represents the non-negotiable purchase price.

attributes.name: inventory_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this upgrade offer is subject to real-time inventory availability checks in the target cabin. True means offer availability depends on seat inventory; false means offer is always available regardless of inventory.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this upgrade offer record. Audit field for change accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this upgrade offer record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: maximum_bid_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary bid amount allowed for bid-based upgrade offers. Null for non-bid offer types. Represents the ceiling price for competitive bidding.

attributes.name: miles_required
attributes.description: Number of Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles required to redeem this upgrade offer. Null for non-miles-based offers.

attributes.name: minimum_bid_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monetary bid amount required for bid-based upgrade offers. Null for non-bid offer types. Represents the floor price for competitive bidding.

attributes.name: offer_close_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure when this upgrade offer closes and is no longer available for purchase or bidding. Defines the closing of the offer window.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code identifying this upgrade offer in merchandising and revenue management systems.

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the upgrade offer including benefits, terms, and conditions presented to passengers during the offer flow.
attributes.references: DOT Consumer Protection Regulations 14 CFR Part 399

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Marketing name or title of the upgrade offer displayed to passengers in booking channels and merchandising platforms.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the upgrade offer. Active offers are available for purchase or bidding; inactive offers are not currently presented; expired offers have passed their validity window; suspended offers are temporarily paused; withdrawn offers have been permanently removed.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the upgrade offer mechanism. Bid upgrade allows passengers to submit competitive bids; instant upgrade is fixed-price immediate purchase; miles upgrade uses Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles; operational upgrade is airline-initiated for operational reasons; points upgrade uses loyalty points; voucher upgrade redeems a voucher or certificate.

attributes.name: offer_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled departure that this upgrade offer becomes available to eligible passengers. Defines the opening of the offer window.

attributes.name: points_required
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points required to redeem this upgrade offer. Null for non-points-based offers. Distinct from miles for coalition or partner loyalty programs.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this upgrade offer when multiple offers are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for offer sequencing and conflict resolution.

attributes.name: revenue_accounting_code
attributes.description: Internal accounting code used to classify and track revenue generated from this upgrade offer in financial reporting and revenue management systems.

attributes.name: target_cabin_class
attributes.description: The destination cabin class to which the passenger will be upgraded if the offer is accepted and confirmed.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Web URL linking to the full legal terms and conditions governing this upgrade offer. Required for consumer protection and transparency compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Consumer Protection Regulations 14 CFR Part 399

products.name: upgrade_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of a passenger cabin upgrade event, whether purchased, bid-won, miles-redeemed, or operationally assigned. Captures upgrade type, origin cabin, destination cabin, amount paid or miles consumed, bid submission and acceptance timestamps, flight segment, passenger reference, and upgrade status (pending, confirmed, waitlisted, cleared, denied). Enables upgrade revenue tracking and yield impact analysis.
products.reference: IATA NDC Upgrade Order

attributes.name: upgrade_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for upgrade_transaction

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Paid upgrade transactions (cash bids, miles+cash) create AR entries for collection tracking. Aviation finance requires AR linkage on upgrade transactions for payment reconciliation, dunning, and BSP s

attributes.name: checkin_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.checkin_session. Business justification: Operational upgrades are frequently processed at check-in counters. Linking upgrade_transaction to checkin_session enables upgrade audit trails tied to specific check-in events, supports IROPS upgrade

attributes.name: destination_fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Fare Class Bucket Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.e_ticket. Business justification: Paid or bid upgrades require ticket reissuance or EMD generation tied to a specific e-ticket. Revenue accounting and audit trails for upgrade transactions must reference the resulting/associated e-tic

attributes.name: ffp_member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program member account used for miles redemption or status-based upgrade eligibility.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id

attributes.name: inventory_leg_id

attributes.name: itinerary_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.itinerary_segment. Business justification: Associates upgrade transactions with flight segments for segment-specific upgrade tracking, inventory control, and operational reporting. Required for per-segment upgrade management.

attributes.name: pax_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the passenger who received or purchased the upgrade.

attributes.name: pnr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.pnr. Business justification: Associates upgrade transactions with booking for upgrade revenue tracking, bid management, and passenger service history. Essential for upgrade program reporting and revenue optimization.

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled flight on which the upgrade was applied.

attributes.name: upgrade_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.upgrade_offer. Business justification: Upgrade transactions are based on specific upgrade offers (e.g., bid upgrade, mileage upgrade, paid upgrade). No FK currently exists. Adding this FK links transactions to their originating offer defin

attributes.name: bid_acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade bid was accepted and confirmed by the system. Null for non-bid or unsuccessful bid upgrades.

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: Amount bid by the passenger in an upgrade auction or bid program. Null for non-bid upgrades.

attributes.name: bid_submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the passenger submitted the upgrade bid. Null for non-bid upgrades.

attributes.name: booking_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the upgrade transaction was initiated: web (airline website), mobile_app (airline mobile application), call_center (phone reservation), airport_kiosk (self-service kiosk), gds (Global Distribution System), travel_agent (third-party agent), partner (codeshare or alliance partner). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|call_center|airport_kiosk|gds|travel_agent|partner — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the upgrade transaction amount.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why the upgrade was denied: insufficient_inventory (no seats available), low_priority (other passengers cleared first), payment_failed (transaction declined), ineligible_fare (fare class not eligible), system_error (technical issue), expired (offer expired), cancelled_by_pax (passenger cancelled). Null if upgrade not denied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_inventory|low_priority|payment_failed|ineligible_fare|system_error|expired|cancelled_by_pax — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: destination_cabin_class
attributes.description: The target cabin class to which the passenger is upgrading (economy, premium_economy, business, first).

attributes.name: destination_fare_class
attributes.description: Single-letter fare class code assigned after the upgrade is confirmed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade transaction record was last updated, reflecting status changes or data corrections.

attributes.name: miles_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of frequent flyer miles consumed for the upgrade. Zero for non-mileage upgrades.

attributes.name: origin_cabin_class
attributes.description: The original cabin class from which the passenger is upgrading (economy, premium_economy, business, first).

attributes.name: origin_fare_class
attributes.description: Single-letter fare class code of the original booking, determining upgrade eligibility and priority.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used for the upgrade transaction: credit_card, debit_card, miles (FFP miles), voucher (upgrade certificate), cash, bank_transfer, none (complimentary or operational). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|miles|voucher|cash|bank_transfer|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_score
attributes.description: Calculated priority score determining upgrade clearance order, based on fare class, elite status, bid amount, and other factors.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the passenger if the upgrade was cancelled or denied after payment, in the transaction currency. Zero if no refund issued.

attributes.name: refund_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed and returned to the passenger. Null if no refund issued.

attributes.name: seat_number_destination
attributes.description: New seat assignment after the upgrade is cleared (e.g., 2A, 8D).

attributes.name: seat_number_origin
attributes.description: Original seat assignment before the upgrade (e.g., 23A, 45F).

attributes.name: upgrade_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount paid by the passenger for the upgrade, in the transaction currency. Zero for non-purchased upgrades (miles, operational, complimentary).

attributes.name: upgrade_cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade was fully processed, seat assigned, and boarding pass updated.

attributes.name: upgrade_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade was confirmed and guaranteed to the passenger.

attributes.name: upgrade_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the upgrade transaction was initiated or requested by the passenger or system.

attributes.name: upgrade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the upgrade transaction: pending (submitted awaiting processing), confirmed (upgrade guaranteed), waitlisted (on standby list), cleared (upgrade processed and seat assigned), denied (upgrade request rejected), cancelled (customer or system cancelled), expired (upgrade offer or bid expired). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|waitlisted|cleared|denied|cancelled|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upgrade_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique transaction number for the upgrade event, used for customer service reference and audit tracking.

attributes.name: upgrade_type
attributes.description: Classification of the upgrade method: purchased (paid cash upgrade), bid_won (successful upgrade bid), miles_redeemed (FFP miles used), operational (involuntary operational upgrade), complimentary (airline-initiated goodwill), status_based (elite status automatic upgrade), voucher (upgrade certificate or voucher applied). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchased|bid_won|miles_redeemed|operational|complimentary|status_based|voucher — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: voucher_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code of the upgrade voucher or certificate applied to this transaction. Null if no voucher used.

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Passenger's position on the upgrade waitlist at the time of transaction creation. Null if not waitlisted.

products.name: eligibility_rule
products.description: Business rules defining which passengers, fare classes, routes, cabin types, booking windows, and FFP tiers are eligible to purchase specific ancillary products. Captures rule type (fare-class restriction, route restriction, tier-based entitlement, advance-purchase window, passenger-type restriction), effective date range, priority order, and override flags. Drives real-time ancillary offer eligibility checks across all sales channels.
products.reference: ATPCO Optional Services Eligibility / IATA NDC Offer Eligibility

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for eligibility_rule

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ancillary.ancillary_category. While eligibility_rule already links to product_catalog for

attributes.name: mel_item_id

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ancillary product or service to which this eligibility rule applies.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Eligibility rules restrict ancillary availability by specific routes (e.g., premium seats only on long-haul, lounge access on international). Real business process: merchandising rules engine evaluate

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Ancillary product eligibility rules are configured per IATA schedule season — winter season rules differ from summer (e.g., ski equipment, seasonal fare class eligibility). Revenue management reviews

attributes.name: aircraft_type_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA aircraft type codes (e.g., 737, 777, A320) for which this ancillary product is eligible. Empty indicates no aircraft restriction.

attributes.name: booking_date_from
attributes.description: Start date of the booking window during which this eligibility rule is active. Null indicates no booking start date restriction.

attributes.name: booking_date_to
attributes.description: End date of the booking window during which this eligibility rule is active. Null indicates no booking end date restriction.

attributes.name: cabin_class_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cabin classes (First, Business, Premium Economy, Economy) eligible for this ancillary product. Empty indicates no cabin restriction.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this eligibility rule record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: destination_airport_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA airport codes representing eligible destination points. Empty indicates no destination restriction.

attributes.name: destination_country_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes representing eligible destination countries. Empty indicates no destination country restriction.

attributes.name: exclusion_rule_flag

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this eligibility rule is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended rule.

attributes.name: fare_class_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of booking class codes (RBD - Revenue Booking Designator) to which this rule applies. Empty indicates no fare class restriction.

attributes.name: ffp_tier_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty program tier codes (e.g., Gold, Platinum, Diamond) eligible for this ancillary product. Empty indicates no tier restriction.

attributes.name: is_combinable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eligibility rule can be combined with other rules (true) or must be evaluated independently (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA airline codes representing marketing carriers for which this rule applies. Empty indicates all carriers.

attributes.name: maximum_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days before departure that the ancillary product may be purchased. Null indicates no maximum advance purchase restriction.
