attributes.name: operating_carrier_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA airline codes representing operating carriers for which this rule applies. Empty indicates all carriers.

attributes.name: origin_airport_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA airport codes representing eligible origin points. Empty indicates no origin restriction.

attributes.name: origin_country_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes representing eligible origin countries. Empty indicates no origin country restriction.

attributes.name: override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized agents or systems may override this eligibility rule under exceptional circumstances.

attributes.name: passenger_type_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA passenger type codes (ADT, CHD, INF, MIL, SRC, etc.) eligible for this ancillary product. Empty indicates no passenger type restriction.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for rule evaluation when multiple rules apply to the same ancillary product. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code identifying this eligibility rule for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the eligibility rule, including rationale, business context, and any special conditions or exceptions.

attributes.name: rule_logic_expression
attributes.description: Complex logical expression or formula defining advanced eligibility conditions beyond standard attribute filters. Used for multi-condition rules requiring AND/OR/NOT logic.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the purpose and scope of this eligibility rule.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility rule indicating whether it is actively enforced in sales channels.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the eligibility rule defining the primary dimension of restriction or entitlement (fare class, route, FFP tier, booking window, passenger type, or cabin).

attributes.name: sales_channel_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels (web, mobile, GDS, call_center, airport, agency) through which this ancillary product may be purchased. Empty indicates all channels.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Web address linking to the full terms and conditions document governing this eligibility rule for customer transparency and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: travel_date_from
attributes.description: Start date of the travel period during which this eligibility rule applies. Null indicates no start date restriction.

attributes.name: travel_date_to
attributes.description: End date of the travel period during which this eligibility rule applies. Null indicates no end date restriction.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Flight inventory and seat capacity availability management — the airline's sellable stock. Owns fare class buckets, seat availability by cabin, overbooking controls, codeshare inventory allocations, and real-time availability snapshots consumed by GDS and direct channels. Directly feeds revenue management yield optimization. Aligns with Amadeus Altéa Inventory.

products.name: flight_inventory
products.description: Core master entity representing the sellable seat inventory for a specific flight-date combination. Owns the authoritative record of total capacity, cabin breakdown, fare class bucket configuration, and overall availability status for each flight leg in the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system. This is the primary inventory control record consumed by GDS, direct channels, and revenue management yield optimization.
products.reference: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Record

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the flight inventory record representing the sellable seat inventory for a specific flight-date combination in the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system.

attributes.name: aircraft_id

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: When equipment changes occur (equipment_change_indicator on flight_inventory), the inventory system must reference the active cabin configuration to recompute class capacities (business_class_capacity

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Flight operations are cost centers in airline accounting. CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) calculations require linking flight inventory to cost centers for profitability analysis and manageme

attributes.name: fleet_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_fleet_assignment. Business justification: Fleet assignment determines aircraft type, seat configuration, and cabin class capacity that inventory must control. Revenue management bucket authorization, overbooking limits, and codeshare allocati

attributes.name: flight_number_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.flight_number. Business justification: Flight inventory controls real-time seat availability for specific flight numbers defined in route planning. Revenue management, codeshare allocation, and GDS distribution all require linking daily in

attributes.name: origin_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.station. Business justification: Flight inventory capacity records must link to origin station for slot-coordinated market compliance reporting, station-level load factor dashboards, and hub capacity planning. Aviation revenue manage

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: FK to route.route.route_id — Flight inventory must reference the route for network-level availability queries, codeshare allocation management, and seasonal capacity planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled flight leg for which this inventory record is maintained. Links to the flight master entity in the flight operations domain.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: seasonal_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.seasonal_schedule. Business justification: Flight inventory operationalizes a specific seasonal schedule template. Linking inventory to seasonal_schedule enables variance analysis (planned vs actual capacity), schedule change impact assessment

attributes.name: altea_inventory_key
attributes.description: Native primary key or reference identifier assigned by the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system to this flight inventory record. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational PSS.

attributes.name: authorized_capacity
attributes.description: Revenue management-approved seat count authorized for sale on this flight-date, which may differ from total physical capacity due to operational holds, crew seat requirements, or regulatory restrictions. This is the effective inventory ceiling used by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent real-time availability snapshot broadcast to GDS and direct booking channels. Reflects the point-in-time at which seats_available and fare class bucket statuses were last synchronized with Amadeus Altéa.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787; IATA NDC Standard

attributes.name: booking_curve_day
attributes.description: Number of days prior to departure at which this inventory snapshot was captured, representing the position on the booking curve (e.g., 90, 60, 30, 14, 7, 1). Used by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management for demand forecasting and fare class optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: business_class_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the Business Class cabin on this flight-date. Reflects the aircraft configuration and any cabin reconfiguration applied for this specific flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: channel_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any channel-specific sales restrictions applied to this flight inventory (e.g., 'DIRECT_ONLY' for web/app exclusive fares, 'GDS_BLOCKED' for GDS channel closure, 'NDC_ONLY' for IATA NDC channel exclusivity). Controls distribution channel access to inventory.
attributes.references: IATA NDC (New Distribution Capability) Standard; IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this flight inventory record includes codeshare seat allocations from partner airlines. When true, a portion of the authorized capacity is reserved for codeshare partner bookings under interline ticketing agreements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 (Codeshare); Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: codeshare_seats_allocated
attributes.description: Number of seats within the authorized capacity ring-fenced for codeshare partner airline bookings on this flight-date. Managed under bilateral codeshare agreements and tracked separately from own-metal inventory for revenue accounting and BSP settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 (Codeshare); IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan); Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight inventory record was first created in the Amadeus Altéa Inventory system, typically at the time of schedule publication or inventory initialization for the flight-date.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled local departure date of the flight leg at the origin station. Together with flight_number, forms the primary business key for inventory lookup by GDS and booking channels.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the arrival station of this flight leg (e.g., LAX, CDG). Used to identify the inventory leg destination in route network and GDS availability queries.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: economy_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the Economy Class cabin on this flight-date. Typically the largest cabin and primary driver of load factor and revenue management decisions.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: equipment_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the aircraft type assigned to this flight-date has been changed from the originally scheduled equipment. Equipment changes may alter cabin configuration, total capacity, and fare class bucket allocations requiring inventory rebalancing.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_config
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the active fare class bucket (booking class) configuration for this flight-date, listing each IATA booking class code and its authorized seat allocation (e.g., 'Y:20,B:15,M:10,Q:5'). Managed by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management and consumed by Amadeus Altéa for availability control.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: first_class_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the First Class cabin on this flight-date. Reflects the aircraft configuration and any cabin reconfiguration applied for this specific flight.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: IATA-format airline designator and numeric flight number (e.g., AA101) identifying the marketed flight for which inventory is being managed. Used by GDS and direct channels to query availability.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; IATA Airline Designator Standard

attributes.name: gds_availability_code
attributes.description: Single-letter availability status code broadcast to Global Distribution Systems (GDS) representing the highest open booking class on this flight-date (e.g., 'Y' for full availability, 'L' for restricted availability). Conforms to IATA availability message standards.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; IATA PADIS (Passenger and Airport Data Interchange Standards); GDS Availability Standards

attributes.name: group_seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats currently held under group booking reservations (typically 10+ passengers under a single PNR group) on this flight-date. Group holds reduce available inventory for individual bookings and are subject to group ticketing deadlines.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: interline_seats_allocated
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated for interline ticketing partner bookings on this flight-date under IATA interline agreements. Distinct from codeshare allocations and tracked for ARC/BSP proration and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 780 (Interline); IATA ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation); Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: inventory_control_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory management for this flight-date is operating under MANUAL (revenue analyst override), AUTOMATED (Sabre AirVision algorithmic control), or HYBRID (automated with manual overrides) mode. Affects how fare class bucket changes are applied.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flight inventory record in Amadeus Altéa. OPEN indicates seats are available for sale; CLOSED indicates no further sales permitted; WAITLIST indicates demand exceeds supply and waitlist is active; SUSPENDED indicates temporary hold on sales; CANCELLED indicates the flight has been cancelled and inventory is frozen.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: last_seat_availability_date
attributes.description: Date on which the last available seat on this flight-date was sold or the inventory was closed. Used for post-departure revenue analysis and booking curve benchmarking.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this flight inventory record, including any changes to seat counts, fare class buckets, overbooking parameters, or inventory status. Critical for real-time availability synchronization with GDS.

attributes.name: load_factor_pct
attributes.description: Current load factor expressed as a percentage, calculated as seats_sold divided by authorized_capacity multiplied by 100. A key revenue management KPI representing the proportion of available seat capacity that has been sold. Used by Sabre AirVision for yield optimization decisions.
attributes.references: IATA WATS (World Air Transport Statistics); Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: operational_seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats withheld from sale for operational purposes including deadhead crew positioning, airline staff travel, and aircraft ferry requirements. These seats are excluded from the sellable inventory pool.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; AIMS Crew Management System

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: Revenue management-approved overbooking multiplier expressed as a percentage above physical capacity (e.g., 105.00 means 5% overbooking allowed). Set by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management based on historical no-show and cancellation rates to maximize load factor while managing denied boarding risk.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 (Oversales); IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: Absolute maximum number of bookings permitted on this flight-date including the overbooking allowance. Computed from authorized_capacity multiplied by overbooking_factor and used as the hard ceiling in the Amadeus Altéa booking engine.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250; Amadeus Altéa Inventory System

attributes.name: premium_economy_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats allocated to the Premium Economy cabin on this flight-date. Nullable for aircraft configurations that do not include a Premium Economy cabin.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: revenue_management_class
attributes.description: Revenue management classification assigned by Sabre AirVision to this flight-date based on demand forecast, booking curve position, and competitive pricing environment. Drives automated fare class bucket opening and closing decisions for yield optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA RASK/CASK Framework

attributes.name: schedule_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this flight-date has undergone a schedule change (time, equipment, or routing modification) since the original inventory record was created. Schedule changes may trigger IROP (Irregular Operations) rebooking workflows and inventory reallocation.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; DOT 14 CFR Part 259 (IROP); IATA Resolution 735

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: Current number of seats available for sale across all cabins on this flight-date, calculated as authorized_capacity minus seats_sold minus overbooking_buffer. This is the real-time availability figure broadcast to GDS and direct booking channels.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: seats_sold
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed seat bookings (Pax) across all cabins and fare classes on this flight-date. Updated in real-time as reservations are created, modified, or cancelled in the Amadeus Altéa Reservation system.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: total_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of physical seats available on the aircraft for this flight-date combination across all cabins. Derived from the aircraft configuration assigned to the flight and represents the maximum sellable inventory ceiling.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: Current number of passengers on the waitlist for this flight-date when inventory_status is WAITLIST or when specific fare classes are closed. Waitlisted passengers are cleared in priority order as cancellations occur.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory System; IATA Resolution 787

products.name: cabin_class
products.description: Reference master defining the physical and commercial cabin classes operated by the airline (e.g., First, Business, Premium Economy, Economy). Captures IATA cabin designator codes, seat configuration standards, service level definitions, and applicable aircraft type associations. Used as the classification backbone for inventory segmentation and revenue management.
products.reference: IATA Cabin Class Designator Standard

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cabin class record within the airline's inventory system. Primary key for this reference master entity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Cabin Class Master

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each cabin class has distinct cost structures (service, catering, crew ratios). Airlines track cabin-level profitability by allocating costs to cabin class cost centers for yield management and produc

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Airlines maintain separate GL revenue accounts by cabin class (first, business, premium economy, economy) for P&L reporting and RASK analysis. Revenue accounting systems post cabin-level revenue to di

attributes.name: applicable_flight_range
attributes.description: Flight range category for which this cabin class configuration is applicable: 'short_haul' (under 3 hours), 'medium_haul' (3–6 hours), 'long_haul' (6–12 hours), 'ultra_long_haul' (over 12 hours), or 'all'. Drives route-specific product deployment and inventory segmentation.
attributes.references: IATA Network Planning Standards; Jeppesen Flight Planning System

attributes.name: baggage_allowance_kg
attributes.description: Standard checked baggage allowance in kilograms included with the base fare for this cabin class. Drives ancillary revenue calculations, passenger service standards, and GDS fare display. Governed by IATA Resolution 302 weight concept.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 — Baggage Allowance; DOT Baggage Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: baggage_pieces_allowed
attributes.description: Number of checked baggage pieces included in the standard allowance for this cabin class under the piece concept. Applicable for routes governed by IATA piece concept (primarily transatlantic and transpacific). Complements baggage_allowance_kg for weight-concept routes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302 — Baggage Piece Concept; DOT Baggage Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: cabin_class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cabin class record. 'active' indicates the cabin is currently offered and sellable; 'inactive' indicates temporarily suspended; 'retired' indicates permanently discontinued; 'pending' indicates configured but not yet activated for sale.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Cabin Class Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: cabin_code
attributes.description: Airline-internal alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cabin class within the carrier's Passenger Service System (PSS). Used in Amadeus Altéa Inventory for cabin-level availability and inventory management. May differ from the IATA designator when the airline operates sub-cabin variants.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Cabin Configuration; IATA SSIM Chapter 2

attributes.name: cabin_name
attributes.description: Commercial marketing name of the cabin class as presented to passengers and travel agents (e.g., 'First Class', 'Business Class', 'Premium Economy', 'Economy'). Used in passenger-facing communications, booking flows, and GDS displays.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728; Amadeus Altéa PSS — Cabin Display Configuration

attributes.name: cabin_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the cabin into one of the four IATA-recognized commercial cabin tiers: first, business, premium_economy, or economy. Drives revenue management segmentation, yield optimization in Sabre AirVision, and inventory bucket hierarchy.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Hierarchy; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: carry_on_allowance_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight in kilograms permitted for carry-on baggage in the cabin for this cabin class. Used in ground handling operations, security screening coordination with TSA/EASA, and passenger service standards.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 302; TSA Carry-On Baggage Standards; EASA Cabin Safety Requirements

attributes.name: codeshare_sellable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cabin class can be sold on codeshare flights operated by partner airlines. When true, inventory allocations for this cabin are made available to codeshare partners through interline agreements. Drives GDS availability display for codeshare itineraries.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare Agreements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Codeshare Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cabin class record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management — Record Control; ICAO Annex 6 Record Keeping

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cabin class definition is retired and no longer available for new bookings. Null for currently active cabin classes. Supports historical inventory analysis and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM; DOT Record Retention Requirements; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cabin class definition becomes commercially active and available for sale. Used for seasonal product changes, new aircraft type introductions, and cabin reconfiguration projects. Aligns with IATA Season scheduling conventions.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM — Schedule Season Dates; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Effective Date Management

attributes.name: fare_basis_prefix
attributes.description: Standard alphabetic prefix used in fare basis codes for this cabin class (e.g., 'Y' for Economy, 'C' for Business, 'F' for First). Aligns fare construction with IATA fare basis code conventions and drives revenue management fare class bucket assignment in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Fare Basis Codes; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: ffp_accrual_multiplier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) Mileage Accrual Multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base miles flown to calculate Frequent Flyer Program (FFP) miles or points accrued for travel in this cabin class. For example, a value of 2.0 means passengers earn double miles. Feeds Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP accrual engine.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787 — Frequent Flyer Programs; Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Configuration

attributes.name: gds_display_code
attributes.description: Code used to represent this cabin class in Global Distribution System (GDS) availability displays (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). May differ from the internal cabin_code for legacy GDS compatibility. Ensures correct cabin identification in travel agent booking workflows.
attributes.references: IATA PADIS Standards; Amadeus GDS Interface Specifications; Sabre Interface Standards

attributes.name: iata_cabin_designator
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Cabin Designator Code
attributes.description: Single-letter IATA standard cabin designator code identifying the commercial cabin class (e.g., F = First, C = Business, W = Premium Economy, Y = Economy). Used as the industry-standard booking class grouping code across Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and interline agreements.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 728 — Cabin Class Designators; IATA Passenger Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: ife_type
attributes.description: Type of In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) system available in this cabin class: 'seatback_screen' = personal seatback display, 'overhead_screen' = shared overhead monitors, 'personal_device' = bring-your-own-device streaming, 'none' = no IFE. Used in product definition and passenger experience standards.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; FAA Advisory Circular AC 25.1309

attributes.name: is_lie_flat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seats in this cabin class convert to a fully flat sleeping surface (180-degree recline). True for premium long-haul First and Business class products. Critical for product differentiation, revenue management premium pricing, and GDS display.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Cabin Product Attributes

attributes.name: lounge_access_entitlement
attributes.description: Level of airport lounge access included with this cabin class: 'none' = no lounge access, 'home_carrier' = access to the airline's own lounges only, 'partner' = access to partner airline lounges, 'all_alliance' = full alliance lounge network access. Drives ground handling instructions and passenger service delivery.
attributes.references: IATA Interline Agreements; Amadeus Altéa PSS — Service Entitlement Configuration

attributes.name: max_overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage above physical seat capacity that bookings may be accepted for this cabin class under the airline's overbooking policy. For example, 10.00 means up to 110% of seats may be sold. Null when overbooking_allowed is false. Governed by DOT regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Oversales; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Overbooking Controls

attributes.name: meal_service_type
attributes.description: Standard meal service type provided in this cabin class: 'full_meal' = multi-course meal service, 'light_meal' = single-course meal, 'snack' = snack and beverage only, 'buy_on_board' = no complimentary meal, 'none' = no food service. Drives catering uplift planning and galley configuration.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM) — Catering

attributes.name: overbooking_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether overbooking is permitted for this cabin class. When true, the inventory system may accept bookings beyond physical seat capacity based on no-show forecasting models. Governed by DOT overbooking regulations and airline revenue management policy.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Oversales; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Overbooking Controls

attributes.name: power_outlet_type
attributes.description: Type of in-seat power outlet available in this cabin class: 'ac_110v', 'ac_220v', 'usb_a', 'usb_c', or 'none'. Used in product specification, passenger communication, and aircraft configuration management in AMOS.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; FAA Advisory Circular AC 25.1353

attributes.name: priority_boarding
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers in this cabin class receive priority boarding privileges ahead of general boarding groups. Drives boarding sequence configuration in SITA Airport Management Platform and ground handling SOPs.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM); SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: priority_check_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers in this cabin class are entitled to dedicated priority check-in counters or lanes. Drives airport operations configuration in SITA Airport Management Platform and ground handling service level agreements.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Handling Manual (AHM); SITA Airport Management Platform

attributes.name: revenue_class_hierarchy
attributes.description: Numeric rank defining the commercial hierarchy of this cabin class relative to others (1 = highest/First, 4 = lowest/Economy). Used by Sabre AirVision Revenue Management for yield optimization, upgrade logic, and inventory nesting rules. Lower number = higher revenue class.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Cabin Hierarchy; IATA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: seat_configuration_code
attributes.description: Standard seat layout configuration code for this cabin class expressed as a row-abreast pattern (e.g., '2-2-2' for Business, '3-3-3' for Economy). Reflects the physical seat arrangement across the aircraft cross-section. Sourced from aircraft type configuration in AMOS.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM Annex B — Aircraft Seat Configuration; AMOS Aircraft Configuration

attributes.name: seat_pitch_inches
attributes.description: Distance in inches between a point on one seat and the same point on the seat directly in front, representing legroom standard for this cabin class. Key product differentiation metric used in marketing, regulatory DOT reporting, and passenger experience benchmarking.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular AC 25.785; DOT Consumer Reporting Requirements; IATA Cabin Product Standards

attributes.name: seat_recline_inches
attributes.description: Maximum recline distance in inches for seats in this cabin class. Distinguishes flat-bed (Business/First) from recliner (Premium Economy) and standard recline (Economy) product tiers. Used in product definition and passenger experience standards.

attributes.name: seat_width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the seat in inches for this cabin class, measured at the widest point of the seat cushion. Used in product specification, passenger comfort benchmarking, and marketing collateral.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; FAA Advisory Circular AC 25.785

attributes.name: service_level_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the service standards, amenities, and passenger experience associated with this cabin class. Includes details such as meal service type, lounge access entitlement, priority boarding, and onboard entertainment offerings. Used for product definition and customer communication.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS — Service Definition

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this cabin class definition originates (e.g., 'ALTEA_INV' for Amadeus Altéa Inventory, 'SABRE_RM' for Sabre AirVision). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; ISO 9001 Data Governance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cabin class record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with downstream systems (GDS, Revenue Management), and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management — Record Control; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Change Management

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether passengers booked in this cabin class are eligible to receive complimentary or paid upgrades to a higher cabin class. Drives upgrade logic in Amadeus Altéa Inventory and Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP upgrade award processing.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Rules; Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP Management

attributes.name: wifi_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-flight Wi-Fi connectivity is available in this cabin class. Drives ancillary service offerings, passenger communication, and product marketing. Complements IFE type for digital connectivity product definition.
attributes.references: IATA Cabin Product Standards; FCC Airborne Mobile Services Regulations

products.name: fare_class_bucket
products.description: Master entity defining individual booking class (RBD — Reservation Booking Designator) buckets within a cabin for a flight inventory record. Captures the single-letter IATA booking class code (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V), the hierarchical nesting within the cabin, authorized capacity (AU), booking limit (BL), overbooking factor, and current availability status. The atomic unit of inventory control in Altéa Inventory and the direct input to Sabre AirVision yield optimization.
products.reference: IATA RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) — Altéa Inventory Booking Class

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fare class bucket record in the Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — RBD Bucket Entity

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: fare_class_bucket defines RBD buckets within a cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK establishes the cabin hierarchy for fare class buckets. cabin_code is red

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.fare. Business justification: Each fare class bucket controls availability for specific filed fares at that RBD level. fare_class_bucket has fare_basis_code (plain) but no fare_id FK. RM yield analysis and revenue dilution reporti

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Airline revenue accounting (IFRS 15) requires each fare class bucket to map to a specific GL revenue account for deferred/recognized revenue posting. Revenue management and finance reconciliation repo

attributes.name: inventory_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight inventory leg record to which this fare class bucket belongs. Links the bucket to a specific flight-date-leg combination managed in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Leg

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: RM analysts configure fare class buckets at the route level; competitive intensity and profitability tier on the route drive bucket nesting and protection levels. Aviation RM systems require route-lev

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Fare class bucket configurations are season-specific; RM systems open new bucket sets each IATA season. Season-level bucket reporting and historical yield analysis require this FK to identify which se

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before departure that a ticket must be purchased to qualify for fares in this booking class (e.g., 7, 14, 21). A value of 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement. Governs ticketing time limit enforcement in Altéa.

attributes.name: allotment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory allocation type for this bucket: own (operating carrier direct sale), codeshare (partner airline marketing), interline (interline ticketing agreement), group (group booking block), charter (charter operator block), blocked (operationally blocked seats). Drives revenue accounting and settlement routing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Allotment Management

attributes.name: authorized_units
attributes.description: Authorized capacity (AU) — the maximum number of seats the revenue management system has authorized for sale in this booking class bucket for the flight leg. Set by Sabre AirVision yield optimization and loaded into Altéa Inventory. Core inventory control parameter.
attributes.references: IATA Revenue Management Guidelines — Authorized Units (AU)

attributes.name: availability_code
attributes.description: IATA standard availability status code transmitted to GDS systems (e.g., A = available, L = waitlist, R = request, C = closed). Distinct from bucket_status in that this is the externally-broadcast GDS code per IATA PADIS standards, while bucket_status is the internal operational state.
attributes.references: IATA PADIS — Passenger and Airport Data Interchange Standards

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the current availability figures (seats_available, current_bookings, load_factor_pct) were captured from Altéa Inventory. Critical for GDS cache freshness validation and real-time availability SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Snapshot; IATA NDC Standard

attributes.name: booking_limit
attributes.description: Booking limit (BL) — the maximum cumulative number of bookings permitted across this bucket and all lower-yield buckets nested beneath it. Enforced in real time by Altéa Inventory to prevent overselling beyond the authorized level.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Limit Control

attributes.name: bucket_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this RBD bucket within its cabin hierarchy, from highest-yield (rank 1) to lowest-yield. Used by Sabre AirVision and Altéa Inventory to determine availability cascade — a lower-ranked (higher-yield) bucket must be open before a higher-ranked (lower-yield) bucket can sell.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Bucket Nesting / IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: bucket_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of the fare class bucket as broadcast to GDS and direct channels: open (seats available for sale), closed (no availability — bucket is shut by RM or capacity), waitlist (no confirmed seats but waitlist accepted), request_only (requires manual approval), suspended (temporarily removed from sale by operations).
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Status / IATA ATA Spec 2000

attributes.name: change_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty charged to the passenger for a voluntary itinerary change on a ticket issued under this booking class, expressed in the filing currency. A value of 0.00 indicates no change fee. Commercially sensitive pricing parameter.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 31 — Voluntary Changes; IATA Resolution 024

attributes.name: change_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the change fee amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency fare filing and BSP/ARC settlement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IATA BSP Settlement

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare class bucket is allocated for codeshare inventory (True) — i.e., seats sold under a partner airline's flight number — or is for the operating carrier's own inventory (False). Governs interline proration and codeshare revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Codeshare Allocation

attributes.name: codeshare_partner_code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter airline designator of the codeshare marketing partner for whom this bucket allocation is reserved (e.g., LH, BA, AA). Null for own-carrier inventory. Used for interline settlement and codeshare capacity reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; IATA Airline Designator Registry

attributes.name: current_bookings
attributes.description: Number of confirmed bookings currently held against this fare class bucket. Updated in near-real-time from Altéa Inventory as PNRs are created, modified, or cancelled. Used to compute remaining availability.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this fare class bucket configuration becomes active for sale. Used for seasonal inventory planning and schedule-period bucket management in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Inventory Period Management; IATA SSIM

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this fare class bucket configuration is no longer active. Null indicates the bucket remains open-ended until explicitly closed. Supports seasonal and schedule-period inventory lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Inventory Period Management; IATA SSIM

attributes.name: fare_basis_code
attributes.description: IATA fare basis code associated with the primary fare filed under this booking class bucket (e.g., YOWUS, BAPUS21). Links the inventory bucket to the fare tariff filed with ATPCO. Used for ticketing, interline proration, and BSP/ARC settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 024 — Fare Basis Code; ATPCO Fare Filing Standards

attributes.name: fare_family_code
attributes.description: Branded fare family or product bundle code associated with this booking class (e.g., BASIC, STANDARD, FLEX, BUSINESS_PLUS). Aligns the RBD bucket with the airline's branded fare product hierarchy for ancillary bundling and NDC offer construction.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard — Offer and Order Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: group_block_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats within this bucket reserved as a group block allocation. A value of 0 indicates no group block. Group blocks are managed separately from individual seat availability and are subject to group contract terms.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Inventory Management; IATA Group Travel Guidelines

attributes.name: is_changeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the itinerary booked under this fare class may be voluntarily changed (True) or is a fixed non-changeable ticket (False). Relevant for IROP handling, voluntary rebooking, and ancillary change-fee revenue.
attributes.references: ATPCO Category 31 — Voluntary Changes; DOT 14 CFR Part 259

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets issued under this booking class are eligible for a full or partial refund (True) or are non-refundable (False). Drives customer service handling, involuntary rerouting compensation, and DOT consumer protection compliance.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 259 — Consumer Protections; ATPCO Category 33 — Voluntary Refunds

attributes.name: last_rm_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent authorized unit or booking limit update pushed from Sabre AirVision to Altéa Inventory. Enables audit of RM optimization cycle frequency and latency monitoring between the two systems.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Optimization Cycle; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: load_factor_pct
attributes.description: Current load factor for this fare class bucket expressed as a percentage (current_bookings / authorized_units × 100). Stored as a snapshot field for real-time RM monitoring and GDS availability optimization. Aligns with IATA load factor (percentage of seats filled) definition.
attributes.references: IATA Standard Schedules Information Manual — Load Factor Definition

attributes.name: max_stay_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the passenger may remain at the destination before return travel must commence for fares in this booking class. A null value indicates no maximum stay restriction. Standard fare restriction filed with ATPCO.

attributes.name: min_stay_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days the passenger must remain at the destination before return travel is permitted for fares in this booking class. A value of 0 indicates no minimum stay restriction. Standard fare restriction filed with ATPCO.

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: Fractional multiplier applied to physical seat capacity to derive the authorized overbooking level for this bucket (e.g., 1.0500 = 5% overbooking). Set by revenue management based on historical no-show and cancellation rates. Commercially sensitive — drives denied boarding exposure. Governed by DOT 14 CFR Part 250.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — Oversales; Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Overbooking Control

attributes.name: protection_level
attributes.description: Number of seats protected (reserved) for higher-yield demand in this bucket, as computed by the EMSR (Expected Marginal Seat Revenue) optimization in Sabre AirVision. Prevents lower-yield bookings from displacing higher-yield passengers. Core RM optimization output.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — EMSR Optimization; IATA Revenue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: rbd_code
attributes.description: Single uppercase IATA letter identifying the booking class (e.g., Y, B, M, Q, V, H, K, L, S, N, O, G). The RBD is the atomic unit of inventory control in Altéa Inventory and the direct input to Sabre AirVision yield optimization. Governed by IATA Resolution 728.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fare class bucket record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SLA compliance tracking per enterprise data governance standards.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fare class bucket record in the Silver layer. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: Current number of seats available for sale in this booking class bucket at the time of the last inventory snapshot. Derived operationally as booking_limit minus current_bookings, but stored as a first-class field for GDS availability response performance. Consumed by GDS channels and direct booking engines.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Count / IATA NDC Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated or last updated this fare class bucket record: ALTEA (Amadeus Altéa Inventory), SABRE_AV (Sabre AirVision Revenue Management), MANUAL (manually entered override), MIGRATION (data migration load). Supports data lineage and audit in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: Current number of waitlisted booking requests queued against this fare class bucket. When seats become available (e.g., cancellations), Altéa Inventory automatically clears waitlisted PNRs in queue order.

attributes.name: yield_class
attributes.description: Revenue management yield classification assigned to this bucket by Sabre AirVision, grouping RBDs into broad yield tiers for reporting and optimization. Commercially sensitive as it reveals pricing strategy segmentation.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Yield Class Segmentation

products.name: seat_availability
products.description: Real-time and historical transactional record of seat availability by fare class bucket for a flight-date, as broadcast to distribution channels and captured at scheduled intervals for audit and analytics. Captures available seat count, status code (Open/Closed/Waitlist), last update timestamp, channel context (GDS, NDC, direct), snapshot trigger reason, and load factor at capture time. Serves as both the live availability signal consumed by Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport systems and the historical availability audit trail for revenue management model training and GDS broadcast verification.
products.reference: IATA ADRM / Altéa Inventory Availability Message

attributes.name: seat_availability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each seat availability snapshot record in the inventory system. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Availability Snapshot Entity

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: seat_availability carries a denormalized `cabin_class` STRING column representing the cabin class code. cabin_class is a first-class master entity in the inventory domain. Adding cabin_class_id as a d

attributes.name: fare_class_bucket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fare_class_bucket. Business justification: seat_availability tracks availability for a specific fare class bucket (RBD). fare_class_bucket is the master entity defining RBD buckets. This FK links transactional availability records to the bucke

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.flight_inventory. Business justification: seat_availability records are real-time availability snapshots for a specific flight-date combination. flight_inventory is the master entity for that flight-date. This FK establishes the natural paren

attributes.name: flight_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating flight record for which seat availability is being tracked. Links to the flight master entity.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current booking status of the fare class bucket as broadcast to distribution channels. Open = seats available for sale; Closed = bucket closed by revenue management; Waitlist = waitlist accepted; Request = booking requires airline confirmation; Sold Out = no seats remain. Core inventory control signal consumed by GDS, NDC, and direct channels.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; IATA Resolution 728; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: availability_version
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version counter for this flight-date-fare-class availability record. Enables ordering of multiple snapshots for the same key and supports optimistic concurrency control in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: booking_class_availability_map
attributes.description: Availability status string (AVS) representing the full cabin availability across all booking classes at the time of snapshot, as broadcast in GDS availability responses (e.g., 'Y9B9M9Q4V0'). Enables reconstruction of the complete availability display seen by travel agents.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory; SITA AIRIMP

attributes.name: broadcast_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this availability update was broadcast to GDS and distribution channels. Distinct from snapshot_timestamp (capture time) and last_updated_timestamp (system update time). Used for GDS broadcast latency measurement and SLA verification.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory; SITA AIRIMP

attributes.name: codeshare_allotment
attributes.description: Number of seats allocated to the codeshare marketing partner within this fare class bucket. Null when codeshare_indicator is false. Used to track partner inventory consumption against agreed allotment caps.

attributes.name: codeshare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this availability record pertains to a codeshare flight operation where the marketing carrier differs from the operating carrier. When true, inventory is managed under a codeshare allocation agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this availability snapshot record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for Silver layer data lineage and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 787; CORSIA; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: days_to_departure
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the snapshot_timestamp date and the flight_date. Critical dimension for revenue management booking curve analysis and yield optimization model training.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Channel context for which this availability snapshot was generated or broadcast. GDS = Global Distribution System (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport); NDC = IATA New Distribution Capability; Direct = airline.com or mobile app; API = B2B direct connect; Interline = partner carrier ticketing; Codeshare = shared flight operation partner.
attributes.references: IATA NDC Standard (PADIS); IATA Resolution 787; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: forecast_demand
attributes.description: Revenue management system's demand forecast for this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot, expressed as expected number of bookings. Captured alongside actual availability for model accuracy tracking and yield optimization.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: gds_provider_code
attributes.description: IATA-assigned GDS provider code identifying the specific GDS to which this availability was broadcast: 1A = Amadeus, 1S = Sabre, 1G = Galileo (Travelport), 1P = Worldspan (Travelport). Null when distribution_channel is not GDS.
attributes.references: IATA GDS Provider Codes; IATA Resolution 787

attributes.name: inventory_control_mode
attributes.description: Method by which inventory is controlled for this availability record: Leg = physical leg-based control; Segment = segment-level control; OD = Origin-Destination (virtual nesting / O&D control). Determines how Amadeus Altéa manages seat allocation across connecting itineraries.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: is_current_snapshot
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this record represents the most recent (current) availability snapshot for the flight-date-fare-class combination. Enables efficient point-in-time queries without full history scan. Set to false when superseded by a newer snapshot.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: is_interline_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this fare class bucket is open for interline ticketing by partner carriers under bilateral interline agreements. Governs availability visibility in interline booking flows.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this availability record was last modified in the source inventory system (Amadeus Altéa). Used for GDS broadcast verification, change detection, and Silver layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: load_factor_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of authorized seats sold at the time of this snapshot, calculated as (seats_sold / seats_authorized) × 100. Captured at snapshot time for historical revenue management model training and GDS broadcast audit. Aligns with IATA load factor (percentage of seats filled) definition.
attributes.references: IATA World Air Transport Statistics; DOT Form 41; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: marketing_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier under whose flight number the seat is sold to passengers. On non-codeshare flights this equals the operating carrier code.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; IATA Resolution 788

attributes.name: nesting_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical nesting position of this fare class bucket within the cabin's virtual nesting structure used by the revenue management system. Lower values indicate higher-yield buckets. Governs availability inheritance between fare classes.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: operating_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two-character IATA airline designator of the carrier physically operating the flight. Differs from the marketing carrier on codeshare flights. Required for interline and codeshare inventory allocation tracking.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Designator Standard; IATA Resolution 788

attributes.name: overbooking_factor
attributes.description: Authorized overbooking multiplier applied to physical seat capacity for this fare class bucket, expressed as a percentage above 100 (e.g., 105.00 = 5% overbooking). Set by revenue management to compensate for expected no-shows and cancellations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT 14 CFR Part 250 (Oversales)

attributes.name: physical_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of physical seats configured in the cabin for this flight-date, before overbooking authorization. Provides the denominator for cabin-level load factor calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: protection_level
attributes.description: Number of seats protected (reserved) for higher-yield fare classes above this bucket in the nesting hierarchy, as set by the revenue management optimizer. Core EMSR (Expected Marginal Seat Revenue) output used in Altéa and Sabre inventory control.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: rm_decision_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the revenue management optimization decision or rule that triggered the current availability status or booking limit for this fare class bucket (e.g., FCST_CLOSE, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, AUTO_OPEN). Supports RM model audit and performance attribution.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; IATA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: seats_authorized
attributes.description: Maximum number of bookings authorized for this fare class bucket as set by the revenue management system. Represents the booking limit or allotment cap controlling inventory exposure for this RBD.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; Amadeus Altéa Inventory; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: seats_available
attributes.description: Number of seats currently available for sale in this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot. A value of zero with status Open may indicate overbooking authorization. Negative values indicate oversold position.

attributes.name: seats_held
attributes.description: Number of seats temporarily held under option, group block, or tour operator allotment that are not yet confirmed bookings but reduce net availability. Distinct from seats_sold as these may be released.

attributes.name: seats_sold
attributes.description: Number of confirmed bookings (including checked-in passengers) held against this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot. Used to compute load factor and remaining availability.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; DOT Form 41 Traffic Statistics

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which this availability record was captured or broadcast. The principal business event timestamp for this EVENT_LOG record. Used for GDS broadcast verification and revenue management time-series analysis.

attributes.name: snapshot_trigger
attributes.description: Business event or system action that caused this availability snapshot to be generated and broadcast. Enables audit of why availability changed at a given point in time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Booking|Cancellation|Schedule Change|RM Override|GDS Poll|NDC Request|Overbooking Adjustment|Batch Interval — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this availability record: ALTEA = Amadeus Altéa Inventory (PSS); SABRE = Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; NETLINE = Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops; MANUAL = manually entered override.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: Number of passengers currently on the waitlist for this fare class bucket at the time of the snapshot. Relevant when availability_status is Waitlist. Used to assess demand pressure and inform overbooking decisions.

products.name: overbooking_control
products.description: Master entity storing the overbooking authorization parameters for a flight inventory record by cabin class. Captures the authorized overbooking percentage, maximum oversale seats, historical no-show rate inputs, spoilage risk threshold, and the revenue management system override flag. Directly managed by revenue management analysts and consumed by Altéa Inventory to set booking limits above physical capacity.
products.reference: Altéa Inventory Overbooking Authorization / Sabre AirVision RM Overbooking

attributes.name: overbooking_control_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the overbooking control record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Overbooking Control Entity

attributes.name: cabin_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cabin_class. Business justification: overbooking_control stores overbooking authorization parameters for a specific cabin class. cabin_class is the reference master for cabin definitions. This FK links control parameters to the cabin mas

attributes.name: cabin_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.cabin_configuration. Business justification: Overbooking models are calibrated against authoritative physical seat capacity from cabin_configuration. physical_seat_capacity on overbooking_control is a denormalized copy prone to staleness after r

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Denied boarding compensation (voluntary and involuntary) is a direct cost tracked by cost center for financial reporting and DOT/regulatory compliance. Airlines monitor IDB costs against overbooking r

attributes.name: flight_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flight inventory record (specific flight departure date and flight number combination) to which this overbooking control applies. Links to the sellable inventory unit in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Flight Inventory Object

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route. Business justification: Overbooking policies are route-specific, driven by route competitive intensity, no-show history, and regulatory market codes. Aviation revenue management and regulatory compliance require overbooking

attributes.name: schedule_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.schedule_season. Business justification: Seasonal no-show rates and overbooking model versions are calibrated per IATA schedule season. Season-level overbooking compliance reporting requires this FK. season_code is a denormalized season refe

attributes.name: yield_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.yield_parameter. Business justification: Overbooking authorization rates are derived from yield parameters (no_show_rate, spoilage_tolerance, overbooking_authorization_rate). The RM system applies yield_parameter settings when computing over

attributes.name: authorized_overbooking_pct
attributes.description: The approved percentage above physical cabin seat capacity that the revenue management system is authorized to sell. For example, a value of 10.00 means up to 10% more seats than physically available may be booked. Derived from historical no-show rates and spoilage risk models in Sabre AirVision Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Overbooking Authorization; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent real-time availability snapshot published to GDS and direct booking channels by Altéa Inventory. Indicates the currency of the current_booking_count and booking_limit values.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Real-Time Availability Distribution; IATA NDC

attributes.name: avg_fare_value_usd
attributes.description: The average fare value in USD for bookings in this cabin on this flight, used as an input to the overbooking revenue optimization model. Enables the model to weigh the revenue benefit of additional bookings against the cost of denied boarding compensation.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Yield Optimization; IATA RP 1724

attributes.name: booking_limit
attributes.description: The computed maximum number of bookings permitted for this cabin on this flight, equal to physical seat capacity plus authorized oversale seats. This is the operative value consumed by Altéa Inventory and GDS availability responses to control seat sales.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Limit; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_input
attributes.description: Historical cancellation rate (expressed as a decimal proportion) for this route, cabin, and season used as an actuarial input alongside the no-show rate in the overbooking model. Distinct from no-show rate as it captures pre-departure cancellations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Cancellation Forecasting

attributes.name: codeshare_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this overbooking control applies to a codeshare inventory allocation rather than the operating carrier's own inventory. Codeshare overbooking controls may differ from mainline controls due to interline agreements and partner airline seat block commitments.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 788 — Codeshare; Amadeus Altéa Inventory

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this overbooking control record. Active indicates the parameters are live and being applied by Altéa Inventory booking limit calculations. Suspended means overbooking is temporarily halted for this cabin. Overridden indicates a manual revenue management analyst override is in effect.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Limit Management; IATA Resolution 830d

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this overbooking control record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Record Audit; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: current_booking_count
attributes.description: The real-time count of confirmed bookings (PNRs) held against this cabin at the time of the last availability snapshot. Used to compute remaining availability and monitor oversale exposure.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Real-Time Availability Snapshot

attributes.name: day_of_week_pattern
attributes.description: Bitmask or string pattern (e.g., '1234567' where each digit represents Mon–Sun) indicating which days of the week this overbooking control applies to. Allows differentiated overbooking levels for weekday versus weekend departures.
attributes.references: IATA SSIM — Day of Week Encoding

attributes.name: denied_boarding_risk_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable probability (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0200 = 2%) that at least one passenger will be involuntarily denied boarding due to oversale. Balances revenue optimization against regulatory denied boarding compensation exposure under DOT 14 CFR Part 250 and IATA Resolution 830d.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; IATA Resolution 830d; EASA Regulation EC 261/2004

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The scheduled departure date of the flight to which this overbooking control record applies. Combined with the flight inventory reference, uniquely identifies the specific flight departure instance.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this overbooking control record becomes operative. Supports scheduling of future overbooking parameter changes in advance of the departure date.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Effective Date Management

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this overbooking control record is no longer operative. Null indicates the record remains active indefinitely until superseded. Supports time-bounded overbooking strategies.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Effective Date Management

attributes.name: go_show_rate_input
attributes.description: Historical rate of passengers who arrive at the gate without a prior reservation (go-shows) for this route and cabin, expressed as a decimal proportion. Used in the overbooking model to account for demand that materialises at departure.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Go-Show Demand Modelling

attributes.name: group_booking_seats_reserved
attributes.description: Number of seats within the cabin that are reserved for confirmed group bookings and excluded from the overbooking calculation. Group bookings typically have lower no-show rates and are treated separately in the overbooking model.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Group Inventory Management; IATA Resolution 728

attributes.name: historical_no_show_rate
attributes.description: The input no-show rate (expressed as a decimal proportion, e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%) derived from historical passenger behaviour for this route, cabin, and season. Used as the primary actuarial input to the overbooking authorization model in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — No-Show Forecasting; IATA RP 1724

attributes.name: idb_compensation_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Estimated maximum financial exposure in USD for involuntary denied boarding (IDB) compensation if all oversold seats result in IDB events. Calculated based on max_oversale_seats and applicable DOT/IATA compensation rates. Used in revenue management risk assessment.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250 — IDB Compensation Rates; IATA Resolution 830d

attributes.name: last_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a revenue management analyst last reviewed and confirmed or adjusted this overbooking control record. Supports governance workflows requiring periodic review of overbooking authorizations.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Review Workflow; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this overbooking control record was most recently modified. Tracks parameter changes by revenue management analysts or automated system recalculations.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Record Audit; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: load_factor_forecast
attributes.description: The forecasted load factor (proportion of physical seats expected to be occupied at departure, expressed as a decimal e.g., 0.9200 = 92%) for this cabin on this flight. Input from Sabre AirVision demand forecasting, used to calibrate the overbooking level.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Demand Forecasting; IATA ASK/RPK Metrics

attributes.name: max_oversale_seats
attributes.description: The absolute maximum number of seats above physical cabin capacity that may be sold, regardless of the authorized overbooking percentage. Acts as a hard cap to limit denied boarding exposure. Set by revenue management analysts in Altéa Inventory.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Booking Limit Cap; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which this overbooking control record must be reviewed by a revenue management analyst. Drives workflow queuing in Sabre AirVision to ensure timely recalibration before departure.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Review Scheduling

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes or context related to this overbooking control record, such as special event considerations, IROP recovery instructions, or coordination notes with ground handling teams.

attributes.name: overbooking_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the statistical overbooking model used to compute the authorized overbooking percentage for this record. Enables reproducibility, model governance, and comparison of model performance across versions in Sabre AirVision.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Model Versioning

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the revenue management analyst when rm_system_override_flag is True. Documents the business rationale for departing from the system-recommended overbooking level (e.g., special event, group booking, IROP recovery).
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Audit Trail; DOT 14 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or regulatory jurisdiction code (e.g., USA, EU) identifying the regulatory regime governing denied boarding compensation obligations for this flight. Determines applicable DOT, EASA EC 261/2004, or national civil aviation authority rules.
attributes.references: DOT 14 CFR Part 250; EASA Regulation EC 261/2004; ICAO Annex 9; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: rm_system_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a revenue management analyst has manually overridden the system-calculated overbooking parameters. When True, the authorized_overbooking_pct and max_oversale_seats reflect analyst-entered values rather than the automated Sabre AirVision model output.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Manual Override Controls

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system that created or last updated this overbooking control record. ALTEA = Amadeus Altéa Inventory automated calculation, SABRE_AV = Sabre AirVision Revenue Management model output, MANUAL = direct analyst entry.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management

attributes.name: spoilage_risk_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable probability (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0500 = 5%) that the flight departs with empty seats due to under-booking. Revenue management uses this threshold to calibrate the overbooking level against the risk of seat spoilage versus denied boarding.
attributes.references: Sabre AirVision Revenue Management — Spoilage/Denied Boarding Trade-off Model

attributes.name: upgrade_buffer_seats
attributes.description: Number of seats held back from the overbooking pool to accommodate anticipated operational upgrades (e.g., elite frequent flyer upgrades, compensation upgrades). Reduces the effective booking limit to preserve upgrade capacity.
attributes.references: Amadeus Altéa Inventory — Upgrade Management; Oracle Loyalty Cloud FFP

attributes.name: voluntary_denied_boarding_target
