attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the company code currency at the time of posting (BKPF-KURSF). Critical for IFRS IAS 21 compliance and interline settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 21; IATA BSP

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (1–16) within the fiscal year to which the posting belongs (BKPF-MONAT in SAP). Periods 13–16 are special closing periods used for year-end adjustments, accruals, and audit corrections.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the accounting document belongs (BKPF-GJAHR in SAP). Used for period-end close, annual financial reporting, and year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classifying the business function of the posting for cost-of-sales accounting (BSEG-FKBER). Enables income statement presentation by function (e.g., Flight Operations, Sales & Distribution, Administration) per IFRS IAS 1.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account number from the chart of accounts to which this line item is posted (BSEG-HKONT / SKA1-SAKNR). Represents the financial classification of the transaction (e.g., fuel expense, lease liability, revenue, accrued liabilities). Core to CASK reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: gl_account_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the GL account (SKA1-TXT50). Denormalised from the chart of accounts for reporting convenience and audit trail completeness. Examples: 'Jet Fuel Expense', 'Aircraft Lease Liability (IFRS 16)', 'Interline Receivable'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; IATA Airline Accounting Guide

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the accounting document header level (BKPF-BKTXT). Provides overall context for the journal entry, shared across all line items of the same document. Used for audit trail and period-end close documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this posting is an intercompany transaction between two legal entities within the airline group (BKPF-BVTYP populated). True = intercompany posting requiring elimination in group consolidation. Critical for IFRS 10 consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; IATA Interline Accounting

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order number used to collect costs for specific projects, campaigns, or temporary cost objects (BSEG-AUFNR). Used in aviation for aircraft modification projects, route launch campaigns, and MRO work orders.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accounting document was last modified in SAP. Tracks changes to parked documents, header text updates, or clearing events. Supports change audit trail requirements under SOX and IFRS.

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: SAP parallel ledger identifier (BKPF-RLDNR) supporting dual IFRS and local GAAP reporting. Common values: '0L' = leading ledger (IFRS), 'N1' = local GAAP ledger. Enables simultaneous reporting under multiple accounting standards required for multinational airline operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Parallel Ledger; IFRS 1; Local GAAP

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the accounting document (BSEG-BUZEI in SAP). Identifies the specific debit or credit posting line within the journal entry. Combined with document_number and company_code forms the natural key of a GL line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accounting document is posted to the general ledger (BKPF-BUDAT). Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date used for financial reporting and period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IFRS IAS 1; ICAO Doc 9562

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accounting document. 'posted' = active GL entry; 'reversed' = entry has been reversed by a reversal document; 'parked' = document saved but not yet posted; 'held' = incomplete document; 'cleared' = open item has been cleared against a payment or offsetting entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of the individual line item posting (BSEG-SGTXT). Provides narrative context for the accounting entry, e.g., 'Jet fuel uplift JFK-LHR 15-Jan', 'IFRS 16 lease liability accrual Q1', 'Interline settlement IATA BSP Jan'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created the accounting document (BKPF-USNAM). Essential for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties controls, and financial fraud detection. May be a batch job ID for automated postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: profit_centre
attributes.description: SAP Controlling profit centre representing a business unit responsible for its own profitability (BSEG-PRCTR / CEPC-PRCTR). Used for route-level, hub-level, or business-segment P&L reporting. Supports RASK and yield analysis by profit centre.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (BKPF-XBLNR), such as a vendor invoice number, AWB (Air Waybill) number, PNR, interline billing statement number, or BSP settlement reference. Enables traceability from the GL back to the originating business transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; IATA BSP; IATA AWB

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the corresponding reversal or reversed document (BKPF-STBLG). Populated when reversal_indicator is true, enabling bidirectional traceability between original and reversal entries for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this document is a reversal of a previously posted document (BKPF-STBLG is populated). True = this is a reversal document. Supports audit trail integrity and period-end close accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BKPF; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (VAT/GST/PFC) associated with this line item in the transaction currency (BSEG-WMWST). Supports tax reconciliation, VAT return preparation, and Passenger Facility Charge (PFC) reporting to airport authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IATA Tax Guide; DOT PFC Regulations; EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code determining the applicable tax rate and tax account for the posting (BSEG-MWSKZ). Relevant for VAT/GST on airline ancillary services, ground handling charges, and MRO procurement. Supports tax reporting to national revenue authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IATA Tax Guide; EU VAT Directive; DOT

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany postings (BSEG-VBUND). Populated when intercompany_indicator is true. Used for automated intercompany elimination during group financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; IATA Interline Accounting

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original transaction (BSEG-WAERS). Identifies the currency in which the business event was denominated, e.g., USD for US routes, EUR for European operations, GBP for UK operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System WBS element for project-based cost assignment (BSEG-PS_PSP_PNR). Used for capital expenditure projects such as fleet acquisition, terminal construction, and major MRO overhauls. Supports IFRS IAS 16 capitalisation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; IFRS IAS 16; IFRS 16

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Individual accounting posting records in the general ledger representing debits and credits for every financial transaction across the airline. Captures document type, posting date, fiscal period, currency, exchange rate, reference document, reversal indicators, and posting user. Aligns with SAP FI document posting model and supports audit trail for regulatory financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Document / Journal Entry

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Primary key for the journal_entry data product in the finance domain silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Model; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each journal entry belongs to ONE company code (legal entity). The journal_entry table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Company code is a mandat

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Each journal entry can be assigned to ONE cost center for CO allocation. The journal_entry table has cost_center (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the cost_centre master. This is a standa

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Each journal entry posts to ONE GL account. The journal_entry table has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the general_ledger master. This is a standard SAP FI relationship

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP FI account type indicating the subledger category for this posting: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor/Accounts Receivable), K=Vendor (Creditor/Accounts Payable), M=Material, S=General Ledger. Determines which subledger is updated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Type (BSEG-KOART); IFRS IAS 1 Balance Sheet Classification

attributes.name: amount_document_currency
attributes.description: The transaction amount in the original document currency (transaction currency). May differ from amount_local_currency when the source document is in a foreign currency, such as interline billing settlements in USD or EUR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Currency Amount (BSEG-WRBTR); IFRS IAS 21; IATA BSP Settlement

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount in the company code's local (functional) currency. This is the primary monetary value for statutory reporting and forms part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Local Currency Amount (BSEG-DMBTR); IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: SAP FI assignment field used for sorting and matching open items during clearing (e.g., flight number, route code, cost object reference). Supports automated payment matching and interline settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Assignment (BSEG-ZUONR); IATA Interline Billing Standards

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area code representing an organizational unit for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be produced (e.g., passenger operations, cargo, MRO, loyalty). Supports segment reporting under IFRS 8.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area (BSEG-GSBER); IFRS 8 Operating Segments; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared (matched against a payment or offsetting entry). Used for accounts receivable aging analysis, days sales outstanding (DSO) calculation, and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Date (BSEG-AUGDT); IFRS IAS 7 Cash Flow Statements; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the clearing transaction that matched and closed this open item (e.g., payment document clearing an invoice, credit memo clearing a debit). Populated when posting_status is 'cleared'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Document (BSEG-AUGBL); IATA BSP Clearing; ARC Settlement

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and ensures the general ledger remains in balance. Aligns with SAP FI posting key logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Debit/Credit Indicator (BSEG-SHKZG); IFRS IAS 1; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original document currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for interline billing, BSP settlements, and multi-currency treasury operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Key (BKPF-WAERS); IATA BSP

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice date, payment date, contract date) that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting_date when documents are processed with a lag.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date (BKPF-BLDAT); IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally visible SAP FI document number uniquely identifying this accounting document within the company code and fiscal year. Used as the primary business reference for audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number (BKPF-BELNR); IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP FI document type code classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, ZP=Payment, AB=Accounting Document). Drives number range assignment and posting rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|ZP|AB|RE|RV|KZ|DZ — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type (BKPF-BLART); IATA ARC/BSP Document Standards

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this journal entry record was created in the SAP S/4HANA system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Entry Time (BKPF-CPUDT/CPUTM); SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the document currency amount to the local currency amount at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP exchange rate tables and aligned with treasury hedging policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate (BKPF-KURSF); IFRS IAS 21; IATA Currency Clearance

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16, including special periods 13–16 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA posting period control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The accounting fiscal year in which this journal entry is recorded, as defined by the airline's fiscal year variant in SAP S/4HANA. May differ from the calendar year for airlines with non-calendar fiscal years.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area classifying the cost by business function (e.g., PROD=Production/Flight Operations, SELL=Sales, ADMN=Administration, MAINT=Maintenance). Supports cost-of-sales accounting and CASK component analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area (BSEG-FKBER); IATA CASK Reporting; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the document header level providing business context for the journal entry (e.g., 'Monthly fuel accrual JFK hub', 'IFRS 16 lease liability Q3', 'Interline BSP settlement October'). Supports audit review and financial analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Header Text (BKPF-BKTXT); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order number used to collect costs for specific projects or events (e.g., aircraft heavy maintenance C-check, airport terminal renovation, fleet acquisition project). Enables project-level cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Orders (BSEG-AUFNR); AMOS MRO Work Order Integration; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last modified in the source system. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Timestamp; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 8 Accounting Policies

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the individual line item level providing specific context for this debit or credit posting (e.g., 'Jet-A fuel uplift LHR 15-Oct', 'ACMI wet lease payment', 'Crew hotel deadhead expense').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Text (BSEG-SGTXT); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency. Defines the base currency for statutory financial reporting for the legal entity.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Currency; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and determines the fiscal period assignment. This is the authoritative accounting date for period-end close and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date (BKPF-BUDAT); IFRS IAS 1; DOT Form 41 Financial Reporting

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP FI two-digit posting key controlling the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field selection for this line item (e.g., 40=GL Debit, 50=GL Credit, 31=Vendor Credit, 01=Customer Debit). Determines the accounting treatment applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key (BSEG-BSCHL); GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Standards

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the general ledger workflow. 'Posted' indicates a completed, immutable entry; 'parked' is a draft pending approval; 'reversed' indicates a correcting entry has been applied; 'cleared' indicates the open item has been matched.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center identifying the business segment (e.g., route, hub, cabin class, cargo) responsible for this posting. Supports profitability analysis by route, fleet type, and business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting (CEPC-PRCTR); IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, PNR, AWB number, interline billing statement number, lease contract reference). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Document Number (BKPF-XBLNR); IATA AWB Standards; IATA BSP

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal document (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries are created to correct erroneous postings and maintain audit integrity in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Indicator (BKPF-STBLG); SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 8 Error Corrections

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component (VAT, GST, PFC, or other applicable taxes) included in or associated with this journal entry posting. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Supports tax reporting and PFC (Passenger Facility Charge) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Amount (BSEG-WMWST); IATA PFC Reporting; DOT Tax Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax type and rate for this posting (e.g., V1=Input VAT 19%, A1=Output VAT 19%). Drives automatic tax calculation and tax return preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Code (BSEG-MWSKZ); IATA Tax Handling Guidelines; DOT/FAA Tax Regulations

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element for project-based cost assignments, such as aircraft acquisition, fleet modification programs, or major infrastructure projects. Supports capital expenditure tracking under IFRS IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS WBS Element (BSEG-PROJK); IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; ICAO Annex 6

products.name: cost_centre
products.description: SAP CO organisational unit master representing cost-incurring and profit-bearing responsibility centres within the airline — e.g., flight operations, cabin crew, MRO line/base stations, ground handling, airport lounges, cargo division, route groups (by hub, region), and corporate functions. Stores centre type (cost/profit), hierarchy level and parent, responsible manager, controlling area, validity periods, budget allocation references, revenue attribution rules, CASK/RASK allocation keys, and internal activity rates. Enables departmental P&L reporting, CASK component attribution, route profitability analysis, and management accounting by business segment.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA (Cost Centre Accounting)

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost centre record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the cost_centre data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Centre Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each cost center belongs to ONE company code. The cost_centre table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Cost centers are assigned to company codes

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Primary SAP CO activity type associated with this cost centre, defining the unit of output for internal activity allocation (e.g., 'FLT-HRS' = flight hours, 'BLK-HRS' = block hours, 'MRO-MHR' = maintenance man-hours, 'GND-TRN' = ground turns). Used to calculate internal activity rates for cost allocation between centres.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Activity-Based Costing; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost centre for the current fiscal year, in the controlling area currency. Represents the authorised spending limit for departmental P&L management. Used in budget vs. actual variance reporting and financial planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Budget Management; IATA Financial Planning Guidelines; IAS 1

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: SAP CO planning version identifier for the budget associated with this cost centre (e.g., '000' = actuals, '001' = original budget, '002' = revised forecast, 'PLAN' = annual plan). Enables comparison of actuals vs. budget vs. forecast in variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Planning Versions; IATA Financial Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI business area assigned to this cost centre, representing a distinct area of operations for internal balance sheet and P&L reporting (e.g., 'PASS' = Passenger, 'CARG' = Cargo, 'MRO' = Maintenance). Enables segment reporting per IFRS 8 without full profit centre accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: cask_allocation_key
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK) Allocation Key
attributes.description: Allocation driver used to apportion this cost centre's costs to Available Seat Kilometers (ASK) for CASK reporting. 'ask' = direct ASK-based allocation; 'block_hours' = by block hours flown; 'departures' = by number of departures; 'pax' = by passenger count; 'revenue' = by revenue share; 'equal' = equal split; 'manual' = manually defined percentages. Critical for unit cost benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ask|block_hours|departures|pax|revenue|equal|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA CASK Methodology; IATA Airline Cost Management Group (ACMG)

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost centre category that classifies the functional nature of the centre (e.g., 'F' = Flight Operations, 'M' = Maintenance, 'G' = Ground Handling, 'A' = Administration, 'C' = Cargo, 'L' = Loyalty). Controls which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F|M|G|A|C|L|S|T — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Category Configuration; IATA Cost Classification

attributes.name: centre_type
attributes.description: Classification of the responsibility centre by financial accountability type. 'cost' centres track expenditure only (e.g., maintenance base); 'profit' centres track both revenue and cost for P&L reporting (e.g., route group, cargo division); 'investment' centres include capital employed; 'revenue' centres track revenue attribution (e.g., lounge, ancillary). Drives CASK/RASK allocation methodology.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines; IFRS 8

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area to which this cost centre belongs. The controlling area defines the organisational unit within which cost accounting is performed (e.g., 'AA01' for the airline group). Determines currency, fiscal year variant, and chart of accounts applicable to this centre.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Enterprise Structure; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: corsia_emissions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost centre is subject to CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation) emissions monitoring and offset cost accounting. True for international route operations cost centres. Drives inclusion in ICAO CORSIA compliance reporting and carbon offset cost allocation.
attributes.references: ICAO CORSIA; ICAO Annex 16 Volume IV; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost centre within the SAP CO controlling area. Used in journal entries, budget allocations, and management reporting (e.g., 'FLT-OPS-001', 'MRO-BASE-LHR', 'CARGO-HUB-JFK'). Aligns with SAP CO cost centre number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_centre_description
attributes.description: Long-form narrative description of the cost centre's business purpose, scope of operations, and cost accountability. Provides context for financial analysts and auditors beyond the short name (e.g., 'Responsible for all direct operating costs of widebody long-haul fleet on North Atlantic routes including fuel uplift, crew costs, and ATC charges').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_centre_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost centre as maintained in SAP CO master data (e.g., 'Flight Operations — North Atlantic Hub', 'Cabin Crew Training — Base London', 'MRO Line Maintenance — Frankfurt'). Used in financial reports and management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_centre_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost centre in SAP CO. 'active' = open for postings; 'inactive' = temporarily suspended; 'locked' = blocked for new postings (period-end); 'pending_activation' = created but not yet released; 'closed' = permanently deactivated with no further postings permitted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost centre master record was first created in the source SAP CO system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance with financial record retention requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; ICAO Annex 6; ISO 9001 Quality Management Records

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost centre's controlling currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Determines the currency in which budgets are planned, actuals are recorded, and variance reports are produced. May differ from company code currency for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the cost centre's budget and planning data applies (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the SAP CO fiscal year variant configured for the controlling area. Used to version budget records and support multi-year trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Fiscal Year; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fuel_cost_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost centre is designated for fuel cost accounting and uplift tracking. True for flight operations and route cost centres where jet fuel (Jet-A/A1) costs are directly attributed. Enables fuel cost per ASK (fuel CASK) component reporting and hedging P&L attribution.
attributes.references: IATA Fuel Cost Management Guidelines; CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); IATA CASK Methodology

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO functional area classifying the cost centre by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., 'PROD' = Production/Operations, 'SELL' = Sales, 'ADMN' = Administration, 'R&D' = Research). Required for IFRS income statement by function of expense.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Functional Area; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP FI general ledger account group associated with primary cost postings for this cost centre. Defines the range of GL accounts permissible for postings, ensuring cost classification consistency (e.g., 'OPEX' for operating expenses, 'FUEL' for fuel costs, 'LABOR' for crew and staff costs).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts; IATA Uniform System of Accounts for Airlines

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Node identifier within the standard cost centre hierarchy (SAP CO standard hierarchy) to which this centre is assigned. Enables roll-up reporting by business segment, division, or region (e.g., 'FLIGHT-OPS', 'MRO-EMEA', 'CARGO-APAC'). Used for group-level CASK reporting and segment P&L consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Standard Hierarchy; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this cost centre within the standard hierarchy tree (1 = top-level division, 2 = sub-division, 3 = department, 4 = operational unit, etc.). Used to control report aggregation and drill-down navigation in management accounting dashboards.

attributes.name: hub_airport_code
attributes.description: IATA three-letter airport code of the hub or base airport associated with this cost centre, where applicable (e.g., 'LHR' for London Heathrow hub operations, 'JFK' for New York hub, 'FRA' for Frankfurt MRO base). Enables geographic cost attribution and hub-level CASK analysis. Null for non-location-specific centres.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes Standard; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: iata_cost_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: IATA (International Air Transport Association) Cost Category
attributes.description: IATA standard cost category classification for airline management accounting and industry benchmarking (e.g., 'Flight Operations', 'Maintenance', 'Passenger Services', 'Sales and Distribution', 'General and Administration'). Enables CASK component benchmarking against IATA industry data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Flight Operations|Maintenance|Passenger Services|Sales and Distribution|General and Administration|Cargo|Ground Operations — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Airline Cost Management Group (ACMG) Guidelines; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost centre carries IFRS 16 right-of-use asset and lease liability obligations (e.g., aircraft operating leases, airport gate leases, hangar leases). True triggers inclusion in IFRS 16 lease liability reporting and depreciation of right-of-use assets. Critical for airline balance sheet compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Lease Accounting; IATA IFRS 16 Implementation Guidance

attributes.name: interline_settlement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost centre participates in interline billing settlement processes (IATA BSP/ARC). True for cost centres associated with interline revenue sharing, prorate agreements, and bilateral settlement with partner carriers. Drives inclusion in interline financial reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP); IATA Interline Traffic Agreements; ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation)

attributes.name: internal_activity_rate
attributes.description: Planned cost rate per unit of activity output for this cost centre (in controlling area currency). Used for internal cost allocation between cost centres (e.g., cost per block hour charged from Flight Operations to Route cost centres). Recalculated each planning cycle. Classified confidential as it reflects internal transfer pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ABC Activity Rate Planning; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: last_changed_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this cost centre master record. Supports audit trail requirements for financial master data governance and SOX compliance controls over cost centre maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Change Document Management; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost centre master record in SAP CO. Used for change tracking, incremental data extraction (delta loads), and audit compliance. Corresponds to SAP CDHDR change document header timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Change Document Management (CDHDR); ISO 9001 Quality Management Records

attributes.name: profit_centre_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit centre to which this cost centre is assigned for internal P&L reporting. Enables revenue attribution and profitability analysis at route, hub, or business segment level. Supports RASK/CASK analysis by profit centre.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA (Profit Centre Accounting); IFRS 8

attributes.name: rask_attribution_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer (RASK) Attribution Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost centre participates in Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer (RASK) attribution for route profitability analysis. True for profit centres and revenue-generating units (e.g., route groups, lounges, ancillary services); False for pure cost centres (e.g., corporate functions, back-office).
attributes.references: IATA RASK Methodology; IATA Managerial Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code to which this cost centre is assigned for regional management reporting (e.g., 'EMEA', 'NORAM', 'APAC', 'LATAM', 'DOM' for domestic). Supports regional P&L roll-up, CASK benchmarking by region, and DOT/EASA regional regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Traffic Conference Areas; DOT Form 41 Geographic Reporting

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the cost centre used in condensed reports, dashboards, and system displays where space is limited. Corresponds to SAP CO short text field (up to 20 characters).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this cost centre is valid and open for financial postings in SAP CO. Supports time-dependent master data management — cost centre attributes may change over time with new validity periods. Aligns with fiscal year planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Time-Dependent Master Data; IAS 1

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Date until which this cost centre is valid for financial postings. Null or 31-Dec-9999 indicates an open-ended validity. Used to manage cost centre lifecycle, seasonal operations (e.g., charter season cost centres), and organisational restructuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Time-Dependent Master Data

products.name: accounts_payable
products.description: SAP FI-AP vendor invoice and payment obligation records for the airline covering MRO suppliers, fuel vendors, airport authorities, GDS providers, catering contractors, and ground handling agents. Each record represents a vendor invoice document with invoice number, vendor ID, invoice date, line items, tax amounts, purchase order reference, goods receipt reference, three-way match status, payment terms, due dates, withholding tax, approval workflow status, payment execution details (method, bank, value date, clearing document), and BSP/ARC settlement obligations. Supports procure-to-pay lifecycle, cash flow forecasting, and supplier payment runs.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (Accounts Payable)

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each vendor invoice record in the accounts payable ledger. Generated by the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion pipeline from SAP FI-AP document entries.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each AP invoice belongs to ONE company code. The accounts_payable table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. This is a mandatory dimension in SAP FI

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which this invoice expense is allocated, supporting CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) reporting and departmental cost accounting within SAP CO.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: AP invoices can be for the purchase or capitalization of fixed assets (aircraft, engines, ground equipment). A FK from accounts_payable to fixed_asset links the payment obligation to the asset being a

attributes.name: fleet_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_order. Business justification: Aircraft purchase progress payments and delivery milestone invoices are AP transactions that must reference the originating fleet order for three-way matching, CAPEX payment tracking, and purchase ord

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: AP invoices and payments generate GL postings in SAP FI-AP. Every accounts_payable record corresponds to one or more GL entries. This FK normalizes the relationship between the AP sub-ledger and the g

attributes.name: ground_handler_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to airport.ground_handler. Business justification: AP invoices are issued by ground handlers for ramp, baggage, and passenger handling services. Linking AP to the ground_handler vendor record enables vendor payment tracking, SLA-linked invoice validat

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: AP invoices for IFRS 16 lease payments should be linked to the lease contract. The accounts_payable table has ifrs16_lease_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating lease-related invoices, but no explicit FK. Adding

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the invoice within the internal approval workflow, reflecting authorization levels required before payment execution. Supports segregation of duties and internal controls per SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow (SWI); Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: bsp_arc_settlement_ref
attributes.description: The IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) or Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) settlement reference number for invoices settled through interline or agency billing cycles. Applicable for GDS provider fees, interline billing, and travel agency commission settlements.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Operations Manual; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; IATA Resolution 850

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP accounting document number of the payment document that cleared (settled) this open invoice item. Populated upon successful payment execution. Corresponds to SAP field AUGBL (Clearing Document). Null for unpaid invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG.AUGBL); IATA BSP Reconciliation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accounts payable record was first created in the SAP FI-AP system, representing the initial document entry time. Used for audit trail, SLA monitoring of invoice processing cycle time, and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF.CPUDT / CPUTM); SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if payment is made by the discount_due_date, as negotiated in the vendor payment terms. Supports working capital optimization and supplier relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms (BSEG.SKFBT); IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which early payment must be made to qualify for the cash discount offered under the vendor's payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Supports cash flow optimization and working capital management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms (T052); IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The calculated date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date plus payment term days. Corresponds to SAP field FAEDT (Net Due Date).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (FAEDE.FAEDT); DOT Prompt Payment Act Compliance

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to translate the invoice currency amount to the local currency at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP exchange rate table (TCURR). Critical for FX exposure reporting and treasury operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF.KURSF / TCURR); IFRS IAS 21; IATA Currency Clearance Service (CCS)

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (1–16, including special periods) within the fiscal year in which this invoice is recorded. Supports monthly accrual management and period-end close processes in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF.MONAT); IFRS IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this vendor invoice is posted in SAP FI. Used for period-end closing, financial reporting, and year-over-year cost analysis. Corresponds to SAP field GJAHR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF.GJAHR); IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fuel_uplift_volume_liters
attributes.description: For fuel vendor invoices, the volume of jet fuel (Jet-A or Jet-A1) uplifted in liters as recorded on the fuel receipt. Supports fuel cost per liter analysis, CASK fuel component reporting, and CORSIA carbon emissions accounting. Null for non-fuel invoices.
attributes.references: IATA Fuel Cost Management Guidelines; CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); ICAO Annex 16 Vol IV

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP general ledger account number to which the invoice expense is posted, enabling cost classification for financial reporting and CASK component analysis (e.g., fuel cost GL, MRO cost GL, airport charges GL). Corresponds to SAP field HKONT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (SKA1.SAKNR); IFRS IAS 1 Chart of Accounts; IATA Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods or services were confirmed as received, forming the third leg of the three-way match (PO → Goods Receipt → Invoice). Critical for MRO parts, fuel uplift, and catering deliveries. Corresponds to SAP MIGO goods receipt posting date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Inventory Management (MKPF.BUDAT); IATA Ground Handling Agreement Standards

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the vendor invoice before deduction of taxes, withholding tax, or discounts, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the full obligation as stated on the vendor's invoice document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG.WRBTR); IFRS IAS 37 Provisions and Contingent Liabilities

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice relates to a lease obligation subject to IFRS 16 Leases accounting treatment (e.g., aircraft dry lease, wet lease, ACMI lease payments, airport gate lease). When true, the payment is classified as a lease liability repayment rather than an operating expense.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Lease Accounting; IATA IFRS 16 Implementation Guidance

attributes.name: invoice_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the vendor invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). May differ from the company code local currency, requiring foreign exchange translation for GL posting. Corresponds to SAP field WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF.WAERS); IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document, representing the business event date for the supply of goods or services. Used as the baseline for payment term calculation and tax point determination. Corresponds to SAP field BLDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BKPF.BLDAT); IATA BSP Billing Cycle Standards

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor's invoice document. Used for vendor reconciliation, dispute resolution, and audit trail. Corresponds to SAP field BELNR (Accounting Document Number) or XBLNR (Reference Document Number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BKPF.XBLNR); IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor invoice within the SAP FI-AP workflow. 'open' = posted and awaiting payment; 'parked' = saved but not yet posted; 'blocked' = payment block applied; 'in_approval' = pending workflow approval; 'cleared' = fully paid and cleared; 'cancelled' = reversed/cancelled document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Document Status; IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) Rules

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this accounts payable record, capturing changes to approval status, payment block, or clearing information. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Documents (CDHDR); SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount translated into the company code's local (functional) currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Used for GL posting, financial reporting, and CASK calculation in the airline's reporting currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BSEG.DMBTR); IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency Translation

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the vendor after deducting withholding tax and any applicable cash discounts from the gross invoice amount. Represents the actual cash outflow obligation. Calculated as gross_amount minus withholding_tax_amount minus discount_amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG.DMBTR); IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a payment block has been applied to this invoice, preventing it from being included in the next payment run. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSPR (Payment Block Key). Null when no block is active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG.ZLSPR); DOT Supplier Payment Compliance

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was executed to the vendor, either via bank transfer, cheque, or BSP/ARC settlement. Populated upon payment run completion. Corresponds to SAP clearing document value date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Run (F110); IATA BSP Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment is executed to the vendor. 'bank_transfer' = SWIFT/SEPA wire; 'cheque' = paper cheque; 'bsp_settlement' = IATA Billing and Settlement Plan net settlement; 'arc_settlement' = Airlines Reporting Corporation settlement; 'direct_debit' = automated debit. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSCH.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG.ZLSCH); IATA BSP Rules; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10N30) defining the agreed payment schedule, discount percentages, and due date calculation rules for this vendor. Corresponds to SAP field ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms (T052.ZTERM); IATA BSP Payment Terms

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor invoice is posted to the SAP general ledger, determining the accounting period for recognition. May differ from invoice date due to processing delays. Corresponds to SAP field BUDAT.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP FI accounting document number (BELNR) assigned upon posting of the vendor invoice in the general ledger. Uniquely identifies the FI document within a company code and fiscal year.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (VAT, GST, or applicable local tax) charged on the vendor invoice. Corresponds to SAP field WMWST. Used for input tax recovery and tax reporting to national revenue authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Tax (BSET.WMWST); IATA Tax and Fees Handbook; ICAO Doc 8632 Taxation

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax rate and tax type (input VAT, zero-rated, exempt) for this invoice line. Drives automated tax calculation and input tax recovery reporting. Corresponds to SAP field MWSKZ.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax (BSET.MWSKZ); IATA Tax and Fees Handbook; ICAO Doc 8632

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the automated three-way match validation comparing the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice for quantity and price alignment. 'matched' = all three documents agree; 'price_variance' = invoice price differs from PO; 'quantity_variance' = invoice quantity differs from GR; 'pending_gr' = goods receipt not yet confirmed; 'failed' = match failed requiring manual review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Invoice Verification (MIRO); IATA Ground Handling Agreement Audit Standards

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor type supplying goods or services to the airline. Drives cost allocation to CASK components and supports spend analytics by supplier category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mro_supplier|fuel_vendor|airport_authority|gds_provider|catering|ground_handling|bsp_arc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM); SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Classification

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax (WHT) to be deducted from the vendor payment and remitted to the tax authority on behalf of the vendor. Applicable for cross-border supplier payments subject to bilateral tax treaties. Corresponds to SAP Extended Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Extended Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM); OECD Model Tax Convention; ICAO Doc 8632

products.name: accounts_receivable
products.description: SAP FI-AR customer receivable and collection records for the airline covering travel agency BSP/ARC settlements, corporate account billings, interline receivables, cargo AWB collections, ancillary service charges, and incoming payment receipts. Tracks invoice issuance, payment receipt (method, bank, value date, clearing reference), dunning status, credit limits, ageing buckets, and reconciliation status. Supports revenue recognition, working capital management, and customer credit risk monitoring.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR (Accounts Receivable)

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts receivable record in the SAP FI-AR module. Primary key for the silver layer lakehouse table.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each AR document belongs to ONE company code. The accounts_receivable table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. This is a mandatory dimension in SA

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: AR invoices and collections generate GL postings in SAP FI-AR. Every accounts_receivable record corresponds to GL entries. This FK normalizes the AR sub-ledger to general ledger relationship, consiste

attributes.name: interline_billing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.interline_billing. Business justification: Interline billing settlements generate AR records when partner airlines owe the airline money. An AR record for interline revenue should reference the originating interline_billing record. This FK lin

attributes.name: ageing_bucket
attributes.description: Ageing classification of the open receivable based on days past due date: CURRENT (not yet due), 1_30_DAYS, 31_60_DAYS, 61_90_DAYS, 91_120_DAYS, OVER_120_DAYS. Drives credit risk assessment and bad debt provisioning under IFRS 9 expected credit loss model.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; DOT Financial Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: ar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable: OPEN (unpaid), PARTIALLY_PAID (partial payment received), CLEARED (fully paid and matched), DISPUTED (customer dispute raised), WRITTEN_OFF (bad debt write-off applied), IN_DUNNING (active dunning process initiated).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: bank_value_date
attributes.description: Value date on which funds were credited to the airline's bank account for this receivable. Distinct from posting date; used for treasury cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Treasury Module; IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: bsp_arc_billing_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) / Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) Billing Period
attributes.description: IATA BSP or ARC billing period identifier (e.g., 2024-W03 for weekly cycle) to which this agency receivable belongs. Supports settlement reconciliation and dispute management with travel agencies.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; ARC Industry Agents Handbook

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receivable was fully cleared (matched against incoming payment or credit memo) in SAP. Null for open items. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP document number of the payment or credit memo that cleared this receivable. Enables end-to-end payment reconciliation and audit trail from invoice to settlement.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center associated with the receivable for internal cost allocation and CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the AR record was first created in the source SAP FI-AR system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports data lineage in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP credit control area (KKBER) under which the customer's credit limit is managed. Groups customers for credit exposure monitoring across company codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management Module

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Approved credit limit assigned to the customer in the credit control area, expressed in the credit control area currency. Used for credit exposure monitoring and order block decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management Module; IFRS 9

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: SAP debtor account number (KUNNR) identifying the customer — travel agency, corporate account, interline carrier, or cargo shipper — against whom the receivable is raised.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; IATA BSP/ARC Settlement

attributes.name: customer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the debtor customer as maintained in SAP customer master. Covers travel agencies, corporate accounts, interline carriers, and cargo clients.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the receivable is past its due date as of the last refresh date. Negative values indicate days until due. Used for DSO reporting and credit risk monitoring.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the reason for a customer dispute on this receivable (e.g., pricing discrepancy, duplicate billing, service not rendered, ADM — Agency Debit Memo dispute). Null when no dispute exists. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PRICE_DISCREPANCY|DUPLICATE_BILLING|SERVICE_NOT_RENDERED|ADM_DISPUTE|CREDIT_NOT_APPLIED|INTERLINE_PRORATE_DIFF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 850 (ADM/ACM); SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management

attributes.name: document_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the AR document amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency airline operations and foreign exchange reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI-AR accounting document number uniquely identifying the receivable posting within the company code. Corresponds to BELNR field in SAP BSID/BSAD tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the AR posting: DR (customer invoice), DG (credit memo), DA (customer document), RV (billing document transfer), AB (accounting document). Drives posting logic and account determination.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is contractually due from the customer, calculated from invoice date plus payment terms (e.g., BSP weekly settlement cycle, net 30 corporate terms). Key input for ageing bucket classification and dunning.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level (1–4) assigned to this receivable in SAP dunning program, indicating the escalation stage of the collection notice. Level 0 means no dunning initiated.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (1–16 including special periods) within the fiscal year in which the AR document was posted. Supports month-end and period-end financial close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the AR document was posted, as defined in the SAP fiscal year variant. Used for period-end close and financial consolidation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: SAP general ledger account number to which the receivable is posted (e.g., trade receivables, interline receivables, cargo receivables). Drives financial statement classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of the receivable before any discounts, taxes, or adjustments, expressed in the document currency. Represents the face value of the invoice or billing document.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: interline_carrier_code
attributes.description: Two or three-character IATA airline designator code of the interline partner carrier for interline receivable types. Null for non-interline receivables. Supports interline prorate and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Interline Traffic Agreements; IATA Airline Designator Codes

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice or billing document was issued to the customer. Used for revenue recognition, ageing bucket calculation, and payment terms baseline.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning notice was issued to the customer for this receivable. Used to track collection activity and enforce dunning intervals.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the AR record in the source SAP FI-AR system, including payment postings, dunning updates, or status changes. Supports incremental data loading in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Open receivable amount translated to the company code local currency using the SAP exchange rate type at posting date. Required for statutory financial reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code local (functional) currency to which document amounts are translated for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount due from the customer after deducting applicable discounts and adjustments but before tax. Used for revenue recognition and working capital reporting.

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the receivable at the current point in time, calculated as gross amount minus payments received and credit memos applied. Core field for working capital management and ageing analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which payment was or is expected to be received: BANK_TRANSFER (wire/SWIFT), BSP_SETTLEMENT (IATA Billing and Settlement Plan automated settlement), ARC_SETTLEMENT (Airlines Reporting Corporation settlement), CREDIT_CARD, DIRECT_DEBIT, CHEQUE.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (ZTERM) defining the contractual payment conditions, discount periods, and due date calculation rules applicable to this receivable (e.g., BSP weekly, net 30, net 60).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; IATA BSP Settlement Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the AR document was posted to the general ledger in SAP. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the basis for period-end cut-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP profit center to which the receivable revenue is attributed, enabling segment-level P&L reporting by route, cabin class, or business unit within the airline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: receivable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable by originating business channel: BSP_AGENCY (IATA Billing and Settlement Plan agency), ARC_AGENCY (Airlines Reporting Corporation agency), CORPORATE (direct corporate account billing), INTERLINE (interline carrier settlement), CARGO_AWB (Air Waybill cargo collection), ANCILLARY (ancillary service charges such as excess baggage, upgrades).
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; IATA Interline Traffic Agreements

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the receivable reconciliation against the originating billing system (BSP, ARC, cargo system, or ancillary billing): MATCHED (confirmed and reconciled), UNMATCHED (discrepancy identified), DISPUTED (formal dispute raised), PENDING_REVIEW (awaiting finance review).
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: External reference number associated with the receivable, such as the BSP billing period reference, ARC settlement report number, Air Waybill (AWB) number for cargo, or PNR for passenger billings. Enables cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA BSP Settlement Standards; ARC Industry Agents Handbook; IATA AWB Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component of the receivable including applicable government taxes, Passenger Facility Charges (PFC), and other statutory levies included in the invoice. Supports tax reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 12; DOT Passenger Facility Charge Regulations; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as bad debt for this receivable, in document currency. Populated when ar_status is WRITTEN_OFF. Supports bad debt expense reporting and IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisioning.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module

products.name: budget_plan
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget plans for the airline covering operating expenditure (OPEX), capital expenditure (CAPEX), and revenue budgets by cost centre, profit centre, and GL account. Stores budget version, planning horizon, approval status, budget owner, and variance thresholds. Supports rolling forecast cycles and board-level financial planning aligned with SAP CO-PA and BPC modules.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO / BPC Budget Planning

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the budget plan record in the finance data product. Primary key for the budget_plan entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each budget plan belongs to ONE company code. The budget_plan table has company_code (STRING) which should be replaced with a FK to the company_code master. Budget plans are company-code specific in S

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account code in SAP FI against which this budget plan is posted. Enables GL-level budget vs. actuals reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (General Ledger); IATA Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: primary_budget_cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost centre to which this budget plan is assigned. Enables cost centre-level budget tracking and variance analysis across airline operational divisions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget plan received final approval from the designated authority (CFO, board, or budget committee). Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC Workflow; SOX Compliance; Internal Governance Policy

attributes.name: ask_budget
attributes.description: Budgeted Available Seat Kilometers (ASK) for the planning period, representing planned capacity output. ASK is the industry-standard capacity metric (seats × kilometers flown). Used as the denominator for CASK and RASK budget calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; DOT Form 41; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level financial category of the budget plan. OPEX = Operating Expenditure; CAPEX = Capital Expenditure; REVENUE = Revenue budget; MIXED = combined OPEX and CAPEX plan. Aligns with SAP CO-PA cost element categories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; IFRS

attributes.name: capex_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated to capital expenditure (CAPEX) within this plan, including aircraft acquisitions, fleet modifications, and infrastructure investments. Supports IFRS 16 lease liability planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Asset Accounting); IFRS 16; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: cask_budget
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK) Budget
attributes.description: Budgeted Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK), calculated as total OPEX budget divided by ASK budget. Expressed in currency units per ASK. Primary airline unit cost efficiency metric used in board-level financial planning and investor reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; DOT Form 41; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: consolidation_level
attributes.description: The organisational level at which this budget plan is consolidated. 'entity' = legal entity; 'division' = business division (e.g., cargo, MRO); 'group' = airline group; 'segment' = IFRS 8 reportable segment. Supports financial consolidation and group reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Consolidation; IFRS 8 (Operating Segments); IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The SAP CO controlling area code under which this budget plan is managed. The controlling area defines the organisational unit for internal cost accounting and profitability analysis in SAP CO-PA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling Area); Internal Management Accounting Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC; SOX Compliance; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the budget amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency airline operations and IATA BSP settlement reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA BSP; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The start date from which this budget plan is effective and binding for financial control purposes. Aligns with the fiscal period start in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The end date through which this budget plan remains effective. Null for open-ended multi-year plans. Aligns with fiscal period end in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget plan primarily applies (e.g., 2025). Used for period-based financial reporting and alignment with SAP FI fiscal year variants.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: forecast_cycle
attributes.description: The frequency at which this rolling forecast budget plan is updated and resubmitted. Applicable only when is_rolling_forecast is True. Supports planning cadence governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC; Internal Financial Planning Policy

attributes.name: fuel_cost_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount specifically allocated to jet fuel procurement and uplift costs. Fuel is typically the largest single OPEX line for airlines. Supports fuel cost accounting and hedging strategy alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/MM; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; DOT Form 41 Schedule P-12

attributes.name: interline_settlement_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted net interline billing settlement amount payable or receivable through IATA BSP/ARC for interline ticketing agreements with partner carriers. Supports interline prorate and billing reconciliation planning.
attributes.references: IATA BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan); IATA ARC; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_rolling_forecast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget plan is part of a rolling forecast cycle (True) or a fixed annual budget (False). Rolling forecasts are updated periodically (monthly/quarterly) to reflect current business conditions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: lease_liability_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount for aircraft and facility lease liabilities recognised under IFRS 16. Covers both operating lease right-of-use asset depreciation and interest on lease liabilities for dry lease and ACMI arrangements.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 (Leases); SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: load_factor_budget_pct
attributes.description: Budgeted passenger load factor expressed as a percentage (e.g., 82.50 = 82.5%). Load factor is the percentage of available seats filled by revenue passengers. Used in revenue budget planning and yield management alignment.
attributes.references: IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; Sabre AirVision Revenue Management; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: locked_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget plan was locked to prevent further modifications, marking the start of the execution period. Locked budgets serve as the baseline for variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC; Internal Financial Control Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for budget planners and approvers to record assumptions, justifications, revision rationale, or board commentary associated with this budget plan version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC; Internal Financial Planning Policy

attributes.name: opex_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated to operating expenditure (OPEX) within this plan, including fuel, crew, maintenance, airport charges, and overhead. Key input for CASK (Cost per Available Seat Kilometer) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; IATA Financial Reporting Guidelines; DOT Form 41

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the budget plan (e.g., 'FY2025 Annual Operating Budget', 'Q3 2025 Rolling Forecast'). Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the budget plan, aligned with SAP BPC plan version numbering (e.g., BP-2025-001). Used for cross-system reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget plan within the approval workflow. 'draft' = in preparation; 'submitted' = awaiting review; 'under_review' = being evaluated; 'approved' = board/CFO approved; 'rejected' = returned for revision; 'locked' = frozen for execution; 'archived' = superseded. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|locked|archived — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BPC Workflow; DOT Financial Reporting

attributes.name: plan_type
